tei:div.tei:p: ritsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/me lce/kanalu mi ri0khapeskrulong
bla dpe tshigs /
hūṃhūm̐ ṭhasbyiltosdi//t+t+waṃltosnyesgre+oX/ wa // (shaṃsdi~Xbyehūṃ ṭ+wāṃdīskreX ༷r+sāX

da ra chadakar chagagazur med kyi 'gan 'khri/ da washes yon can gyi 'dam ga gleng ba/ (1)sgyu rtsal gyi dgra bo/da wasgyu rtsal gyi ched du sgyu rtsal byed do zer ba'i lta tshul las 'phros pa/ (12)drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa/da wa〈bgro gleng〉le tshan du kha brda byas pa'i sgra phab bshus pa/ (17)dang rten dang skur 'debs/ da wadra ngos kyi dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gyi skor gleng ba/(34)dge 'dun chos 'phel dang〈gsar 'gyur me long〉 (57)baiḍūr+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/da wadage 'dun chos 'phel mchog 'jig rten mi yul dang zhal gyes rjes phyi rabs pa rnams kyis rim bzhin khong gi mdzad dgongs rgyus lon byung ba'i zin tho/ (65)2006lo'i dpe klog dang bris rtsom skor gyi zin bris thor bu/ (84)dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang gi mno bsam/— 1 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/da wa2006lo'i spyi tshogs dang rig gnas snang tshul skor gyi dpyad brjod/(92)bsam blo'i 'grul bzhud ring mo/da wang rang ches klog par spro ba'i dpe deb dag las khag dang po/ (118)khro gnyer dang 'dzum mdangs/da walu'u zhun dang hu'u hri snying stobs las 'phros pa'i gtam/ (126)na mnyam grogs po zhig la bskur pa'i 'phrin yig (144 )rtogs sad dgag sgrub rgyu 'bras blo migad wanub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’steng nas gtam bshad pa'i sgra phab bshus pa/ (151)shes rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi grwa btsun/da wanub byang mi rigs slob chen nas gtam bshad pa'i sgra phab bshus pa/(187)dpa' dar ring mo/da wadapal don grub rgyal sku gshegs nas lo 'khor20lon pa'i dus dran du/(221)mjug byang / (304)— 2 —

zur med kyi 'a na 'a /gzur med kyi 'gan 'khri/da washes yon can gyi 'dam ga gleng ba/gcigadus rabs nyer gcig par bslebs pa na 'u cag la rang dbang shes yon can skor zhig byung ste/ bod rang gi lo rgyus dang chos lugs/spyi tshogs/ bsam blo/ slob gso/ rtsom rig sogs kyi thad la rang rkya 'pher ba'i lta tshul sna tshogs brjod pa dang de 'brel gyi rigs gzhung bgro gleng gi khor yug cig(ltosabacas kyis)kyang ngang gis chags pa red/lta tshul gsar pa de dag gis bod kyi spyi tshogs bcos sgyur dang bsam blo bcings 'grol/ mi tshul bsam blo/ smra brjod rang dbang / rnam mang rig gnas bcas kyi cha nas 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin gyi lta tshul gang mang brjod yod pa ni bsnyon du med pa yin/ 'di ni mi rigs shig la mtshon na dpal yon dar zhing spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i snga ltas yin pa dang / sa zhing la cha bzhag na char chu lta bu dang lo tog la cha bzhag na sa bon lta bu yin pa red/shes yon can gyis deng gi spyi tshogs kyi khrod du go gnas gal chen zin pa dang / khong tsho spyi tshogs la hur brtson gyis 'jug cing dgag — 1 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/sgrub kyi spobs pas phyug pa dang / drang bden gyi phyogs nas langs pa/spyi gzhung la do khur byed pa/ sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi ldan pa/ bsam blo rang dbang yin pa/ rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal bar ma zad/ da dung dngos yod dang 'thab rtsod kyis nam yang smag rum spyi tshogs kyi kha gtad du 'greng ste mun sel gyi 'od snang 'tshol bar byed/ 'di ni da gzod shes yon can gyi stobs shugs red la/ shes yon can rnams‘‘'phag 'tshag’’byed pa'i mthar thug gi rin thang yang red/ 'di lta bu'i shes yon can yod pas spyi tshogs de mang gtso dang rang dbang / 'dra mnyam/zhi bde ngang 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba dang / 'di lta bu'i shes yon can yod pas mi ba'i rin thang dang mi ba'i thob thang mi ba'i rtsis thang raring raring riring bcas ni mi yul gyi gtsug rgyan du 'gyur nges red/gnyis/nga tshos 'das zin pa'i dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang gi sngon byon gyi shes yon can rnams(don dngos su dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang du deng rabs kyi shes yon can gyi mtshan nyid tshang ba ni dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gnyis ma gtogs byung med) brgyud yong ba'i lam bu dag la phyi mig cig bltas na/ khong tsho'i lam bu ni kyag kyog ldan la tsher mas khengs pa'i ladzi rdi zhig ste/ skabs de'i kha rub kyi spyi tshogs dang‘‘shes rmongs kyi

zur med kyi 'ag 'a /grog rong’’ de rmongs 'thom gyi dad pa dang / mi kha/ zur za/sdigs dmod/ phrag dog gnod sems/ 'bur 'joms sogs kyi rdo 'jong gis lam bu'i srid zheng kun tu yongs su khebs 'dug pa red/ de lta na'ang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs rdog phres su khur te khrag dmar 'dzar 'dzar gyi ngang mdun nas mdun phyogs su bskyod/ dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gis rang mi rigs la zhen pa dkar po'i ngang nas mi tshul shes yon can(rkispraṣ+ṭhasnyeya1cha)gyi lam bu gsar du btod pa dang / don grub rgyal lags kyis‘‘rang gi mgo bo mthon po de gzhan gyi rkang 'og tu mi 'jog’’pa'i dam bca' brtan po'i ngang nas rang dbang shes yon can(khri skrek+ṇikhri'〉cha)gyi lam bu gsar du btod byung ba red/khong rnam pa gnyis kyis rang gi gces pa'i tshe srog 'ben du bzhag ste bgrod dka' ba'i lam bu gnyis bdams pa dang / rang nyid kyi mi tshe de'ang rang gis bdams pa'i lam bu'i steng du mjug rdzogs pa red/'di ni shes yon can zhig gi mi tshe'i 'dam ga'am dam bca' yin pa dang / yang na 'gan 'khri'i khur po phrag tu blangs pa'i mi gzhi'i snying stobs shig kyang yin pa red/‘‘dge chos snying stobs’’dang‘‘rang grol snying stobs’’gnyis ni da lta'i char 'u cag gis nges par du rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gtong dgos shing / srol rgyun 'di ni 'u cag gi shes yon can gyi sde la mtshon spya kain

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/tu nas gal che ba yin/ lhag par du mi spyang po dang sgam po rnams brin pa'i dus 'dir snying stobs 'di la ji 'dra'i rin thang ldan ang / lo 'di 'ga'i ring la gsar skyes na gzhon kha shas kyis dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog dang don grub rgyal rnam pa gnyis kyi snying stobs dang bsam blo/ mi gzhi bcas la zhib 'jug dang de dag 'don spel byed pa ni/dus rabs 'di'i nang du de lta bu'i snying stobs dang mi gzhi ni ri bong gi rwa dang nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du dkon pas yin zhing / yang gcig bshad na bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang mi tshul bsam blo'i ma lag 'dzugs skrun byed par 'di lta'i shes yon can ha cang mkho bas red/dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu pa dang stong lo gnyis pa'i 'go 'di la bod du rig gnas kyi las gnyer mkhan mang du byung zhing /mi de rnams la de 'brel gyi cho lo'ang sna tshogs bstsal yod pa ni ched mkhas pa dang / zhib 'jug pa/ slob gso pa/ lo tsā pa/ skad sbyor pa/ sgyu rtsal pa/ brtsams sgrung pa/ snyan ngag pa/ dpyad brjod pa sogs lta bu red/ yin na'ang gong du bstan pa'i bye brag pa re re shes yon can du brtsi rgyu ni dka' tsam gda' ste/ rgyu mtshan ci yis she na/ shes yon can zhig yin na sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi ldan pa dang rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal ba sogs gong du brjod zin pas 'dir rgyas spros kyi ngal ba ma byas so/ /— 4 —

zur med kyi 'a na 'khri/gsum/dus kyi 'gyur ldog dang mi rang gi gnas bab/ 'tsho ba'i phugs bsam/ bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ dga' kha 'khyer phyogs sogs kyi dbang gis 'u cag gi rig gnas pa dag gis rang la 'tsham pa'i lam bu re'ang bdams yod pa red/ dper na/ dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las lags dang chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs sogs kyis lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi lam bu bdams pa dang / mkhyen rab 'od gsal sogs kyis brda sprod zhib 'jug gi lam bu bdams pa/ dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo sogs kyis nang bstan lo tsā byed pa'i lam bu bdams pa/ 'ju skal bzang dang ljang bu/ mkhas grub sogs kyis snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi lam bu bdams pa/ tshe ring don grub dang stag 'bum rgyal/ bkra shis dpal ldan sogs kyis brtsams sgrung 'bri ba'i lam bu bdams pa/zhogs dung dang nyi gzhon/ byang skar/ me lce sogs kyis rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi lam bu bdams pa/ bdud lha rgyal sogs kyis rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi lam bu bdams pa/ 'brong bu tshe ring rdo rje sogs kyis nub phyogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i(khos sher rtogs rig pa zhes 'bod kyin 'dug)zhib 'jug gi lam bu bdams pa/ gcod pa don grub sogs kyis ge sar zhib 'jug gi lam bu bdams pa sogs lta bu red/ gzhan — 5 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/yang la la zhig ni rig tshan gang la'ang‘‘zhib 'jug’’byed cing rtsom lus gang la'ang 'jug pas ched du rigs 'di'o zhes rjod thabs bral/ (don gyis mi 'di'i rigs la don snying dang ldan pa'i 'bras bu zhig ye nas ston rgyu med)kho tshos bdams pa'i lam bu de la'ang spyi sger gnyis thad nas mu bzhi brtsi chog ste/ sger la phan zhing spyi la gnod pa'i lam bu dang /spyi la phan zhing sger la gnod pa'i lam bu/ spyi sger gnyis kar phan pa'i lam bu/ spyi sger gnyis kar gnod pa'i lam bu'o/ /'dir brjod pa'i spyi zhes pa ni mi rigs sam spyi gzhung zhig la go ba dang / sger zhes pa ni mi rang nyid dam rang kho na la go dgos/ des na la las mi sger gyi khe phan dang rnyed grags sogs kyi don du sger la phan zhing spyi la gnod pa'i lam bu bdams pa yin la/ (‘‘rang la blta ba'i me long’’du bltas pa bzhin rang nyid ngo 'phrod par gyis dang / rang gis rang ngo ma zin na nyin zhig gzhan gyis ming nas bzung tshe ji 'dra'i ngo tsha ba kha5 6/nga) la las mi rigs kyi mdun lam dang spyi gzhung la do khur byed pa'i ched du spyi la phan zhing sger la gnod pa'i lam bu bdams pa yin te/ dper na/ mi tshul shes yon can dang rang dbang shes yon can rnams lta bu'o/ /(mi tshul shes yon can dang rang dbang shes yon can gnyis kyi srol rgyun 'u cag la yod na'ang / yid pham pa zhig la da lta srol rgyun 'di'i rgyun chad de mthud thub kyin mi 'dug) spyi sger gnyis kar phan pa'i lam ba 'dem mkhan ni/ dper na zhogs da 6 da ra

zur med kyi 'gan 'khri/dung sogs lta bu yin zhing kho tshos rang mi rigs kyi gnas bab la rkang btsugs te dpyod shes ldan pa'i ngang nas lo rgyas la phyir rtog dang /༄rig gnas la dgag sgrub/ spyi tshogs la hur brtson gyis 'jug pa'i dus mtshungs su/ mi rang nyid la'ang rnam shes tsha 'dri dang skyon mtshang gshag bcos/ bag chags dong sprug sogs mi rang nyid nas ci ltar 'go rtsom dgos pa'i blang bya yang yang 'don gyi yo/da pa red/ yang spyi sger gnyis kar gnod pa'i lam bu 'dem mkhan yang yod de/ dper na/ mi rigs dang rig gnas kyi bla rdung zhing srog 'tshong ba'i mi rnams lta bu'o/ /bzhi/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i dkyil nas bzung bod kyi rig gnas gar stegs steng du 'ju skal bzang lags dang ljang bu lags/ dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo lags bcas la gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po byed kyin yod pa red/ khong tsho'i gsar rtsom gyi grub 'bras dang rig gnas kyi don snying ni gal chen yin pa ni smos ma dgos/nga rang nyid kyang khong tsho'i brtsams chos la blta rgyur ha cang dga' po yod/ yin na'ang khong tsho ni spyi la phan zhing sger la gnod pa'i lam bu ru zhugs med la/ spyi sger gnyis kar phan pa'i lam bu ru de— baḍi ljing

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/zhugs med pa red/ khong tsho'i shes rab kyi spyan zung gis spyi tshogs kyi mun nag gi gru zur re re mthong na'ang de la do khur dang hur brtson gyis mi 'jug par g.yol cing gzur bar byed/ khong tsho dngos yod kyi gnad don gang mang zhig la 'phrad cing phrag tu len dgos na'ang mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ khong tsho'i brtsams chos ni sher rab kyi dpal gyis bskrun cing phul du byung na'ang mi ser gyi bde sdug ni thed la bor/de bas khong tsho ni nam yang‘‘lag pa phu rung du btang ste zur nas lta mkhan’’yin pa las/ snying stobs chen pos spyi tshogs la dngos su 'jug mkhan ni ma yin no/ /spyi la phan zhing sger la gnod pa'i lam bu ru mi 'jug pa dang /yang na spyi sger gnyis kar phan pa'i lam bu gang rung du mi 'jug pa ni dus rabs 'di'i nad rtags gtso bo red la/ shes yon can rnams kyis rang gi mi rigs dang lo rgyus/ spyi tshogs bcas la 'gan ma khur ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig kyang red/ bya spyod 'di dag gi shugs nas ci zhig mthong thub ce na/ kho tshos‘‘spyi tshogs rgyu 'bras’’kyi 'gan mi khur la/kha nas bshad pa dang lag nas sgrub pa gnyis gzhi gcig la'ang mi 'bab/gtso bo rang bde na‘‘skal med sar ske mi sring’’zhes pa'i 'dod tshul de red/ spyi tshogs la 'gan mi khur zhing rgyu 'bras blo mig ldongs pa'i mkhas pa dang rtsom mkhan sogs ni 'u cag la ji ltar mang yang de ni snying ge 8 —

gzur med kyi 'gan 'khri/rje ba'i mi rigs 'dir mtshon na‘‘lhag ma’’zhig ci la min/da lta rang re'i shes yon can gyi sde la mtshon na/ ljid tig tig gi 'gan 'khri de phrag tu len rgyu yin nam len rgyu min pa dang / lo rgyus la 'gan khur ba'i skad cha 'chad rgyu yin nam 'chad rgyu min pa/ bsam blo'i rno dbal tsha ba'i rtsom yig 'bri rgyu yin nam 'bri rgyu min pa/ spyi la phan zhing sger la gnod pa'i lam bu'am spyi sger gnyis kar phan pa'i lam bu 'dem rgyu yin nam 'dem rgyu min pa sogs kyi 'dam ga chen po zhig la thug 'dug 'dam ga de byed par snying stobs shig dang spobs pa zhigargyu 'bras shig dgos pas na skabs 'dir khyed la mtshon na ci zhig 'dam ga byed dam/ yang na khyed rang shes yon can gyi lam bu gang gi steng du gom pa spo'am/lnga/'u cag gi rigs gzhung bgro gleng dang bsam blo'i khor yug ni da dung de 'dra'i gtsang yangs shig min pas/ dgag sgrub dang skyon brjod kyi bgyi ba don du gnyer rgyu ni sla mo zhig gtan nas ma yin/dgag sgrub dang skyon brjod kyi rtsom yig bris pa yin na gzhan la dus rgyun phog thug gtong srid pa dang / lhag par du mi'i ming nas bzung tshe pha rol po la zhe sdang dang khong khro yang slong bar byed cing stabs ma — 9 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/legs na‘‘dgra’’ru yang 'dzin las che/ de lta na'ang bdag gis ming nas 'dzin pa'i 'bri stangs de bdams pa ni/ dgag sgrub byed yul gang zhig yin yang‘‘mdung rtse’’ni lta tshul dang don dag la gtad yod pa las mi sger la gtad pa zhig gtan nas min/ de bas nga'i grogs po gang mang zhig gis rtsom yig tu pha rol po'i ming nas ma bzung na legs tshul brjod mod/ 'on kyang bdag gis de'i lan du kho bo la‘‘spyi dgra’’ma gtogs‘‘sger dgra’’med pas nga la nongs 'gyod ci yang med ces brjod pa yin/ yang gcig brjod na ming nas ma bzung bar dgag sgrub dang skyon brjod byed pa ni 'gan ma khur ba'i rigs gzhung gnyer stangs shig red la/ rnam 'gyur mi drang ba'i byed stangs shig kyang red/ gal te skyon brjod yod tshad mi che ge mo dang don dag ga ge mo zhes spyi bam tsam zhig brjod pa yin na/ ‘‘sa stong la bo'u stong’’dang gzugs brnyan gyi 'ben la rgyag pa las ma 'das pas/ de las ci yang ma bris par kha khu sim por bsdad na legs pa red/ don dngos su 'u cag su zhig yin yang dbang grags mi sna la dgag sgrub dang / ‘‘tshad ma'i gsung’’la dogs slong byed chog chog yin zhing / mi bu'i thob thang dang mi bu'i rtsis thang de'ang brtson len byed chog chog cig yin pa red/slad mar dkyel yangs dang rang dbang / 'dra mnyam dang sger — 10 —
tshugs bcas kyi rigs gzhung bgro gleng gi kho/ ra yug gtsang yangs shig chags pa'i re smon dang bcas rtsom yig 'di'i mjug bsdus pa'o/ /2005lo'i zla4pa'i tshes21—22nyin zi ling du/

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/sgyu rtsal gyi dgra bo/da wasgyu rtsal gyi ched du sgyu rtsal byed do zer ba'i lta tshul las 'phros pa/sems la 'gan 'khri meng/ pa na/ sgru rtsal zhes pa sbrum du med/da wang kha'e ling /du1deng sang 'u cag gi rtsom pa po mi nyung ba zhig gis zer don/ lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi ring la bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gis grub 'bras chen po blangs shing / 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi rjes kyang chod bzhin 'dug ces rang snang skyid pa'i 'ur sgrog gin yod pa red/ des mi tshad brtsams chos skor zhig rgya yig gam tha na phyi gling gi yi ge ste dbyin ji'i yi ge dang / h+pha ran si'i yi ge 'jar man gyi yi ge sogs su'ang bsgyur 'dug ces ngom so yang yang byed kyin mchis mod/ ngas bltas na/〈 sbrang char〉sogs kyi dus deb re 'ga'i steng spel pa'i brtsams chos re gnyis dang / sgrung ring sgrung 'bring kha shas yod pas 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi rjes chod pa yin na de ni 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi chu tshad la dma' ⑦cho wajukha'eṭ+wāṃng/r+ghaṃ1〉྅ 1kau9—)sgying go'ir+sha sh+lautram̐n rtsom mkhan daju / rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan/brtsams ṭ+wāṃ~X mas rang nga〉dang〈rtul da can bsam sa su 'brangs pa〉 gas 'dug

rtsal gyi dgra bo/phab pa kho nar zad/ drang mor bshad na/ 'u cag‘‘rang yul rang la rgyus yod’’(dge chos kyi tshig)pas de 'dra'i rdzun lab dgos don mi 'dug ang /da lta'i 'u cag gi rtsom rig gi gnas bab 'di la gzhigs tshe/ 'u cag la 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi chu tshad dang mnyam pa'i brtsams chos shig 'byung rgyu ni nyin mo'i skar ma lta bu dang mo gsham gyi bu'i dpe red/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'u cag gi rtsom pa po rnams la 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes dang gdung sems chen po/ rgyu 'bras blo mig sogs rtsom mkhan zhig la nges par du tshang dgos pa'i cha rkyen dag ye nas med pas so/ /2'u cag gi mi phal mo che yis bod pa tsho ni‘‘gom pa spo shes na bro gar 'khrab shes la/ skad cha bshad shes na glu dbyangs len shes’’zer/ da lta gong gi‘‘yon tan’’'di gnyis kyi steng la da dung shes pa gcig kha snon byed chog ste/ de ni‘‘ka kha 'don shes na snyan ngag 'bri shes’’zhes pa de red/ deng gi char slob 'bring slob mas snyan ngag 'bri la/ slob chen pa yis kyang snyan ngag 'bri/ rab byung pa yis snyan ngag 'bri la/mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang snyan ngag 'bri/ snyan ngag la 'jug mkhan ha cang mang zhing snyan ngag gi‘‘bstan pa’’shin tu dar ba 'dis ci zhig — 13 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/gsal bshad byas yod dam/'u cag gi rtsom rig la 'jug mkhan gang mang zhig gis‘‘sgyu rtsal gyi ched du sgyu col byed do’’zer zhing / ‘‘྾྾ring lugs’’dang‘‘྾ ྾grub mtha'’’sogs kyi dar cha dgung la phyar te mi tshe'i 'dun ma rtsom rig la bcol ba dang / rtsom rig ni‘‘nor bu dgos 'dod dpung 'joms’’shig tu mthong nas de las zas dgos na zas dang gos dgos na gos ster ba lta bur ngos 'dzin gyin 'dug rtsom rig gi mdzes sdug la rab tu dungs shing / sgyu rtsal gyi bsru brid la shin tu zhen chags che ba 'dis ci zhig gsal bshad byas yod dam/snyan ngag 'bri mkhan kun gyi sems khong du dga' skyo chags sdang gi tshor pa skyen po zhig yod las che na'ang / 'u cag gi rjes lus kyi spyi tshogs dang nyam thag pa'i mi ser/ dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba sogs mthong tshe/ da dung snyan ngag than thun re bris te sdod pa ni ngo tsha zhig ma yin zugaca//rtsom rig la 'jug mkhan kun gyis sgyu rtsal gyi ched du sgyu rtsal byed do zhes mdzes sdug gi bslu brid cig la kha g.yar chog na'ang / mi rigs 'di'i dka' sdug dang / bkres skom/ nad yams/ blun rmongs sogs la kha ya mi byed pa'am gdung sems ma skyes na/ de ni dngos yod la g.yol ba dang 'gan 'khri la gzur ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig — 14 —

lha rtsal gyi dgra bo/yin pas don gyis kho tsho ni sgyu rtsal gyi3 dgra bo red/mdzes gtso ring lugs(khustsucha5)kyi seng ras kyis dpyod shes kyi mig zung sgrib par byed cing / sgyu rtsal rnal ma'i rdzun gtam gyis dngos yod kyi bden don sbas par byed pa red/ u ru su'i rtsom mkhan chen mo thol si to'emelags kyis/ mdzes gtso ring lugs dang sgyu col gyi ched du sgyu rtsal byed pa yod tshad ni bde thang ma yin la nyen kha'ang che/de ni don snying gis stongs pa'i yi ge'i ro‘ shaṃ rtsed kho na tsam mo e/sa gsungs/ 'u cag ni tag tag thol si to'e yis gsungs pa'i nyen kha 'di la thug 'dug pa red/ gal te nyen kha 'di las grol ba dang yang na sgyu rtsal gyi bslu brid de las thar dgos na/ nges par du bod kyi dngos yod spyi chogs la gdong gtod dgos shing / lo rgyus dang rig gnas/ dus rabs dang dngos yod bcas kyis bstsal pa'i 'gan 'khri rlabs po che de phrag tu len dgos pa yin no/ /rgya'i na gzhon rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan ho zhung h+phe②lags na re/ (rtsom rig gi)thabs rtsal ni ji ltar khyad du 'phags na/ rdzun 'khrug hāng sh+lau zlodesiklor+shas/ ram̐sdig10/chordu05:skyongolo.oṃ 1828—1910)u ru su'i rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chos dmag hozhungah+phe/snro'i.oṃ༄ 19shārnyi )ñtshang sh+lau'i rmi gār+shan mkhas zlo dang / rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan/ dpe skun mkhan/ brtsams sago/ hu dā pa' ma nga ba ga khu( sa rab gas 'dugasdi 15 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/gtam de ltar du gab sbas byed pa dang / 'tsho ba dngos dang de ltar du thag ring bar ma zad/ rtsom rig gi snying stobs dang yang de ltar du rgyang ring ba red ces bstan/ gong gi thol si to'e lags dang ho zhung h+phe lags kyi skad cha 'di dag la bsam gzhig gnad du smin pa zhig gtong thub tshe/ klog pa po rnams kyis kho bo'i rtsom thung 'di'i kha byang la sgyu rtsal gyi dgra bo zhes 'dogs pa'i dgos pa dang dmigs yul yang zhor la rtogs 'ong gi red/2005lo'i zla4pa'i tshes27nyin zi ling du/

drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa/drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa/da wa〈bgro gleng〉le tshan du kha brda byas pa'i sgra phab bshus pa/dus chod/ 2005lo'i zla9pa'i ches28nyin/sa gnas/ mcho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs/mi sna/ me lce/mgo 'dzin pa/ pad ma rig 'jin/mgo 'dzin pa/ nyan mkhan lhan rgyas rnam pa/ khyed rnam pa bde mo yin nam/ da lta khyed tshos nyan bzhin pa ni mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi〈bgro gleng〉le tshan yin/ nga ni le tshan 'di'i mgo 'dzin pa pad ma rig 'dzin yin/ thengs 'di'i〈bgro gleng〉le tshan gyi nang du gdan 'dren zhus pa'i sku mgron ni〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉khang gi sku zhabs gcod pa klu rgyal lags yin/ kho'i smyug ming la me lce zer/ yad sku zhabs me lce lags/ khyed bde mo kyipen namyo//me lce/ nga bde mo yin/ mgo 'dzin pa khyed rang bde mo yin nam/mgo 'dzin pa/ bde mo yin/ de ring nged gnyis kyi gleng bya gtso bo ni na ning do tshigs la bod kyi dpyad brjod 'bri mkhan la la zhig gis — 17 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rtsom pa po che ge mos bris pa'i brtsams chos la dpyad brjod spel ba'i skabs su/ brtsams chos la dpyad pa mi gtong bar rtsom pa po la mi gzhi dma' 'beb byed pa dang / yang na zur za byed pa/ yang na khyad gsod gtong ba sogs kyi snang tshul byung dang 'byung gi 'dug khyed rang nyid gzhon skyes dpyad brjod pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas 'dir khyed la 'dri 'dod pa ni/ khyed kyis bltas na rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa zhig la 'dzoms dgos pa'i cha rkyen ni ci zhig red/ me lce/ dpyad brjod pa zhig la mtshon na/ thog mar rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal po zhig yod dgos pa dang / dus mtshungs su dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs ldan pa dang drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa mnga' ba/bsam blo rang dbang yin pa/ sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi ldan pa zhig ci nas kyang yin dgos gi gong gi cha rkyen 'di dag 'dzoms tshe da gzod phul byung gi dpyad brjod pa zhig tu brtsi chog chog red snyam gimago 'dzin pa/ khyed kyis2004lo'i〈shar dung ri〉dus deb steng na〈bden pa'i rang sgra〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig cig bris 'dug rtsom yig de ru khyed kyis deng gi mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang / mi gzhi khyad gsod byed pa'i rig gnas snang tshul de la dgag sgrub byas yod gi khyed kyis blta sa na mi gzhi dma' 'beb sogs byed pa'i rig gnas snang tshul 'di la phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen gang zhig 'dug gam/— 18 —

drang tam brjod pa'i spobs pa/me lce/ 'u cag gi mkhas pa rnams la phan tshun bar mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang khyad gsod byed pa'i srol rgyun yod gi snyam/ kho bos bris pa'i〈bden pa'i rang sgra〉ru brjod yod pa ltar/ nye rabs kyi mkhas dbang rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho lags dang yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan lags gnyis kyis rigs gzhung brtsad pa'i mtha' mar rigs rus yag btsog bshad cing mi gzhi dma' 'beb byas pa dang /nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mo dor zhi lags kyis rig pa'i dpa' bo dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog la mi gzhi dma' 'beb byas pa/ de nas ldong yon tan rgya mtsho lags kyis deng sang gi na gzhon bsam blo pa dang rtogs sad pa skor zhig la mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang khyad gsod byas pa'i dpe 'di lta bu yod gi de'i rkyen gyis phan tshun bar mi gzhi dma' 'beb byed pa'i srol rgyun 'di shin tu mi bzang ba red/ ngas bltas na da lta 'u cag gis srol rgyun 'di'i rigs kyi rgyun bcad na legs par snyam/ mi gzhi dma' 'beb byed mkhan gyi mi der mtshon na'ang / pha rol po la mi gzhi dma' 'beb byed pa dang /yang na mi gzhi khyad gsod gtong ba/ yang na 'phya smod mtshang 'bru zhig byas pa yin na kho tsho la yid tshim zhing snying bde ba'i tshor pa zhig sbyin gyi yod pa 'dra/ ngas bltas na de ni sems khams kyi nad cig red/yang gcig bshad na/ smyos ma yin gyi nad cig red snyam gi— 19 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/mgo 'dzin pa/ red/ red/ deng sang bod kyi rtsom stegs steng na gong gi gnas tshul 'di lta bu mang po 'byung bzhin mchis/ dper na/rtsom pa po che ge mos bris pa'i brtsams chos ji 'dra bzang na'ang /rtsom pa po blor ma babs tshe brtsams chos de'ang legs por mi brtsi bar ma zad/ da dung brtsams chos logs su bskyur te mi de la dgag pa rgyag pa dang / yang na mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang khyad gsod sogs byed kyin 'dug spyir yin na brtsams chos de la dpyad pa gtong ba las rtsom pa po la mi gzhi dma' 'beb byed pa ni mi 'grig gi snyam/ khyed kyis bltas na ci 'dra red/me lce/ de 'dra rang red/ rigs gzhung bsam blo'i skor bgro gleng byed pa'am rtsod gleng byed pa dang / yang na rtsom rig brtsams chos shig la dpyad pa gtong ba'i skabs su/ mi phan tshun bar brtsi bkur dang dkyel yangs byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ de las 'phros te mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang mi gzhi khyad gsod byas na ga la 'grig de tsam gyis gnad don yang thag gcod byed mi thub gi der brten/ 'u cag gis bya ba ci zhig sgrub na nam yang rtsa ba bor nas yal gar 'jus 'dug pa'i tshor pa zhig ster gi da khyod kyis nga la mi gzhi dma' 'beb byas/ngas kho la mi gzhi khyad gsod btang / khos kyang mi gzhan zhig la mi gzhi dma' 'beb byed pa 'di ni rig gnas kyi btsog pa 'khor rgyug red/— 20 —

drang tam brjod pa'i spobs pa/btsog pa 'khor rgyug 'di gtsang sel ma byas na 'u cag gi rig gnas bgro gleng gi khor yug de nam yang gtsang yangs shig mi chags par ma zad/ lam gsar pa zhig nam yang rnyed thub rgyu ma red 'dod gi de bas 'u cag la rang dbang dang dkyel yangs/ 'dra mnyam/ sger tshugs dang ldan pa'i rigs gzhung bgro gleng gi khor yu/ga gtsang yangs shig nam yang chags thabs bral ba red/deng sang bod kyi mi chos rig gnas zer na'ang 'dra/ rig gnas gsar pa zer na'ang 'dra/ de'i ma lag gsar pa zhig 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i go rim khrod du/ gong du gleng zin pa'i phan tshun bar mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang zur za/ khyad gsod bcas byed pa'i srol rgyun nam bag chags rnying pa'i rgyun 'di gcod pa'am yang na rigs 'di'i mjug rdzogs na legs po 'dug snyam/mgo 'dzin pa/ ‘6mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dang me tog mnyam ba'ad’’kyi sgo nas rigs gzhung bgro gleng byed rgyu ni ha cang gal chen 'ig red/rtsom pa po zhig gi brtsams chos dang dpyad brjod pa zhig gi lta tshul bzang min de gtso bo lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i khrod nas brdar sha gcod rgyu zhig dang / yang na dus kyi byed pos bden kha ster rgyu zhig red/ khyed ni da lta'i bod kyi gzhon skyes rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa zhig red/ des na khyed kyis rtsom rig dpyad brjod 'bri ba'i skabs su rnam — 21 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'gyur ga 'dra 'dzin gyi yod dam/me lce/ nga rang nyid la mtshon na/ brtsams chos thi/ga la dpyad pa gtong dus gtso bo ni brtsams chos de la dus rabs kyi da gongs pas phyug yod med dang / de'i khrod du spyi gzhung la do khurabyed kyi yod med/de bsam blo gting zab yin min bcas la lta gi yod/ yang gcig bshad na ngas dpyad brjod 'bri ba ni u ru su'i bsam blo mkhan dang dpyad brjod mkhan pe lin si kheduyis brjod pa ltar/ ‘‘da lta bdag gis nyin rgyun sems la dran bzhin pa dang rmi lam du rmi bzhin pa ni/dngos yod dang ji ltar 'thab rtsod byed rgyu de yin’’zhes pa ltar ro/ /na ning do tshigs nas bzung nga la mtshon na rtsom rig brtsams chos rkyang rkyang la dpyad brjod 'bri ba de je nyung du btang ba yin/ gtso bo spyi tshogs dpyad brjod dang / skabs don dpyad brjod/ bsam blo'i dpyad brjod/ 'bol rtsom bcas kyi skor mang tsam 'bri bzhin yod pa dang / 'di'i phyogs la hur brtson gyis 'jug bzhin yod/ gzhan yang dge 'dun chos 'phel skor gyi dpyad brjod kyang 'ga' re 'bri gi yod/ dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog ni bod kyi sngon byon mkhas pa rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mnga' ba'i rig rjo peñtshanasatī/ (562khurtsobariram̐skya://oṃmos 1811—1sbyi8)spya ru srur+sha gasnar ṅgirje mang snanā ring lugs pa dngarngo / 2༵ na wad ga pa mkhan/ ma ga dpyad ba da mkhan/ ba mas sa ma ga 'char 〉 gas 'dug

drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa/pa'i dpa' bo zhig red/ khong la dogs slong gi blo spobs ldan pa dang /dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs yod pa/ lhad med kyi mi gzhi mnga' ba'i mkhas pa chen po zhig red/ dge 'dun chos 'phel khong shes yon can zhig gi ngos nas dpyad pa btang na dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bod kyi spyi tshogs la rin thang dang don snying gal chen ldan pa red/ khong gi bsam blo dang mi gzhi sogs ni dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bod kyi rig gnas gas ra pa'i ma lag 'dzugs skrun gyi thad la bsam blo'i thon khungs byed chog pa'i rin thang ldan pa red/ deng sang 'u cag la mtshon na mi chos rig gnas kyi lam gsar pa zhig 'ding bzhin pa'i sgang red/'di lta'i dus khyad par ba zhig gi nang du 'u cag la nges par du mi chos rig gnas kyi dar cha zhig dgos pa red/ ngas bltas na dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog ni bod kyi shes yo/na can gyi ngos thad nas mig dpe gson po byed chog pa dang / bsam blo'i thon khungs kyang byed chog pa zhig red snyam/ de'i rkyen gyis bdag gis bsam blo'i dpyad brjod sogs 'bri ba'i zhor du dge chos skor gyi dpyad brjod 'ga' re 'bri ba'i rgyu mtshan der thug yod/mgo 'dzin pa/ khyed kyis thog mar rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi skor bris pa dang / rim bzhin spyi tshogs dpyad brjod kyi skor bris pa/ de nas rim bzhin bsam blo'i dpyad brjod dang dge chos dpyad brjod kyi — 23 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/skor bris pa red/ nye ba'i lo 'di 'ga'i ring gi bod kyi dus deb dang tshags par gang mang gi steng na khyed kyi rtsom yig ni mang po bkod yod gides na khyed kyis rtsom rig brtsams chos dang spyi tshogs gnad don/bsam blo'i skor la dpyad brjod 'bri ba'i skabs su khyed kyi langs phyogs gtso bo ci zhig yin nam/me lce/ 'u gnyis kyis da ci gong du kha brda byas pa'i skabs su dpyad brjod pa zhig la mtshon na rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal dgos pa dang /dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs ldan pa/ drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa mnga' ba zhig yin dgos zhes gleng ba ltar/ lhag par du drang gtam brjod rgyu ni gal chen nang gi 'gangs chen red/ de'i rkyen gyis ngas 'di nas bdag gi langs phyogs de tshig dum gnyis su bsdus te bshad na/‘‘kha khu sim por gson pa las/ /drang gtam smras te shi na dga'’’duzhes pa 'di yin/ langs phyogs 'di'am dam bca' 'di kho bos dus rtag tu rdo la ri mo brkos pa bzhin sems la brtan por bcangs yod/mgo 'dzin pa/ red/ sngon byon mkhas pas gsungs pa bzhin‘‘dam pas dang po khas reches dka'/ /gal te khas ni blangs gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo brkos pa bzhin/ /shi yang gzhan du mi byed do’’zhes pa lta bu'i legs hāshadanywa ga rnyi su/nga n+dhukū tre+egārnyi sbridū swānā byā nā swā sbo ljasdo snyu sbyonā sh+laud+dhi snar+sha8 kau/9—1052)lags kyi rang dbang rtsod pa'i da 24 da

drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa/rtsa don gzhir bzung ste dpyad brjod 'bri ba ni dngos gnas bla na med cing shin tu dkon po red ang /me lce/ de lta bu'i tshad thig la slebs thub rgyu dka' mo red mod/yin na'ang rang nus lcogs chod kyis 'bad pa byed bzhin yod/mgo 'dzin pa/ red/ red/ nga la da dung khyed la 'dri rgyu zhig yod pa ni khyed kyis bltas na da lta'i bod kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi 'gan khur gtso bo ci zhig red dam/ khyed kyis 'di'i phyogs kyi kha brda zhig byed rogs/me lce/ deng sang gi bod kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi 'gan khur gtso bo ni/ gcig na drang gtam bshad rgyu dang / gnyis na blo 'byed byed rgyu de'o/ /drang gtam ci zhig bshad dgos gi zhe na/ skyon cha ther 'don dang rnag thog khab gtsags byed dgos pa red/ blo 'byed ci zhig byed dgos gi zhe na/ 'di la phyogs gnyis yod gi gcig ni rang nyid kyi rmongs pa'i blo sgo 'byed dgos pa dang / cig shos ni gzhan gyi rmongs pa'i blo sgo 'byed dgos pa red/ dpyad brjod pa zhig la cha mtshon na thog mar rang nyid kyi rmongs pa'i blo sgo ma phye bar gzhan gyi rmongs pa'i blo sgo ci ltar 'byed/ de bas dpyad brjod pa zhig yin na thog mar rang nyid kyi rmongs pa'i blo sgo 'byed dgos pa dang / de nas gzhan pha rol po'i blo sgo 'byed dgos pa red/— 25 —

— cherama'ilam gyi nga ro/drang gtam brjod rgyu dang blo 'byed byed rgyu ni ha cang dka' tshegs che ba'i las don zhig red/ 'di ni nam yang kher rkyang pa dang bsam blo pa dag gi bya gzhag cig yin pa red/ las don 'di gnyer ba yin na sdug bsngal ha cang che ni red/ yin na'ang dka' tshegs yod gisdug bsngal che gi kyag kyog dang ldan pa zhig red ces phyir nur byas na de ni gtan nas mi 'grig pa zhig red/ yang na de ni sdar ma dag gi bya spyod red/ 'jar man gyi rtsom mkhan ki ra sidu yis‘‘blo 'byed kyi sdug bsngal ni so so rang gis sel thabs byed pa las 'os med’’ces brjod pa ltar/ blo 'byed byed na'ang 'dra/ drang gtam brjod na'ang 'dra/dgag sgrub kyi dpyad brjod bris na'ang 'dra/ 'di'i skabs su khyod la dka' tshegs dang sdug bsngal ji ltar che rung gtso bo rang nyid kyis sel thabs byed dgos pa red/mgo 'jin pa/ dpyad brjod pa zhig yin na rigs gzhung gi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig yod dgos pa dang / sngon thon gyi bsam blo yod dgos pa/ de las gzhan da dung mi rang nyid la gshag bcos byed pa'i snying stobs shig kyang ldan dgos gi khyed kyis bltas na de 'dra zhig e red/so ① kirasi/ lo(snipyosgyidzo8ram̐ri oṃkhrispyatho/927—)'jar man gyi rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chos〈ṣ+ṭhatshop+lu〉gas (sprudupy-i6 1999 ra la ma ga bya dag /

drang tam bajod pa'i spobs pa/me lce/ red/ khyed kyis bshad pa bden gi dpyad brjod pa zhig la mtshon na mi gzhan gyi brtsams chos dang lta tshul la gshag bcos byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ dus rtag tu mi rang nyid la'ang gshag bcos dang rnam shes la tsha 'dri gtong dgos gi 'di ni shin tu gal che ba zhig red/ nga rang nyid kyi dpe cha'i nang du yin na'ang 'dra/ nga'i grogs po dag gi dpe cha'i nang yin na'ang 'dra/ mi rang nyid nas ji ltar 'go rtsom pa'i blang bya yang yang 'don gyin yod pa ni der thug yod pa red/mgo 'dzin pa/ brtsams chos shig la dpyad pa gtong dus dpyod shes dang lhag bsam rnam dag gis dpyad pa btang ba yin na/ da gzod 'u cag gis brjod pa'i‘‘nad mkhris pa'i sman la zhim po med/sha tsha ba'i gtam la snyan mo med’’ces pa'i rang bzhin red/ de las ldog ste pha rol po'i mi gzhi la dma' 'beb byed pa dang khyad gsod gtong ba'i tha shal gyi rtsom yig bris na zhe sdang slong ba dang dgra ru 'dzin rgyu las phan 'bras ci yang yod pa ma red/me lce/ red/ 'u cag gi rigs gzhung bgro gleng dang rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi khor yug de 'dra'i gtsang yangs shig chags med pa'i rkyen gyis gong du brjod pa'i phan tshun bar dgra ru 'dzin pa dang / phan tshun gyi bar thag je ring du 'gro ba'i gnas tshul de lta bu byung dang 'byung — 27 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/gi yod pa red/ nga rang nyid la mtshon na/ dpyad brjod 'bri ba'i skabs su nam yang pha rol po dang yang na dgag sgrub byed yul gyi ming nas 'dzin gyi yod/ ming nas 'dzin pa'i 'bri stangs de bed spyod kyi yod/ pha rol po'i ming nas bzung ste dgag sgrub byed pa dang skyon brjod byed pa'i dpyad brjod bris tshe stabs ma legs na pha rol pos‘‘dgra’’ru 'dzin pa'i nyen kha che gi kho tsho la'ang phog thug gtong gi yod ni red/ nga la mtshon na lhag bsam dkar po'i ngang nas dpyad brjod la 'jug pa yin na'ang / ma bsam sa nas kho bo‘‘dgra’’ru 'dzin pa'i gnas tshul 'byung gi da lo'i〈shar dung ri〉dus deb tu bkod yod pa'i〈gzur med kyi 'gan 'khri〉zhes par kho bos 'di'i skor cung tsam bris yod/ rtsom yig de ru pha rol po'i ming nas 'dzin pa'i dgag sgrub byed stangs dang dpyad brjod spel stangs kyi lam bu 'di bdams tshe/ pha rol pos‘‘dgra’’ru 'dzin gi kho bo la mtshon na dgag sgrub byed yul dang dpyad brjod spel yul gang zhig yin yang nga'i mdung rtse ni de'i lta tshul dang don dag der gtad yod pa ma gtogs/mi sger la gtad pa zhig gtan nas min/ de bas nga la nongs 'gyod ci yang med/ nga'i bsam pa dkar po yin zhes brjod yod/ ngas de ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ dpyad brjod 'bri ba'i skabs su pha rol po'i ming nas ma bzung bar bris pa yin na/ de ni 'gan ma — 28 —

drang tam brjod pa'i spobs pa/khur ba'i rigs gzhung gnyer stangs shig red la/ yang gcig bshad na rnam 'gyur mi drang ba'i dpyad brjod spel stangs shig kyang red snyam gigal te 'u cag gis bris pa'i dpyad brjod yod tshad ni mi che ge mo dang /brtsams chos ga ge mo/ yang na don dag ga ge mo zhes spyi bam tsam zhig brjod pa yin na de ni‘‘sa stong la bo'u stong’’dang gzugs brnyan gyi 'ben la brgyab pa kho na tsam red/ de la snying po ci yang mi 'dugader brten/ kho bos nam yang dpyad brjod 'bri dus rnam 'gyur drang dgos gi kun slong dag dgos gi 'gan 'khur dgos gi zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan de la thug yod/mgo 'dzin pa/ khyed kyis bltas na deng sang bod du rigs gzhung gi rmang gzhi mthug pa dang lhag bsam rnam dag can gyi dpyad brjod pa ga tshod yod pa red dam/me lce/ (dgod sgra)khyed kyi dri ba 'di la 'gran slong rang bzhin che gangs bltas na rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi phyogs nas nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan bdud lha rgyal lags shin tu bzang gi dge rgan khong ni gna' deng krung phyi'i dpe cha mang por lta rgya che bar ma zad/rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi rmang gzhi'ang brtan po zhig yod pa red/khong gis bris pa'i rtsom rig dpyad brjod gang zhig yin yang chu tshad mthon por slebs 'dug pa dang / rang nyid kyi 'gan 'khri de phrag tu — 29 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/blangs yod pa zhig red/ de ni khong gis brtsams pa'i〈'tshol rtog snying stobs〉la bltas na gsal por shes thub girig gnas dpyad brjod kyi phyogs nas nga'i grogs po sku zhabs zhogs dung lags sogs ni shin tu bzang gi sku zhabs zhogs dung lags kyis brtsams pa'i〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉yin na'ang 'dra/〈bdag dpe tshogs〉khrod kyi〈dogs slong snying stobs〉yin na'ang 'dra/brtsams chos gang zhig la mtshon na dpyod shes kyi blo mig gsal zhing dpyad brjod kyi chu tshad kyang nges can zhig la slebs 'dug pa red/khong gi dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs dang spyi tshogs la hur brtson gyis 'jug pa'i spobs pa/ drang po drang gzhag gi mi gzhi sogs ni 'u cag gi shes yon can gyi sde'i mig dpe ru bzung chog pa zhig red/ gzhan yang dga' 'os pa zhig la nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la bod du 'bol rtsom 'bri ba'i mtho rlabs shig 'phyur 'dug na gzhon rnams kyi khrod na 'bol rtsom la 'jug mkhan mang po yod gi ngas bltas na 'di ni bzang ltas shig red snyam/mgo 'dzin pa/ red/ dus tshod kyi dbang gis le tshan 'di mjug bsdu ran la nye/ mjug mthar ngas khyed la 'dri 'dod pa ni/ khyed kyis bltas na bod kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi kha phyogs 'di ji ltar song na da gzod‘‘mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dang me tog mnyam bzhad’’kyi — 30 —

drang tam brjod pa'i spobs pa/lam du skyod thub bam/me lce/ 'u cag gi rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi kha phyogs 'di rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam/ dgag sgrub/ dkyel yangs/ sger tshugs/btsi 'khur mi byed pa bcas kyi lam du zhugs tshe/ da gzod‘‘mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dang me tog mnyam bzhad’’kyi lam du skyod thub par 'dod/ de ma yin par dpyad brjod pa tshos rtsom pa po rnams 'a kha yag bshad pa dang ngo so bstod pa/ yang na phan tshun bar mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang khyad gsod byed pa/ gzhan yang brtsams chos de'i sgyu rtsal rang bzhin khyad du 'phags tshul dang rjod byed rna bar snyan tshul rkyang bshad pa yin na snying po ci yang med gi spyir na 'u cag bi mi rigs 'dir mtshon na da dung sgyu rtsal rkyang ba dang mdzes dpyod rkyang ba gleng rgyu ni snga drags 'dug gal che ba ni bsam blo dang spyi tshogs kyi ngos thad nas dpyad pa gtong rgyu dang / de ltar dpyad pa btang na gnad don thag gcod byed thub pas dpyad brjod kyi rnam pa 'di dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i rang re'i spyi tshogs la mtshon na shin tu mkho gal che ba zhig red/gzhan yang ngas 'dir gleng 'dod pa ni/ ngas bltas na 'u cag gi deng rabs rtsom rig gi gsar rtsom thad kyi gnad don gtso bo de gsham gyi phyogs 'di dag na mchis te/ 'u cag gi rtsom pa po rnams la — 31 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga rdo/dka' sdug gi 'du shes med pa dang / 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes med pa/gdung sems chen po'i 'du shes sogs med gi de'i rkyen gyis kho tshos bris pa'i brtsams chos dag kyang gtam rgyud rdzun bzo byed pa dang / mi bu'i rtsis thang rdog brdzis gtong ba/ mi bu'i tshe srog la gong bkur mi byed pa/ bsam blo'i zab tshad med pa sogs kyi rtsom rig gi gad snyigs yin pa red/ deng rabs ring lugs kyi rtsom rig la dga' ba'i rtsom pa po mi nyung ba zhig la mtshon na'ang thabs rtsal de gtso bor bzung nas rang gi srog bor yod mkhan yang ha cang mang gi rgya'i na gzhon rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan ho zhung h+phe lags kyis/ ‘‘rtsom rig gi thabs rtsal ni ji ltar khyad du 'phags na/ rdzun gtam de ltar du gab sbas byed pa dang / 'tsho ba dngos dang de ltar du thag ring bar ma zad/rtsom rig gi snying stobs dang yang de ltar du rgyang ring ba red’’ces brjod pa ni dngos gnas bden pa red/ lhag par du 'u cag la mtshon na 'di ni rnag thog gtsags khel gyi legs bshad cig ci la min/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas brjod na/ deng sang gi rang re'i rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyis gong gi rtsom rig gi gnad don 'di dag gi rdzun gyi khung bu de brtol dgos pa ma yin nam/mdor na/ 'u cag gi mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang mi gzhi khyad gsod byed pa'i snang tshul 'di dang / dngos yod la g.yol nas rdzun gyi — 32 —

drang tam brjod pa'i spobs pa/thang ma brdal ba'i rtsom rig gi snang tshul 'di med pa bzo dgos na/thog mar 'u cag gi rtsom pa po rnams kyis bod rang gi dngos yod spyi tshogs dang / lto skya gos hrul gyi 'tsho ba ngan ngon 'di la nges shes zab mo zhig skye dgos gi dus dang rnam pa kun tu bod rang gi zhing sa de 'bor mi nyan gi 'di ni de ring gi gleng mol 'di'i gzhi 'bab sa gtso bo'ang yin/mgo 'dzin pa/ sku zhabs me lce lags/ 'dir ngas yang bskyar khyed rang nged cag gi〈bgro gleng〉le tshan du zhugs par snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhus pa yin/me lce/ ngas kyang khyed rnam pas bdag la 'di 'dra'i go skabs shig bstsal par thugs rje che zhus pa yin/2005lo'i zla11pa'i tshes4nyin yi ger phab tshar/ yi ger 'beb skabs 'phri snon cung zad byas yod/

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dang rten dang skur 'debs/da wadra ngos kyi dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gyi skor gleng ba/nye ba'i lo 'di 'gar dus rabs kyi 'phel phyogs dang bstun nas 'u cag gis kyang brda 'phrin dus rabs kyi bag ma de bsu 'go brtsams shing / bag ma des bstsal pa'i phyi'i gzugs kyi cha dang nang bcud kyi cha de la yang myong rol gang legs byed bzhin mchis/ des mi tshad mi rang rang gi bsam pa'i dran tshul dang yid kyi 'char sgo de yang bag ma de brgyud nas sba gsang med par lhugs por brjod kyin 'dug brda 'phrin dus rabs kyi dge mtshan gtso bo gcig ni lce ldan dang lce med su zhig yin yang / shes nas smra ba dang ma shes par smra ba gang zhig yin yang / rang gi ci bsam de bshad chog la/ yang na che ba rgyal khab kyi srid don nas chung ba mi sger gyi don chung bar du yang gleng chog pa red/gsar 'gyur brgyud lam gang dang bsdur na'ang dra ba la ltos bcas kyis rang dbang dang ldan pa dang / myur tshad dang ldan pa/ shong tshad che ba/phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyi khyad chos mang po yod pa red/ de bas dra ba 'dis bod mi'i rgyun lobs su song yod pa'i klog 'don dang / myong rol/ smra brjod/ bsam gzhig bcas kyi thad la brdab gsig dang — 34 bhe

dang dang ra 'debs/gsar brje/ g.yo skyom gang mang thebs yod pas mi tshad/ slar yang 'u cag la klog 'don dang / myong rol/ smra brjod/ bsam gzhig bcas kyi sgo glegs gsar pa zhig kyang phye yod pa red/'dir gleng bar bya ba ni dra ngos kyi dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gyi skor bgro gleng byed pa de yin zhing / khong rnam pa gnyis ni brgya lo20pa'i nang du byung ba'i gsar gtod kyi spobs pas phyug cing /rnam dpyod kyi blo mig yangs pa'i shes yon can gnyis yin pa dang/ 'u cag gi phyi rabs pa rnams la mtshon na shugs rkyen ches che ba'i shes yon can gnyis kyang yin pa red/ da lta'i dus 'di la yang skyes bu mang po zhig la khong gnyis kyi bsam blo dang / kun spyod/ rtsom gshis sogs kyis shugs rkyen gang mang thebs dang thebs bzhin yod pa ni bsnyon du med/ de bas dge chos dang don grub rgyal rnam pa gnyis ni na gzhon gang mang zhig gi dang rten(r+ṣat+yā)du gyur yod pa red/ khong rnam pa gnyis dang rten du bkur ba'i dra grogs tshos dge chos la‘‘rig pa'i dpa' bo 'dzam gling rgyan gcig’’dang‘‘bod kyi nor bu’’sogs kyi cho lo stsol gyin 'dug la/ don grub rgyal la‘‘mi rigs kyi dpa' bo’’dang‘‘rtsom rig gsar pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed pa’’‘‘gangs ljongs kyi mar me tshe 'bar’’sogs kyi cho lo stsol gyin 'dug yang khong gnyis la mi dga' mkhan dag gis tshig mtshon gyi mda' mo char ba bzhin du 'beb — 35 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bzhin 'dug dga' ba rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyis dang rten du bkur ba dang mi dga' ba rnams kyis mchil zhags 'phangs te skur 'debs byed pa'i snang tshul 'di la 'u cag gis nges par du bsam gzhig gtong rgyu 'dug ste/ lhag par du mi dga' mkhan rnams kyis dma' 'beb kyi mchil zhags 'phen pa dang/ tshig mtshon gyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'di las 'u cag gi rig gnas pa'i sde na da dung khong rnam pa gnyis la go ba lon med pa mtshon zhing / rang mi rigs kyi skyo gar de la yang ngos zin gsal po zhig thob kyi med pa de gsal bshad byas 'dugazhor du rgya nag giyozloṣ+ṭhazlorkeṣ+ṭha7zhes pa'i rma med kyi legs bshad 'di kho tsho'i steng sbyor ba yin na ga'u kha sbyor bzhin du 'gro nges so/ /gsham du bkod pa ni〈gangs ljongs gzhon nu〉dra tshigs dang〈hi ma la ya glog brnyan rig gnas〉dra tshigs steng gi dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gnyis kyi skor bgro gleng byed skabs skur ba btab pa'i 'thus tshab kyi sbyar byang skor zhig yin la/ sbyar byang de dag dang 'brel nas kho bos kyang dpyad brjod 'ga' bri bar 'dod do/ /1 dra grogs mdung lags na re/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rjes 'bring('brangs)na bod mi rigs dang kha thag je ring je ring red/ don grub rgyal la lad zlos byas na bod mi rigasakli 'gro lamarje dog red/dge chos lags kyis‘‘kha rgya rgan rgya'i bar ni ring ba ste/ /dbus — 36 —

dang dang ra 'debs/ dang a mdo lam yang shin tu ring / / ma ga dha dang bod ni ches cher ring / /legs sbyar dngos dang sum rkang de las ring’’zhes gsungs pa bzhin dra grogs mdung lags dang dge chos gnyis kyi bar thag ni dngos gnas ma ga dha dang bod las kyang ring bar 'dug bar thag de ni bsam blo'i bar thag dang mig rgyang gi bar thag shes rab kyi bar thagarnam dpyod kyi bar thag cig red/ ‘‘dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rjes 'brangs na bod mi rigs dang kha thag je ring je ring’’yin tshe/ 'u cag su'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin na da gzod bod mi rigs dang kha thag je nye je nye yin nam/ thob dang go sa'i ched du gzhan mi rigs la mgo 'dogs lus 'bul byas pa'i chos lugs grub mtha' khag gi bla sprul dag gi rjes su 'brang dgos pa yin nam/ yang na spyang ki nang la khrid yong mkhan gyi mkhas pa'i dbang bo dag gi rjes su 'brang dgos pa yin/yang na pha bsad na rgyal rnga rdung mkhan blun po dag gi rjes su 'brang dgos pa yin/ 'di ni 'u cag la mtshon na gnad don zhig red la/nges par du dpyod shes kyis bsam gzhig gtong dgos pa'i gnad don zhig kyang red/don grub rgyal lags kyis khong gi sku tshe thung thung gi ring la rang mi rigs 'di srol rgyun gyi rkang lam phra mo nas deng rabs kyi gzhung lam chen mo'i steng du bgrod par hur brtson chen po byas pa dang / tha na — 37 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/de'i ched du rang gi tshe srog kyang phul zin na/ da dung‘‘don grub rgyal la lad zlos byas na bod mi rigs kyi 'gro lam je dog je dog red’’zer/ngas bltas na 'u cag gi 'gro lam je dog nas je dog tu 'gyur byed gtso bo ni shes yon can gyi sde na dge chos dang don grub rgyal lta bu'i rdzun gtam zlog pa'i skyes bu med pa dang / khong gnyis kyi snying stobs rgyun 'dzin byed mkhan med pas red snyam/ de las ldog ste 'u cag la mod pa ni spyang tshul dang sgam tshul ston pa'i shes yon can rdzus ma rnams so/ /2 dra grogs shis lags na re/ dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal dang ya tung ni bud medā dang du chang gi dbang du gyur pa kho na ded/ kho cho du chang dang bud med kyi ched du shi na mi rigs kyi don du tshe srog 'dor thub pa'i skyes chen yin nam/ dra grogs gdung khri lags na re/ dge 'dun chos 'phel ni rtsom pa po dang bsam blo pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang kho ni chab srid pa zhig min/ rgyu mtshan ni khos rgya che ba'i bod mi rigs ni smyo chu btungs pa'i smyon par brtsis shing / kho rang gcig pu 'jig rten 'di'i mkhas par brlams(zlom)nas/ bod mi yongs kyi kha gtad du langs pa red/ de(de'i)phyir kho'i bsam blo dang snying stobs ni bod kyi bcings 'grol dang rang dbang / mang gtso dang mi'i thob thang bcas la mi phan zhing / kho ni don dngos gzhir 'jin mi shes pa'i stong bsam ring lugs pa zhig red/ de'i phyir mjug mthar kho ni rang kho na'i 'dod sred tsam skong ba'i du chang sred gsum gyi bran du gyur cing / du chang sred gsum gyi zhen dungs kyis kho'i srog — 38 —

dang dang ra 'debs/kyang bcad pa yin no/ /〈'dod pa'i bstan bcos〉su/ ‘‘bud med mi 'dod skyes pa su zhig mchis/ /skyes pa mi 'dod bud med su zhig mchis/ /phyi rol brdzu yi khyad par ma gtogs pa/ /thams cad kun kyang 'di la dga' bar nges’’zhes gsungs pa ni shin tu mad pa'i gtam du 'khums te/ 'di ni mi bu'i lhan skyes kyi 'dod pa dang mi bu'i rang bzhin de la yin 'jog byas pa zhig red/ 'u cag gi‘‘chos pa’’dang‘‘mkhas pa’’skor zhig bud med la dga' bzhin du de la smad cing dgag byar 'dzin pa'i tshul 'chos kyi bzo lta de mthong bas/ dge chos kyi ngag las/ ‘‘'khor lo lnga ldan rtsa yi 'phrul 'khor la/ / rang bzhin gshis kyis gnas sa'i bde ba 'di/ /skyon du bzung nas dgag pa ci la 'thad/ /'dod pa'i don la dga' ba 'dod chags te/ /'dod pa'i don la dga' ba dad pa nyid/ /mi 'dod don la 'jigs pa zhe sdang ste/ /mi 'dod don la 'jigs pa nges 'byung nyid/ /'dod dang mi 'dod sems kyi khyad chos te/ /bsgyur tu btub kyang spang du med nga lags’’zhes kyang thal lo/ /don du dra grogs shis lags the ba'i bud med dang du chang gi dbang du ma gyur pa rnams la mtshon na yang / ‘‘gzugs kyi nang na mdzes pa'i mthar thug pa’’ni‘‘skyes pa'i mig la bud med gzugs’’min pa dang / ‘‘sgra yi nang na snyan pa'i mthar thug pa’’ni‘‘skyes pa'i rna bar bud med sgra’’min zhes sus da 39 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/kha tshon gcod thub ste mi thub bo/ /dge chos dang don grub rgyal ni mi rigs 'di rmongs gnyid las dkrog ched rang gi gces pa'i tshe srog kyang phangs med du dor ba zhig yin pa las/ ‘‘bod mi yongs kyi kha gtad du langs pa’’zhig min pa ni 'u cag gi nye rabs dang deng rabs kyi lo rgyus la blo sbyong tog tsam yod pa zhig yin phyin ha go yong gi red mod/ 'on kyang drang ldog la blang dor 'byed pa'i blo mig ldongs pa'i mi skor zhig la mtshon na da dung dpe klog mang du byed dgos tshod du 'dug des na 'dir yang bskyar‘‘gcig pur lus pa'i bden pa'i bu chung’’dge chos lags lha sar sku gshegs khar gsungs pa'i gsung dum zhig dang / don grub rgyal gyi kha chems yi ge 'god pa'i dgos pa shin tu che ste/ gsham du de 'god pa la/‘‘ngas dka' las tog tsam brgyab pa de/ yin rgyu bod kyi don du byas pa'i khul yin yang / gang yang byung ma song / dber na lung pa kha byang lta zhig tu me tog dkar po snying rje bo gcig skyes/ de la dri snom mkhan phar zhog mig zur tsam yang lta mkhan ma rnyed pas lung pa de'i nang du skam pa 'dra ba zhig rang red/’’‘‘da ni 'dzam gling na dkon pa'i be+eḍūr+ya'i bum pa zhig rdo la brdabs tshar/’’da wadage 'dun chos 'phel gyis/(〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rnam thar〉du gsal)‘‘sems pa 'di sdug bsngal gyis yongs su mnan te ljid tig tig gi ngang khyed da 40 da

dang dang ra 'debs/dang rgyas phyag phul ba yin/ kho bos lam 'di 'dra zhig bdams pa'i gtam ngan 'di go dus khyed nyid ha las shing hang sang bas mi tshad/ bdag gi non 'khrul zhig tu brtsi na'ang thang mod/ gal srid khyed kyis sems rnal la phab ste kho bo'i shi rkyen 'dir zhib 'dang re brgyab che/ mtha' mjug gi rgyas phyag phul don la'ang rgyu mtshan ye nas med pa ma yin pa'i nges shes 'drong 'ong gi red/ khyed dang gtan bral du 'gyur ba'i skabs 'dir/ nga ni khyed dang mjal 'dod ci 'dra che ang /yin na'ang de ni srid pa zhig ma yin te/ de ring ngas da dung khyed la glig 'phrin zhig btang don ni/ myur du las gnas spor ba'i brda yig cig 'byor bar re ba che bas yin/ 'on kyang / ngas bsam gzhig zhib mo zhig btang ba na/ rang rigs 'di sngar bzhin blun rmongs dang rjes lus kyi klong du 'khyams shing / de'i don du kho bos kyang rtsom yig kha grangs longs pa zhig bris te kho pa cho'i go rtogs de sad na snyam yang / pham kha ni rang gis nyo dgos byung rkyen/ ngas rang nyid kyi nyam chung ba'i che srog blos btang ste dung brda gsal po zhig bsgrags pa yin/’’da wadon grub rgyal gyis/ (2005lo'i〈gangs rgyan me tog〉deb bzhi pa'i steng gi〈dpa' dar ring mo〉ru gsal)tsho3 dra grogs rigs zhen lags na re/ dge chos 'chal po dang don grub rgyal gzhan zhen ring lugs pa bcas kyi langs phyogs la dogs slong dang dgag gzhag bya dgos/mi su zhig yin rung gzhan gyi lta tshul la mi 'thad tshe de la dogs slong dang dgag sgrub ni byed chog chog yin pa red/ 'jig rten steng — 41 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/tshad ma'i skyes bu dang tshad ma'i bden don zhes pa zhig nam yang med par 'dod/ lo rgyus steng gi chag 'jig gang mang dang god chag gang mang / nad yams gang mang / dmar gsod gang mang zhig ni‘‘tshad ma'i skyes bu’’yi‘‘tshad ma'i gsung’’la nyan pa dang / ‘‘tshad ma'i bden don’’yin par rlom nas byung ba zhig red/ yang na‘‘tshad ma'i skyes bu’’dang‘‘tshad ma'i bden don’’‘‘'jig rten gyi mgon skyabs chen mo’’sogs kyi ming thog nas sger gcod pa dang srid 'dzin pa dag gis mang tshogs la sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho dang khrag gi mtsho mo bskyil ba red/ de'i rkyen gyis skyes bu su zhig yin yang rung / lta tshul gang zhig yin yang chogade la dogs slong dang dgag sgrub byed chog chog yin pas na/ dge chos dang don grub rgyal gnyis kyang de las ma 'das/ yin na'ang / dge chos kyi‘‘spyod pa 'chal ba’’tsam gyis khong gi rigs gzhung dang bsam blo la gnod pa ci yang byed kyi mi 'dug ste/ gal te spyod pa 'chal ba'i dbang du btang yang khong gis mkhas pa'i dam tshig ni srog la babs kyang 'bad pas bsrungs yod pas mi tshad/ da dung‘‘rang sde'i rigs la zhen pa dkar po'i mdangs/ / rang byung snying gi dbus na gnas pa 'dis/ /rang yul kha ba can gyi rjes 'bangs la/ /rang gi nus pas sri zhu cung zad sgrub’’yod pa red/ 'o na spyod pa legs shing ya rabs tshul ldan du rlom pa'i‘‘mkhas pa’’tshos gnad 'gag gi skabs su mkhas pa'i — 42 ge

dang dang ra 'debs/dam tshig srung gi 'dug gam/ yang na rang yul kha ba can la zhen pa dkar po'i ngang nas sri zhu sgrub kyi 'dug gam/ kho bo dogs pa za 'ong /‘‘don grub rgyal gzhan zhen ring lugs pa’’zhes pa ni phal cher rgya mi rigs la dga' zhen 'dug ces bshad kyi yod pa 'dra/ yang gcig bshad na rgya mi rigs kyi rig gnas la dga' zhen 'dug ces bshad kyi yod pa 'dra/ ngas bltas na don grub rgyal gyi mi tshe dang ljags rtsom sogs gang la bltas yong na/ khong gi 'phag 'tshag gi nga ro de 'u cag gi phyir du sgrog gin 'dug rtogs sad kyi cong brda de 'u cag gi phyir du rgyag gin 'dug tshe srog gi mar me de 'u cag gi phyir du sgron gyin 'dug mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas dang len byed pa de yang khong la tshur len gyi snying stobs ldan pas red/ gsar gtod kyi spobs pas phyug pas red/ mdun skyod kyi blo spobs mnga' bas red/ mdor na/〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉ru‘‘mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i sngon chad kyis da lta'i tshab byed mi rung la/ ba tshwa'i dri dang 'grogs pa'i kha sang gis de ring gi skom pa ga la sod/ rnyed par dka' ba'i lo rgyus kyi bem po la/dus dang mthun pa'i srog gi dbang po ma zhugs na/ yar rgyas kyi 'pharatshortsa lding mi srid la/ sngon thon gyi snying khrag rgyu mi thub cing / mdun skyod kyi gom pa de bas kyang ngo’’zhes brjod pa ltar ro/ /4 dra grogs blo bzang nyi 'od lags na re/ don grub rgyal la rgya mi rigs kyi — 43 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ rtsom rig mkhas can lu'u shun(zhun)dang cha mtshungs pa yang 'dug lu'u shun(zhun)ni nam yang so so'i mi rigs kyi mtshang 'byin ma tshar bar sdod pa dang phyis su yang kho cho ni srol rgyun gyi nying khu brlag pa'i phyi lugs mar khe sidudang dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rjes 'brangs pa tsam du zad/dra grogs mdung lags na re/ ltos(ltas)ngan de'i ring nas bzung bod mi rigs la kla klo dang mun 'thoms/ rnying zhen/ blo rgyang / mkhyegs 'dzin/rig pa rtul po/ phyogs zhen/ rmongs dad/ blun rmongs bcas kyi ming ngan btags byung ba red/ khas(khos)gzhan rtsom la lad zlos byas te bod kyi lo rgyus ring mo'i lam chen der rkang lam phra mo zhes ngan dmod dang / bod mi shes rab ldan pa dag la rgan po blo gyong zer nas bsdegs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bod la rang dbang thob na ma dga' ba min na ci yin/lu'u zhunadugyi mi tshe gang bo ni mun nag dang sger gcod/ blun rmongs dang gnya' gnon/ rmongs 'thom dang rjes lus sogs dang kha gtad du 'greng ba zhig red/ de bas khong sku ma gshegs bar du de dag dang 'thab rtsod kyis glo gri ngar ma'i 'bol rtsom ni chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bris shing / ljid tig tig gi gom pa yang mdun nas mdun nas spos pa red/ khong gis skabs de ga'i mi dang phyi rabs pa rnams la pa/ hārtsamanākā nāsi ma/ rtsaslo trīm shār+shakau〉 k+shik+ṇi sgrishaṃ818—1883)'jar man pa/ mar khe si ring lugs kyi srol 'byed 'a 6) lusmilhan/ (shā ma 1881—1936)krung go'i rtsom rig mkhan dang bsam blo mkhan/ brtsams chosaṭ+wāṃ.agatam /sa was 'dug

dang dang ra 'debs/bzhag pa'i snang brnyan ni nges pa don gyi bsam blo'i 'thab mo pa zhig go/don grub rgyal khong la mtshon na 'u cag gi rnying zhen dang le lo/ sgyid lug dang bag 'khum/ rjes lus dang kla klo sogs la sun 'byin pa'i blo spobs dang / srol rgyun dang rgyab gtod pa'i 'du shes drag po yod par ma zad/ da dung‘‘ngag las sems can thams cad kyi 'phrin las sgrub par khas 'ches kyang / don la rang don 'ba' zhig ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa'i ser mo pa 'di dag gi nang du/ rgod bro ba'i a tsa ra shin tu mang ste/ gdong la 'bag gyon nas 'cham byed mkhan dang phyogs mtshungs pas so/ /kho bo ni bstod smad kyi 'ben du gyur kyang rung gis tshe 'dir ni de dag gi ldog zlar mtha' gcig tu langs rtsis yod’’ces brjod pa ltar dngos gnas 'thab mo pa zhig gi brtul zhugs 'dzin rgyu yin par khas 'ches 'dug yin na'ang rkyen gang mang zhig gi dbang gis dgag sgrub kyi las de ni skyi pags tsam ma gtogs nang gi srog snying la‘‘glo gri’’yis‘‘'dzer’’thub mi 'dug de ni nga la mtshon na ches yid phangs pa'i gnas shig red/ de'i dbang gis don grub rgyal dang lu'u zhun gnyis la 'dra ba'i cha yang yod la/ mi 'dra ba'i cha yang yod pa red/lu'u zhun ni‘‘srol rgyun gyi nying khu brlag pa'i phyi lugs mar khe si dang dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rjes 'brangs’’ yod pa ni bden la/— 45 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/brgya lo20pa'i lo rabs30pa'i nang du gung khran tang dang mnyam 'brel yang byas 'dug pa red/dulu'u zhun gyis skabs der gung khran ring lugs kyi lam bu bdams pa ni/ gcig na skabs de'i nub phyogs kyi deng rabs can gyi lam bu la the tshom dang re chad byung zhing / rgya nag gi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srol rgyun rig gnas la yin dgag byas pa dang / gnyis na khong gi gsar brje'i phugs bsam de gung khran ring lugs dang kha 'phrod pas red snyam/ yin na'ang khong ni ring lugs gang zhig yin yang rang gi dpyod shes kyis brtag dpyad ma btang bar tshod tshod la hol rgyug byed mkhan zhig ni min par 'dug khyad par du srid dbang sger gcod byed pa'i srid gzhung dang / skyid sdug kho na'i khe phan la dmigs pa'i ring lugs dang gzhung lugs la de bas kyang dga' po med pa zhig kyang yin 'dug de'i skor ni rgya'i deng rabs kyi lu'u zhun zhib 'jug ched mkhas pa dang mi tshul bsam blo mkhan chan li chunadudang lin zhan kriduganyis kyis bris pa'i ched rtsom dag la gzigs na ha cang gsal/ brgya lo20pa'i nang gi‘‘rig gsar’’sogs kyi skabs la chab srid kyi dgos dbang gis lu'u zhun la cho lo mang po bstsal te gsar krung golha nga ṣ+ṭṛsdo k+ṣiṃrnyi zhu 〉sha ṣ+ṭṛ pa sa/ spyoñdza snazla snash+lausdo sna〉ḍi sh+laubye s+t+ra sna spyi zlo / sna/zlo / yin pa bstan/ mna' 'brel de ni rdumas+dzalināsnyi/sa(spyaṭ+wāṃsbyi/prikauzlokraljit+na spyanā rdur+sha nābalda sdi sngu glusna sdobyā tāsbrikū nād snarnozlo zlodu r+shang / mi tshul sdusam rjo trīn/zhan—/( kāṣ+ṭha/khri1948—)krung go'i dzong rabs kyi ༈ma mkha na dang mkhas pa/ brtsams chosami yu la pya lusdod zhudī6gas 'dug

dang dang ra 'debs/brje'i ched du khong gi dar cha phyar pa ni 'khyog bsgyur byas pa kho na las ma 'das/ de ni shes yon can zhig gi ngos nas bltas na ngo tsha dang skyo gar chen po zhig yin pa red/ gzhan chan li chun lags kyi〈lu'u zhun gyi las dbang〉(rtsom 'di rgya yig gi dra tshigs〉lkozosh+tsa zhes par gsal)zhes par gong gi 'di'i skor la gsed 'grol mang po byas 'dug pas mos pa yod mkhan tshos rtsom der gzigs par 'tshal/spyir nub phyogs yul nas rtsa ba tshugs pa'i mar khe si ring lugs(yang na dmar po'i ring lugs)'di spyi tshogs bcings 'grol dang spyi tshogs gsar brje/ spyi tshogs 'dra mnyam sogs kyi phyogs la gzhol che ba'i gzhung lugs shig tu snang na'ang / ma bsam sa nas gzhung lugs 'di'i 'bras bu ni nub phyogs nas ma smin par su'u len dang krung go sogs nas smin song ba red/ su'u len dang krung go sogs la mar khe si ring lugs 'di dar ba nas bzung / mar le ring lugs ni 'jigs skul dang drag shugs/ gdug rtsub rang bzhin gyi gsar brje'i ming tshab cig tu gyur pas/ da lta mar le ring lugs dang gung khran ring lugs zhes na skyes bu su zhig yin yang snying mi bde zhing rna la gzan pa lta bu'i tshor pa zhig 'gog min du skyes 'ong gi yod pa red/ de bas don grub rgyal yang‘‘srol rgyun gyi nying khu brlag pa'i phyi lugs mar khe si dang dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rjes 'brangs’’zhes dang / yang na‘‘bod la — 47 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rang dbang thob na ma dga' ba min na ci yin’’zhes brjod na 'u cag gis khong la zhwa mo bskon rgyu che drags song la/ skur 'debs byed rgyu yang thal drags song ngo / /gzhan du na dra grogs mdung lags kyi skad cha 'di ni ma brtag ma dpyad pa'i gzu lum gyi gtam kho nar snang /5 dra grogs grags pa rgya mcho lags na re/ 'das pa'i dge chos dang don grub rgyal/ deng dus kyi zhogs dung dang de'i rjes 'bring('brangs)dang bcas bod nang dkrugs pa la shin tu mkhas/ phyi'i shes bya bod nang drangs nas bod dar rgyas btang ba'i byas rjes til 'bru tsam yang ston rgyu med/ de 'dra la stod pa mi 'bab smad pa 'bab/dge chos dang don grub rgyal sogs kyis bod nang ji ltar dkrugs song / yang na khong tsho ni 'u cag gi 'phel rgyas kyi gegs rkyen ci zhig tu gyur song / gal srid khong tshos bod nang dkrugs pa'i nag nyes 'di red ces ston rgyu zhig yod na smad pa dang sdigs mo 'bab mod/ 'on kyang bsam blo'i phyogs nas 'u cag la g.yo skyom dang‘‘phyi dkrug nang dkrug’’bzos pa yin na/ de ni bsam blo'i thad kyi thod brgal chen po zhig red la/ yang na 'u cag la da dung gson shugs dang re ba yod pa'i rtags shig red snyam/ don dngos su 'u cag gi grub mtha' khag gi lo rgyus la bltas yong na bod nang dkrugs mkhan ni su red/ yang na rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs la bod nang dkrugs te deng — 48 —

dang dang ra 'debs/rabs can 'phel rgyas kyi bkag rdo ru 'gyur byed de dag su zhig gis bsgrubs pa red/ 'dir kho bos lan 'debs pa'i ngal ba ma byas kyang klog po tshos zhib tu bsam na ha go yong gi red/ 'u cag dar rgyas su gtong rgyu ni shes yon can re gnyis kyis theg pa zhig ma yin par/ de ni bod mi spyi'i bsam blo dang 'byung spus/ shes yon/ blo sbyong /nus pa sogs dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa zhig red/ yin na'ang shes yon can ni spyi tshogs kyi sgul shugs dang kha lo sgyur po yin pa ni bsnyon du med/ 'u cag la 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ldan zhing nyam chung gi tshogs(sh+laustostsa9/tsā)la do khur byed pa dang / spyi tshogs la hur brtson gyis 'jug pa'i shes yon can 'di 'dra ba byung na da dung‘‘bod nang dkrugs pa la shin tu mkhas’’zhes brjod tshe/ da ni‘‘rgyu mtshan med par brjod na yid ches shing / /rgyu mtshan btsal te smras na brnyas byed pa'i/ /skye bo rmongs pa'i sems kyi gshis lugs 'di/ /tshad ma'i 'jug pa kun las 'das pa lags’’zhes pa'i dge chos kyi gsung 'di lan du sbyin dgos byung /spyir na rig gnas zhes pa 'di snying stobs shig la go na 'grigade'i rkyen gyis mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas ni 'di'o zhes rdog rdog cig ston rgyu ma yin par/ gtso bo mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas de snying stobs shig gi tshul du slob sbyong dang tshur len byed dgos par 'dod / snying stobs de yang sgra yangs 'jug gi snying stobs shig ste/ dper na/— 49 —

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/tshan rig snying stobs dang / rang dbang snying stobs/ mang gtso'i snying stobs/ khrims kyi snying stobs/ chos lugs snying stobs/ rtsom rig snying stobs sogs mang po yod pa red/ des na 'u cag la mtshon na lo rgyus kyi dkyogs mtshams shig la slebs yod pa'i skabs 'dir/mi rigs rang la dus rabs dang spyi tshogs la 'tsham pa'i bsam blo'i thon khungs dang rin thang lta tshul zhig nges par du dgos song ba red/ yang gcig bshad na dus rabs dang spyi tshogs la 'tsham pa'i rig gnas snying stobs shig nges par du dgos song ba red/ 'u cag gi gtso rgyugs rig gnas ni ldog ste mi bu 'bur 'joms dang mi bu'i rin thang khyad du gsod pa'i rig gnas shig yin phyin/ deng sang gi dus rabs dang spyi tshogs la mi 'tsham pa red/ de bas 'u cag gi mig ltos ni mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas snying stobs steng la mi phyogs thu med yin song /de la rkyen byas te mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas snying stobs la slob sbyong dang tshur len byed dgos byung ba red/ rgya'i na gzhon rang dbang shes yon can yus cedulags kyis blo 'byed kyi thad nas rgya mi rigs kyis slob sbyong dang tshur len byed dgos pa'i bsam blo'i thon khungs brgyad brtsis yod pa las bzhi ni 'u cag la yang shin tu phan par 'dod de/ de dag chos〈stu gasnyan+ni n+dhe/ga t+t+waṃ〉ḍā〈m+biphrirno khyo3 bli sbri slo nā n+d+ra kūtāsna glurnyi lhartar+sha r+shazlo 'a/du/da don dpyad brjod mkhan/ brtsams ———— /)() ———— ra

dang na dang ra 'debs/ni/ (1)gna' rabs ke ri se dang ro ma'i dpyod shes ring lugs dang khrims lugs rig pa'i srol rgyun/ (2)rig rtsal bskyar dar tshun gyi mi lugs ring lugs(rke7lha5)kyi bsam blo/ (3)a ri gtso byas pa'i nub phyogs deng rabs kyi rtsa khrims chab srid shes rig (4)lnga bzhi'i rig gnas gsar pa gtso byas pa'i krung go'i deng rabs rig gnas bcas so/ /dhings bltas na 'u cag gi deng rabs rig gnas kyi kha phyogs ni bod rang gi btsan po'i skabs kyi rig gnas snying stobs rmang gzhir byas thog gong du brjod pa'i bsam blo'i thon khungs bzhi bo des zur brgyan pa dang / da dung de'i steng du gna' rabs ke ri se'i so khi ra thedudang / rgya gar gyi sems dpa' chen por 'bod pa'i gan dhidhi.u ru su'i sol ze nyi chenaduyo rob shar ma'i ha weladhidang wa le sa'adume che ne 8tshalhaljasdospyo/88dzo7n+dhu⑫ne+egh+rihāstushāltisna0lja6༵11sna.a+yaugrisnyi9tram̐shārnyit+nanā 5ram̐bs swo lto mtshun nyid rig pa sdukhanadhi/ /ṅgā laṭ+wāṃ stush+lau ci maspyasku kyāng stut+ma swāspyazlo zlospra ṭ+wāṃ ༵ 8k+ta rgya ṅgisdo sh+laud+ngha lhashāṭā zlok+ṣiṃṅgināran+t+ra /t+yā 'añdzan/sagasnru r+sha sdostukā/ 4sdus ṭ+wāṃpa'ashā larnyi t+na ñtshan/daski/ byudīṭīsdu2zlo.ausmrajusnrostakhriskyatram̐)kū18—u ru su'i rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chosako la lengaṭ+wā maha4krāṭ+wāṃ/'a/nya53/:70khyatā rjo〉 rwa /sdu spradi sgyu nyigludīsta r+sha/ra rtom mkhan dngahūṃ ཿbsriglumakhanaso/ 1993—2002dhi b.rawa nā sa 'a zu/ maṇa/ shāswā/ skyazlo ṭ+wā rlid ljarnyi/43n+d+rashās+t+ra ṭānasnyu 〈tshob wa ṅgisdu ma kāk+ṣiṃ/ ma ḍārnyizi bhāp+tak+tazlo bsdo khyi lha nāsna gyi srid 'dzin/ brtsams chos〈wa le sa' rang rnamasogs 'dug 1983ra no la 'i bde'i bya dga' ༵༵/da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/khidu a me ri kha'i mar thin lu sir khenarjo lho a h+phe ri kha'i man ti ladhi rgya nag gi li'u zha'o porjosogs skyes chen dag gi bsam blo dang snying stobs kyis kha skong dgos par 'dod/ 'di ni kho bos 'dod pa'i bod kyi deng rabs zirdog gnas dang zirdog gnas gsar pa'i ma lag go/6 dra grogs mdung lags na re/ don grub rgyal ni gzhan zhen rang(ring)lugs pa zhig dang lad zlos ring lugs pa zhig red/ kho rang gi pha mes dag gi lo rgyus kyi lam chen ring mo 'di'i thog 'tshar longs byung zhing 'dab lag rgyas rjes/de rkang lam phra mo dang lam rnying zhig tu brtsis nas bshig mgo brtsams/ khos lo rgyus kyi lam bu de gzhan gyis bshig bzhin pa la rogs ram byas te bshig pa ma zad/kho dang 'dra bar de'i thog nas 'tshar longs byung zhing rang mgo thon pa'i rang rigs kyi klad med 'ga' skul nas bshig tu bcug kho chos lam bu de da dung mu mthud du bshig gin yod/ kho chos rkang lam phra mo de bshig ma tshar na sems mi bde/ kho cho'i nang gi mi la las da lta rkang lam phra mo bskyun nas gzhan gyi gzhung lam chen mo snyeg zin/ la las rkang lam phra mo dor nas mes(me)'khor la bsdad zin/ la la ni gzhan gyis bzos zin pa'i myur mgyogs lam bur zhugs pa'i ltaspyi tshogahā su mai༈dane pa trī/sot+t+waṃṭ+wāṃlha/thi'i01smo lko.oṃkhuṭ+wāṃ 1946—)po lan gyi bsam blo mkhan/ brtsams chos k+to'i daṭ+wāṃngs tāsdadhāṭī t+nasnar lhasdin /lam̐ nā rnyu ṅgesnyu slosna3/rngaspyo10baḥmishā khyusatā1ñdza gli spyo ḍā zhikau yam̐〉'-is 1shāṭaṃṅgi—1sdutrīhāṭ+wāṃṭā ra ṅge bye shāsna bar gyithi spya sh+lau ghā khrish+lau /srisdogā ñdzan/lolngabe+etshim/ sa rmāji ldi rnashāshāhūṃshāce)sh+lau shā smi ṭ+wāṃ sh+lau/sa cha zlodu sdid maskyanu/3loram̐ kau ram̐zlo sna sbyiram̐ṭā bya dgaldu ༷rnyi/'u zha'opo/ (7oṃ3 1955—hūṃkrung go'i deng rabs kyi srid don dpyad brjod sprajin dang rig gnas dpyad brdzaḍi2 mkhan / brtsams chas〈'dam ga' dgag sgrub〉dang rgyu 'bras la rdzun bshad pa' ma rags〉sags 'dug

dang na dang ra 'debs/(sta)gon byed bzhin 'dug yin na yang kho tshos pha mes kyi rkang lam phra mo de bshig dgos don ci yin nam/lta tshul 'di 'dra yod mkhan ni dra grogs mdung lags kho na ma yin par phyi sdod bod mi'i khrod na'ang yod pa red/ dper na/ hor gtsang 'jigs med lags kyi〈〈khrag thigs las skyes pa'i ljang myugad deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig dang de'i rgyab ljongs〉zhes par yang gong gi lta tshul 'di dang cha 'dra ba brjod 'dug don grub rgyal lags kyis 'u cag la bstsal pa'i gdams ngag ni‘‘pha mas sprad pa'i mgo bo mthon po de gzhan gyi rkang 'og tu mi 'jog pa dang / kha ba can gyi la rgya'i dpung ba de gzhan gyi mgo thog tu bsgrengs’’dgos pa 'di yin na'ang / 'u cag gis phyir 'khor te khong gi mi tshe la sdom tshig bkod pa ni‘‘srol rgyun gyi rkang lam phra mo bshig mkhan’’dang / ‘‘chos lugs dang srol rgyun gyi 'du shes rnams rbad de spong mkhan’’red/ don dngos su rang re'i‘‘rkang lam phra mo’’bshig mkhan dang / yang na‘‘rig gsar’’gyi rlung 'tshub phyogs bzhir ldang ba'i skabs su lag tu 'jor thogs nas lha khang 'du khang bshig mkhan dang / lag tu sta re bzung nas lha sku dum bur gsil mkhan/ lag tu dbyug pa phyar te rang gi pha ma dang dge rgan la 'thab rtsod byed mkhan/ dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas te chos dpe me la sreg mkhan/ rang gi khe phan bsam nas nang mi lkog zhu byed — 53 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/mkhan sogs kyi‘‘gtor bshig pa’’ni gzhan ma yin par rang re'i spun zla dag red/ 'di'i skor ni rgya'i na gzhonarang dbang shes yon can wang li zhungarjolags kyis brtsams pa'i〈bya pi/tor/ bod kyi las dbang〉dang / bud med mdzangs ma 'od zer lags kyis brtsams pa'i〈gsar brje〉gnyis su gsal por bkod 'dug khyad par du〈gsar brje〉ru 'khod pa'i skabs thog de'i 'dra par de dag mthong thengs rer kho bo'i sems la rang dbang med par tsag shad bar med du rgyug 'ong / klog po lags/ khom long re byung tshe khyed kyis kyang gong gi dpe deb 'di gnyis la gzigs dang / klog po khyed la'ang sha gseng rus gseng nas tsag shad yang yang rgyug srid/'jar man gyi hi thi liradu gyis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs su ya hu dā pa khri drug brgya lhag dmar gsod btang ba'i byas nyes de ni hi thi lir 'dus pa'i 'jar man pa yod tshad kyi nag nyes shig red la/ krung go'i‘‘rig gsar’’gyi lo bcu'i ya nga ba'i chag 'jig gi byas nyes de ni rlabs chen gtso 'dzin the ba'i krung go pa yongs kyi nag nyes shig red/ de bzhin du 'u cag gi‘‘rig gsar’’skabs kyi‘‘gtor gtoradhi/ bosding kyinā nāng da /batrīrdothegardo 'a1dzolha3—)krung go'i deng rabs kyi rtsom mkhan dang / mkhas pa/ brtsams chos〈bya gnyis hā sloṣ+ṭṛ 4khrisnar//(sa5spyo/0dz+raspyo71889—1945)na tsi 'jar man gyi mgo gtso/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen — 54 —

dang dang spur 'debs/bshig’’gi byas nyes de yang rang re bod mi yongs kyi nag nyes shig yin pa red/ de ltar smra ba'i rgyu mtshan ni thun mong gis nag nyes bzos shing byas nyes kyi 'gan 'khri de thun mong la yod pas so/ /a ri'i bud med chab srid mkhas pa han na' a ren tidulags kyi dgongs pa ltar na/lo rgyus kyi byas nyes 'di lta bu byung don ni spyi tshogs yongs la dpyod shes kyi bsam gzhig dang dgag sgrub kyi 'du shes med pa dang / yang na thun mong gis 'gog rgol ma byas pas lan par 'dod/ des na lo rgyus phyir rtog ces pa de yang 'gan 'khri'i phyir rtog cig yin zhing / byas nyes de'i 'gan 'khri la phyir rtog byed pa'i tshe na thun mong gi 'gan 'khri la phyir rtog byed dgos pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis kho bos kyang‘‘'u cag la nag nyes yod/ 'u cag gis 'gyod bshags byed’’ces brjod pa yin/7 dra grogs dpyi sa dpal bzang lags na de/ kho(don grub rgyal)shi song ba ni bod pa tshang la dgra bo zhig tshar bcad pa red/'u cag gi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khor yug 'di'i nang du dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal lta bu'i mi bu shes rab can dang /mi bu snying stobs can/ mi bu dpa' gdeng can/ mi bu bsam blo can ni lta ba log par rtsi ba red/ bstan bshig tu rtsi ba red/ dgra bor pa'im① tshonakāswā rnyi nāspya nā/ṭ+wāṃgahūṃsprabaṃbe+edzildispyahūṃkhubaṭāskyiphroṃḍā rtsaṣā& 1906—1975)a me ri kha'i chab srid rig /bathag / than/ bkathag sgyub//duthag ———— /5/) ————

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rtsi ba red/ yang na dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal lta bu ni 'u cag gi srol rgyun rig gnas la mtshon na tshar gcad yul dang /'bur 'joms bya yul/ bsgral bya yin pa red/ dge 'dun chos 'phel ni skabs de'i dbang 'dzin pas khri mun du bcug ste mnar gcod yang yang btang mthar mi yul nas bskrad pa dang / don grub rgyal ni rang rigs rnams rmongs gnyid las sad du 'jug phyir rang gi gces pa'i tshe srog blos btang ba red/ khong gnyis 'jig rten mi yul nas btsan gyis bskrad pa'i nag nyes de rang re bod pa tshang ma'i steng du yod pa red/ de bas dra grogs dpyi sa dpal bzang lags ltar du‘‘kho shi song ba ni bod pa tshang la dgra bo zhig tshar bcad pa red’’ces dga' ba'i thal mo rdeb rgyu ma yin par/ 'u cag gis nyes dmigs de la ngos zin nas 'gyod bshags yang yang byed pa dang / rang sems la tsha 'dri yang yang gtong dgos pa red/ nag nyes ngos len pa'i snying stobs dang nag nyes la 'gyod bshags byed pa'i snying stobs 'di 'u cag la ha cang mkho gal che zhing / snying stobs de lta bu rgyud la skyes tshe ma 'ongs par 'u cag la skyo gar dang chabasna 'jig de 'dra mi 'byung bar shin tu phan pa yod pas na/ nga tshos 'di da 'gyod bshags snying stobs rgyang 'bod byed pa yin no/ /2006lo'i zla10pa'i tshes31—zla11pa'i tshes6nyin lan gru ru/— 56 —

da 'a na chos 'phel dang〈 sar 'a ra me long〉dge 'dun chos 'phel dang〈gsar 'gyur me long〉〉1dge 'dun chos 'phel khong rgya gar du bzhugs dus〈gsar 'gyur me long〉〉steng du rgyun par rtsom yig spel gyin yod pa red/ 〈gsar 'gyur me long〉ni bha bu mthar phyin lags kyis rgya gar ka blon sbug tu gnyer ba'i bod yig gsar shog thog ma yin zhing spyi lo1926lor gsar du bton// dge chos dang bha bu mthar phyin gnyis ni grogs po yin pa dang / ‘‘gsar 'gyur spel ba po’’zhig yin pa'i cha nas bha bu mthar phyin lags kyis dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi‘‘gsar 'gyur’’gyi rin thang de rtogs shing khong la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen yang gang mang bskrun pa red/des mi tshad dge chos lags kyis kyang bha bu mthar phyin lags la rogs skyor gyi tshul gyis〈gsar 'gyur me long〉du dus yun thung thung zhig gi ring la bya ba'ang bsgrubs pa red/ dge chos lags kyis da dung〈bha bu mthar phyin lags la gnang ba'i ka bshad〉ces pa zhig〈gsar 'gyur me long〉steng du spel te/ rtsom de ru‘‘ka ma la ltar dag pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /kha ba can du gsar 'gyur spel ba po/ /ga bur 'od la 'gran

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/pa'i lhag bsam can/ /nga yi mdza' ba'i grogs po mthar de phyin’’duzhes khong gi grogs po bha bu mthar phyin lags la bsngags brjod kyang mdzad 'dugadage chos lags rgya gar du bzhugs ring〈〈gsar 'gyur me long〉steng du rags rtsis byas na bsdoms pas rtsom yig bcu gcig spel 'dug ste/ de dag ni〈rgya gar mthong nas sngon med pa'i blo bskyed〉(1936lo)dang / 〈phal skad ka bshad〉(1936lo) 〈'jig rten ril mo'am zlum po〉(1937lo) 〈lha sa dang ra sa〉(1937lo) 〈〈bod kyi rgyal rabs gal chen〉(1938lo) 〈yul gyi ming dang mtshams brje tshul〉(1939lo) 〈rgya'i rgyal rabs thung dzun gang mu zhes bya bar sngar rgya bod gnyis kyi bar mna' bskyal tshul dang btsan po khri ral ba can gyi bzhugs sgar skor gsal ba las btus te mdo tsam brjod pa la〉(1943lo) 〈rgya bod mna' bskyal tshul dang gong ma'i rgyal sa bod kyis bzung tshul〉(1943lo) 〈bod kyi rgyal bo snga ba rnams kyi dus su bod kyi rgyal srid dar ba'i rtse mor son pa sogs kyi lo rgyus〉(1943lo) 〈bha bu mthar phyin lags la gnang ba'i ka bshad〉(lo tshigs mi gsal) 〈nga rgyal gyis tshad spar ba'i tshul〉 (lo tshigs mi gsal)bcas so/ /rtsom yig 'di dag spel bas dge 'dun chos 'phel dpeskruljatshadamyut+t+waṃs sdoṭīng dge 'tshang chos h+phisnrermi ñdza gsar+sha /dh+ra sagasungapa sdimagaklol rje rgyal gyis bsgrigs/ 'ang kang gyi ling — ——— 58 —sde // / 2002 khur :gu3 'o/ / 287 /

da 'a na chos 'phel dang〈 sar 'a ra me long〉lags kyi mkhas pa'i go sa yang rim gyis gtan 'khel byung ba dang mtshan snyan grags kyang je cher song / der brten/ dge chos ni deng rabs dpal yon gyi grub cha gtso shos gcig ste gsar lam lag char byas nas rang gi lta tshul gsar shog tu spel ba'i 'u cag gi mkhas pa thog ma'i gras yin pa red/2dge 'dun chos 'phel lags ni skabs der〈gsar 'gyur me long〉steng gi‘‘gsar 'gyur mi sna’’gtso bo zhig tu'ang gyur 'dug ste/gsar shog de'i steng du khong gi brtsams chos las ga'an khong gi gnas tshul kyang mang po 'khod 'dug pa red/ dper na/ 1947lo'i zla dang po'i tshes1nyin bton pa'i〈gsar 'gyur me long〉ang3pa'i steng du‘‘'di khul gnas tshul go thos byung bar/ bod gzhung mchog nas sba tshang lhod yangs gnang gshis dge 'dun chos 'phel la da dung do dam thog bka' zhib gnang gi yod skad thos’’zhes dang / yang1949lo'i zla5pa'i tshes1nyin bton pa'i〈gsar 'gyur me long〉steng du‘‘dge bshes dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog kyang rgya gar khul lo mang sku bzhugs thog sngar gyi chos 'byung mang po rtsad zhib dang / bod kyi rgyal rabs sogs kyang rgya dkar nag gi skad yig khag nas bsgyur phab sogs mkhyen rgya che stabs/ deng bod kyi rgyal rabs gsar rnying khag go bsdur gyis rgyal — 59 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rabs gsar pa zhig sgrig brtsam gyi zhabs 'degs su bsko gnang mdzad kyi yod skad’’ces 'khod 'dug pa lta bu'o/ /1951lo'i zla8pa'i tshes14nyin gyi phyi dro dge chos lags lha sar sku gshegs pa dang / nyin mo 'dir‘‘'dzam gling na dkon pa'i baiḍūr+ya'i bum pa’’zhig bod rang gis rdo la brdabs pa red/ 'di ni dge chos khong gi skyo gar zhig yin par ma zad/ 'u cag gi mi rigs kyi skyo gar chen po zhig kyang yin pa red/ dge chos lags mi yul nas btsan gyis bskrad pa'i nag nyes la 'u cag gis 'gyod bshags byed dgos shing /mi sger gyi ngos nas 'gyod bshags byed dgos pas mi tshad/ 'u cag bod mi yongs kyis 'gyod bshags byed dgos pa red/ dge chos lags sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul de1951lo'i zla12pa'i tshes1nyin bton pa'i〈gsar 'gyur me long〉ang9pa'i steng du spel don/ ‘‘phyi lo1947(1946lo)pa'i nang lho 'brug brgyud bod du phebs/ lo de ga'i nang bod gzhung nas don gnad ci zhig gi ched du do dam btson 'jug gnang’’zhes dang / ‘‘phyi nang rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun chos 'phel zhes mtshan snyan grags pa mchog gi sku gzugs bde min chus skyon gyis nye sngon zla8tshes15(tshes14)nyin sku tshe las 'das song ba'i gnas tshul mi snyan pa thos pa shin tu nas kyang yid skyo ba'i rang bzhin du gyur’’zhes 'khod 'dug pa red/ lhag par du — 60 —

da 'dun chos 'apel dang〈gsar 'gyur me long〉dge chos khong lha sar btson 'jug gnang ba'i skabs su〈gsar 'gyur me long〉du〈gal che gal che/ ya mtshan ya mtshan/ brtag dpyad brtag dpyad/ mgyogs po mgyogs po〉zhes pa spel te don rkyen 'di shin tu gal che ba'i tshul gyis der do snang chen po byas 'dugadage chos lags kyi brtsams chos dang khong gi skor gyi gnas tshul mang po zhig〈gsar 'gyur me long〉steng du spel ba 'dis khong ni skabs de'i mi sna skad grags can zhig yin pa dang / gsar shog gis mtshon pa'i deng rabs rig gnas la ha cang 'brel 'dris che ba'i mkhas pa zhig kyang yin pa mtshon 'dug snyam/3dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyis dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs/ sum cu pa'i nang du‘‘shog bu'i gsar lam’’ste gsar shog dang dus deb sogs kyi gal chen rang bzhin dang de'i rin thang la ngos zin gas la po zhig thob 'dug par snyam ste/ khong gis〈gsar 'gyur me long〉steng snga phyir brtsams chos skor zhig spel bar ma zad/ da dung dus yu/na thung ngu zhig la〈gsar 'gyur me long〉rtsom sgrig gi bya ba yang bsgrubs pa red/shes yon can zhig la mtshon na gsar shog dang dus deb bsgrub rgyu ni ha cang gal che zhing / rang gi bsam blo smyug rtser ci dgar bsgyur pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas dang spyi tshogs mthong ba'i‘‘me longari’yang bzo — 61 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dgos pa red/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i u ru su la mtshon na shes yon can mang po zhig thad kar du dus deb bsgrubs pa'i bya bar zhugs myong ste/ dper na/ pe lin si khe yis〈mes rgyal gyi bya ba'i zin bris〉bsgrubs pa dang / chir nis zhe h+phi si khedudang ne khi ra so h+phiduganyis kyis〈deng rabs kyi mi〉bsgrubs pa lta bu red/ rgya nag lta bur mtshon na yang‘lnga bzhi’’las 'gul gyi snga gzhugye/ tu khren tu'u zhi'ududang hu'u hri①lu'u zhun sogs kyis〈na gzhon gsar pa〉dang / 〈rlabs gsar〉〈deng rabs dpyad brjod〉sogs gtso gnyer byas te skabs de'i spyi tshogs la shugs rkyen mi chung ba bzos shing phan pa rgya cher bskrun/gsar shog dang dus deb kyi dge mtshan che shos gcig ni/ ngas bltas na skabs de'i rig gnas dang spyi tshogs mthong ba'i‘me long’’yin pa las gzhan mi bu'i smra brjod la‘gar stegs’’chen po zhig bskrun yod pa de red/ de bas skabs don gsar 'gyur yin na 'dra/ spyi tshogs snang tshul yin na 'dra/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yin na 'dra/ bsam blo ris/ gnas yin na 'dra/ brda 'phrin de rigs gsar shog dang dus deb brje sprahā gasgrit+yāspyisnashesngah+phispyidak+to//khobahāmanywarmirjir+ghaṃri/stu'usnru/ ji sgot+na/sgophroṃḍāsh+lau choshā8ṭāzhe 1haṃsdo 9phresna 〉nywa da kaud+me ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭī rdosnrukhi ṭ+wāṃt+t+waṃ two sgro/ pye/sa ༵spya~X6gādu ༵dra rjermi ṭ+wā1ṭ+wāgasdu 8༵snyispra187la u ru su'i snyan ngag mkhan/ brtsams du khrenatu'uzhi'u/ aspyortsakhre1879dge19shā2)krung skyu rik+ta gnasapa sar pyu'i las 'gul slong mkhan/ rtsom rig gzhung phyigasamasan+t+ra/ baṭ+wākau 1༵91na tusngi 62lta kru sprak+ṣiṃ desrarasprusnguṭ+wāmakākāpaldiswārārmirmiblomakhan brtsamasachosasgam dkye~X sprang za/nga dbang gas 'duṅka /
