da 'a na chos 'phel dang〈 sar 'a ra me long〉〉brgyud de klog pa po la khyab spel byas pa yin na da gzod spyi chogs la tshobyed nus 'dom/ thub pa red/the/satshoyon can dang gsar shog dus deb gnyis kyi bar la 'brel ba zab mo zhig mchis la/ shes yon can zhig gis spyi tshogs la 'gan khur min de yang tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas gsar shog dus deb cig gnyer min la rag las 'dug pa red/ de ni gong du brjod pa'e u ru su dang rgya nag gi shes yo/na can de dag gi steng nas nges shes 'drongs/ thub pa yin/ dge chos lags kyis rang ngos nas thad kar du gsar shog dus deb bsgrubs med na'ang / khong gis〈gsar 'gyur me 'o/nga〉steng bcoms chos spel ba dang gsar shog de sgrub rogs byaru/ pa des kho/ nga nyid ni 'u cag gi gsar shog dus deb kyi rin thang thog mar rtogs mkhan dang / yang na gsar shog dus deb kyis mtshon pa'i smra brjod stobs shugs kyis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded kyi nus pa 'don gyi yod par yid ches byed mkhan thog ma yin par 'dod/gsham du cha 'jog rang bzhin gyi tshig 'gas rtsom thung 'di mjug bsdu bar bya ste/ ga'/ te dge chos khong phyir bod yul du log med par rgya gar nas〈gsar 'gyur me long〉gtso sgrub mdzad yod tshe/ gal te 'u cag gis khong 'jig rten mi yul nas ma bskrad par khong la lha sa nas〈gsar 'gyur me long〉〉lta bu'i gsar shog cig gsar du 'don nga/'i — 63 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/mthun rkyen bskrun yod tshe/ gal te 'u cag la dge chos lta bu'i mig rgyang ring zhing mno bsam thongs pa'i shes yo/na can kha shas yo da tshe/gal te kho bo ni rgyun du 'di lta bu'i bsam gzhig gi klong du 'thim 'gro'o/ /(gsal bshad/ rtsom thung 'di las 'byung ba'i〈gsar 'gyur me long〉steng gi lung rnams kirti blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis rtsom sgrig byas pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rab byed zhabs btags ma〉las drangs pa yin)2006lo'i zla12pa'i tshes21nyin lan gru ru/

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/be+eḍūr+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/da wadabe/ 'dun chos 'phel mchog 'jig rten mi yul dang zhal gyes rjes phyi rabs pa rnams kyis rim bzhin khong gi mdzad dgongs rgyus lon byung ba'i zin tho/dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog ni spyi lo1903lo'i hor zla3pa'i tshes23nyin mdo smad reb gong zho 'ong dpyi ru sku 'khrungs shing /1909lor g.ya' ma bkra shis 'khyil dgon par slob gnyer gnang bar phebs/ 1921lor mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer gnang bar phebs/ 1927lor dbus gtsang du phebs te 'bras spungs dgon pa'i sgo mang grwa tshang gi klu 'bum khams tshan du slob gnyer gnang /1934lor rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ra hu ladulags kyis gdan drangs pa ltar rgya gar du phebs/ lo ngo12ring gi rgyal khams 'grims pa'i kyag kyog gi lam bu ring mo de 'di nas 'go tshugs/ 1946lor phyir lha sar phebs/1947lor bka' shag srid gzhung gis 'dzin bzung byas te khri mun du bcug 1950lor btson nas phyung / 1951lo'i hor zla8pa'i tshes14nyin grong khyer lha sa'i dga' ru shag gi yang steng du sku gshegs/skabs der dgung lo49las son med/ gsung rtsom la〈rgyal khams rnam/sdonas ṭā ñdzu sna/ spradzi/r+sātsho1ri93—1963)rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang mkhas pa/ brtsams chos 〈ra hu la'i rang —65—

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rigs pas bskor ba'i gtam rgyud gser gyi thang ma〉dang / 〈deb ther dkar po〉〈klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉〉〈'dod pa'i bstan bcos〉sogs yod pa red/ khong la bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma rnams la mi ldan pa'i lhad med kyi mi gzhi dang / dogs slong gi snying stobs/ dgag sgrub kyi blo spobs sogs ldan par ma zad/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi gces nor du grub pa'i rang dbang gi bsam blo dang mang gtso'i dgongs pa dang tshan rig gi lta ba bcas kyang ldan pas/ khong ni bod kyi mi chos rig gnas kyi dung mo che 'bud mkhan dang blo 'byed bsam blo mkhan rma med cig yin pa red/ khong gi steng nas 'u cag gis ser mo pad rig gnas pa——shes yon can bcas kyi rtogs pa'i rab 'bring tha gsum gyi 'phel rim de gsal por mthong thub cing / khong gi steng nas 'u cag gis shes yond snying stobasad kun spyod bcas rig pa'i mi bo che rnams kyis lo rgyus dang dus rabs la skul 'ded gtong ba'i sgul shugs gtso bo ste 'jig rten pa'i theg chen gyi lam de rtogs thub pa yin/rtsom yig 'di ru gtso bo smyug thogs pas rang nyid kyis rgyus lon byung ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rnams gzhir bzung ste/ dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog 'jig rten mi yul dang zhal gyes rjes phyi rabs pa rnams kyis khong gi ‘‘snang brnyan’’de ji ltar ngos/ zin byung ba dang /lhag par du shes yon can gyi sde yis‘‘dge chos snying stobs’’de ji ltar bhe 66 ge

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/rgyus lon byung ba'i go rim de ngo sprod rags bsdus shig byed par 'dod/rtsom 'di lta bu zhig 'bri ba'i dmigs yul yang‘‘dge chos snying stobs’’de dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i rang mi rigs kyi mi chos rig gnas 'dzugs skrun thad kyi bsam blo dang rig gnas dang kun spyod sogs kyi bsam blo'i thon khungs gtos che ba zhig tu 'gyur bar snying nas re ba lags/1956—1957lor/rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho lagye/sa kyis〈klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉〉gyi dgag lan du〈klu sgrub dgongs rgyan la che long du brtags pa mi 'jigs sergo'i nga ro〉zhes pa mdzad/ ljags rtsom 'di1984lo'i zla12par mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rtsom〉pod gsum pa ru bkod 'dug1972lor/rgan po shes rab rgya mtsho lags kyis〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus bzhugs so〉(si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis1988lo'i zla dang por par du bskrun pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉zhes pa'i sngon 'gro ru gsal)zhes pa bris/1980lor/raka ra bkras mthong thub bstan chos dar lags kyis brtsams pa'i— 67 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/〈〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rnam thar〉zhes pa rgya gar du par du bskrun/dpe deb 'di ni bod yig gis bris pa'i dge chos kyi rnam thar thog ma red/1982lor/tshe tan zhabs drung lags kyis mdzad pa'i〈deb dkar du 'gos lor skyon bstan pa mi 'jug pa'i dpyad pa〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i khong gi〈bstan rtsis kun btus〉zhes par bkod 'dug1983lor/dge chos khong gi slob ma hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar lags kyis〈mkhas mchog dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dag pa'i snang ba〉(thog mar〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉1983lo'i deb2pa'i steng spel ba dang / rjes su bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis1987lo'i zla6par par du bskrun pa'i〈bod rig pa'i gros mol tshogs 'du'i ched rtsom gces bsdus〉zhes par bkod 'dug)brtsams pa dang / rtsom 'di le'u dang po a mdo'i yul du 'khrungs nas bod du phebs pa sogs kyi mdzad pa che long tsam zhu rgyu'i skor dang / le'u gnyis pa rgya gar dang sing ga la'i yu/la du byon nas slob gnyer gnang ba'i skor/ le'u gsum pa〈deb ther dkar po〉'bri rtsom gnang ba'i skor/ le'u bzhi pa btsan rgyal — 68 —

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/ring lugs pa dang bka' shag ngan sbrel gyis ma nyes kha yo/ga bkal ba'i skor/ le'u lnga pa mjug bsdu'i gtam bcas kyis grub 'dug rtsom 'di ni dge chos khong gi mi tshe la 'ib 'jug byed par don snying gal chen ldan/kirti blo bzang bstan 'dzin lags kyis phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rab byed〉ces pa rgya gar du par du bskru na/1984lor/li yi'u dbyirdzuyis bris pa'i〈bod kyi lo rgyus mkhas can dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus〉zhes pa〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉1984lo'i deb4pa'i steng spel/ rtsom pa pos dge chos mchog ni rgyal gces ring lugs pa dang / mang gtso ring lugs pa/ dngos gtso ring lugs pa zhig yin par brjod 'dug1985lor/ h+pha ran si'i mdzangs ma his thir②lags kyis〈a mdo'i sprang gog〉(〈'dzam gling na dkon pa'i be+eḍūr+ya'i bum pa zhig rdo la brdabs tshul〉)gas nga trim rmitrīsbi snrusdi/4rtswak+ko 8 byesna12—)krung go'i deng rabs kyi bod rig pa rme khan/ brtsams chos li yi'u dbyi yi sdo'i② rgasasbrir/ 5khuskurdu6khudz+ra tshicho 9—hā)h+pha ran si'i bod rig pa'i bud med mkhas pa/ bcoms chos 〈a ma ra sprang ga gas 'dug da 69 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ces pa h+pha ran si nas si ra du bskrun/ deb 'di'i rgya 'gyur tu'u yung pinadhilags kyis bsgyur yod skad mod/ 'on kyang nga/ lta'i b.rapar skrun byung med/1986lor/hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar lags kyis bris pa'i〈mkhas pa'i dbang po dge 'dun chos 'phel rgya gar du byon skabs kyi gnas tshul rags tsam brjod pa〉zhes/ pa〈sbrang char〉sta1986lo'i deb4pa'i steng spel/1988lor/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsu nga rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉dngos su par skrun 'grem spel byas/de nas bzung dge chos mchog gi phyag rtsom ni rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi bsam pa'i bgo skal du gyur/1989lor/mkha' 'bum bkra shis kyis bris pa'i〈rje shes rab rgya mtsho dang dge 'dun chos 'phel rnam gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i skor〉zhes pa〈sbrang char〉1989lo'i deb3pa'i steng spel/1990lor/byeshumy-ibosdo skyi rnyidā gho pa/ ji ༈shādze+eshu rnodze+edṛ rbephresdiju hūṃlha ṣ+pe dū ñtsāsnas ḍā bo r+sha ༵k+tazlo /mi da/ge zlot+t+waṃsna spya nākāsnu n+t+ra t+nasnra thard gadhi ༵dug

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i cho/ra nyams ngo zin tshu' bod ljongs bod yis/ dpe rnying dade skrun ba/ nga gis hor khang bso da na/mas ngang r+ṣapre 'bar la gas kyir phyogre/sa bsgrigs byas pa'i〈dbe 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom〉pod gsum gyi bdag nyid can de dngos su par skrun 'grem spel byas/ 'di ni dge chos zhib 'jug khrod kyi ches dga' 'os pa'i bya gzhag bla med cig go/mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyis bris pa'i〈〈deb ther dkar po〉las srong btsan sgam/ po'i lo tshigs/ thad kyi dogs snang 'ga' 'a/ dpyad nga 〉'e/sa pa〈sbrang char〉1990lo'i deb2pa'i steng spel/1991lon/chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs dang nor brang o rgyan lags gnyis kyis rtsom sgrig byas pa'i〈bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu yi phreng ba〉(bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / 1991lo'i zla3pa'i par)yi smad cha ru〈nye dus kyi mkhas pa'i ded dpon dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus〉zhes pa'i rtsom ring mo zhig bris 'duga'abrong bu tshe ring rdo rjes bris pa'irdo 〈gangs can rig pa'i gling gi bsam blo pa chen po bcu ngo sprod mdor bsdus〉(〈bod ljongs 'ib 'jug〉1991lo'i deb4pa)zhes par〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi‘‘tha snyad tshad mas stong pa'i’’dgongs pa〉〉zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig 'dug pa dang / rtsom pa pos dge chos mchog gangs can rig pa'i gling gi bsam blo mkhan chen po — 71 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bcu'i gras su bgrangs 'dug1992lor/sha bo tshe ring gis bris pa'i rab 'byams pa'i dpyad rtsom〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel dang khong gi snyan rtsom bshad pa lhag bsam 'o ma'i rdzing bu〉zhes pa de〈bod kyi shes rig dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉(krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang / 1992lo'i zla11pa'i par)deb gsum pa ru bkod 'dug rtsom pa pos dge chos khong gi mi tshe gang bo'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang snyan rtsom gyi bsam blo'i rang bzhi/na dang snyan rtsom gyi sgyu col rang bzhin bcas la dpyad pa btang ba gnad du things shing dpyad gzhi'i rin thang yang nges can zhig ldan/1994lor/sangs rgyas don grub kyis bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi snyan rtsom gyi sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs rags tsam bshad pa〉zhes pa〈mtsho sngon slob gso〉1994lo'i deb2pa'i steng spel/1995lor/sbyin pa dar rgyas kyis bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdo khams smad du bzhag pa'i mdzad rjes rnam thar mdor bsdus〉zhes pa〈gangs ljongs rig gnas〉1995lo'i deb dang po'i steng spel/— 72 —

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin chul/bu bzhi bsam pa'i don grub kyis bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug skor rags tsam gleng ba〉zhes pa〈〈krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉1995lo'i deb2pa'i steng spel/ rtsom pa pos mi'i rin thang gi lta ba dang / zhib 'jug byed thabs dang rigs lam gnyis kyi thad nas dpyad pa btang 'dugarin chen rgya mtshos bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi snyan rtsom las tshor 'du mtshon pa'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin cung tsam gleng ba〉zhes pa〈rtser snyeg〉1995lo'i deb2pa'i steng spel/ko do mkhan pos bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi mi tshe hril bo'i nang du gnad che sa 'ga' bshad pa ge sar gyi mda' mo〉zhes pa〈〈gangs ljongs gtsug lag〉1995lo'i dus deb 'phar ma 'i steng spel/1996lor/skal bzang chos 'phel lags kyis rgya yig tu bsgyur pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉zhes pa krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis par skrun 'grem spel byas/chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs lags kyis bris pa'i〈mkhas pa'i dbang po dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus〉zhes pa〈krung go'i bod ljongs〉1996lo'i deb4pa'i steng spel/ rtsom gyi zur du dge — 73 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/chos mchog sku gshegs khar bskyon pa'i sku par zhig kyang bkod 'dug pa dang / sku par de ni shin tu rtsa chen zhig yin pa red/1997lor/rdo rje rgyal lags kyis brtsams pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel〉〉zhes/ pa kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun 'grem spel byas /deb 'di'i zur bkod du〈bod chen po'i srid lugs dang 'brel ba'i rgyal rabs deb ther dkar po'i gzhung gi dka' gnad zin bris pad dkar chun 'phangs〉zhes pa bkod 'dugachu skyes dge 'dun bsam gtan lags kyis bsgrigs pa'i〈los smra'i tshang tshing sreg pa'i lung rigs rdo rje me lce〉zhes pa kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun 'grem spel byas/ deb 'dir dge chos kyi〈〈klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉la dgag sgrub byed pa'i dpyad rtsom bzhi bsdus 'dug pa dang / dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo lags kyis〈'go brjong/ li shi'i me tog〉ces pa bris te dge chos mchog la ches mi 'os pa'i mi gzhi dma' 'beb mang tsam byas 'dugabasod nams rdo rjes bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge chos kyi lo tsā'i dpyad gtam skor la rags tsam dpyad pa〉〉 zhes pa 〈 rtser snyeg〉1997lo'i deb dang po'i steng spel/1998lor/— 74 —

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/chos 'tsho yis bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi snyan rtsom gyi khyad chos gleng ba〉〉zhes pa〈mtsho sngon slob gso〉1998lo'i deb3pa'i steng sngege95//1999lor/hor gtsang 'jigs med kyis brtsams pa'i〈drang bden gyis bslus pa'i slong mo bad mdo smad pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi mi tshe dpyad brjod〉ces pa rgya gar du par du bskrun/tshe dbang thar gyis bris pa'i〈dge chos kyi lo rgyus 'ib bsdur gyi zhib 'jug rigs lam skor rags tsam gleng ba〉zhes pa〈〈mtsho sngon slob gso〉1999lo'i deb dang po'i steng spel/khyung phrug blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bris pa'i〈〈gtam rgyud gser gyi thang ma'i zin tho dge chos dgongs rgyan〉dang〈klu sgrub dgongs rgyan gyi snying po tshigs su bcad pa'i dka' gnas rdo rje tshig dgrol〉〈zab mo dbu ma'i bsnyel zin byams brtse 'o ma'i bsang gtor〉〉zhes pa de kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈bod rig pa'i dpyad gleng grog chu phra mo'i stangs stabs〉zhes par bkod 'dug2000lor/tu'u yung pin lags kyis brtsams pa'i rgya yig gi〈dus rabs nyi shu pa'i bod kyi ser mo pa ngo mtshar can—mi tshul ring lugs kyi sngon skyod — 75 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/pa mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rnam thar〉zhes pa krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis par skrun 'grem spel byas/ deb 'di ni rgyal nang gi dge chos zhib 'jug skor gyi rigs gzhung ched deb dang po yin 'dug pa dang / dge chos mchog la sgo kun nas zhib 'jug mdzad pa'i grub 'bras ches legs shos kyang red/tshe ring dbang rgyal dang lcang zhabs pa 'gyur med tshe dbang gnyis kyis brtsams pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel skor la dpyad pa tshangs pa'i drang thig〉ces pa si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun 'grem spel byas/a sngags tshe ring bkra shis kyis bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug las 'phros pa'i gtam dpyid kyi pho nya'i mgrin dbyangs〉zhes pa〈nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i rig gzhung dus deb〉2000lo'i deb dang po'i steng spel/sgang rgyal mtshan tshe ring gis bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis yu la srol goms gshis la do snang mdzad pa'i skor mdo tsam gleng ba〉zhes pa〈dung ri〉2000lo'i deb dang po'i steng spel/sha bo khyi thar dang sha mo mchog gnyis kyis bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi ri mo'i sgyu rtsal skor rags tsam gleng ba〉zhes pa〈rtser snyeg〉2000lo'i deb3pa'i steng spel/— 76 sdi

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/dar rgyas kyis bris/ pa'i〈〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang khong gi brtsams chos 'ga'i dpyad brjod〉 ces pa 〈 mtsho sngon slob gso〉2000lo'i deb5pa'i steng spel/2001lon/raka ra bkras mthong thub bstan chos dar lags kyis brtsams pa'i〈rgyal rabs deb ther dkar po'i kha skong mes blon gong ma'i 'al chems〉〉zhes pa rgya gar du par du bskrun/lcang skya dge 'dun bkra shis kyis bris pa'i〈〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi snyan ngag gi rtsom rtsal skor cung zad gleng ba〉zhes pa〈shegangs ljongs rig gnas〉2001lo'i deb2pa'i steng spel/gcod pa klu rgyal gyis bris pa'i〈bod kyi mtshan nyid smra pa'i snyan ngag mkhan dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gi snyan ngag gi bsam blo'i skor thog mar dpyad pa〉〉zhes pa〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉2001lo'i deb3pa'i steng spel/ rtsom pa pos dge chos mchog gi snyan ngag de mi tshul gyi bsam blo dang blo 'byed kyi bsam blo gnyis kyi thad nas dpyad pa btang 'dugabya mdo don grub tshe ring gis bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi dungs brjod snyan ngag〈btson nas blangs pa'i mgur〉〉zhes pa〈gangs rgyan me tog〉2001lo'i deb3pa'i steng spel/ge 77 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/be'u brgya tshe ring bsam 'grub kyis bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang bud med tsho'i las dbang〉zhes pa〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉2001lo'i zla11pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos4pa'i steng spel/mtsho sngon yul shul du‘‘mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel sku gshegs nas bgrang bya lnga bcu lon par(1951—2001)rjes dran gyi snyan ngag gyer 'don tshogs 'du’’'tshogs pa dang / 〈'dzam gling na dkon pa'i baiḍūr+ya'i bum pa〉zhes pa'i rjes dran gyi snyan ngag gi deb chung zhig kyang par du bskrun 'dug2002lor/rdo rje rgyal lags kyis sdud sgrig byas pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dune chos 'phel gyi gsar rnyed gsung rtsom〉zhes pa zhang kang gyi ling dpe skrun tshad yod kung zis par skrun 'grem spel byas/ deb 'dir〈'dzam gling rgyas bshad〉dang〈rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du nang ba'i mchod rten dang gnas mchog byin can rnams kyi bshad pa〉〈btson nas hor khang la gnang ba'i phyag bris〉〈bha bu mthar phyin lags la gnang ba'i ka bshad〉sogs sngar mthong ma myong ba'i gsung rtsom dag bsdus 'dug la/gzhan yang dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gi phyag bris bstar ma sna tshogs kyang bsdus 'dugame lces bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang‘‘ngo log pa'i’’— 78 —

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i ra nyams ngo zin chul/mdzad spyod〉ces pa〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉2002lo'i zla dang po'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos4pa'i steng spel/me lces bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel skor gyi dran rtog thor bu〉(dang po)zhes pa〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉2002lo'i zla7pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos4pa'i steng spel/gcod pa klu rgyal gyis bris pa'i〈〈dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gi snyan ngag sgyu rtsal skor rags trem gleng ba〉zhes pa〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉2002lo'i zla8pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos4pa'i steng sngege95/me lces bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel skor gyi dran rtog thor bu〉(gnyis pa) zhes pa〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉〉2002lo'i zla10pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos4pa'i steng spel/chu skyes dge 'dun bsam gtan gyis bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge chos rin po che'i dungs zhen las 'phros pa'i mdzad rjes rags tsam gleng ba〉zhes pa〈〈mtsho sngon dge thon slob chen mi rigs dge thon slob gling gi rig gzhung dus deb〉2002lo'i deb2pa'i steng spel/2003lor/nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi dmangs khrod kyi nang khul dus deb〈shar dung ri〉yi steng dge chos mchog sku 'khrungs nas lo 'khor brgya — 79 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/lon pa'i rjes dran du ched bsgrigs le tshan zhig spel ba dang / le tshan de ru de ga'i rtsom sgrig khang nas bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gi lo tshigs lo rgyus rags bsdus(1903—1951)〉zhes pa dang / me lces bris pa'i〈'dzam gling na dkon pa'i baiḍūr+ya'i bum pa—dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog sku 'khrungs nas lo 'khor brgya lon par ched du bris pa〉dang / gzi mig gis bris pa'i〈yang yang dran 'osad mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi bsam blo'i snying stobs la 'khyug tsam lta ba〉〉 chu skyes dge 'dun bsam gtan gyis bris pa'i〈rigs pa'i seṅge saṃgha dharmar bsngags pa'i mi zad gsang ba'i 'gyur khug〉bcas bkod 'dugazla10pa'i tshes24nyin/ pe cin du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyis‘‘mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog sku 'khrungs nas lo 'khor brgya lon par rjes dran zhu ba'i rigs gzhung dpyad gleng gros tshogs’’bsdus/zla11pa'i tshes7—9nyin/ a me ri kha'i grong khyer ne'u yog nas‘‘la rtse’’dpe mdzod khang gis mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog sku 'khrungs nas lo 'khor brgya lon par ched du rjes dran gyi bgro gleng tshogs 'du bsdus pa dang / tshogs 'du'i steng rgyal spyi'i steng gi dge chos mchog dang 'brel ba yod pa'i khyim mi dang grogs po/ zhib 'jug pa/ khong gi ri mo dang phyag bris sogs gces nyar gnang yod mkhan gyi — 80 ge

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/mi sna sogs zhugs te/ rigs gzhung bgro gleng dang brtsams chos 'grem ston/ lo rgyus la phyir lta so/gas khyab che sa nas dge chos mchog la rjes dran byas/kirti blo bzang bstan 'dzin lags kyis sgrig rtsom byas pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rab byed zhabs btags mad mdo smad pa mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi ngag rgyun lo rgyus sogs dpyad ga'i'i yig cha phyogs bsgrigs〉zhes pa rgya gar du par du bskrun/pad ma dbang rgyal lags kyis bsgyur pa'i〈klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉gyi rgya 'gyur ma de mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun 'grem spel byas/a sngags tshe ring bkra shis kyis bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi bod kyi rig gnas 'dzugs skrun thad kyi bsam blo las 'phros pa'i gtam〉zhes pa de〈nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig sde khag tshugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu lon pa'i rig gzhung dpyad rtsom 〉(mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 2003lo'i zla3pa'i par) zhes par bkod 'dug pa dang / rtsom pa pos dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi bod kyi rig gnas 'dzugs skrun thad kyi bsam blo ni‘‘srol rgyun yod tshad la dogs slong yod pa'i sgos snyigs bcud dbye thog gzhan gyi rig pa dge mtshan can nang 'dren byas te rang nyid can du gyur par byed pa’’yin par brjod 'dug— 81 —

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/me lces bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel skor gyi dran rtog thor bu〉(gsum pa)zhes pa〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉2003lo'i zla12pa'i tshes20nyin gyi par ngos4pa'i steng spel/2004lor/rdo rje rgyal lags kyis brtsams pa'i〈'dzam gling dung zla dkar bo〉zhes pa zhang kang gyi ling dpe skrun tshad yod kung zis par skrun 'grem spel byas/ deb 'dir〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi mi tshe'i rin thang〉dang / 〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi mi tshe'i sdom tshig〉〈bod chen po'i srid lugs dang 'brel ba'i rgyal rabs deb ther dkar po'i kha skong deb ther dkar po zhabs btags ma〉sogs rtsom yig brgyad bsdus 'dug〈krung go'i bod rig pa〉rgya yig gi2004lo'i deb dang po'i steng dge chos mchog la rjes dran zhu ba'i ched sgrig le tshan zhig spel 'dug pa dang / le tshan de ru tu'u yung pin dang khrin chin dbyinadhisogs kyis bris pa'i rtsom yig lnga bkod 'dugasha bo khyi thar dang lha mgon tshe ring gnyis kyis bris pa'i〈sgyu rtsal mkhan po dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gi ri mo 'ga'i 'bri thabs dang mtshon stangs sko ra gleng ba〉zhes pa〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉2004lo'i deb3pa'i steng spel/gsaraljang/ḍābyuljinab nywan+dha/ts+tshasdo྾wī19lhatrī—tswakrud+dhi sdonā r+shazlo zloshusna kyi bod rig pa mkhan/ brtsams chosaṭ+wāṃthang yig —— —— / )shārti ———— rngasno khur rngasno sdog mun

be+e r+ya'i bum pa'i nor nyams ngo zin tshul/bkra shis kyis bris pa'i〈rdo la brdabs pa'i bum pa zhig〉ces pa〈khams pa'i bod yig tshags par〉〉2004lo'i zla12pa'i tshes14nyin gyi par ngos3pa'i steng spel/2005lor/me lces bris pa'i〈blo 'byed bsam blo'i ngos nas dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gleng ba〉zhes pa de yun nan mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i〈mi gzhi'i snying stobs〉(〈bdag dpe tshogs〉)zhes par bkod 'duga.a sngags tshe ring bkra shis kyis bris pa'i〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba la rags tsam dpyad pa〉〉zhes pa〈krung go'i bod rig pa〉2005lo'i deb2pa'i steng spel/me lces bris pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang bod kyi deng rabs spyi tshogs〉〉zhes pa de mi 'gyang bar par du bskrun pa'i〈khu sim khad kyis dkrog〉(bsam blo'i thol rtsom phyogs bsgrigs)ces par bkod yod/(gsal bshad/ smyug thogs pas dge chos skor gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rnams 'tshol ba'i go rim khrod du/ rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis da dung lag son ma byung ba'i rtsom yig mi nyung ba zhig yod srid pas/ mkhyen ldan klog pa po rnams kyis med pa kha skong dang dgongs 'char lhugs por gnang ba'i re ba zhu)2005lo'i zla7pa'i tshes7—24nyin zi ling du/— 83 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/2006lo'i dpe klog dang bris rtsom skor gyi zin bris thor bu/lo re re'i lo mjug tu bslebs tshe/ rang nyid kyi lo ngo gcig ring gi bya ba la spyi bsdoms thung thung zhig byas na 'grig ste/ lhag par du dpe cha pa zhig dang rtsom po zhig la mtshon na lo 'di'i nang rang gis bklags pa'i dpe cha dang bris pa'i rtsom yig skor zin tho ru bkod na de ni don snying ldan pa'i bya ba zhig ci la min/da lo'i rang gi dpe klog dang bris rtsom skor la phyi mig cig bltas na/ lo sngon ma dag dang bsdur tshe dpe klog dang bris rtsom nyis cha nas ha cang nyung drags pa'i tshor pa zhig 'gog min du skye/ spyir kho bos rang nyid la nges par du bklag dgos pa'i dpe tho zhig bris te dpe cha de rnams bklag pa'i 'char gzhi yo/da na'ang / bya ba'i las gnas spar ba sogs kyi dbang gis dus tshod mang po zhig 'gor 'gyangs byas pas dpe tho'i phyed ka la yang blta ma thub/ dpe char mang du blta ma thub pa dang bsam gzhig gnad smin gtong ma thub tshe rtsom la 'jug rgyu zer ba ni ngal ba'i rgyu kho nar zad/ de lta na'ang bya ba'i bar glegs nas dus — 84 —

2006lo'i dpe klog dang bris tsom lhur gyi zin bris thor bu/tshod btsan gyis‘‘btsir’’te gsham gyi dpe cha 'di dag bklags pa yin/dpe cha 'di dag las la shas shig zhib klog byas pa dang la shas shig bam klog byas pa yin/bod yig gi skor la/1 chos skyong gis brtsams pa'i〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉〉(kan su/'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi2006lo'i zla5pa'i par) deb de ni rang grol 'ib 'jug skor kyi ched deb thog ma yin 'dug la rang grol zhib 'jug spyir bshad pa dang / don grub rgyal gyi mi tshe/ brtsam sa chos kyi bshad pa/don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs bcas le'u bzhi yis grub 'dug dpal don grub rgyal la‘‘mi’’yi ngos thad nas zhib 'jug byas shing rnam thar brtsams pa ni dngos gnas rjes su yi rang byed dgos pa'i gnas su mthong / yin na'ang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs mnga' zhing rgyab gtod kyi 'du shes drag par ma zad/ mi tshe dpa' gdeng gis brtas pa'i‘‘don grub rgyal’’gyi snang brnyan gson po 'ig klog po'i spyan sngar du star thub mi 'dug2 hor gtsang 'jigs med kyis brtsams pa'i〈khrag thigs las skyes pa'i ljang myugad deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig dang de'i rgyab ljongs〉(2000lor rgya gar rda ram sa la nas par du bskrun) deb de ru spyi lo1980ge2000lo'i bar gyi bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor la dpyad pa spel — 85 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/grags can gnyis la bltas pa yin/ gcig ni h+phun 'a'o kangadugis 'khrab 'khrid byas pa'i〈mtshan mo'i gsol ston〉(〈ṣ+ṭhaṭ+wā〉)zhes pa dang /cig shos ni krang dbyi mo'u②yis 'khrab 'khrid byas pa'i〈1yālokhultozoṅge lto〉zhes pa de'o/ /glog brnyan 'di gnyis ni da lo'i rgya nang gi ches tsha 'ur che ba'i glog brnyan gnyis red/ bltas rjes kyi 'char snang ni‘‘gnam 'og gi 'i bde’’dang‘‘rgyal khab’’sogs kyi phyir du khrag gi rgya mtsho bskyil ba dang ro yi ri rab brtsigs chog chog yin la/ dbang sgyur pa zhig la mtshon na drag shugs(ṣā7)ni ha cang lugs mthun yin pa bstan 'dug ngo bo drag tsub can gyi chab srid sger gcod lam lugs la‘‘bstod glu’’phul zhing / mi bu yod tshad mgo sgur nywa lhom gyi sgal tshigs med pa can tag tag byed par bskul pa'i glog brnyan 'di lta bu sgor dung phyur mang pos phab skrun byas pa dang / de la'ang blta mkhan mang pos dga' 'bod byed pa la bltas na/ mang tshogs kyi sems su gcig na da rung dbang grags la dad pa'i bag chags shin tu mthug pa dang / gnyis na kho tsho'i rkub g.yog dang brarngu / g.yog byed par goms pa'i bsam blo de sngar bzhin sra mkhregs a 'thaskyug su gyur 'dug pa mtshon 'dug snyam/brtsamahri chosahūṃsmiñtshasdo k+taX ga/hūṃl/rnyi ram̐ri ṣā/ga/ tāshaṃṅka)krung go'i deng rabs kyi glog brnyan 'khrab 'khrid pa/ glog brnyan zhu/chokrangadabyibomosna (byerjicho kā ts+tsha 1951—)krung go'i deng rabs kyi glog brnyan 'khrab 'drid pa/ glog brnyan brtsamar ༵8dpa' rigs 'dug

2006lo'i dpe klog dang bris rtsom tshar gyi zin bris thor bu/bris rtsom gyi phyogs nas lo stod la rtsom yig gcig kyang 'bri ma thub la/ lo smad la'ang〈dang rten dang skur 'debs—dra ngos kyi dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gyi skor gleng ba〉dang〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang 〈 gsar 'gyur me long〉〉〉 gnyis las 'bri ma thub/bris pa'i rtsom gnyis ka yang dge 'dun chos 'phel lags dang 'brel ba yod la// da lo nas bzung kho bos zur ngos ga'an 'ig nas dge 'dun chos 'phel la zhib 'jug tog tsam bgyis khul byas pa yin/ da dung blos bsla/ngas byas zin pa'i bri 'gyur gyi rtsom ni〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar〉dang / 〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho〉〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang‘‘nub bod legs bcos skyid sdug’’〉〈dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal〉〉sogs yod/ kho bos rtsom 'di dag 'bri ba'i dmigs yul ni dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyi mthong sne 'di brgyud de dus rabs20pa'i shes yon can gyi tshogs spyi de'i snang brnyan dang rang gzugs kyi zur zhig slar mtshon byed 'dod pa dang / zhor du khong tsho'i nang sems kyi 'jig rten nam bsam pa'i lo rgyus rags pa zhig kyang gleng 'dod pa 95gas/spyir na da dung nga rang 'bri bar mos pa'i rno dbal tsha ba'i 'bol rtsom kha shas kyang do tshigs 'bri ba'i 'char gzhi yo/da/ na'ang / rkyen du — 89 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ma'i dbang gis rtsom dngos la 'jug ma thub pas da lo ci yang 'bri thub ma song snyam pa'i blo pham shin tu che yang / yig 'bru khri gsum lhag longs pa'i rang nyid kyi spyi lo1998—2004lo'i bar gyi thor gyar du song ba'i nyin tho rnams dag bsgrigs byas pas rtsom 'bri'i 'dod pa de cung tsam tshim thub pa byung /gzhan da dung gleng rgyu zhig la nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas snga phyir thengs gnyis la gtam bshad byas pa yin/ snga ma ni bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi rang mos gleng stegs tshogs pa'i re zhus ltar2006lo'i zla4pa'i tshes23nyin〈rtogs sad dgag sgrub rgyu 'bras blo mig〉ces pa'i gtam bshad byas pa dang / phyi ma ni bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi2004lo'i dngos gzhi rtsom rig 'dzin grwa'i re zhus ltar2006lo'i zla11pa'i tshes20nyin〈shes rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’dang ‘‘me long’’nang gi grwa btsun〉zhes pa'i gtam bshad byas/gtam bshad 'di gnyis kyi nang don ni gzhug nas sgra phab dngos bshus te brtse ldan gyi klog po rnams kyi spyan sngar dbul rtsis yod pas de gar gzigs par bya'o/ /lo ngo hril po gcig gi nyi ma 'di ltar nub rir yol song lo ngo gcig gi nyi gzhon gsar pa slar yang shar ri'i rtse nas yar 'phags byung / ‘‘kho bo'i mig kong nam yang mchi mas brlan pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re da 90 da
yin nam/ de ni nga rang sa gzhi 'dir snying nas dga' drags pas so/ /’’ skabs 'dir rang gis rang la 'di ltar smras/2006lo'i zla12pa'i tshes30—31nyin lan gru ru/

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsan brje’’dang nang gi mno bsam/da wa2006lo'i spyi tshogs dang rig gnas snang tshul skor gyi dpyad brjod/'das ma thag pa'i spyi lo2006lor 'u cag la spyi tshogs dang rig gnas snang tshul gang mang zhig byung ba dang / de la yang mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin mkhan dang smra lce kha la sgyur mkhan gang mang byung dang 'byung gi yo/da pa red/ spyir na snang tshul gang dang gang zhig yin yang de la tshang mas yin min dang drang ldog gi bsam tshul ci rigs brjod pa ni mi rnams kyis spyi tshogs dang rig gnas snang tshul de rigs la do snang byed ba'in pa mtshon/ ma zad/ mi nyid kyi smra brjod khe dbang mngon 'gyur byed bzhin pa'ang mtshon/ lhag par du shes yon can zhig gi ngos thad nas gleng na‘‘rig gnas snang tshulari’dang‘‘spyi tshogs snang tshul’’'di dag la dus rtag tu do snang dang thugs khur byed dgos shing /dus mtshungs su rang gi rgyu 'bras blo mig de dpral ba'i mig zung bzhin du bsrungs nas drang bden skyong ba dang nag nyes la dgag sgrub byed rgyu ni shin tu nas gal che ba zhig go/lo ngo 'di'i nang du byung ba'i snang tshul gang zhig yin yang spyi phyogs nas bltas na shes yon can tsho'i dpe khang(༈glo)phyi nang gi cha gnyis nas — 92 bhe

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang ma bsam/gleng chog ste/ shes yon can tsho'i dpe khang gi phyi ni 'a 'ur zang zing gi cha shas che ba'i‘‘gsar brje’’yi mkha' dbugs stug pa dang / shes yo/na can tsho'i dpe khang gi nang ni lhing 'jags zhi lhod kyi cha shas che ba'i mno bsam gyi sdug la spyor ba'o/ /gsham du snang tshul gtso bo kha shas zur du phyung nas gleng ba la/rgyan lpags sreg spyor gyi las 'gul/2006lo'i lo gsar gyi snga bar du rgyan lpags rnams me la sreg pa dang gser dngul gyi rgyan cha rnams spong dgos tshul gyi gleng phyogs shig ga sa gang du rlung ltar grags pa dang / mi rnams kyi sems pa yang gleng phyogs de dang bstun nas 'phyo ldem yang yang byas/ la shas kyis de ni nges par du lag tu bstar dgos shing / bstar rin yo/da pa'i don snying can gyi bya gzhag cig red zer/ yang la shas kyis rgyan lpags rnams yin gcig min gnyis me la sreg dgos don mi 'dug phyin chad lus la ma gon tshe 'grig yod pa red zer/ yang la shas kyis kha bshad chu yi lbu ba dang lag len gser gyi thigs pa zer ba ltar mi rang nyid kyi steng la babs tshe da gzod ji 'dra zhig yin pa ha go yong gi red zer/ yang la shas kyis gang ltar kyang da thengs rgyan lpags me la sreg thub gi ma red zer/ tag tag yin min gyi gleng phyogs sna tshogs bzo bzhin pa'i sgang — 93 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/la kha ba'i ljongs kyi gru zur zhig nas rgyan lpags rnams me la sreg pa'i du sngon dgung la zug par gyur/ de nas bzung dkar mdzes dang /rta'u/ ka ring / bis mdo/ reb gong / gcan tsha/ mdzod dgernga ba/ lha sa/ gtsod/ bla brang sogs su sram lpags dang gzig lpags/ stag lpags sogs gtsos pa'i rgyan lpags rnams me la sreg pa'i 'go brtsams te las 'gul lta bu zhig 'phyur/ las 'gul 'di ni ri bo hi ma la ya'i pha rol gyi gsung skad cig dang 'brel zhing / gzhis sdod nas sbyor ba dngos la 'jug mkhan yang ri bo nyi ma la ya'i pha rol tu chos mjal la song ste phyir thon pa'i mang tshogs phal pa dag red/ mang tshogs phal pa dag gis bslangs pa'i las 'gul 'di la kho bos thog mar yin 'jog dang bcas rjes su yi rang byas pa'i dus mtshungs su rang nyid kyi blo spobs dang rtogs pa/ blo sbyong / dpa' gdeng sogs mang tshogs phal pa zhig la'ang mi do bar da dung shes yon can du khas 'ches bzhin pa'i bya spyod 'di la the tshom dang / rang gi rnam shes la tsha 'dri thengs shig mi byed thu med byung / las 'gul 'di ni kho bor mtshon na rang gi lci yang srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma lta bu zhig tu gyur pa dang / las 'gul 'di ni rang gis rang la phyir rtog byed pa'i bsam gzhig gi them skas lta bu zhig tu'ang gyur/las 'gul 'di'i gal chen rang bzhin dang lo rgyus kyi don snying — 94 —

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang gi mno bsam/sogs mi gzhan gyis mang du brjod yod pas na kho bos 'dir bskyar zlos dang yig tshogs kyi ngal ba lhur mi len zhing / lo ngo gcig 'gor ba'i de ring gi nyin mor las 'gul de la yang bskyar bsam gzhig re btang na dran 'char 'di 'dra yang 'byung ste/(1)'u cag gi lo rgyus dang da lta'i gnas bab gang la bltas yo/nga na/ bla sprul dang chos lugs pa ni rang re'i spyi tshogs 'di'i yo/da tshad dang srog shing lta bur gyur 'dug bla sprul dang chos lugs pas gsungs pa ni da gzod tshad mar 'dzin zhing gtsug tu bkur la/ bla sprul dang chos lugs pas bstan pa ni da gzod bden par mthong zhing snying nas dad/ yod tshad bla sprul dang chos lugs pas kha lo sgyur pa'i spyi tshogs 'di'i nang du sger tshugs dang dgag sgrub kyi go cha spras pa'i shes yon can dag ni ji 'dra'i nyam chung ang / bla sprul dang chos lugs pa'i mdun du rang gi pha ma dang dge rgan sogs mi bur mi brtsi la/bla sprul dang chos lugs pa'i gam du bden don dang rang dbang zhes pa'ang ming gi lhag ma tsam mo/ /shes yon can tshos hur brtson chen ngo sa 'phag 'tshag ji ltar byas kyang rung / shes yon can tshos blo spobs chen pos nga ro ji ltar bsgrags kyang rung / shes yon can tshos dka' sdug chen pos rgyu 'bras blo mig ji ltar brtsis kyang rung / bla sprul dang chos lugs pa dag gi dbang grags kyi mdun du de dag ni rgya mtsho'i nang du rdo — 95 —

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘ sar brje’’dang nang mno bsam/dpa' lags dang nged gnyis kyis kyang rgyab skyor shugs chen byed pa'i sems byung gis rang gi ming rtags(smyug ming)bkod de sbyar byang spel ba yin/don rkyen 'di 'dra zhig byung bar tshang mas sems kyis mi bzod cing zhe spo gting nas langs kyi yod na'ang / shes yon can gyi sde na kha bshad tsam las lag len gyi ngag thog rgyab skyor byed mkhan shin tu nyung ba red/ 'phrin yig 'di spel ba'i sgang la'ang nga tshos nye 'khor gyi las grogs dang grogs po dag la ngag thog rgyab skyor byed par bskul mod/tshang mas gong gi 'phrin yig 'di la myong rol byed pa tsam las rgyab skyor byed mi ni nyin mo'i skar ma'i dpe ru gyur/ de bas 'u cag gi shes yon can du rlom pa phal mo che ni nam yang lag pa phu rung du bsdus pa'i ltad mo me yin pa las/ phu thung dpung rtsar brdzes pa'i lag len pa ni ma yin no/ / da lta'i spyi tshogs la mkho ba ni mi rigs kyi bde sdug thed la bor ba'i mkhas pa dag min la/ bya gzhi'i(/lkom+mu)rnam grangs gnyer ba'i zhib 'jug pa dag kyang min/ da lta'i spyi tshogs la mkho ba ni sgyu rtsal gyi gser khri snyeg pa'i snyan ngag pa dag min la/ yi ge'i rol rtsed la —byāng ba'i rtsom pa po dag kyang min/ ldog ste rang re la mkho ba ni spyi tshogs la hur brtson gyis 'jug cing rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal ba'i lag len pa yin la/ yang gcig bshad na 'u cag la mkho ba ni rang gi rgyus pa phyung nas — 97 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dpal 'bar sgron pa'i shes yon can rnal ma'i snying stobs so/ /(3)spyir na 'u cag ni lo rgyus kyi byung ba gal chen re dang yang na gnad 'gag gi skabs gang zhig la 'phrad na yang hol rgyug byed par dga' zhing / ri bong cal 'drogs kyi rnam thar skyong bar spro ste/gzab nan dpyod ldan gyi rtog dpyod med pa dang mig rgyang ring po'i mno bsam mi gtong ba ni 'u cag gi skyon che shos shig tu snang / 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi dpe chung chung zhig gi sgo nas brjod na yang / mi che ge mos bshad pa de bden 'dug ces brjod tshe tshang ma de'i phyogs su rgyugs par byed la/ yang mi che ge mos bshad pa de nor 'dug ces brjod tshe tshang mas der rgyab gtod ci thub byed pa red/ dge chos lags kyis〈rdoklu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉du gsungs pa'i rgyal po smyo chu 'thung mkhan de'ang hol rgyug mkhan zhig ma red ces sus smra bar spobs/ 'dir kho bos rgyan lpags sreg sbyor gyi las 'gul de la hol rgyug gi cha ldan no zhes der skyon btsal ba dang dma' phab pa ni gtan nas min na yang / las 'gul 'di'i steng nas kyang 'u cag la ches ma mtha' yang dpyod shes dang gzab nan dpyod ldan gyi srol rgyun med par hol rgyug dang rtsing rags kyi —cha ldan pa ni nges par du khas len dgos pa zhig red/ 'u cag ni dpyod shes dang ldan pa'i mi rigs shig ma yin pas na/ nam yang mi nyid kyi tsis thang dang mi gzhi/ khe dbang dang sger tshugs bcas dang — 98 —

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang 4 mno bsam/ring du gīs shing / 'u cag ni hol rgyug cal 'drogs byed par gom sa pa'i mi rigs shig yin pas na/ nam yang rjes lus dang rmongs dad/bag 'khum dang gnya' gnon gyi ngang nas 'tsho dgos byung ba red/dra skud la brgyus pa'i ka mad sum cu/tshan rtsal yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel ba'i dus rabs 'di'i nang du dra ba ni 'u cag gi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi grub cha gal chen zhig tu gyur dang 'gyur bzhin yod pa dang / dra ba 'di byung bas mi rnams kyi rin thang lta tshul dang / 'tsho ba rol stangs/ dga' kha 'khyer phyogs/bsam gzhig gtong stangs sogs la'ang snum gyis gos zin pa ltar dngos shugs gang rung nas shugs rkyen thebs bzhin pa ni bsnyon du med/'u cag la dra ba dar rgyas byung nas lo ngo mang po 'gor med na'ang / da lta mi mang po zhig gis rtsis 'khor gyi mdun du 'tshang kha shig shig byed cing / phab gzhung steng mdzub mos yang yang rdeg bzhin dra skud la brgyus pa'i 'od lam lam gyi ka mad sum cu'i tshig gi phreng ba de dag 'dzam gling ril mo'i sgang la ris med du gtor gyin yod pa red/lhag par du2006lo'i zla5par‘‘bod kyi skad yig dra tshigs’’kyis‘‘bod yig zin bris’’spel ba nas bzung zin bris 'bri mkhan dang der lta mkhan ni char shul gyi sha mo brdol ba ji bzhin mang du byung ba dang /— 99 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dus mtshungs su‘‘gangs ljongs gzhon nu dra tshigs’’dang‘‘mchod me bod kyi rtsom rig dra ba’’‘‘hi ma la ya glog brnyan rig gnas dra tshigs’’sogs su'ang gtam brjod dang sbyar byang mang po spel gyin 'dug pas mtho sgang gi yu/la gru 'di ru dra bar 'jug pa'i mtho rlabs lta bu zhig 'phyur/ dra ba'i steng rig gnas dang bsam blo/ spyi tshogs dang chab srid/ rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal sogs bgro gleng byed sa'i khor yug legs po zhig bskrun yo/da la/ dra ba'i steng mi rnams la rang nyid kyi dran 'char yod tshad sba gsang med par lhugs por brjod chog pa'i stegs bu zhig kyang mkho sprod byas yod/ dra bas mi nyid kyi smra brjod rang dbang gi khe dbang de mi bu re rer sprad yod la/ dra bas mi nyid kyi sger tshugs kyi rtsis thang de mi bu re rer gnangs yod/ dra ba la 'u cag gi rtsom sgrig pa'i phyag gi gzhog gcod gtub gsum gyi‘‘sta re’’de thogs med la/ dra ba la 'u cag gi chen po dag gi dbang grags de'ang mi mnga'/ de bas dra bas dus rabs 'di gsar du bskrun pa dang / dus rabs kyis slar yang 'u cag la dra ba'i legs skyes 'di bgo skal du bstsal byung /dra ba 'di legs par bed spyod gtong shes na gong gi dge mtshan 'di dag mchis shing / de las ldo ga tshe smyon pa'i lag tu ral gri shor ba bzhin gang sar g.yug ste phan tshun bar mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang khyad gsod/ yang na gseg 'dri ba dang klan ka 'tshol ba/ gzu lum gyi — 100 —

dpe khang phyi yi gsar brje dang nang gi mno bsam/gtam smra ba/ dgos med kyi gtam smra ba/ nyog gtam smra ba sogs kyi yo byad cig tu gyur 'gro gi yod pa red/ da lta'i 'u cag gi dra ba'i gnas bab la gzhigs na phal cher ldog phyogs kyi nus pa 'di cung shugs che bar snang ste/ dra ba 'di brgyud nas rang re'i bsam blo rig gnas kyi bgro gleng gi khor yug de 'khrug cha dod po dang phun sum je tshogs su/ mi gtong bar yi ge'i gad snyigs spungs sa 'ig tu btang dang gtong ba'in pa ni ji 'dra'i phangs pa la ang / spyir na bsam blo dang dngos po'i dpal yon gang zhig yin yang 'u cag gangs ri'i ra bas bskor pa'i yu/la du bslebs tshe de'i ngo bo 'gyur 'gro ba ni chos nyid cig tu snang bas bya thabs zad/nye char rgya'i rang dbang ring lugs kyi mkhas pa li'u cun nyin①lags kyis krung go'i‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar ni zin bris(/r+ghaṃ.oṃ)nas 'go rtsom dgos’’zhes 'bod skul yang yang gtong ba bzhin du/ 'u cag gis kyang dra ba dang zin bris de rig gnas gsar pa dang bsam blo gsar pa'i me kha gso byed cig dang / yang na dra skud la brgyus pa'i ka mad sum cu 'di 'phag 'tshag gi nga ro sgrog cing rang dbang gi glu gzhas len spyad cig tu btang na cis mi chogamangagañtsā tāskyirtushāñtshan+d+rasgosdosmok+ṣiṃrīdakautsho~X'eṭ+wāṃsprudū nā'i ñtshar+sha zlozlolju / chab srid mkhas pa/ brtsam sa chos〈〈spyi mthun 〉〉 ra 〉〉 ———— 1()1 ————

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’zhes pa'i na gzhon snyan ngag pa'i tshogs pa 'di ni2005lo'i zla6pa'i tshes30nas zla7pa'i tshes2nyin bar mtsho sngon po nas bsdus pa'i‘‘snyan ngag gyer 'don 'du tshogs lang tsho'i rbab chu skabs gnyis pa’’yi steng dngos su dbu brnyes tshul khyab bsgrags byas shing / da dung skyabs chen bde grol lags kyis de 'brel gyi bsgrags gtam zhig kyang sgrog 'don byas/ 2006lo'i zla7par‘‘skabs dang po'i bod kyi snyan ngag gi mi rabs gsum pa'i bgro gleng 'du tshogs’’de gna' mkhar zi ling du bsdus/ tshogs thog tu‘‘thog mar 'du tshogs kyi dang blangs las mi skyabs chen bde grol dang khri sems dpa' gnyis kyis so sor〈bya ba lam du song ba zhig la snyan ngag rnyed byung〉zhes pa dang〈gtor brlag gi yon tan dang nyes dmigs〉zhes pa sgrog sbyong gnang ste bod kyi de snga'i snyan ngag rtsom thabs mi 'dra ba gsum ste me long ma'i lugs dang / don grub rgyal rang grol gyi lugs/ 'ju skal bzang gi lugs bcas dang gyes phyag 'tshal zhing / mi rabs gsum pa ni tshogs pa zhig yin pa las grub mtha' zhig min pa dang / gal te mi rabs gsum pa 'dre red zer na 'dre yin/ 'on kyang nyin mor rgyu ba'i 'dre las mtshan mor rgyu ba'i 'dre min pa sogs gsal bshad gnang nas mi — 102 —

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang gi mno bsam/rabs gsum par 'jug pa'i thog ma'i sge'u khung de ha cang dkar cha ldan par phye’’(‘‘mchod me bod kyi rtsom rig dra ba’’ru gsal)ba red/ der mthud nas tshogs mi dag gis‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’yi lo rgyus kyi don snying gleng zhor rang rang gi snyan ngag kyang tshogs thog tu gyer 'don byas/ thengs 'di'i 'du tshogs de ni kho tshor mtshon na‘‘rang dbang ldan pa zhig dang /rlabs che ba'i rtsom rig gi las 'gul zhig phan tshun bar du mchog dman shor med par 'dra mnyam ldan pa zhig lang tsho'i stobs shugs dang dbyangs gsal gyi mdzes sdug mtshon pa zhig tu ngos mi 'dzin ka med byung’’(‘‘mchod me bod kyi rtsom rig dra ba’’ru gsal)ba zhig yin 'dug ‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’yi snyan ngag pa'i tshogs pa de thun mong ma yin pa dang khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin tshul la a bu lags kyis kyang‘‘ming don mtshungs pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag gi tshogs pa zhig yin par khas blangs te tshogs pa de'i dmigs gzhi/ dang gnas bab kyi phyogs nas pha ran si'i bsdus brjod ring lugs dang cha 'dra ba'i phyogs kyang mang po yo/da tshul gyi rgyu mtshan zhib par gleng’’(‘‘mchod me bod kyi rtsom rig dra ba’’ru gsal)'dug pa red/gong du‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’yi skor gyi gnas tshul rags bsdus shig bkod zin la/ da ni nga tshos‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’ru 'bod pa'i na gzhon snyan ngag pa 'di tshos snyan ngag ci zhig 'bri ba dang / ci zhig ge 103 —

cherama'ilamagyingaro/ da wagi ched du snyan ngag 'bri bar 'khyug tsam bltas na/skyabs chen bde grol lags kyis snyan ngag ni rang nyid kyi ched du 'bri'o zer/ mda' btsan po lags kyis ngas mal khri'i sgang nas snyan ngag gi 'khrig pa spyod srid zer/ 'brug ljang lags kyis nga tshos gcer bur phud nas snyan ngag bris na cis mi chog zer/ re rkang gling lags kyis smad 'tshong ma sangs rgyas sgrol ma ni lha mo zhig go zer/ 'brong phrug lags kyis nga la chung ma med dngul lor med/ chang yod snyan ngag yod zer/ the'u reng lags kyis mi rabs gsum pa ni dor ma med pa'i gcer bu yin zer/ kho tsho'i rnam dpyod kyi shes rab dang dwangs gtsang gi smyug rtse nas 'phyur ba'i snyan ngag ni 'di lta ste/ ‘‘khang ba 'di'i nang nas(ngas(rang gi rkang snam kha skor sgyid khugs su phud nas(mje ngan 'di rtsa ba nas gcod thabs mi 'dug ces(chags sred sgye gang dang mnyam du su zhig la sgug dgos(khang ba 'di'i nang nas(ngas(rang gi rlig rtsid yod tshad thag pa zhig tu brgyus nas(myos bum lhug lhug byed pa'i bu mo zhig la('di khyod kyi rkang snam kha thug byos zhes(brtse dung spar mo gang dang lhan du ster srid dam(khang ba 'di'i nang nas(ngas(bu mo zhig gi mchu sgros la mchu sgros glan gyin(rang gi pho mtshan mo'i mo mtshan la shed kyis rdzong gin(dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'di nas bor 'gro la(bde ba'i zhing khams bhe 104 —

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang gi mno bsam/'di nas rnyed 'gro zhes(snying nye ba'i bu chung zhig 'jog thub bam’’(〈〈khang ba 'di'i nang nas〉)zhes dang / yang / ‘‘chags sred kyis mnar ba'i nam mkha' chen po 'di nidzelha mo zhig gi mig ya gcig la khrun thag bcad pas(khyod kyi mdzes sdug de yang(bye thang skya bo de'i sgal gzhung du nub nges ladzenu 'bur dang brla sha(mtshan ma bcas kyi mtshon don du babs pa(bye sgang gi nyams 'gyur re re(khyod kyi bla srog rku ba'i ma dzes pa re re yin la(bud med kyi gzugs ris lta bu'i sgyen gzugs des(khyod la 'dod sred kyi bslu brid cig gtong nges’’(〈gcer bur bud nas /khyod la bltas pa〉)zhes dang / yang / ‘‘sang nyin ni 'khrig pa'i sgang gi pho mo gnyis red(brtse ba de zab drags pas(ngas(khyod rkang thung zhig gi tshad du bzhag yo/da(mje dang rlig pa gnyis lhung rag bar du’’(〈ngas/ khyod rang rkang thung zhig gi tshad du bzhag yod〉)zhes dang / yang / ‘‘de ni7pho mtshan gyi khu ba 'dzar ba'i 'od snang dang(mo mtshan phyi ru slog pa'i 'jam mnyen las(gna' bo'i nyi zla gnyis ka gtan nas min’’(〈khyod rang mi 'thad na'ang / ngas 'di ltar bris na ci red〉)zhes dang / yang / ‘‘bud med cig yin na(myos bum gnyis ston gyin sgeg nyams ston mod(rlig 'bras gnyis ka(cis kyang nang du bsdu thabs dka'(nam rgyun bud med tshor 'khrig pa spyod byed kyi de nyid(da lta(chang dam brgya phrag 'thung ba'i bzi bo zhig dang 'dra(rlig tsid kho na g.yag lce zhig dang 'dra bar(— 105 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'doms na 'tshang khas 'dzing bas(gcer bur bud dus snying bo mi 'dug’’(〈me long gi mdun nas〉)ces pa'o/ / gzhan yang re rkang gling lags kyi〈dus tshod skar ma bcu'i yun la bris pa'i snyan ngag tshan pa bco brgyad〉dang / gshed ma lags kyi〈mo mtshan rdzun ma 'di nga la mi dgos〉 mda' btsan po lags kyi〈skyag pa〉 skyabs chen bde grol lags kyi〈gcer bur 'bud pa〉sogs kyang gong du drangs pa'i snyan ngag 'di dag dang cha mtshungs par 'dug go/snyan ngag de dag gis mtshon pa'i‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’yi snyan ngag ni ngo tsha'i rdzu bag dang bral ba'i‘‘kha btsog’’gi‘‘snyan ngag’’cig red la/yi ge'i rol rtsed gnyer ba'i gad snyigs kyi‘‘snyan ngag’’cig kyang red/snyan ngag de dag gis mtshon pa'i‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’yi snying stobs ni khog smad gcer bur 'bud pa'i snying stobs dang / sgyu rtsal rdog brdzis su gtong ba'i snying stobs red/ snyan ngag de dag gis mtshon pa'i‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’yi bya spyod ni a gsar gyi gtam 'dod tsha po red la/dngos yod kyi 'gan 'khri la g.yol thabs shig kyang red/ kho bo ni sgyu rtsal kha la 'khyer nas sgyu rtsal rdog brdzis gtong ba dang / sgyu rtsal gyi gzhal yas khang nas dngos yod kyi dza drag yal bar dor ba'i rtsom rig dang nam nam zha zhar ring du gyes nges so/ /brgya la sgyu rtsal gyi ched du sgyu rtsal gnyer ba'i dus shig yod srid kyang 'u cag la mtshon na da dung de ni da 106 da

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang gi mno bsam/rmi lam gyi zhing khams shig yin pa las dngos yod kyi gnas tshul zhig gtan nas ma yin/ gzhan yang‘‘snyan ngag’’'di'i rigs dar khyab tu song na kun spyod kyi kha dbugs btsog por bzo srid pa dang / snyan ngag la thog mar 'jug mkhan dag gi lhad med kyi byis blo de'ang dri mas sbags srid/ gal te mi lo gang mang zhig gi rjes su‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’yi snyan ngag pa dag gi bu phrug tshos rang gi pha mas bris pa'i‘‘kha btsog’’gi‘‘snyan ngag’’'di dag la gdong gtad tshe sems ngos su ci zhig 'char ram/ yang na bu phrug tshos rang gi pha mas bris pa'i brtsams chos 'di dag la lta ba mig gis bzod dam/ dgod bro ba zhig la‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’yi snyan ngag pa'i gras su snying nas 'tshang 'dod kyi the'u reng zer ba zhig gis phyir 'khor te kho rang tsho'i gdong 'bag tshal bar gshags 'dug ste/ ‘‘mi rabs gsum pa(a ma'i pang khug nas gcer bur bud byung(mi rabs gsum pas(lha khang gi nang rol nas skyag pa btang byung(mi rabs gsum pas(sring mo dang sde mi'i gras nas mo mtshan mo mtshan zhes bos byung(mi rabs gsum pas(chung ma dang bu tsha'i gam nas rlig ril rlig ril zhes bsgrags byung /’’(‘‘mchod me bod kyi rtsom rig dra ba’’yi gleng stegs su gsal) der brten/ gsar du byung ba'i snyan ngag pa'i tshogs pa 'di la yin gcig min gnyis ming zhig gdags dgos tshe‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’zhes gsol ba las‘‘rgud pa'i mi rabs’’zhes gsol — 107 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/na 'grig par 'dod do/ /skabs lnga pa'i〈sbrang char〉〉rtsom rig bya dga'/〈sbrang char〉rtsom rig bya dga' ni 'u cag gi rtsom rig bya dga'i khrod mtshan snyan ches mtho shos dang bya dga'i dngul grangs ches mang shos yin pa red/ de bas bya dga' de ni rtsom mkhan gang mang zhig gi mig gi dbang po 'phrog byed dang sems kyi 'gram chu ldang sar gyur 'dug2006lo'i zla8pa'i tshes16nyin‘‘a ru bod sman’’rtags can gyi skabs lnga pa'i〈sbrang char〉rtsom rig bya dga' gnang ba'i tshogs 'du de gna' mkhar zi ling du tshogs shing / 2003lo nas2005lo'i bar gyi〈〈sbrang char〉du spel ba'i brtsams chos lnga la bya dga' thob/ de dag ni stag 'bum rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung〈khyi dang bdag po/ da dung gnyen tshan dag〉dang / tshe ring don grub kyi brtsams sgrung〈btsun/ yag〉 ye shes bzang bo'i snyan ngag〈slob dpon thon mi'i rtogs pa nyung ngur brjod pa'i gtam〉 co ne yum tshe ring gi brtsams sgrung〈rnam smin〉〉 khri sems dpa'i snyan ngag〈zhi bder smon pa〉bcas so/ /'u cag gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi las don yar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong ba zer na 'dra/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi dpung khag je rgyas je legs su gtong ba zer na 'dra/ gsar rtsom la mos pa'i las dang po — 108 —

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘ sar brje’’dang nang gi ma bsam/ba rnams gso skyong byed pa zer na 'dra/ gang ltar kyang〈sbrang char〉〉rtsom sgrig khang gis rtsom mkhan dag gi ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu la brtsi mthong dang yin 'jog byas dang byed bzhin pa ni dga' 'os pa'i don zhig red snyam/ lhag par du deng sang mi thams cad kyi bsam pa'i blo kha de dbang dang 'byor pa'i phyogs la snyeg gin 'dug pa'i skabs 'dir/da dung yang rang shong spyil bu'i nang du smyu gu shugs kyis 'chang ste u tshugs kyis sdod pa'i mi bu dag la skul lcag dang bcas sems ngal gso ba ni ma gzhi nas don dag legs po zhig ci la min/ yin na'ang bod kyi‘‘mi dmangs rtsom rig’’tu 'bod pa'i〈 sbrang char〉dang / yang na〈sbrang char〉rtsom rig bya dga' la mtshon na da dung mi 'dang sa'am zhan cha yang 'ga' re mchis te/ (1) brtsams chos dpyad 'dem gyi khyab khongs de〈sbrang char〉kho na las bod khams yo/ngas la khyab med pas ha cang gu dog la rang rlom che ba dang / (2)rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bya dga' kho na las rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi bya dga' spel gyin med pas bya zhig yin na gshog pa ya gcig chad pa'i snang ba ster ba/ (3)brtsams chos kyi bsam blo'i rin thang sngog 'don byed pa mi 'dang ba'o/ / ('di las rtag par bya dga' 'thob 'os pa la mi thob pa dang 'thob mi 'os pa la bya dga' thob pa'i snang tshul ya ma brla dag 'byung gi yod pa red)gzhan yang gleng rgyu zhig la rang re'i rtsom stegs su bya dga' yi ngos ge 109 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/thad nas‘‘gcod pa don grub yab sras gsum’’zhes pa'i bshad tshul zhig rlung ltar grags pa bzhin du/ 'u cag gi khor yug 'di nas phyis su‘‘྾྾྾yab sras gsum’’zhes pa 'di 'dra yang bskyar mi 'byung ba'i gdeng tshod su la'ang med pas na/ gzhug phyogs bya dga' yi rnam grangs gang zhig yin yang 'di 'dra'i dgod bro ba'i snang tshul mi 'byung bar dogs zon nan mo byed dgos pa red/'dra 'bag gyon pa'i li a'o/2006lo'i zla9pa'i tshes28nyin tha'e wan gyi rtsom mkhan li a'o①lags kyis zhang kang rgya bya brnyan 'phrin khang gi‘‘li a'o la bshad rgyu yod’’ces pa'i le tshan du bod kyi skor la dpyad brjod spel bas 'u cag gi yon tan pa'i sde ni 'ur chil ler btang / khong gis‘‘'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus de 'phel rim chen po gsum brgyud myong ba dang / de dag ni lha yis dbang bsgyur pa dang rgyal pos dbang bsgyur pa/ mi mang gis dbang bsgyur pa gsum yin pa red/ da lta 'dzam gling ril mo'i sgang gi sa cha phal che ba mi mang gis dbang sgyur bzhin yod na'ang /bod ni da dung lha'i dbang sgyur gyi 'og tu gnas 'dug’’ces dang / da dung‘‘bod la lha yi thob thang las mi bu'i thob thang med pa dang / bod brtsamaṭā chosaliḍā go/sko phroṃsaspra blo'i9 shār+ghazlo hūṃsnazlo lago ༵na gāṭ+wā kli nā smi rnoshā zlosdu/ dang / rig gnas dpyad brjod mkhan/— 110 ge

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang gi mno bsam/la rmongs dad las chos lugs mi 'dug’’ ‘‘bcings 'grol yar sngon gyi lha'i dbang sgyur 'og gi bod yul ni mun nag dang kla klo/ rmongs dad/gdug rtsub kyi zhing khams shig yin pa red’’ ‘‘de lta bu'i gdug rtsub dang /mun nag kla klo/ rjes lus kyi zhing bran lam lugs shig med par gtong ba la skyid sdug gam tshogs pa gcig ma gtogs mi 'dug ste/ de ni krung go gung khran tang ngo’’ ‘‘mdo dbus lcags lam bskrun te me 'khor shar gtong thub pa ni gung khran tang gi byas rjes bla na med pa zhig red’’‘‘nang logs su chos spel ba'i grwa btsun dag gis mi gzhan gyi bsam pa'i sdug bsngal sel thub ce na de ni rnar mi 'gro ba'i stong gtam kho na'o’’‘‘bod mis brkyangs phyag 'tshal ba dang lha la dad pa byed pa/ skye ba snga phyi yod par 'dod pa sogs ni blun rmongs kyi rtags kho na red’’ces pa sogs mang du brjod byung /zhib 'jug slob ma'i sbyang bya gnyer skabs kyi nga'i sems khong gi li a'o lags ni sger gcod kyi dbang sgyur pa dang srid dbang gi kha gtad du 'greng ste drang bden skyong ba dang / blo 'byed bya bar hur brtson gyis 'jug pa'i sger tshugs kyi shes yon can zhig yin par ma zad/tha'e wan gyi mang gtso dang rang dbang gi phyir du tshe srog gta' mar 'jog mkhan gyi shes yon can zhig kyang yin/ yin na'ang dus de ring li a'o lags 'gyur zin/ nye ba'i lo 'di 'gar khong gis gdong gi — 111 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'dra 'bag yun gyis bshus te rang gi gdong ris ngo ma bo de klog pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar bstan byung / da snga yan chad kyi rig gnas gar stegs steng gi li a'o lags ni gdong la 'dra 'bag gyon pa'i li a'o red/ 'dra 'bag bshus te nga tsho'i mdun thad du krong nger 'gying ba'i li a'o lags ni ci 'dra zhig red ce na/ de ni bran gshis tshang zhing mi gzhi bor ba dang / 'gan 'khri la g.yol zhing rdzun gtam la goms pa'i li a'o red/ dus de nas bzung kho bo'i sems khong gi dpa' bo'i snang brnyan brjid che ba de sil bur thor ba dang‘‘shes yon can’’gyi zhwa mo rdzig po de'ang rdzus ma zhig yin pa shes/ der brten/ thengs 'di'i rang re'i skor gyi dpyad brjod 'di la mtshon na'ang kho bos glo bur ba dang mtshar bo zhig la gtan nas ngos 'dzin gyin med de/ de ni dus kyi snga phyi zhig yin pa ma gtogs snga rung 'phyi rung nam zhig la khos brjod srid pa'i skad cha red/ li a'o lags kyis sger gcod srid dbang la zhabs g.yog sgrub pa'i bya spyod de nga tsho ma zad rgya nag gi shes yon can gyi sde na'ang khrel dgod byed sa'i gnas su gyur 'dug ste/ de la rgya'i na gzhon shes yon can zhig gis 'di skad du/ ‘‘kho bo ni tha'e wan gling phran du sger tshugs kyis 'tsho ba'i li a'o la dga' la/ kho bo ni krung go'i skam sar ma yong ba'i sngon gyi li a'o la yang dga'/ kho bo ni zhang kang rgya bya brnyan 'phrin khang dang mnyam 'brel ma byas pa'i yar sngon gyi — 112 —

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang gi mno bsam/li a'o la de bas kyang dga' 'o’’zer/li a'o lags kyi gtam de dag dang 'brel nas 'u cag gi mi mang po zhig kha spo kha nas langs shing zhe spo gting nas langs te dra ngos nas dza drag dang ldan pa'i rtsod gleng gi rlabs phreng zhig kyang 'phyur bar byas/de ru spyi tshogs steng gi rig gnas pa las gzhan da dung grwa pa dang slob chen slob ma mang du 'dus pa red/ dra grogs rnams kyis rtsod gleng dang bcas li a'o lags la sdigs mo byas pa'i sbyar byang kha shas 'dir dpe mtshon du bkod na/ ‘‘rang nyid kyis ci yang mi shes pa mi bshad par bla med kyi mi rigs shig la sdigs mo byed pa'i glen rgan’’ zhes dang /‘‘ngas kho rang bzhin du mi bskyur kho thag yin’’ ‘‘shi 'gro rgyu khyod pha rol du sprod dgos rgyu red’’ ‘‘nga tsho'i bod mi rigs la cha mtshon na li a'o lta bu ni ra ma 'phag nas ra khang zhig mi thub pa rang red’’ ‘‘ngo ma li a/'o yis 'di ltar bshad rgyu mang na kho rang nyid la rnam smin 'khor kho thag yin/gal te de ring nga rang li a'o la thug btang na/ nga rang gis rang srog la yang mi blta bar kho rang lnga lam du brdzang kho thag yin’’ ‘‘snying ma rje/lo ngo stong phrag gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i rig gnas shig dang / 'dzam gling gi mig dper gyur pa'i mi rigs shig la/ kho lta bu zhig gis ji 'dra brjod kyang / nga la zhe sdang dang phrag dog ci yang med’’ ‘‘rgya rgan khyod kyi kha las mar la cig lhung gi smon lam/ kha mi sos rgyu bo nga ngo ma khyod la bhe 113 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/snying langs gi’’ ‘‘kha der thal rdul blug rgyu kho’’ ‘‘li a'o zhes pa'i mi de sdug shi snying nad thebs par shog’’(〈bod skad yig dra tshigs〉kyi〈kha kha'i zin bris〉su gsal zhing mi ming dang mngon gsal gyi yig nor skor zhig bcos yod)ces pa lta bu'o/ / yang drang phyogs kyi sbyar byang spel mkhan zhig kyang 'dug ste/ dper na/ ‘‘bod mi rigs ni da bar du lha'i dbang bsgyur khrod rmongs dad kyis 'tsho bzhin yod zer ba 'di tag tag don dngos red/ bod ni tha'e wan dang bsdur na sa rgya che ba yin mod/'on kyang 'phel rgyas med par chos lugs kyi bran bsgyur 'og mgo 'khor te bsdad yod zer ba 'di bden pa red’’(〈bod skad yig dra tshigs〉kyi〈'bar rde'u zin bris〉las〈tha'e wan gyi li o la skad cha med〉ces pa'i sbyar byang du gsal)ces pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang go thos la slob chen gyi slob ma skor zhig gis dra ba'i steng nas li a'o lags kyi dpyad brjod der bltas rjes khong khro dang bcas rtsis 'khor gyi shel ngos su smyu gus 'dzer ba dang khu tshur gyis kyang gzhus yod skad/ngas bltas na gong gi snang tshul 'di dag gis ches ma mtha' yang gnad don 'di 'dra zhig gsal bshad byas 'dug ste/ (1)'di 'dra'i 'ur chen po zhig langs don ni li a'o lags kyi gtam kha shas shig rnag thog gtsags khel ltar 'u cag gi skran nad steng khel song ba red/ (2)rgya nag gi shes yon can rnal ma zhig la mtshon na grangs da 114 da

dpe nga phyi yi‘‘ sar brje’’dang nang 4 ma bsam/nyung mi rigs kyi gnad don skor la nges par du drang gtam smra ba dang skad chen po rgyag dgos pa red/ de ma yin par mi rigs chen po'i bsam blo yis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi bde sdug thed la bor tshe de ni shes yon can rdzus ma 'ba' zhig go/ (3)gzhan gyi dgag sgrub dang skyon brjod kyi skad sgra zur tsam yang thos mi 'dod pa'i mi rigs shig yin phyin/ bsam blo bcings 'grol dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas ni mo gsham gyi bu ltar dka' zhing 'od zer gyi lam chen ni nam yang yod mi srid do/ /(4) gong gi rgyan lpags sreg sbyor gyi las 'gul dang cha 'dra bar cal 'drogs dang 'ur zing gi cha ldan zhing / sems pa lhod la babs te dpyod shes kyis bsam gzhig gtong ba'i srol ni mi 'dug (5)'u cag la nam yang gzhan skyon la blta ba'i spyan mig kho na ldan pa las rang skyon la blta ba'i me long ni med do/ /skyes bu gsum dang dpe deb gsum/2006lor rang re'i dpe deb dang dus deb/ tshags par dang dra ngos sogs kyi bar gseng du skyes bu gsum gyi mtshan ni mu tig bzhin 'od lam lam 'tsher zhing chu mig bzhin yang yang brdol gyi yo da pa red/khong tsho ni dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal/ zhogs dung gsum mo/ /— 115 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dge 'dun chos 'phel/ khong ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i stod kyi‘‘mngon gyur rtags kyi bden pa ngo sprod’’mkhan dang / ‘‘'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog pa'i tshang tshing’’du sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi dang mkhas pa'i dam tshig srog la babs kyang 'bad pas srung mkhan gcig pu'o/ /don grub rgyal/ khong gis dus rabs nyi shu pa'i smad tsam la rtsom rig gsar pa'i dar cha thog mar dgung la phyar te 'u cag gi blun rmongs dang rjes lus kyi cha sogs mtshang 'byin ther 'don byas shing / tha na rang gi gces pa'i tshe srog kyang mi rigs 'dir rtogs sad kyi cong brda rgyag phyir phangs med du sbyin/ dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal rnam pa gnyis byung bas 'u cag gi dus rabs nyi shu pa'i bsam blo'i lo rgyus de yang gleng rin yod pa zhig dang ngom du ri ba zhig tu gyur/zhogs dung / khong gis lha chos rig gnas kyi na bun 'thibs pa'i khor yug 'di nas bsam gzhig gi mgo bo mi thegs bzhin du khur te/snying stobs chen pos mi chos rig gnas kyi dung mo che 'bud 'go brtsams/2006lor〈rgyan lpags sreg sbyor lo rgyus kyis brjed mi srid pa'i las 'gul thengs shig〉dang〈phyag 'tshal ba ni bran gyi rang gshis nyid〉ces pa gnyis spel ba yis khong gi rin thang dang shugs rkyen de shes yon can gyi sde la yang bskyar bden dpang thengs shig byas/gzhan yang / 'u cag la2006lo'i dpe deb ches legs shos ni da 116 da

dpe khang phyi yi‘‘gsar brje’’dang nang mno bsam/'di'o zhes pa zhig ston rgyu ma byung yang / rgya nag gi dpe klog gi sde dang shes yon can gyi sde na dpe deb gsum ni kun gyi gleng gzhir gyur 'dug pa red/ dnge/ deb de dag rang re'i dpe klog gi sde la kha gsab 'os sbyor gyi tshul gyis 'dir 'god pa la/1 〈tsho0zlostutswa༈shu ṣāhūṃrkirdo/1〉(r+sā3༈smosne/shā /thardo3lhañtsāstso 4stu tshi7r+ṣalta/spyo/ rnya༈ 20064r+ṣa 7ya/'i2 〈yirkitsornguzu —/ 〉sgokā6ṅkashastso loglospraskyalam̐/ṭha/tram̐ 2006lho10yaglo3 〈kre// rta 61ri skyekroci 00①0〉glu( /〉ngamestso tshorjekhrak+ṣa1kha༈glo chi/'i4/ 2006ming10) 4/nikrobacas theṭa/ /2007lo'i zla1pa'i tshes23da zla2pa'i tshes1nyin lan gru ru/

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bsam blo'i 'grul bzhud ring mo/da wang rang ches klog par spro ba'i dpe deb dag las khag dang po/nyin 'ga'i sngon la〈shar dung ri〉dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pa zhig dang grogs po skor zhig gis dpe deb legs shos skor zhig 'os sbyor zhu ba'i re ba zhus pa dang / dus mtshungs su dpe deb de dag gang nas nyo thub pa'i skor yang dris byung / kho bos nam yang dpe deb ni grogs po phan tshun bar gyi legs skyes ches bzang po zhig tu rtsi bzhin yod la/ legs skyes su phul pa'i dpe deb des pha rol bor phan zhig e thogs kyi re ba yang byed bzhin yod/ der brten/ kho bor mtshon na grogs po nang khul du rgyun par phan tshun bar dpe deb 'os sbyor dang dpe deb legs skyes su 'bul rgyu ni goms srol zhig tu gyur yod/ dpe cha pa zhig la mtshon na dpe klog gi‘‘ltogs skom’’byung ba'i skabs der rang nyid kyis snying nas re ba'i‘‘bsam blo'i rgyags phye’’zhig dang 'phrad tshe de las yid dga' zhing blo tshim pa zhig med pa red/ rgya'i deng rabs kyi mi tshul mkhas pa kru'u zhu'e chinarjolags na re/ ‘‘ji lta bu'i lta klog gi byung ba rtsadhichokru'uzhusbyachiskyo/rdzo(lkor+ha7 1952zas)krungaspyi'iradezlolarasdos sdi mai /snadākaugablos+dzakhrilji kār+sha /sa'ardzulhas pa/ba zusam /ga1//na da da gas ldan rgyal khab nya shegab gyu ༄ nga na sa

bsam blo'i 'a la ba da ring mo/yod na de lta bu'i bsam blo'i lo 'khor yod do’’zhes pa bzhin ltos bcas kyis dpe deb ci 'dra zhig bklags na mi bu'i bsam blo yang de dang cha 'dra ba zhig chags thub kyi yod pa red/ spyir na 'dir klog pa po rnams la gsal zhing dag pa'i sgo nas dpe deb legs shos 'os sbyor zhu rgyu ni kho bo lta bus lcogs pa zhig ma yin na'ang / rang gi dpe klog gi 'grul bzhud ring mo'i khrod du rang nyid ches klog par spro ba'i dpe deb kha shas rim pa bzhin du zin thor bkod nas khong rnam par dpyad gzhi zhig gi tshul du phul na mi chog pa med do/ /〈me dang 'khyags rom〉dhidape deb 'di ni na gzhon rang dbarnga shes yon can yus ce lags kyi bsam blo'i thol rtsom deb thog ma yin zhing / rgya nag gi shes yon can gyi sde dang bsam blo'i rig gnas sde la g.yo skyom drag po bzos myong ba'i dpe deb kyang red/ dpe deb 'di dngos su par skrun 'grem spel ma byas pa'i yar sngon la‘‘'then sgam rtsom rig’’tu 'bod pa'i rtsom yig 'di rnams phyogs bsgrigs kyis snum dpar gyi deb chung bzhi ru bsdus te nang khul du bkram pa dang / slob chen so so nas lag bris kyi rnam pas ga sa gang du khyab pas na gzhon rnams kyi khrod du mnyam 'ur chen po byung /① 〈 lkoṣ+ka lo〉ṣā rke stso phrephywa ‘ ṣ+kakhur+sā ’ lornyeṭ+wāṃ 1998lho4(glo— 119 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dpe skrun mkhan po ho zhung h+phe lags kyi rtsol ba la brten nas dpe deb 'di〈‘‘rtswa thang tsho ba'i’’gyi ling dpe tshogs〉kyi khrod nas klog pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa byung la/ khu sim pa'i rgya nag gi rig gnas kyi sde la sngar med pa'i gson shugs kyi yo lang zhig rgyas par byas/spyi lo2000lo'i dgun gzhung gi grang ngar ha cang che ba'i mtshan mo zhig la kho bos dpe deb 'di thog mar bklags shing / klog pa'i dus kyi spro ba dang bsam gzhig gi longs spyod sogs ni dus da lta yang yid kyi me long ngos nas yal thabs bral/ rtsom pa pos dgag sgrub kyi langs phyogs dang dogs slong gi snying stobs/ bas mtha' pa'i tshul 'dzin pa bcas kyi rtsa don lhur blangs nas rtsom la 'jug pa dang / rno dbal tsha ba'i yig 'bru re re'i rgyab tu dpyod shes dang rgyu 'bras blo mig sogs kyis yongs su brgyan 'dug de bzhin du chab srid sger gcod la sdang ba'i khong khro dang / rang dbang mang gtso la smon pa'i 'bod skul sogs kyang sha thon rus thon byas 'dug pa red/ rtsom pa pos‘‘'jig rten steng ches bzod sgom byed mi rung ba ni yi ge'i gad snyigs red/ de bas smyu gu lag la 'dzin thengs re rer kho bo'i snying rtsa yang yang 'dar 'ong’’zhes brjod pa bzhin/ 'u cag gi yi ge'i gad snyigs la goms shing bsam blo mkhregs 'dzin la mos pa dag gis kyang kho'i brtsams chos de dag klog thengs rer snying rtsa yang yang mi 'dar ba ci la srid/— 120 —

bsam blo'i 'a la ba da ring mo/grang shur shur gyi mtshan mo re re ni de ltar tsha ber ber gyi bsam gzhig gis bskyal pas mjug mthar kho bo'i lus la'ang tsha drod cig khad kyis rgyas byung ngo / /〈'dam ga'i dgag sgrub—li tse ho'u dang gleng mol byed pa〉〉zhudape deb 'di ni brgya lo20pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i smad du rgya nag gi‘‘rtsom stegs gyi ling’’du 'bod pa'i sku zhabs li'u 'a'o po lags kyis brtsams pa dang / dpe deb 'dis khong nyid rgya'i rig gnas/ kyi sde dang bsam blo'i sde nas gdan thob nges can zhig zin par rmang gzhi bting zhing / de dang bstun nas khong gi mtshan snyan grags kyang phyogs kun khyab par gyur/ deb 'di'i 'go brjod du rtsom pa pos‘‘deb 'di ni kho bor mtshon na li tse ho'u②dang gleng mol byed pa yin la/ srol rgyun rig gnas dang krung go'i deng rabs kyi shes yon can rnams dang gleng mol byed pa yang yin/ 'di lta'i gleng mol gyi rnam pa la brten nas nga rang sger tshugs kyi mi bu zhig yin pa'i gzhi grub rin thang de bden dpang byed pa yin la/ krung go'i deng rabs kyi rigs gzhung gi sde ru dbang grags la brtsi mthong byed pa dang / dbang grags la dngangs ༵ rlohūṃs+hospyoljiṇ+ḍaṃ/1༈rtohā~Xk+tosnroshātshoṭāṣ+yo〉 lha'//smo ram̐ṣ+ṭṛ zlo+osum̐ 8shā&ḍā sde/ sdo4 hūṃpa shākauram̐ k+ṣi 1/( snrodzes rig mkhan/brtsams chos〈krung ga' dang rabs kya bsam blo' la rgyus rnam pa ra bshad pasigs 'dug da 121 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/skrag skyes pa/ dbang grags kyi rjes su chu sna gar khrid byed pa'i dus rabs de nges par du lo rgyus su 'gyur nges pa dang yid 'dzin du 'gyur nges pa de bden dpang byed pa yang yin’’zhes brjod 'dug la/ deb kyi mgo mjug bar gsum gang la bltas kyang rtsom pa pos dngos gnas sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi dang sger tshugs kyi bsam gzhig gi go cha yongs su spras te dbang grags dang sger gcod/ bran gshis dang mkhregs 'dzin sogs la dgag sgrub mthil phyin pa mdzad 'dugasku zhabs li'u zha'o po lags kyi skad cha re re ni bsam blo'i glog zhags shig dang 'dra bar mi sems la tsag shad rgyug cing / snying khams kyi 'phar lding dang bsam gzhig gi rlabs phreng de'ang rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ji bzhin yang yang skyom par byed pa red/ gzhan yang deb 'di'i nang du shes yon can gyi‘‘rus snyi'i nad’’(ṣ+ṭhaṣ+pelo)la dpyad pa gnad smin btang 'dug pa dang / ‘‘rus pa sra mo can’’dang‘‘sgal tshigs can’’zhig tu 'gyur ba'i thabs lam nyag gcig ni mi nyid kyi rtogs sad dang sger tshugs kyi‘‘bdag’’yin pa de gsal por bstan 'dug go/gal te deb 'di la gdeng 'jog tshig gcig ma zhig bya dgos tshe/kho bos o si khru ri ya'i rtsom mkhan kha h+phi khadhilags kyi skad cha zhig g.yar rdzong〉|ṅges ṭāsnyurno/(stu5sku1smo'i oṃlko—co 1883—1924)o si khru ri ya'i brtsams sgrung mkhan/ brtsams chos〈mkhar — 122 —

bsam blo'i 'a la ba da ring mo/nas brjod 'dod de/ ‘‘'u cag la mkho ba'i dpe deb ni nges par du rang re'i sems khong gi 'khyag dar de sil bur gsil thub pa'i rno sta lta bu zhig yin dgos’’zhes pa de'o/ /deb 'di ni dngos gnas 'u cag gi‘‘sems khong gi 'khyag dar’’sil bur gsil thub pa'i‘‘rno sta’’lta bu zhig red ce na thal mi che bar sems so/ /〈rtul phod can gyi bsam pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa〉(rngu‘‘rtul phod can ni nga dang mnyam du nang du skyod/ sdar ma dag ni snga mo'i dus nas bral bar shog’’ces pa'i tshig dum 'di ni rtsom pa po wang kha'e ling lags kyis khong gi dpe deb kyi mdun shog steng bkod 'dug cing klog pa po rnams la gnangs pa'i‘‘lde mig’’red/ deb 'di ma bklags pa'i yar sngon la mdun shog steng nas gcig tu gong gi tshig dum 'di mthong ba dang / gnyis su brgya lo19pa dang20pa'i nang gi gser gyi ri lta bu'i‘‘rtul phod can’’skor zhig gi sku par la mjal thub ste/ de dag ni u ru su'i sol ze nyi chen dang kor khi②e ren puradhi'ajar man gyi polarjo sogs red/ der brten/ klog pa po zhig la mtshon na deb pa'i—༷markukausna/ṭ+wāṃ.ā+oṃ༈0shāsmo1 ñtshashā&ñtsā pyostun+d+raḍāhūṃl+lī ne+eram̐ shāgli 0hūṃrku r+shashaṃ/globartsams chos dus dang mi ma thun —bye salnge /snro dz+rī rnoñtsidhe~X/ṭ+wāṃni sgo7tre72ba65ṣātha tsholko skyeṣ+ṭha 1891—1967)u ru su 'i rtsom mkhan/ brtsa mas chor mi bunugyipol/(5/phyo/ /khrine1917—༵9kaudzhai'asbyar sdin gyi rtsom maṭ+wān/ brtsams chosapol gyi rtsom dpyadadangasgyu rtsal rang dbangari gas 'dug 19—2 ra la ma ga bya dga' ba/ da 123 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'di klog pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen du snying stobs dang blo spobs nges can zhig ma ldan tshe/ deb 'di'i shog lho dang po de phar slog rgyu'ang ha cang dka' ba'i gnas su gyur 'dug pa red/yin na'ang dpa' gdeng can gyi klog pa po skor zhig spobs pa cher bskyed kyis‘‘rtul phod can gyi bsam pa'i rjes su 'brangs’’song / deb 'di ru rtsom pa po'i dpe klog gi zin tho21bsdus 'dug pa dang /bklags pa'i dpe deb dag kyang khos brjod pa'i‘‘nges pa don gyi dpe deb kyis mi de ‘skrag’tu 'jug srid’’pa tag tag red/ dper na/dbyin ji'i rtsom mkhan or weladugyi〈byol song gling ka〉〉dang〈1984〉kor khi yi〈dus dang mi mthun pa'i bsam blo〉 h+pha ran si'i rtsom mkhan kha mu'uduyi〈ngo rgol pa〉 u ru su'i rtsom mkhan pa na ye h+phidhiyi〈〈skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i lo zla〉 sol ze nyi chen gyi〈rang rnam〉 e ren pur gyi〈mi bu lo zla 'tsho ba〉〉 sogs yin pa red/ brtsams chos de dag bklags pa brgyud rtsom pa po'i nang sems nas ci zhig bshad 'dod kyi spobs pa zhig me ri ltar 'phyur zhing / gsar brje dang rgyal khab/chab srid dang bsam blo/ shes yon can dang 'thab mo pa sogs kyi skor byol zhu nga glik+tonā ༷ṅgi/garlo hā/sgo72//tshotsholo 1903—19kha0)datram̐nasdo'irtsom maXn/ brtsamasachos 1984ṭ+wāṃngagar rtsohā rirno snarnyi//skibasbyisnas ts+tshaslo0sna rnoslo ni1ldarā1sbyi6 smrañtsā r+shashā /ṭaṃ k+tazhi grub smra ba' brtsams sgrung mkhan dang / sa zlaso sgo nā 'arji / ya h+phi/ khu.a4rke1—1)u ru su' —ma mkhan/ brtsams chosaskar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i lo — 124 —

bsam blo'i 'a la ba da ring mo/la rang rkya 'pher ba'i lta tshul gsong por brjod 'dugartul phod can de dag gi bsam blo dang mi gzhi/ blo spobs dang rgyu 'bras blo mig sogs la shes rtogs cung tsam byung ba na 'u cag gi‘‘sdar ma’’rnams kyi bya spyod dag rang bzhin gyis lhang la bud 'ongs pa dang /gal te 'u cag la'ang khong rnam pa lta bu'i rtul phod can kha shas byung yo/da tshe rang re'i lo rgyus kyi glegs bam de'ang da lta'i 'di 'dra zhig min pa thag gis chod do/ /2007lo'i zla4pa'i tshes12nyin lan gru ru/

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/khro gnyen dang 'dzum mdangs/da walu'u zhun dang hu'u hri snying stobs las 'phros pa'i gtam/kho bo'i bris rtsom〈dang rten dang skur 'debs—dra ngos kyi dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gyi skor gleng ba〉(gnyis pa)① zhes par 'di 'dra'i skad cha zhig yod de/ ‘‘mi rigs rang la dus rabs dang spyi tshogs la 'tsham pa'i bsam blo'i thon khungs dang rin thang lta tshul zhig nges par du dgos song ba red/ yang gcig bshad na dus rabs dang spyi tshogs la 'tsham pa'i rig gnas snying stobs shig nges par du dgos song ba red/ 'u cag gi gtso rgyugs rig gnas ni ldog ste mi bu 'bur 'joms dang mi bu'i rin thang khyad du gsod pa'i rig gnas shig yin phyin/ deng sang gi dus rabs dang spyi tshogs la mi 'tsham pa red/de bas 'u cag gi mig ltos ni mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas snying stobs steng la mi phyogs thu med yin song / de la rkyen byas te mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas snying stobs la slob sbyong dang tshur len byed dgos byung ba red/ rgya'i na gzhon rang dbang shes yon can yus ce lags kyis blo 'byed kyi thad nas rgya mi rigs kyis slob sbyong dang tshur len byed dgos du 〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur/2007lo'i zla3pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos4par 'khod/— 126 —

khro gnyer dang 'dzum mdangs/pa'i bsam blo'i thon khungs brgyad brtsis yod pa las bzhi ni 'u cag la yang shin tu phan par 'dod de/ de dag ni/ (1)gna' rabs ke ri se dang ro ma'i dpyod shes ring lugs dang khrims lugs rig pa'i srol rgyun/ (2)rig rtsal bskyar dar tshun gyi mi lugs ring lugs kyi bsam blo/ (3)a ri gtso byas pa'i nub phyogs deng rabs kyi rtsa khrims chab srid shes rig (4)lnga bzhi'i rig gnas gsar pa gtso byas pa'i krung go'i deng rabs rig gnas bcas so/ /ngas bltas na 'u cag gi deng rabs rig gnas kyi kha phyogs ni bod rang gi btsan po'i skabs kyi rig gnas snying stobs rmang gzhi byas thog gong du brjod pa'i bsam blo'i thon khungs bzhi bo des zur brgyan pa dang / da dung de'i steng du gna' rabs ke ri se'i so khi ra the dang / rgya gar gyi sems dpa' chen por 'bod pa'i gan dhi/ u ru su'i sol ze nyi chen/ yo rob shar ma'i ha wel dang wa le sa'/ me che ne khi/ a me ri kha'i mar thin lu sir khen/ lho a h+phe ri kha'i man ti la/ rgya nag gi li'u zha'o po sogs skyes chen dag gi bsam blo dang snying stobs kyis kha skong dgos par 'dod/'di ni kho bos 'dod pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rig gnas dang rig gnas gsar pa'i ma lag go’’zhes pa'o/ / skad cha 'di dag ni spyir na bam bshad dang spyi bshad cig tu song yo/da na'ang / rang nyid kyis bod kyi deng rabs rig gnas gsar 'dzugs thad bton pa'i lta tshul rags pa — 127 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/tsam 'ig yi na la/ lo ngo 'di 'ga'i ring la yang nas yang du zhun brdar byas pa'i bsam gzhig gi 'bras bu zhig kyang yin/nye char/ 〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉gyi〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉par ngos kyi rtsom sgrig pa tshe ring bkra shis lags nas gleng gzhi 'di 'u cag gi rig gnas pa'i sde la mtshon na ha cang gal chen 'ig yin par mthong ste/ de ga'i tshags par steng‘‘rig gnas snying to/bas gsar 'dzugs’’zhes pa'i gleng gzhi zhig bkod sgrig byas te rgya che'i smyug thogs pa rnams la bgro gleng gi stegs bu zhig yangs por bskrun 'dug pa red/ rtsom sgrig pa zhig gi ngos thad nas shes rig bgro gleng gi khor yug gtsang yangs shig skrun par 'bad 'bad dung dung byed bzhin pa de ni nga tsho la mtshon na cis kyang rjes su yi rang byed dgos pa'i gnas su 'khums/ 'u cag la ma gzhi nas dpyod shes dang rgyu 'bras kyi blo mig gsal ba'i dus deb dang rtsom sgrig pa mdzub mo nang 'gug gis ga tshod bgrang rgyu yod ang /gong gi bam bshad du song yod pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rig gnas gsar 'dzugs thad kyi rig gnas snying stobs de dag ni shin tu rgya che la gting zab pa dang / zhib par gleng dgos tshe rig gnas snying stobs re re yang glegs bam gang mang zhig tu bskyil dgos tshod red/ de lta'i 'bras bu ni kho bo gcig pu'i 'jon pa zhig ma yin la/ kho bo lta bu'i ge 128 —

khro gnyer dang 'dzum mdangs/skyes sto/bas kyi shes rab dang sbyangs stobs kyi yo/na tan nyis cha nas 'an pa zhig gis lcogs pa 'ig ni de bas kyang ma yin no/ /de ni mi bu gang mang 'ig gi blo gros dang shes yo na/ 'bad brtson so/gas la rag las pa 'ig red/ de bas bdag la mtshon na mi rigs ga'an gyi banu/ma blo'i thon khungs dang rig gnas snying stobs dag las rang nyid kyis lcogs tshod cig gleng bar 'dod cing / de yang gtso bo mi rigs rang gi gnas bab la rkang btsugs te spyi tshogs la 'tsham zhing bsam blo'i rin thang dang ldan pa dag rang gi go ba len stangs ltar tshig nyung don 'dus kyi sgo nas ngo sprod rags tsam byed 'dod do/ /‘‘bod btsan po'i skabs kyi rig gnas/ snying stobs’’skor la sku 'bas nyi gzhon lags kyi〈thu bhod kyi rig gnas snying stobs〉// dang kho bo'i〈〈〈phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo〉las bstan pa'i bod btsan po'i skabs kyi mi chos bsam blo'i skor la dpyad pa〉〉tshobhesna sogs su cung tsam spros yo/da pas klog po rnams kyis de gar gzigs pas 'thus la/ 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni‘‘lnga bzhi’’las 'gul skabs kyi rig gnas gsar pa'i dar cha lta bu'i skyes chen gnyis te lu'u zhun(1881—1936)ngos 1lco~Xparanyi ga ginān/ gyirig gnas snying stobs 〉yu na nan mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 200 gyi lo'i zla dang po'i par 'os 1 hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ ga/ 'a /lca/'i khu sim khad kyis dkrog〉kan su 'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 20)5'o'i zla12pa'i pa ra zorka ngotra — 129 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dang hu'u hri(1891——1962)gnyis yin cing / khong rnam pa gnyis ni rgya nag gi rig gnas kyi sde dang bsam blo'i sde la mtshon na shugs rkyen ches che zhing mtshan snyan ches cher 'bar ba gnyis yin pas mi tshad/ da dung bsam blo'i thon khungs gtos che ba gnyis kyang yin pa red/ khong gnyis kyi sku par gang mang zhig la bltas na lu'u zhun lags ni khro gnyer gyi nyams kyis bsdad 'dug la/ hu'u hri lags ni 'dzum mdangs kyi nyams kyis bsdad 'dug pa red/ sku par steng mngon pa'i‘‘khro gnyer’’dang‘‘'dzum mdangs’’gnyis kyis khong gnyis kyi gshis ka dang langs phyogs sogs mtshon 'dug pa dang / tha na so so'i snying stobs shig mtshon 'dug ces kyang brjod chog deng sang rgya'i rig gnas kyi sde na'ang‘‘lu'u zhun snying stobs’’dang‘‘hu'u hri snying stobs’’zhes shes yon can mang po zhig gis de la zhib 'jug byed pa dang / snying stobs de rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gyi phyogs la yang las don gang mang bsgrubs dang sgrub mus su mchis/ yang na lu'u zhun gyi lam bu dang hu'u hri'i lam bu zhes krung go'i shes yon can gyi lam bu rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis su brtsis te so so'i rin thang 'khyer so ltar/ la la lu'u zhun gyi lam bu'i steng gom pa spo bzhin yod la/ la la hu'u hri'i lam bu'i steng gom kha sgyur gyin yod pa red/ snga ma ni dper na lin zhan kri dang chan li chun — 130 —
