khro gnyer dang 'dzum mdangs/sogs lta bu dang / phyi ma ni dper na sku tshe smad kyi li hren kri(kyedang zhe yung②sogs lta bu'o/ /yang shes yon can kha shas kyis‘‘tag tag lo ngo brgya 'gor song na'ang krung go'i gnad don ni sngar bzhin sngon gyi gnad don de ga rang red la/ sngon chad hu'u hri dang lu'u zhun gnyis mgo 'thom myong ba'i gnad don dag gis da lta nga tsho yang sngar ba'in mgo 'thom du bcug yod/ 'di ni krung hwa mi rigs kyi skyo gar zhig go’’②zhes kyang brjod myong / zhib tu bsam na don gyis gnad don(rang dbang dang mang gtso/ tshan rig sogs)'di dag ni 'u cag gi gnad don zhig kyang ci la min/ gnad don de dag la gdong gtod phyir nga tshos kyang lu'u zhun gyis mtshon pa'i‘‘dgag sgrub snying stobs’’sogs dang hu'u hri yis mtshon pa'i‘‘dkyel yangs snying stobs’’sogs tshur len dang tha na der slob sbyong yang byed dgos 'dug gsham du‘‘lu'u zhun snying stobs’’dang‘‘hu'u hri snying stobs’’gnyis las 'u cag la sman pa'i gsos su 'gyur ba skor zhig dpe mtshon du drangs te brjod na/dgag sgrub dang dkyel yangs/chos snyo na tram̐phre r+shathrung/( zlo/kau ṅges dze+ekaulhaḍāskyirnyiṭ+wāṃ )trīsdir+sha go'i dedu rabs kyi mkhas pa dngatre / bas ma blo rdzuXn/ brtsasduX rang dalbong māṃl+lī ga/sa( 4sa lha na 1shāt+na 1rme ༵sa ldib gh+ra' the sa kā lha pyu mkhas pa/ brtsams sa'adas pa' pa zla—krung 'a 360② 0lko rmaṣ+ṭhayākāmya〉 ṭ+wāṃkāmi/sgyu.oṃrma lolo)lkuzatsāsku ā+oṃrje1rki lam̐lornye khyi2003lho12(li2 — 131 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/‘6mi rigs kyi sgal tshigs’’dang‘‘rus pa mkhregs po’’ru 'bod pa'i lu'u zhun lags kyis sku tshe gang bor sger gcod ring lugs dang blun rmongs ring lugs la mtha' gcig tu dgag sgrub tsha nan byas shing /srid dbang la 'phrad na rung bstun mi byed pa dang rtsod zla la 'phrad na‘‘gcig kyang gu yangs su mi gtong’’ba ni khong gi gshis su grub 'dug pa red/ 1933lor 'jar pan gyi grogs po zhig la bskur pa'i 'phrin yig cig tu khong gis 'di skad du/ ‘‘nye char krung go'i rnam pa can gyi h+pha shi si(ṣ+ṭhastesbemo)dar 'go tshugs song / grogs po'i khrod du mi gcig bor song la mi gcig lkog gsod byas song / da dung mi mang po zhig lkog gsod byed pa'i nyen kha shin tu che/ ji ltar bshad kyang rung nga ni da rung gson por gnas yod/ nga rang da dung gson por gnas thub pa yin na ngas ni smyu gu lag tu 'chang ste kho tsho'i dkrum mda' la ya lan sprod nges yin’’dhizhes brjod/ tshig dum thung thung 'di las kyang nga tshos khong gi dgag sgrub snying stobs kyi zur trem zhig mthong thub pa yin no/ /‘‘krung go'i rig rtsal bskyar dar gyi pha yab’’dang‘‘krung go'i rang dbang ring lugs kyi 'thus tshab mi sna’’ru 'bod pa'i hu'u hri lags kyis‘‘lnga bzhi’’las 'gul gyi skabs su blo 'byed bsam blo'i las su zhugs 137① rmi khwa smye 〈sprarki7)’chahwad ṣ+pelho.ā+oṃrjeh+pho kāskye47 0phro〉lpoglo rkiṭha yam̐ lornyekre2007ñtsa 3(lo2 — 132 —

khro gnyer dang 'dzum mdangs/nas dgag sgrub kyi lnga gas rtsom mang du spel cing / rim gyis rang dbang ring lugs(/ni khe ko kro)kyi lam bur zhugs te srid don phyogs/ la hur brtson byas/ rang dbang ring lugs ni hu'u hri lags kyi mi tshe gang bo'i hur brtson gyi dmigs 'ben yin pa dang / rang dbang ring 'u gasri pa zhig yin min gyi tshad 'jal byed gcig ni mi des dkyel yangs dang sga ma dkyel la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur ga 'dra yin pa de redari ces nga ba'in du/dkyel yangs dang sgam dkyel ni hu'u hri lags kyi bsam blo'i srog r+shang lta bur gyur 'dug pa red/ de bas khong si/sa tsho‘sgam/ jakyel ni rang ngabang las kyang da dung lhag par gco che'o’’zhes yang nas yang du brjod myong ba red/ khong gis de ltar smra ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ‘‘nga tshos kyang 'di ltar bshad chog ste/ sgam dkyel ni rang dbang gi rtsa ba'o/ /spyi tshogs steng sgam dkyel med tshe rang dbang yang yod mi srid/ gna' deng krung phyi gang zhig la mtshon na'ang 'di ltar yin te/ sgam dkyel med pa yin na rang dbang yod mi srid do/ /mi rnams kyis/ nam yang kho tsho'i dran tshul 'khrul med yin pa dang / kho tsho'i bsam blo yang dag yin pa/ kho tsho'i dad pa'ang yang dag yin par yid ches byeja kyi yo/da pa red/ 'di ni sgam dkyel ma yin pa yo/da tshad kyi rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs red/ ga'oca te ('i ram̐ slosmo)t+takha/tsho 〈ge4p+lu( 1(// 1 kronya) glu/ //7 ༈‘ mizhi 〉〈rwa—/ ///—sprapyaṣ+peṇ+ḍaṃ//khu)7/shrī tsā ///shā/ haṃ〉 ( / /) hūṃ//3 ‘/33/ )da 133 ——

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/spyi tshogs steng gi dbang grags ldan pa'i mi tshang mas kho tsho'i dad pa 'khrul med yin pa dang kho tsho'i bsam blo 'khrul med yin par 'dod tshe/kho tshos mi gzhan la dad mos rang dbang dang bsam blo rang dbang /smra brjod rang dbang / dpe skrun rang dbang bcas ye nas ster mi srid do’’dhizhes brjod/ der brten/ hu'u hri lags ni dus rabs20pa'i krung go'i shetra/ yo/na can gyi khrod nas dkyel yangs smra ba 'khrul med cig yin pa red/bsam blo gsar brje dang chab srid legs bcos/lu'u zhun lags kyis spyi tshogs shig 'phel rgyas dang shes rig dar ba'i lam du skyod dgos tshe‘‘bsam blo gsar brje’’dang‘‘rgyal dmangs kyi gshis kar bcos sgyur’’byed dgos par 'dod la/ hu'u hri lags kyis de dang mi mtshungs par‘‘chab srid legs bcos’’byed rgyu ni gtso bo yin par 'dod/ ‘‘lnga bzhi’’las 'gul la mtshan gsol stangs kyi thog nas kyang khong gnyis kyi khyad par de zur tsam mthong thub ste/ hu'u hri lags ni‘‘lnga bzhi’’zer ba las‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’zer bar mos pa dang /lu'u zhun lags kyis‘‘lnga bzhi’’la‘‘bsam blo gsar brje’’zhes 'bod par 251 du lotho ṭ+wāṃlnga kuthokhrikhye〉ṭ+wāṃlngakurokhrikhyed oṃcalta.oṃṭ+wā〉snro shi7lornyeṭ+wāṃ2006lho3(lo2 — 134 —

khro gnyer dang 'dzum mdangs/spro ba red/‘‘rgyal dmangs kyi gshis kar bcos sgyurari’byed pa dang66rgyal dmangs kyi gshis kar dgag sgrubari’byed rgyu ni lu'u zhunatsholags kyi 'gan 'khri gtso bo yin pa dang / de ni khong gi mthar thug gi bas/ma blo'i 'bab sa'ang yin pa red/ de bas〈a'agatam rgyud〉〉dang〈〈smyon pa'i zin tho〉sogs kyis mtshon pa'i brtsams sgrung dang 'bol rtsom sogs ljags rtsom mang du spel ba red/ spyi gzhung bya gzhag(yi༅bye /—/ 〉)la do khur dang dngos yod chab srid legs bcos kyis rang dbang ring lugs kyi lam bur 'jug rgyu ni hu'u hri lags kyi 'gan 'khri gtso bo nyid yin cing / khong gi sku tshe gang bo'i hur brtson gyi kha phyogs kyang yin pa red/de bas〈〈rang dbang ring lugs〉dang〈'gro ba mi'i thob thang gleng ba'i bsdus rtsom gyi gleng gzhi〉〉sogs kyis mtshon pa'i srid don dpyad brjod sogs ljags rtsom mang du spel ba red/ de ni dus rabs20pa'i lo rabs20pa'i nang du khong gis gtso gnyer byas pa'i dus deb〈brtson pa〉nas〈〈zla gsar〉dang / lo rabs30pa'i nang gi〈sger tshugs dpyad brjod〉nas lo rabs40pa'i smad kyi〈rang dbang krung go〉bcas la phyi mig cig bltas tshe khong gi zhabs rjes re re ni chab srid legs bcos dang rang dbang ring lugs kyi zhabs rjes re re yin pa gsal por mthong thub bo/ /— 135 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bas ma blo gsar brje dang chab srid legs bcos gnyis kyi thad nas / ‘‘lu'u zhun gyi gtan tshigs ni rgyal dmangs legs po 'ig meng pa yin na srid gzhung legs po zhig kyang yod mi srid pas/ rgyal dmangs gnad don thag gcod bya ma thub tshe dmangs skyong(khu r+sha/)gnad don gleng thabs bral tshes pa de red la/ hu'u hri yis de las ldo ga ste gnad don ni rgyal dmangs kyi phyogs na med par srid gzhung gi phyogs na yo/da de/ gal te rgyal dmangs la gnad don yo/da pa'i dbang du btang yang dmangs skyong ni spel chog chog yin pa red/ de ni dmangs skyong la ma ga'i nas spyi dmangs legs po zhig bzo ba'i byed nus ldan pas so’’tu)zhes pa'o/ /'bol rtsom dang skabs don dpyad bajod/gong du bstan pa ltar lu'u zhun lags ni‘‘bsam blo gsar brje’’la spro ba dang hu'u hri lags/ ni‘‘chab srid legs bcos’’la phyogs pa red/‘‘bsam blo gsar brje’’yin na'ang 'dra/ ‘‘chab srid legs bcos’’yin na'ang 'dra/ las de gnyis la 'jug par rang rang la thun mong ma yin pa'i‘‘mtshon cha’’re yo/da pa red/ de bas lu'u zhun lags kyis rang gyi 1hā྾stustu lha 9〈ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ka〉rtsokreṭ+wālā5rikolko ri— stulko〈oṃphywa rkispra〉(lko2/ni) /d+ngha1twa)/ko/ —kyo.oṃr+ha54 a/1 20(5da 136 da

wo gnyene+e dang 'jum mdangs si‘‘mtshon cha’’ni‘‘'bol rtsom’’la byas te mi lo stong phrag du ma'i ring bi srol rgyun gyi bag chags rnying pa dang ‘myi za ba'i’’rig gnas/ snya༈(tuyi tha mal ba'i gshis ka sogs la dgag sgrub tsha nan mdzad pa dang / hu'u hri lags kyis rang gi‘‘ma chon cha’’ni‘‘skabs don dar+yad brjod’’'a/ byas te sge ra gcod ring lugs kyi nag nyes/ dang khrims med lugs/ med kyi bya spyod/rang dbang mang gtso'i rin thang sogs rgyu ma ci/ 'ded kyis/ brjod nga/ red/‘‘ 'bol rtsom’’ gyis dgag sgrub dang su na 'byin/ ther 'don/6‘gshag bcos ’’sogs lhur len pa dang / ‘‘skabs don dbya da brjod/’’ni dgag sgrub sogs‘‘'bol rtsom’’la mnga' ba'i khyad chos dag ga'ir bzung ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng spyi gzhung bya ga'ag dang skabs don chab srid kyi phyogs la gzhol che ba zhig red/ ‘‘'bol rtsomari’ni‘‘khro nyams’’de dkar gtsang gi shog bu'i ngos su yi ge'i gzugs su mngon pa yin na/‘‘skabs don dpyad brjod’’kyis‘‘'dzum dmul’’dang bcas dbang sgyur srid gzhung la‘‘'gram lcag’’tsha thag chod pa zhig gzhu ba red/yang dpe'i ngos nas brjod na/ ‘‘'bol rtsom’’ni‘‘glo gri’’ngar ma zhig dang 'dra la/ ‘‘skabs don dpyad brjod’’ni‘‘glo gri’’ngar ma'i steng ‘dkar po chig thub’’cig bsnan pa dang yang 'dra'o/ /snga mas pha rol po la‘‘gshag bcos’’dang‘‘'dzer’’ci thub byed la/ phyi mas pha rol po la‘‘gshag bcos ’byed pa'i dus mtshungs su‘‘sman mchog’’kyang gnang ba — 137 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/red/deng gi rgya nag gi shes yon can gyi sde ru‘‘'bol rtsom’’la 'jug pa'i lu'u zhun dang‘‘skabs don dpyad brjod’’la 'jug pa'i hu'u hri gnyis ni so so'i rin thang lta tshul gyi mtshon don zhig tu gyur 'dug ste/de la kho tshos‘‘‘'bol rtsom’ni lu'u zhun red la hu'u hri ni ‘skabs don dpyad brjod’do’’zhes thal ba red/shes yon can gyi lam bu gnyis/lu'u zhun bskyod pa'i lam bu ni blo 'byed bsam blo'i lam bu yin pa dang / hu'u hri bskyod pa'i lam bu ni rang dbang ring lugs kyi lam bu yin pa red/ yang na lu'u zhun bskyod pa'i lam bu ni‘‘rgyal dmangs kyi gshis kar bcos sgyur’’byed pa'i lam bu red la/ hu'u hri bskyod pa'i lam bu ni‘‘dngos yod chab srid legs bcos’’byed pa'i lam bu red/de lta bu'i lam bu rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis byung don yang khong gnyis kyi bsam blo'i rgyab ljongs dang phyi 'grim slob gnyer gyi rgyab ljongs bcas la rag las 'dug ste/ lu'u zhun gyis shar phyogs yul gyi 'jar pan nas 'jar man gyi nis chadhiring lugs dang srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugasachosaskyorno spyosdo khyi rmi/ slorno rnapyo pas+dza shākaulda0 shārnyisokaukli 'a/lha44—1900)'jar man gyi mtshan nyid rig pa mkhan/ brtsams — 138 —

gnyer dang 'dzum mdangs/(rkeṣ+ṭha/pochaspra)skor gyi‘‘nu zho’’nus pa dang / hu'u hri yis nub phyogs yul gyi a me ri kha nas dbyin ji dang a ri'i rang dbang ring lugs(yo r+sādzekherngukro)skor gyi‘‘nu zho’’nus pas red/ der brten/ hu'u hri lags kyis nam yang dbyin ji dang a me ri kha'i legs bcos rang bzhin ldan pa'i rang dbang ring lugs kyis krung go 'di skyob par 'dod pa dang / lu'u zhun lags kyi krung go'i gnad don thag gcod pa'i thabs lam de ni gtso bo su'u len dang u ru su'i rnam pa can gyi 'byor med gral rim gyi steng la phyogs 'dug pa red/①nga tshos khong gnyis brgyud pa'i lam bu de la rgyus lon cung tsam byung rjes 'di ltar yang smra chog ste/ lu'u zhun lags ni dgag sgrub chos can gyi shes yon can(miram̐//7ṣ+ṭhakāṭha〉po )gyi rigs su gtogs pa dang hu'u hri lags ni 'dzugs skrun chos can gyi shes yon can(tshornyekhri7dzā0kāya〉r+ha)gyi rigs su gtogs pa red/ ltos bcas kyis snga ma la‘‘gtor’’gyi cha mang du ldan zhing phyi ma la‘‘'dzugs’’kyi cha mang du ldan pa red/ so so'i zur mi krādra ba'i dbang gis lu'u zhun sogs kyis nam yang bas mtha' pa'i tshul bzung ste lam lugs kyi phyi nas dgag sgrub kyi las la 'jug pa dang /hu'u hri sogs kyis nam yang sgam dkyel pa'i tshul bzung ste lam lugs kyi lolot+takhyuspyuspyushās+ho sbyilto/ lo stotshi2uṣ+yo.oṃkro7rtsakroroḍasngoṣ+ṭha〉〈rngu༈tshordzopyatsho )skrophro/shrīdzāsmokā (/11 —da ge da wa 139 da wa

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/nang nas dgag sgrub byed pa'i zhor du chab srid legs bcos(zhi bde'i bcos sgyur yang zer)la brtson pa red/ de ni khong gi gtam bshad cig las kyang gsal por mthong thub ste/ kho/ nga gis‘‘mdor na/ rang dbang ring lugs kyi go don dang po ni rang dbang dang / go don gnyis pa ni mang gtso/ go don gsum pa ni sgam dkyel te phyogs 'gal skyid sdug la sgam dkyel byed pa/ go don bzhi pa ni zhi bde dang rim car gyi bcos sgyur yin no’’zhes zer/(t+ya‘‘khro nyams’’mngon pa'i lu'u zhun yin na'ang 'dra/ ‘‘'dzum mdangs’’phyung ba'i hu'u hri yin na'ang 'dra/ da lta'i 'u cag gi rig gnas pa'i sde la mtshon na khong gnyis ka'i snying stobs ni shin tu nas mkho gal che 'ing / 'u cag gi shes yon can tsho'i hur brtson gyi kha phyogs kyang gcig ni lu'u zhun gyis mtshon pa'i blo 'byed bsam blo dang rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi lam bu yin dgos pa dang / cig shos ni hu'u hri yis mtshon pa'i chab srid legs bcos dang rig gnas 'dzugs skrun gyi lam bu yin dgos par 'dod/ mi bu'i rtogs pa ma sa da cing chos lugs kyi rmongs 'thom las thar med pa'i 'u cag la mtshon na lu'u zhun gyi‘‘glo gri’’ngar ma mkho la/ chos lugs rig gnas kho na ma 159 ① nya/lo 〈khri/11lha tsho〉〈stsa skru dze+edzikhyed lolo༈r+sā7 ṇimyu〉lo4 nelam̐glornyetram̐ 2006ci3ya lam̐/lo snga da 140 da

khro gnyer dang 'dzum mdangs/gtogs mi chos rig gnas kyi nyi zer tsam yang phog ma myong ba'i 'u cag la ma tshon na hu'u hri yi‘‘da/kar po chig thub’’kyang shin tu mkho ba red/de sngon lu'u zhun dang hu'u hri gnyis bzhud myong ba'i lam bu de ni da lta 'u cag brgyud dgos pa'i lam bu yin pa dang / mi lo70lhag gi yar sngon du lu'u zhun dang hu'u hri gnyis 'phrad myong ba'i gnad don dag ni da lta'i 'u cag gi mig mdun du dpyangs yo/da pa'i gnad don yang yin pa red/ de bas 'u cag gi shes yon can gyi sde 'dir mtshon na‘‘glo gri’’ngar ma'i 'bol rtsom la 'jug ci thub byed dgos pas mi tshad/‘‘dkar po chig thub’’kyi skabs don dpyad brjod la yang hur brtson chen pos 'jug dgos so/ /nye ba'i lo 'di 'ga'i ring la 'u cag gi rig gnas kyi sde ru 'bol rtsom la 'jug mi cung mang zhing rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi tsha rlabs shig 'phyur ba'in pa ni dngos gnas dga' 'os pa'i gnas su mchis pa dang /de ni sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi dang rang dbang gi bsam blo la nges shes cung tsam rnyed pa'i rtags mtshan zhig kyang yin pa red/ yin na'ang rig gnas dgag sgrub kho nas 'u cag gi deng rabs rig gnas gsar 'dzugs kyi bya gzhag la rngo thogs dka' bas 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin gyi rig gnas gsar 'dzugs kyi las don 'di'ang snang med du gtan nas bskyur mi rung ngo / / yang gcig bshad na/ rang re'i shes yon can — 141 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rnams ‘‘gtor’’gyi phyogs kho na la mgo 'khor nas mi 'dug par‘‘'dzugs’’kyi phyogs la yang bsam blo yang yang gtong ba'i dgos pa shin tu che snyam/ 'u cag gi shes yon can gyi sde'i‘‘gtor’’gyi cha dar ba dang‘‘'dzugs’’kyi cha stong ba'i‘‘do mi mnyam’’pa'i gnad don 'di la dmigs te/ kho bos〈shes yon can〉zhes pa'i dmangs khrod kyi nang khul dus deb cig gnyer nas 'di'i thad la smra brjod kyi stegs bu zhig bskrun 'dod snying nas che zhing / gal te lam lhongs 'dra byung tshe〈shes yon can〉'di ni 'u cag gi deng rabs rig gnas gsar 'dzugs thad kyi bgro gleng gi stegs bu zhig tu 'gyur rgyu'i re ba yod/rtsom thung 'di mjug bsdu la nye ba'i skabs su rgya nag gi lu'u zhun zhib 'jug ched mkhas pa sun yusadulags kyi skad cha zhig mthong byung ste/skad cha 'di mjug bsdu'i gtam gyi tshul du 'dir 'god pa la/ khong gis 'di skad du/ ‘‘sku zhabs ka'o yon tung lags kyis lu'u zhun snying stobs ni ‘sman’ dang / hu'u hri'i bsam blo ni ‘zas’la dpe bzhag 'dug pa de ni 'grel shin tu legs po zhig red/ kho bo ni 'dam ga 'di gnyis ka'i dgos nges rang bzhin la the tshom sru tsam yang med pa yin no/ /bkres skom gyis mnar ba'i mi rigs shig la mtshon na ches brtsamahri chosasusmuḍi snrun/ sdoṇ+ḍaṃ spyi'u sgri9/khyugs )'asdir+sha go'i deng rabs kyi rtsom mkhan dang / lu'u zhun la zhib 'jug byed mkhan/— 142 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/na mnyam grogs po zhig la bskur pa'i 'phrin yigagrogs po lags/nye char sku lus bde zhing slob gnyer gyi bgyi ba yar 'gro yin pa'i 'tshams zhu/ khyed kyis bskur pa'i 'phrin yig gnyis(2005lo'i zla12pa dang2006lo'i zla3 pa)snga phyir kho bo'i lag tu 'byor zhing / khyed kyi bya ba'i gnas tshul dang sems khong gi na zug sogs kyang 'phrin yig las wa ler mthong byung / khyod kyis ngas bris pa'i rtsom dag bklags shing kho bo na mnyam‘‘rtogs sad pa’’ru mthong nas nga dang lhag bsam rnam dag gis grogs/ shig bsgrig bsam pa la snying thag pa nas bka' drin mi chung ba zhu/kho bos snga mo nas 'phrin lan dus ltar du bskur dgos bsam yang bya ba'i brel 'tshub kyi dbang gis da lta'i bar du lus/ 'di la khyod kyis bzod sgom gnang rogs/ da nangs gzhung las khang du thon ma thag ma gzhi lag sne ru bya ba tsag tsig cig yod mod/ yin na'ang‘‘'phrin gyi bu lon’’'di myur du‘‘'jalari’dgos par mthong nas yi ge 'di 'bri 'go brtsams pa yin/khyed kyi 'phrin yig tu kher rkyang gi sdug bsngal dang / bsam gzhig gi spro snang / khor yug gi mun 'thom/ spyi tshogs kyi nag nyes — 144 —

na mnyam grogs po la bsar pa'i 'phrin yigasogs brjod 'dug par kho bo la'ang de mtshungs kyi mnyam 'ur byung /rgyu mtshan ni nga'ang khyod dang 'dra bar lang tsho ni ngar shugs kyis btegs shing / nag nyes la 'bur tshugs su lta bas so/ /'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus steng‘6sad’’snga ba'i mi bu su zhig la mtshon na'ang kher rkyang si sdug bsngal ma myangs pa dang rang sems sdug la mi sbyor mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dug 'u cag gi nyam chung zhing blo ma rgyas pa'i mi rigs 'dir mchon na da dung dus yun shin tu ring mo zhig la‘‘sad mi’’rnams kyi bsam ga'ig gi mgo bo thur du dpyangs shing / ljid tig tig gi gom pa mdun nas mdun du spo dgos tshod 'dug de bas sdug bsngal de dag ni rang nyid kyi nga rgyal cig tu brtsi chog chog yin la/ ‘‘bde skyid’’cig tu rlom chog chog kyang yin/da lo khyod mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling du zhib 'jug slob mar rgyugs 'phrod pa ni dngos gnas dga' 'os pa'i bya ba zhig red/ shes rmongs kyi ri grong zhig nas ltos bcas kyis deng rabs kyi khyad chos dod pa'i grong khyer zhig tu yong thub pa byung tshe/ rang gi lta rgya dang thos mya/dran rgya sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas je legs su 'gro nges/ spyir mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling ni mkhregs 'dzin dang srol rgyun gyi kha dbugs ha cang stug na'ang / khor yu/ga de'i nang nas snying stobs chen pos‘‘ku co’’brgyab ste thon pa yin na/ de ni da gzod dpa' bo yin pa — 1‘/5 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/red/ blo 'byed pa yin pa red/ de bzhin du bdag gis khyod la yang yang bshad pa bzhin mi bu de la‘‘lcags srog’’thogs srid pa red/ ngas bltas na khyod kyis mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling nas zhib 'jug slob ma'i sbyang bya gnyer ba'i dgos pa dang don snying gcig ni 'di na yod par snyam/ rang gi nye 'khor gyi dge slob tshos khyod la zur za dang tshig mtshon gyi mda' mo ji ltar bskor na chog yang na mngon lkog gang rung nas bas mtha' ru phud rgyag ji ltar btang yang rung / de dag khyod kyis‘‘dgra’’ru mi 'dzin par gnon shugs shig tu brtsis nas sgul shugs su bsgyur dgos pa red/ de ltar yong tshe mtha' mjug gi rgyal kha ni kho tsho'i ma yin par khyod rang nyid kyi yin pa red/ khyod kyis slob sbyong gi khor yug de bdams pa 'grig 'dug kha dpe la stag gsod na stag tshang nang nas gsod dgos zer ba ma yin nam/lo 'di 'ga'i ring la rang re'i rtsom stegs su srol rgyun rig gnas la phyir rtog dang dgag sgrub byed pa'i bsam blo'i mtho rlabs shig 'phyur zhing / de 'brel gyi brtsams chos kyang snga gzhug tu skor zhig thon pa red/ bsam blo rig gnas kyi mtho rlabs der dmigs nas shes nas smra mkhan dang ma shes par smra mkhan dang / lce ldan dang lce med gnyis kas‘‘byi ba khrom rgyug kun gyis rdung’’zer ba'i dpe ltar dgag lan ni char zhod ji bzhin babs byung / nga'i bris rtsom kho nar kha gtad pa'i — 146 —

na mnyam grogs po ga la bsar pa'i 'phrin yigadagag lan gyi skor(dpe deb dang dus deb sna tshogs/ da dung dra ngos sogs su gsal ba)yang deb chung chung zhig ni longs chod red/ don dngos su de dag gi nang du blo gzu bo'i sgo nas dgag sgrub byas yod pa ha cang nyung nyung red/ mang che ba ni〈bden pa'i rang sgra ma yin pa'i‘‘bden pa'i rang sgra’’bklags pa'i 'char snang〉lta bu'i snyad rko ba dang klan ka 'tshol ba rkyang red/ dkyel yangs dang dpyod shes kyis dgag pa rgyag mkhan ni shin tu nyung nyung red/ de bas rig gnas rtsod gleng gi ches ma mtha'i cha rkyen dag kyang med par byas 'gro bas rang dbang bgro gleng gi dbu chen mo ji ltar tshugs sam/ rig gnas kyi gad snyigs de dang de lta bu mang du byung bar snying nas ma bzod pa dang / rig gnas bgro gleng gi khor yug gtsang yangs shig chags par dmigs te nyid kyis kyang da lo'i〈shar dung ri〉yi steng du〈〈ku co〉'bri dgos byung ba red/ kha bde mgo yang tsho la ci bshad na bshad du chugs/ bshad yams dang dkrog gtam de dag gis nga tsho la ye nas gnod mi srid/ nga tshos de'i rigs la mi smra'i brtul zhugs bzung na dga'/ 'di'i rigs la kha ya byas te dus tshod 'phro brlag gtong ba las da dung bsam gzhig gi gtsub brdar khrod rtsom thung zhig la blos bslangs byas na legs snyam gyi yod/mi rang rang gi gshis ka dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so'i dbang gis nga la na mnyam khrod du blos thub kyi grogs po ha cang nyung / ldog ste rang — 147 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/las lo na che ba'i dar ma dang rgan pa'i khrod du mi phyed snying grogs kha shas yo/da/ nub byang mi rigs slob chen du slob gnyer byed pa'i skabs/ nas bzung rang dang na tshod mnyam pa'i bsam blo'i dpung grogs kha shas btsal myong yang / dus dang rgyu rkyen gang mang gi dbang gis re re bzhin du phan tshun gyi 'brel 'dris nyung nas nyung du phyin/ pha yu/la kan lho klu chu nas yin pa'i na mnyam grogs po(nga rang zhib 'jug slo ba ma lo rim gnyis par sleb dus kho rang dngos gzhi mthar phyin te bud song)zhig dang yig lam nas rig gnas bgro gleng mang du byas mod/ 'on kyang kho bo mthar phyin rjes de'i rgyun mu nas mur skyong ma thub pas da lta'i bar du blo pham ha cang che'o/ / zi ling du bya ba sgrub pa'i skabs su'ang rtsom sgrig gi dgos dbang gis mi mang po zhig la 'brel ba byas te ngo shes mang na'ang /sems pa'i nang la sems pa 'jog thub pa'i grogs po nyung ba yin/ de bas rgyun du rang dang na tshod mnyam pa'i bsam blo'i dpung grogs shig la snying nas re ba byed kyi yod/ lhag par du grogs po'i bar gyi 'brel zam de zhal mjal dang / kha par/ dra ba sogs brgyud pa las brtse sems kyis khyogs pa'i 'phrin lam brgyud par nga rang shin tu mos/'phrin yig ni da gzod nang sems dmar rjen mtshon byed dang / brtse ba lhog lhog tu 'phyur sa yin pa red ang / nyid kyis yid ches dang bcas 'phrin yig gi lam nas kho bo la grogs bsgrigs par snying nas — 148 —

na mnyam gro sa po rug la bsar pa'i 'phrin yigathugs rje che zhu ba'i dus mtshungs/ su/ 'phrin lam 'di'i rgyun mu ma thud du skyong rgyu'i 'dun pa shin tu che/ (grangs je mang dang don je 'dus/ gting je zab/ rgya je cher gtong dgos)nyin bcu lhag gi yar sngon la zi ling nas grogs sku 'bas byang skar tshang du nga tsho mnyam du 'dzoms te kha lag zos shing / kha brda t+na tshogs byas pa de ni kho bo'i snang ngor glog brnyan gyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba ji ba'in nam yang brjed thabs bral/ de ni grogs po dang grogs po'i bar gyi mdza' brtse'i gleng mol zhig dang / bsam blo dang bsam blo'i bar du mched pa'i shes rab kyi me stag 'ba' 'ig go/ slad mar yang nga tsho la 'di 'dra'i mnyam 'dzoms kyi go skabs mang nas mang du 'gro ba'i smon 'dun yang yang zhu/ zi ling du sdod pa'i lo ngo gsum gyi ring la khyod tsho'i slob gling gi dpe mdzod khang dang / zhing chen dpe mdzod khang gnyis kyi thon khungs de legs par bed spyod gnang rgyu mkhyen/ a ken thin gyi rtsom mkhan por ke sipokyelags kyis mi tshe gang bor dpe mdzod khang du phyag las gnang zhing dpe char gzigs pa'i gtang rag tu ma tha' mar rang nyid kyi spyan zung yang dpe mdzod khang la phul ba red/ 'u cag la de lta bu'i snying stobs mi ldan na'ang dpe klog ni mang tsam byed sgrungamaljan pokāgātrī/ (3byertsad+moshu~Xrngiri(maldirnorik+shi.a+yauzla1shāltasdirge~Xshākaulha.a ken thin gyi snyan ngag mkhan dang brtsa mas / / )ri da 149 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dgos 'dug 〈bla dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun thad la gong rim nas chog mchan thob pa dang / da lta rtsom sgrig gi lag len dngos la 'jug bzhin yod/ nyid kyi dpe cha yang 'char gzhi'i nang du bzhag zin/dpe tshogs mnyam gcig tu 'grem rgyu ni cung dka' tsam gda' bas/sngon la re re bzhin par skrun byed rtsis yod/ de bas khyod rang 'tshub cha dang sems 'tshab sogs ci yang langs mi dgos par bsam gzhig mthar chod pa byas te yun gyis bris pas chog sang lo'i spyi zla bcu pa'i bar du bris tshar na chog go/ dpe tshogs 'di 'dra zhig par skrun byed pa'i kho bo'i dmigs 'ben ni 'u cag gi khu sim pa'i rtsom stegs su‘‘gong mas na bza' ci yang mnabs mi 'dug’’zer mkhan gyi‘‘byis pa’’gzhung drang skor zhig sngog 'don byed rgyu de yin/'phrin yig gi zhor du rgya'i mi tshul mkhas pa lin zhan kri lags kyi bris rtsom zhig kyang bskur yod pas nyid kyis nyams su bzhes rogs/spyir na 'phrin yig 'di sug bris su bgyid dgos mod/ stabs bde zor yang gi ched du rtsis 'khor las yi ger btab pas khyed rang dgongs 'gal med par zhu zhes thengs 'di'i 'bri mtshams re zhig bzhag pa'o/ /grogs me lces spyi lo2006lo'i zla11pa'i ches16—17nyin lan gru ru/

gas sad dgag ba 'bras blo migartogs sad dgag sgrub rgyu 'bras blo migad wa nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi‘ rang mos gleng stegs’’steng nas gtam bshad pa'i sgra phab bshus pa/spyi lo2006lo'i zla4pa'i tshes23nyin/mgo 'dzin pa kirti skyabs/ brtse ldan gyi slob grogs rnam pa/ do dgong gi rang mos gleng stegs skabs30pa la nga chos〈mi gzhi'i snying stobs〉dang〈khu sim khad kyis dgrog〉gi rtsom pa po sku zhabs me lce lags 'dir ched du gdan 'dren byas nas slob grogs rnams dang mnyam du kha brda byed du 'jug rgyu yin/ khong da thengs lan gru la 'byor yod pa shes rjes nga chos 'chad khrid cig byed dgos pa'i re ba yang yang zhus pa dang / khong gis kyang bya ba'i bar glegs nas 'u cag la kha brda zhig byed par khas len byas pa la/ ngas 'di nas rang mos gleng stegs chogs pa dang〈shar dung ri〉rtsom sgrig chogs pa'i tshab byas te khong la lhag bsam zol med kyis bka' drin che zhus pa yin/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra) des na gsham nas sku zhabs me lce lags kyis dus tshod phyed ka'i ring la gtam bshad rgyu dang / bshad tshar rjes 'u cag dang mnyam du bgro gleng byed rgyu yin pas tshang mas 'dri chig mang po 'dri rgyu dang bcas da 'go rtsom rgyu bya'o/ /(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)me lce/ thog mar nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas 'u cag — 151 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/sla ra yang mnyam 'dzoms byung ste 'di 'dra'i kha brda 'ig byed pa'i go skabs byung ba la nga rang ha cang dga' ni yin/ spyir na da thengs nga rang lan grur sger gyi bya ba phran tshegs shig sgru ba tu yo/nga ba yin pas//slob grogs tsho dang kha brda byed rgyu'i gra sgrig ye nas med/ yin na'ang kha sang khe nyin rang mos gleng stegs kyi 'gan 'dzin pa dang〈shar dung ri〉yi 'gan 'dzin pa/ da dung zhib 'jug slo ba ma kha shas kyis 'di 'dra'i 'chad khrid cig bya dgos pa'i re ba yang yang zhus mthar ngas kyang khas ma blangs sa ma song ba lta bur gyur/ drang mor bshad na khong tsho'i ngo ma chod ni yin/ de ma gtogs nga la 'chad khrid byed rgyu'i gra sgrig med la/ cang bshad rgyu yang mi 'dug des na gsham nas ngas dus tshod phyed ka'i ring la rang gi dran tshul thung thung zhig bshad rjes gtso bo 'u cag gis mnyam du bgro gleng byed/ ngas kyang khyed rnams kyi bsam tshul la ha cang nyan 'dod che gi do dgong gi rang mos gleng stegs 'di sngar gyi rnam pa las 'da' 'gongs byung ste 'chad mkhan gyis gtam nyung du smra rgyu dang / nyam/ mkhan gyis gtam mang du smra rgyu byed/ do dgong smra brjod rang dbang gi khe dbang de khyed rnam par sprad pa yin/ (nyan po'i dgod sgra dang thal mo rdeb sgra)nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi bsam blo'i rtags mtshan dang tog lta bur gyur pa'i‘‘rang mos — 152 —

rtogs sad dgag ba bo 'bras blo migagleng stegs’’'di spyi lo2002'o/'i zla12pa'i tshes/8nyin 'bo tshugs pa nas bzung / de ring si bar du skabs 30pa la bslebs pa 'di ni 'dir bzhugs kyi slob grogs tsho dang lhag nga ra du rang mos gleng stegs kyi 'gan 'dzin pa rnams kyi bka' drin yin pa red/ rjes phyogs kyang 'di'i rgyun mu ma thud du skyong rgyu ni nga'i re ba yi na/ ya —da do dbong bi brjod gzhi dngos 'a/ 'jug pa la/ sgo sa/ma du〈rtoganu sa da dgag sgrub rgyu 'bras blo mi ga〉〉ces bris 'dug pa ltar/ blta sa/ tshod la sgo sri ma steng du yod pa'i tha snya/da dang brda chang 'di gsum ni spyir btang si brda chad gsum yin mod/ 'on kyang brda chang 'di gsu ma gyi thog nas deng rabs kyi 'u cag gi bas ma blo'i mu tho rlabs zer na'ang 'dra/ bas ma blo'i 'phel rim/ zer na'ang 'dra/ de gas/la por mthong thub gi ci 'ig la zer na/ brgya lo20pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa la sku 'bas/ bron grub rgyal gtso byas pa'i yo/na tan pa'i sde la rtogs sad thebs/ 'aso tshugs pa dang / de nas lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i smad tsam la yo/na tan pa'i sde nas dgag sgrub kyi lta tshul 'don mkhan kha ༅sa byung ba dang / deng ruki nga rgyu 'bras blo mig de shes yo na can gyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig tu brtsis te rig gnas kyi sde na shes/ yo/na can gyi blang bya gal chen 'ig tu 'gyur ba'in pa sogs las shes thub pa red/ rtogs sa da yin na 'dra/dgag sgru ba yin na 'dra/ rgyu 'bras blo mig yin na 'dra/ de la rang ge—— /du3 —

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/gzhan gnyis kyi thad nas go don gnyis re 'dug brda chad 'di gsum ga ni deng rabs bsam blo'i steng gi brjod gzhi'am srog lta bur gyur 'dug snyam la/ yang na deng rabs bsam blo'i phreng thag ring mo'i mdo 'dzin lta bu zhig tu'ang gyur 'dug snyam/ dang po/ rtogs sad ces pa ni ma rig pa'i mun pa dang rmongs dad kyi mu/na pa snang bar byas thog mi bu la skyes thob tu mnga' ba'i dpyod shes kyi blo rig mngon par phyung zhing / dbang dang grags pa'i(ṣ+ṭhatsho)rjes su ma song bar rang gi rigs shes kyis gzhal spobs pa zhig la go rgya yig gi7ma zhes pa bsgyur pa red/ de la don gnyis 'dus te/ gcig ni mi bu rang nyid rtogs sad thebs rgyu dang / gnyis ni mi bu gzhan rtogs pa sad du 'jug rgyu'o/ / gnyis pa/ dgag sgrub ces pa ni mi bu rnams blun rmongs ring lugs kyi sdom gcun las rnam par grol ba dang / bsam blo gsar pas rig gnas dang spyi tshogs dang chab srid sogs kyi las sgo bcos sgyur byed par gegs su 'gro ba'i bag chags rnying pa dang /bsam blo rnying pa/ goms srol rnying pa/ rig gnas snang tshul ngan pa dang spyi tshogs snang tshul ngan pa sogs la dgag pa dang mtshang 'byin byed par go rgya yig gi7ṇ+ḍaṃ/1 zhes pa bsgyur pa red/ de la'ang don gnyis 'dus te/ gcig ni rig gnas dang spyi tshogs thad kyi nag nyes sogs la dgag sgrub byed pa dang / cig shos ni mi rang nyid kyi nag nyes dang — 154 —

gas sad dgag ba bo'abrasablomig da skyon cha sogs la dus rtag tu phyir rtog dang dgag sgrub byed pa'o/ /gsum pa/ rgyu 'bras blo mig ces pa 'di ni mi chos rig pa'am kun spyod mtshan nyid rig pa'i brda chad cig yin pa red/ rgyu 'bras blo mig zer ba la rgyu 'bras shes shing legs nyes shan 'byed pa'i don yod par ma zad/ drang bden skyong ba dang gzu bo bshad pa/ gnas lugs rtsi zhing srung ba sogs kyi don yang 'dug pas nga tshos tha snyad 'di gsar du bzos pa zhig yin/ 'di ni shes yon can zhig la mtshon na de'i khyad chos gtso bo'am srog lta bu yin pa red/ rgya yig giṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha zhes pa bsgyur pa red/ 'di la yang don gnyis 'dus te/ gcig ni rgyu 'bras rang rtogs kyis rtsi ba dang / cig shos ni rgyu 'bras gzhan la rtsi ru 'jug pa'o/ /④ shes yon can zhig yin na kho'i las 'gan gtso bo ni rang gis drang bden skyong ba dang gnas lugs rtsi ba'i dus mtshungs su/ gzhan la'ang rang gi shes yon gyi nus pas de ltar rgyu 'bras rtsi ru 'jug pa zhig yin pa red/rtogs sad dang dgag sgrub dang rgyu 'bras blo mig gsum ni deng rabs kyi srog gi dbang pos bzung ba'i shes yon can zhig la mtshon na lam gyi rim pa gsum yin pa red/ thog mar mi bu gang der dpyod sho ngobu zhogs dung gi〈dogs slo nga snying stobs〉yu na nan mi rigs dpe skun khang / 2005lo'i zla dang po'i par/ga sa82dang86par gsal/ — 155 d+ngha

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/shes kyi rtogs sad thebs/ bar du dgag sgrub kyi las la 'jugamatha' ma ra rgyu 'bras blo mig de dpral ba'i mig bzhin du brtsi srung byed pa'o/ /yang gcig bshad na 'di ni shes yo/na can gyi bsam blo'i rtogs pa de gong nas gong du 'phags tshul zhig kyang yin par 'dod/ da lta'i 'u cag gi shes yo/na can gyi sde na rtogs sad thebs yo/da mkhan yang gang mang ma nga yo/da gyi red/ dgag sgrub kyi las la 'jug mkhan yang gang mang mang yod gyi red/ yin na'ang rgyu 'bras blo mig can shin tu nyung nyung red/ 'di ni 'u cag gis nges par du bas ma gzhig gtong dgos pa'i gnad don 'ig red 'dod gi gzhan yang rgyu 'bras blo mig gi skor la mtshan nyid rig pa dang mi chos kun spyod rig pa'i ngos nas rgyas bshad mang du yo/da kyang dus tshod kyi dbang gis 'di tsam gyis chog ni byed/ 'di'i skor la spro ba yod mkhan tshos dpe cha gzhan dag la gzigs re zhu/gong nas brjod pa ltar brda chad 'di gsum las shes rig gsar pa'am rig gnas gsar pa dang / yang na deng rabs bsam blo'i 'phel rim rags tsam zhig mthong thub pa yin/ ma 'ongs par 'u cag gi deng rabs bas/ma blo'i lo rgyus shig 'bri ba'i dbang du btang na brda chad 'di gsum las 'phros te 'bri chog chog yin pa red/ zhor du ngas 'di nas gleng 'dod pa zhig ni nga tsho ci'i phyir 'dug ma bzod par hur — 156 —

sa sad da ba 'bras blo mibartson chen pos dgag sgrub kyi las la 'jug pa'am ci'i phyir rang gi smra lce de 'dug bzod med par drang gtam brjod pa dang / yang na ci'i phyir mang mang gi mig nang gi tsher ma dang mchil zhags 'phen sa'i‘‘'ben’’du gyur pa de yin/ nga tshos dgag sgrub kyi rtsom yig bris shing‘‘lta log pa’’yi brtul zhugs bzung ba na spyi tshogs steng bshad yams sna tshogs khyab bzhin yod pa red/ yad da bstan bshig red zer ni/lta ba log pa red zer ni/ ngo log pa red zer ni/ mi gzhi mi legs gi zer ni/ dmar po'i lugs red zer ni/ dmar po'i phogs za mkhan red zer ni/ myul ma red zer ni sogs rna la gzan pa gang mang mang yod gi kho tsho la ci bshad na bshad du chugs/ nga tshos de rnams la kha ya ye nas mi byed/ nga tsho de ltar hur brtson chen pos lam la chas don ni 'u cag gi mi rigs 'di'i mgo la lo rgyus thog skyo gar mang po byung zig chag 'jig mang po byung zig brdab gsig mang po byung zig da lta yin na'ang de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ de'i rkyen gyis nga tshos de dag sems nas ma bzod pas yin/ 'di ltar song na 'u cag gis rgyun par ngom so byed bzhin pa'i bod kyi rig gnas 'di yang srung 'dzin byed thub rgyu ma red snyam pas yin/ nga tsho la ngo ma sems na na zug chen po yod gi grogs zhogs dung lags kyis dus rgyun bshad pa ltar te/ mngan mtshang sgrog phyir mngan mtshang rjod pa ma ge 157 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/yin te/ mngan mtshang gi skran nad gshags pa'i phyi rol tu bzang legs kyi phra phung mdog dang ldan pa'i phung po dag e 'byon la re ba yin zhes pa ltar ro/ /phyi rol gyi kha ba bu yug ji ltar 'tshub kyang / srol rgyun gyi rkang lam phra mo ji ltar dog kyang / dbang grags kyi rgya stag ngar mo ji ltar batren yang / nga tsho mu mthud du lam la 'jug rtsis yod/nga tshos mu mthud du 'phag 'tshag rgyag rtsis yod/ nga tshos mu mthud du drang gtam brjod rtsis yod/ da de 'dra red/ rnam pa tsho/ nga'i gtam bshad mtshams 'di nas 'jog bka' drin che/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra) ya—da gsham nas 'u cag gis rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam gyi sgo nas mnyam du phan tshun bsam blo brje res dang bgro gleng byed/ phan tshun bar la 'dzem dogs ci yang byed dgos gi ma red/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)mgo 'dzin pa pad ma dbang rgyal/ slob grogs rnam pa/ do dgong sku zhabs me lce lags kyis gtam bshad gnang ba la nga tshos snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu gi yin/ spyir kho rang da thengs dngos gnas brel 'tshub chen po 'dug yin na'ang nga tshos yin gcig min gnyis 'chad khrid cig byed dgos par yang yang bskul ngor khos kyang khas blangs pa red/ des na do dgong gi dus tshod dang go skabs 'di dam 'dzin byas te tshang mas kho la 'dri tshig 'dri ba dang / mnyam du bgro — 158 —

gas sad da ba 'bras blo migleng byed rgyu ni ha cang gal chen red/ khos gong du bshad pa ltar do dgong gi rang mos gleng stegs 'di sngon gyi rnam pa las brgal te 'chad pa po yis nyung du bshad rgyu dang / nyan pa po yis mang du smra dgos zhes pa ltar 'di yang rang mos gleng stegs kyi rnam pa gsar pa zhig yin pas tshang mas bgro gleng gi 'khrug cha dod po yong bar byed dgos/ da thengs kyi rang mos gleng stegs skabs30pa 'di nas 'go brtsams te nga tshos gangs ljongs gzhon nu dra tshigs dang mnyam 'brel byas te tshogs thengs re re'i nang don gnad bsdus dra ba'i steng du dgod rgyu yin pas/ rjes phyogs dra ba'i steng nas kyang rang mos gleng stegs kyi gnas tshul la rgyus lon byed thub/ slob grogs tshos gong du brjod zin pa'i rtogs sad dang dgag sgrub/ rgyu 'bras blo mig bcas kyi skor nas bgro gleng byas kyang chog la/ de ma yin par deng sang gi bsam blo'i skor dang / rig gnas dang spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul sogs las 'phros te bgro gleng byas kyang chog yang na kha sang de ring la〈shar dung ri〉dus deb kyi kha gtad du langs pa'i dus deb kyang re gnyis dpar yod pas de'i skor gyi dran tshul brjod na'ang chog gang ltar tshang mas bgro gleng byed rgyu ni ha cang gal chen red/slob grogs ka pa/ thog mar ngas khyed rang 'dir phebs te nged cag la 'chad khrid byas par bka' drin che zhus pa yin/ de nas deng sang — 159 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'u cag gi rig gnas kyi sde na rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi tsha rlabs shig 'phyur bzhin 'dug rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi tsha rlabs de lta bu zhig 'phyur bas skya ser gnyis kyi bar la 'gal ba zhig kyang rang bzhin gyis 'ong gin 'dug de bas rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi las 'dis ser mo pa dang grong pa'i bar gyi mthun sgril la gnod kyin yod pa'i tshor pa zhig kyang ster gi rig gnas dgag sgrub las 'phros te skor zhig gis brjod don bskyur te pha rol po'i mtshang 'bru ba dang snyad rko ba/ gseg 'dri ba sogs byed god gi khyed la yang dra ba dang dus deb sogs kyi steng na gong gi de bzhin du klan ka 'tshol ba dang mi gzhi dma' 'beb byas yod gi 〈bdag dpe tshogs〉〉bkram pa dang〈khu sim khad kyis dkrog〉par skrun byas rjes su khyed la mtshon na de'i rigs mthong myong yod par ma zad/ de'i rigs la 'phrad kyang yod gyi red/ gzhan khyed kyis bltas na 'u cag gi rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi khor yug de lam yang dag cig tu 'gro gi yod dam med gi (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)me lce/ 'u cag gi rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi khor yug de gtsang yangs shig chags par re nas〈bdag dpe tshogs〉dang de 'brel gyi brtsams chos mang po zhig byung ba red/ yin na'ang ma bsam sa nas smra brjod rang dbang dang de'i khor yug gtsang yangs shig chags rgyu phar zhog de las ldog ste gong gi slob grogs 'dis brjod pa bzhin nga tshor — 160 —

gas sad dag ba 'bras blo mimatshang 'bru ba dang snyad rko ba/ gseg 'dri ba/ klan ka 'tshol ba/rigs rus bzang ngan bshad pa/ mi gzhi khyad gsod dang 'phya dmod dma' 'beb sogs byed pa'i rnam pa zhig chags 'dug ngas kyang de'i rigs mthong myong bar ma zad de'i rigs la 'phrad kyang myong /khyad par du na ning dgun kha nas bzung nga dang nga'i grogs po tsho la 'di'i skor gyi brda 'phrin mi nyung ba zhig 'byor thal/ brda 'phrin de'i nang du dpe deb dang dus deb yod la/ tshags par dang rlung 'phrin yang yod/ da dung dra ba'i steng na yang ha cang dza drag che gi ngas bltas na de ni shin tu rgyun ldan zhig red bsam gi lhag par du 'u cag lta bu'i deng rabs rig gnas kyi gnyom lag rgyas med pa'i mi rigs shig la mtshon na de ni ha cang rgyun ldan zhig red/ da so ma shes rig gsar pa'i myu gu 'bus 'go tshugs pa dang / srol rgyun gyi rkang lam phra mo nas deng rabs kyi gzhung lam steng du gom pa spo 'go tshugs pa'i 'u cag la mtshon na de ni rgyun ldan zhig yin ni red/ che phyogs nas de ltar bsam blo gtong gi yod/ yang mtshams la lar de 'dra'i zhe sdang can gyi skad cha dang snying la gzan pa'i tshig mtshon go na rang nyid kyi sems tshor ljid mor 'gyur dus kyang yod gi yin na'ang nga tshos de'i rigs la mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'chang gi yin/ lan ci yang 'debs/ si/ ma red/ dkyel yangs kyi rnam 'gyur zhig 'dzin gi yin/— 161 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'u cag gi da lta'i rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi snang tshul 'di la bltas yo/nga na smra brjod rang dbang gi khor yug gtsang yangs shig gi lam du skyod kyin med par/ tshig mtshon gyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i log lam zhig tu 'gro gi 'dug 'di ltar song tshe mthun sgril la mi gnod rang gnod ma yin nam/ rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi lam bu je dog dang 'gag 'phrang je rtsub tu 'gro bzhin pa 'di ni nga la mtshon na sems khral ches che shos shig red/ ‘‘dgag sgrub pa’’zhig yin na shes yon gyi blo sbyong dang bsam blo'i rtogs pa/ mi gzhi'i sger tshugs bcas gya nom pa zhig med tshe 'u cag gi rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi khor yug de gtsang yangs shig 'byung khag po yin pa red/ 'di'i skor2005lo'i〈spang ljongs〉dgun deb tu 'khod pa'i kho bo'i〈drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa〉zhes par rags tsam gleng yod/ zhib tu shes 'dod mkhan tshos rtsom der gzigs rogs zhu/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)me lce/ yad da ngas khyed rnam par 'dri tshig cig 'dri/ deng sang dra ba'i ngos dang spyi tshogs kyi steng du nub byang mi rigs slob chen dang /〈shar dung ri〉dus deb/ rang mos gleng stegs bcas la skyon brjod dang dgag sgrub mang po byed kyin 'dug dper na/ nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi slob ma(bod kyi slob ma)zhig yin phyin phal cher lta log pa red zer ba dang / yang na kho tsho chos lugs la mi dga' zer gyin — 162 —

gas sad dgag ba 'bras blo miga'adug 〈shar dung ri〉dus deb ni‘‘kha gson po dang lag shi bo’’red zer gyin 'dug rang mos gleng stegs ni‘‘don gyi snying po med pa'i rang rang gang 'dod kyi gtam gleng’’zhig red zer gyin 'dug des mi tshad nub byang mi rigs slob chen ni‘‘rig gnas kyi cha nas gsar pa gsar pa mi shes pa dang rnying pa rnying pa mi shes pa'i bod kyi zhabs 'dren mkhan mang po 'tshogs sa’’zhig red zer gyin 'dug ‘‘nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi mi’’ru 'bod pa'i khyed rnams la mtshon na skad cha 'di dag thos skabs/ rang gi ngo tsha zhig red bsam gyi yod dam/ yang na rang gi gzi brjid cig red bsam gyi yod/ yang na rang gi slob sbyong gi khor yug 'di la 'khang ra byed kyi yod/slob grogs kha pa/ a rogs tsho/ 'di la 'u cag gis nges par du lan 'debs dgos gi red/ tshang ma kha rog ger 'dug nyan gi ma red/(nyan po'i dgod sgra)slob grogs ka pa/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo yin na 'dra/〈shar dung ri〉dus deb yin na 'dra/ rang mos gleng stegs yin na 'dra/ spyi tshogs steng na 'dra mi 'dra sna tshogs bshad kyin 'dug cha ma cho rigs mang po bshad kyin 'dug lhag par du rang mos gleng stegs la mtshon na/ gleng stegs 'di 'go tshugs nas da lta'i bar du phal cher lo ngo bzhi yi lo rgyus yod gi sku zhabs me lce lags 'di gar — 163 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/zhib 'jug slob ma yin pa'i skabs su kho dang go dgu lo'i dngos gzhi 'dzin grwa dang nga tsho mi skor zhig gis gsar du btsugs pa zhig yin/lo ngo 'di dag gi ring la slob grogs tsho'i smra brjod rang dbang dang /snying stobs/ bsam blo sogs kyi thad la nus pa bla lhag thon yod pa red/ deng sang spyi tshogs steng rang mos gleng stegs la bzang ngan sna tshogs bshad bzhin pa la/ nga la mtshon na ha cang dga' 'os pa zhig red/ ci'i phyir brer na/ yin min gang mang dang bzang ngan sna tshogs bshad pa des rang mos gleng stegs kyis nus pa thon song ba'i rtags red/ spyi tshogs la g.yo 'gul thebs song ba'i rtags red/kho la gson shugs ldan pa'i rtags red/ de ma yin par ci yang grags rgyu med pa ni nus pa ma thon pa'i rtags red 'dod gi rang mos gleng stegs kyis khu sim pa'i bod kyi spyi tshogs de nyid gnyid las dkrogs te mi rnams la 'dang rgyag rgyu zhig byin pa red/ de ni dngos gnas dga' 'os pa zhig red snyam gi de'i rkyen gyis spyi tshogs kyis gdeng 'jog ji ltar byas rung nga la mtshon na de ni 'u cag gi nga rgyal dang gzi brjid cig tu brtsi rung ba dang / la rgya zhig tu brtsis na yang mi chog rgyu med gi 'dod gi(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)slob grogs ga pa/ mi mang po zhig ni nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas yin zer na dga' gi 'dug des mi tshad lta log pa red zer — 164 —

gas sad dgag ba — 'bras blo migan yang dga' gi 'dug rgyu mtshan ni lta log pa yin zer na der bas/ma blo gsar pa dang lta tshul gsar pa/ yang na thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gzhig gtong stangs shig yod pas red/ mi su zhig yin rung thun mong ma yin pa zhig la dga' ni red/ ga'an dang mi mthun pa'i khyad par ba zhig la dga' ni red/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod kyi slob ma rnams lta log red ces brjod na dga' gi yo/da pa de ni nga la mtshon na skyon brjod byed dgos pa zhig red/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod skad yig rig gnas slob gling gi slob ma rnams ci 'dra zhig yin pa 'u cag rang mi rang la rgyus yo da ni red/ 'u cag gi dge rgan phul byung can la la dang / yang na mthar phyin zin pa'i slob ma phul byung can de dag gi 'od zer de 'u cag gi dge slob mang po'i steng la 'phros pas/ da gzod nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo 'di spyi tshogs steng skad grags yod par gyur pa red/ slob ma gang mang zhig gis 'od zer de la brten nas rang nyid nga rgyal skye gi yod pa red/de'i rkyen gyis nga rang nyid la mtshon na ha cang skyo gi(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra) tshang mas nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma rnams la bsam blo yod/ lta tshul yod/ bsam phod pa dang / bshad phod pa/sgrub phod pa can yin zhes gleng gi yo/da pa red/ kha sang de ring bltas yo/nga na don dngos su de 'dra zhig e red/ rang gi lag zung brang khar — 165 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/sbyar te zhib tu 'dang zhig rgyob dang / da lta de 'dra e yod gi gtan nas yod ni ma red/ lta log pa dang bsam blo can phar zhog tha na slob ma rnams la khrid stegs steng nas mar 'khor te gtam zhig bshad pa'i snying stobs kyang mi 'dug da 'u cag dga' rgyu e yod gi nga rgyal skye rgyu e yod gi de gcig yin/ deng sang gzhan gyis gdeng 'khrog byed pa'i tshe na de la rgyu mtshan zhig yod ni red/ yang na khyod la bsam blo yod dgos ni red/ yang na khyod la thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gzhig gtong stangs khyad par ba zhig yod dgos ni red/ yang na khyod la grub 'bras khyad par ba zhig yod dgos ni red/ 'u cag gi zhib 'jug slob ma rnams yin na 'dra/ dngos gzhi slob ma rnams yin na 'dra/ ched sbyong slob ma rnams yin na 'dra/ tshang mas mig mdun gyi slob deb kho na dang skar grangs tsam la mi blta bar dpe char mang du bltas/ bsam gzhig mang po btang ste rang nyid kyi lam rang nyid kyis gsar gtod byed dgos ni red/ rang nyid kyi nus pa zhig sbyang dgos ni red/ 'u cag gi bod yig sde khag gi slob khrid kyi bkod sgrig dang slob ma tsho'i sbyang bya la bltas yong na 'u cag la lam gcig ma gtogs yod pa ma red/ de'i rkyen gyis spyi tshogs steng nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor re ltos chen po byed pa la nga ha cang skrag gi ha cang sems khur che gi sngon chad kyi mi bu rnam dpyod can dag gis lam btod shul — 166 —

rtogs sad dgag ba — 'bras blo miganas 'u cag phyi rabs pa rnams kyis shul zin rgyu ma red snyam nas skrag gisems khur che gi des na 'u cag nga rgyal zhig skye dgos pa dang la rgya zhig 'dzin dgos na da lta nas 'go rtsom dgos gi thog mar rang nyid mi yin pa ngos zin dgos gi bar du sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi brtan po zhig chags dgos gi mtha' mar rang rkya thub pa'i bsam blo zhig yod dgos gi de ltar yin na da gzod‘‘nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi mi’’zhig yin zer na chog la/ nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi snying stobs so zhes na'ang chog pa red/ de gnyis yin/ do dgong nga ha cang dga' drags pa'i rkyen gyis sems tshor de gnon ma thub par skad cha 'di 'dra zhig thal song / yad da bka' drin che/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)slob grogs nga pa/ ya—da 'di nas ngas skad cha thung thung zhig bshad/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i smad tsam dang /dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i 'go 'dir 'u cag la bod rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas la phyir rtog dang dgag sgrub byed pa'i myu gu 'bus 'go tshugs pa red/ 'di 'dra'i bsam blo'i mtho rlabs shig zer na chog girlung 'tshub cig brer na chog gi rlabs rgyun 'i/ga zer na chog gi'adi 'dra zhig 'phyur byung ba red/ ngas bltas na de ni bod kyi rig gnas la da dung gson shugs yod pa'i rtags red/ de ci zhig la zer na/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs bdun cu pa'i nang la bsam blo'i — 167 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/mtho rlabs 'di 'dra zhig ci'i phyir 'byung ma thub pa red/ yang na lo rabs sum cu pa'i nang la ci'i phyir 'byung ma thub pa red/ yang na de las snga ba'i bod la chos lugs kyi grub mtha' mang po yo/da pa'i dus su ci'i phyir 'byung ma thub pa red/ des na tag tag kha sang de ring la 'di 'dra zhig 'byung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig red/ 'di ni ngas gong du bshad pa ltar bod kyi rig gnas la da dung gson shugs gsar pa dang tshe srog gsar pa zhig yod pa'i rtags red/ de gcig yin/yang phyir 'khor nas 'dang zhig brgyab na rtogs sad pa dang bsam blo pa 'di lta bu da lta'i mkhas dbang tsho'i khrod nas ci'i phyir ma byung ba red/ lhag par du bod rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i mkhas pa'i khrod du ci'i phyir ma byung ba red/yang na rtogs sad pa dang bsam blo pa 'di 'dra lo tshod kyi cha nas na gzhon dang / shes bya'i sgrig gzhi'am grub cha'i cha nas nub gling gi rig gnas la shes rtogs yod pa'i mi'i khrod nas byung song ba red/ 'di la 'dang rgyag rgyu mang po zhig yod gi snyam/ ngas bltas na 'u cag la 'di 'dra zhig byung ba ni nub phyogs rig gnas kyi snying stobs la thos bsam dang de tshur len byed pa'i 'bras bu red snyam/ gal te nub phyogs rig gnas kyi snying stobs 'di med pa'i dbang du btang na/ 'u cag gi na gzhon khrod kyi rtogs sad pa dang bsam blo pa 'di dag kyang yod ni ma — 168 —

gas sad dgag ba bo 'bras blo migared ces kha tshon bcad de brjod chog deng sang gi rig gnas dgag sgrub yin na 'dra/ rig gnas phyir rtog yin na 'dra/ rig gnas blo 'byed yin na 'dra/ de'i srog snying mi bu'i steng du 'jog pa dang / mi tshul ring lugs kyi bsam blo gleng ba 'di yang nub phyogs rig gnas kyi snying stobs shig red/ de ni nub gling gi rig rtsal bskyar dar dang blo 'byed las 'gul/ chos lugs bcos sgyur sogs kyi lo rgyus la bltas na shes gi des na do dgong gi brjod gzhi ste rtogs sad dang /dgag sgrub/ rgyu 'bras blo mig 'di la mtshon na yang thog mar gang nas rtogs sad thebs dgos gi zer na/ srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dra rgya las rtogs sad thebs dgos gi gang la dgag sgrub byed dgos gi zer na/srol rgyun rig gnas las dus rabs dang spyi tshogs la mi 'tsham pa'i cha de la dgag sgrub byed dgos gi rgyu 'bras blo mig de yang gzu bo'i sgo nas drang bden skyong ba dang gnas lugs rtsi ba'i blo mig yod dgos gikhyed cag ni lam 'di la thog mar zhugs mkhan red/ khyed tshos tsher ma'i lam bu 'di lta bu zhig kyang bdams dang zig nged cag la mtshon na'ang 'di'i phyogs kyi 'gan khur yod ni red/ legs bshad du/cang shes rta yis rab btsal bas/ / phyi bzhin khyi yang 'brangs par byed/ / ces pa bzhin nged tsho ni khyed cag gi rjes 'ded dgos pa red/de yin na khyed tshos kyang 'di'i skor la 'dang rgyag dgos gi da khyed la — 169 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'dri rgyu zhig ni rtogs sad yin na gang nas sad dgos gi sad bya gang red/ sad bya'i yul mun nag gang red/ dgag sgrub yin na gang la dgag sgrub byed dgos gi 'u cag gi srol rgyun rig gnas ni 'di 'dra'i gtos che ba zhig red/ de'i gang zhig la dgag sgrub byed dgos gi ngas bltas na mi tshul bsam blo las bstan pa ltar thog mar mi bu'i rin thang dang go gnas de gtan la phab/ de nas mi bu'i skyes thob kyi 'dod pa sogs mngon du dbyung dgos par 'dod/ de ltar byas nas spyi tshogs dang rig gnas kyi sgrig gzhi gsar pa zhig chags dgos giyang kha sang nged cag skor zhig kha brda byed dus/ la shas kyis deng sang bod kyi nang pa'i chos lugs 'di la mi gang mang zhig gis dgag sgrub byed kyi yod na'ang / nang pa'i chos lugs 'dis mi mang po zhig la sems kyi rgyags phye gya nom pa zhig stsol thub gi bod mi mang po'i sems dro gi zer/ des na dad pa yod pa tsam gyis sems dro thub ni e red/ 'di la yang ngo mas 'dang rgyag rgyu yod gi da de 'dra zhig red/ bshad gi bshad gi yang 'phros thal/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdob sgra)me lce/ red/ khyed kyis bshad pa bden gi khyed kyi 'dri tshig gi lan de phal cher khyed kyis dri ba 'dri zhor du rang gis lan btab btang thal/ nga'i lan yang phal cher de 'dra zhig red/ gong nas kyang mang po bshad zin/ da yang bskyar bye brag gis je gsal du gcig — 170 —

sa sad da ba 'bras blo mibatang na/ 'u cag rtogs sad ci zhig thebs dgos gi zer na/ mi bu skyed sring byed sa dang mi bu sgal tshigs can yar slong sa mi 'gro ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khor yug de las rtogs sad thebs dgos gi zer ba yin/ gang zhig la dgag sgrub byed dgos gi zer na/ mi bu'i rin thang khyad du gsod cing mi bu yar slong bar gegs su gyur pa'i rig gnas de la dgag sgrub byed dgos gi zer ba yin/ de ltar byed par shes yon can zhig la mtshon na rgyu 'bras blo mig yod dgos gi zer ba yin/ drang bden skyong dgos gi zer ba yin/ rgyu 'bras gnas lugs rtsi dgos gi zer ba yin/slob grogs kha pa/ rtogs sad ces pa ni cig gi nang nas sad dgos gi zer god gi dgag sgrub ces pa ni mi 'tsham pa zhig la dgag dgos gi zer god gi de gnyis go gi yin na'ang rgyu 'bras blo mig ces pa de nga la mtshon na cung mi go gi 'di ni nga rang gi go ba len stangs shig la rag las pas lan ma btab kyang chog(nyan po'i dgod sgra)me lce/ ya—rgyu 'bras blo mig 'di khyed la mtshon na ma ge mog ge(mag mog)zhig red la/ (nyan po'i dgod sgra)slob grogs kha pa/ 'u cag rtsom la 'jug pa'i skabs su tha snyad gang mang zhig bed spyod gtong gi yod pa red/ tha snyad de dag mang tshogs dang kha gyes song tshe mi 'grig gi snyam/ nga rang gi ched las ni skad brda — 171 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rig pa yin pas rgyun du 'di'i phyogs la 'dang cung tsam re rgyag gi yod/'u cag gis mang tshogs kyi skad cha la 'dang rgyag dgos gi dper na/rgyu 'bras zer ba 'di la yang mang tshogs kyi skad cha'i khrod na de dang cha mtshungs pa yod gi yang rtogs sad thebs zer ba 'di la mang tshogs kyi skad cha'i khrod du rtogs pa sad zer gi 'di dang 'di lta bu'i tha snyad mang po zhig bod rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas nang na yod gi deng sang bkol sa yang 'gro gi kha la yang bde gi de ma yin par tha snyad rang la yod bzhin du tshod tshod la gsar bzo byas na mi 'grig gi deng sang gi tha snyad mang po zhig la rgya nag skad kyi shan zhugs yod pa 'dra/de'i rkyen gyis tha snyad gang zhig bkol na mang tshogs dang nye bar bcar dgos pa las de la kha bral na mi 'grig gi 'dod/ rtogs pa sad na yang mang tshogs kyi khrod nas rtogs pa sad dgos pa las/ ltag rgyab zhig nas rtogs pa sad na mi 'grig ga(nyan po'i dgod sgra dang thal mo rdeb sgra)slob grogs kha pa/ (rtsed mo'i tshul du)nga rang‘‘sad’’snga ba'i rkyen gyis skad cha kha shas shig ngag las thal song ni red/ yad da slob grogs gang mang zhig gis rang gi dran tshul brjod thub kyi med pa la bltas yo/nga na da rung‘‘sad’’med ni mang po yod ga(nyan po'i dgod sgra dang thal mo rdeb sgra) a la de ku re yin/ tshang mas rang rang gi lta tshul zhig rjod dang /— 172 —

rtogs sad dgag ba 'bras blo migame lce/ ngo ma bod kyi mi rigs slob grwa chen mo gzhan rnams dang bsdur na/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo ni‘‘sad’’snga la 'di gar‘‘sad mi’’yang mang ni red/slob grogs ca pa/ rig gnas dang rigs gzhung gang zhig yin yang tha snyad ni ha cang gal chen 'ig yin pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig red/des na tha snyad 'di bod rang gi skad kyi chos nyid dang mthun pa byed rgyu ni gtso bo zhig red/ da gong du slob grogs kha pas bshad pa ltar/dper na/ rtogs sad thebs la rtogs pa sad zer rgyu dang / yang dper na deng sang dus deb dang tshags par sogs kyi steng du rtsom sgrig pa zer gyin 'dug ngas bltas na de ni ma dag pa zhig red/ de la rtsom sgrig byed mkhan zhes bshad na 'grig gi da lta bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i tha snyad mang po zhig la rgya nag skad kyi bro ba che gi khyed rnams la mtshon na tha snyad bkol ba'i skabs su bod rang gi skad dang mthun pa dang / bod rang gi brda sprod dang mthun pa/ bod rang gi tha snyad kyi grub lugs dang mthun par byed rgyu ni shin tu gal chen red 'dod gi(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)mgo 'dzin pa pad ma dbang rgyal/ gong nas zhib 'jug slob ma rnams kyis bgro gleng mang po mdzad song / yin na'ang dngos gzhi slob ma rnams da rung kha rog ger bsdad 'dug gong du bshad pa bzhin nub — 173 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo ni‘‘sad’’snga ba red zer god gi bltas yong na don dngos su de 'dra zhig kyang red/ de ci'i phyir zer na/ 'u cag la slob ma rnams kyis rang mos sgos rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i bsam blo rig gnas bgro gleng byed sa'i rang mos gleng stegs yod la/ 〈shar dung ri〉lta bu'i dus deb kyang yod/ des mi tshad 'khos zhan zhing nyam chung ba'i bod kyi bud med kyi gnas stangs la dmigs te ched du bsgrubs pa'i〈gangs can skyes ma'i tshags par〉lta bu yang yod pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis skad cha de lta bu bshad chog chog red snyam gi gsham nas dngos gzhi slob ma rnams dang lhag par du skyes ma tshos gtam bshad gnang bar snying nas re ba zhus pa yin/slob grogs cha pa/ khyed kyi〈khu sim khad kyis dkrog〉las〈dus kyis bskul pa'i cong brda〉zhes pa'i rtsom du 'di 'dra'i skad cha zhig yod gi‘‘nga rang mthar phyin sa'i nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo lta bur mtshon na/ na ning(2003lor)bod skad yig sde khag nas dngos gzhi slob ma37dang zhib 'jug slob ma8mthar phyin/ yid skyo ba zhig la dngos gzhi slob ma37las spyi tshogs steng las gnas rnyed pa mi5ma gtogs med pa red/ de las kyang khyed cag yid ches dka' ba zhig ni zhib 'jug slob ma'i khrod na'ang bya ba ma rag par lus yod pa de yin/’’ 'di ni ngas bltas na bod kyi slob gso'i gnad don gal chen zhig red la/ bod — 174 —

sa sad dag ba 'bras blo mispyi'i gnad don gal chen zhig kyang red/ deng sang spyi tshogs steng mthar phyin slob ma rnams kyi lag tu bya ba mi rag pa ni tshang mas shes ni red/ de ni slob gso gnyer stangs la rag las pa zhig red/ 'u cag gi slob gso gnyer stangs ni sna gcig can dang chig rkyang ba yin pa red/des mi tshad slob ma rnams kyi yon tshad dang nus pa/ 'byung spus sogs la'ang thad kar du 'brel ba yod pa zhig red/ gong nas rnam pa tshos bshad tshul la bltas na/ spyir yin na mi rigs slob grwa chen mo gzhan dag dang bsdur na rang re'i nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma rnams kyi lag tu bya ba rag na 'grig gi yin na'ang don dngos su de 'dra zhig ma red/ da lo nga rang gtsos mi rigs dge thon mtho rim ched sbyong slob grwar song ba yin/ slob grwa de'i slob ma rnams kyi slob gnyer byed stangs dang slob grwa'i sgrig lam ni 'u cag las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang gi des mi tshad mthar phyin slob ma rnams kyi lag tu bya ba rag tshad kyang 'u cag las mang gi go thos ltar na na ning lha sa'i las khungs kha shas kyis las byed mi sna bsdu skabs/ lho nub mi rigs slob grwa chen mo gcig pu nas mi bcu drug bsdus te 'u cag gi slob grwa nas mi gcig kyang ma blangs zig 'di rnams la bltas yong na/ 'u cag gi slob ma rnams ni phul byung min pa'i rtags red/ da gong du slob grogs ga pas bshad pa bzhin 'u cag nga rgyal skye rgyu med gi mgo bo krog krog — 175 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/byed rgyu med gi rang rang gi ngos thad nas slob sbyong la hur brtson byed dgos gi 'dod gi nga'i bsam tshul de 'dra zhig yin/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)slob grogs ja pa/ ngas khyed la 'dri rgyu zhig ni rig gnas gsar pa zhes pa de don ngo mas gang 'dra zhig la ngos 'dzin gyi yod dam/me lce/ rig gnas gsar pa zhes dngos po ltar du rdog rdog cig ston rgyu yod pa ma red la/ spang skong phyag rgya ltar du gnam nas 'bab rgyu zhig kyang yod ni ma red/ de ni rang dbang dang mang gtso/ 'dra mnyam/ tshan rig sogs 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi yongs khyab rin thang(sdotsho༈rkilta)lta tshul gtso byas pa'i mi bu dpyod shes can dang mi bu sgal tshigs can/ mi bu gzhung drang can/ mi bu sger tshugs can/ mi bu rgyu 'bras can yar slong ba dang skyed sring byed pa'i mi chos rig gnas 'di la brjod kyi yod pa red/ 'u cag la mtshon na da so ma mi chos rig gnas kyi myu gu 'bus 'go tshugs pa tsam red/ de'i rtsa ba tshugs shing yal 'dab rgyas rgyu ni mi rabs gang mang zhig gi las don red snyam/slob grogs ga pa/ deng sang mi mang po zhig gis zi ling gi zhogs dung sogs kyis chos lugs la dgag ste rig gnas gsar pa bshad god gi zhes sdigs mo byed kyin 'dug ngas bltas na kho tshos kyang nga tshos rig gnas gsar pa bshad god ces gleng gi mi 'dug kho tshos bshad — 176 —

gas sad dag ba 'bras blo migagi yod pa ni mi bu ci ltar slong ba dang mi bu'i rang ngo zin rgyu de gtso bo bshad god gi mi bu de gleng ba'i tshe na chos lugs dang 'brel ba cung tsam yod pas de la dgag sgrub byas pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis dgon pa'i grwa pa tshos de la go ba yang dag cig lon gyi mi 'dug 〈〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉〉dang〈bdag dpe tshogs〉sogs gang la bltas yong na chos lugs kyi ched du chos lugs la dgag pa rgyag pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis mi mang po zhig ni rig gnas gsar pa zhes gleng na mi dga' ba dang / yang na rig gnas gsar pa zhes pa'i tha snyad de'i steng la ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis de kho na la shi 'tham ro 'tham byed pa ni mi 'grig gi snyam/ bsam gzhig gtong stangs de sna mang can dang rgya skyed na 'grig gi(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)slob grogs ja pa/ skad cha gsar pa dang bsam blo gsar pa yin pa tsam gyis de'i rjes su 'brangs na mi 'grig gislob grogs ga pa/ 'o le/ rgyu 'bras blo mig dang sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi ni 'di 'dra'i skabs la da gzod bshad dgos song ba red/ rang gi mgo bo de rang la thogs yod pas gzhan zer rjes 'brangs dang blun po chu sna gar 'khrid byed nyan ni ma red/slob grogs ja pa/ ngas bltas na thun mong ma yin pa dang khyad par ba zhig yin tshe yod tshad rig gnas gsar pa la ngos 'dzin gyin 'dug— 177 bhe

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/de bas mi zhig la mtshon na rang gi lta tshul de bden na mi bden na de 'dra zhig yod tshe bsam blo gsar pa yin par rlom god gi de 'dra zhig red la/slob grogs ga pa/ lung gi rgyab rtsa dang rigs pa'i sgrub byed sogs ci yang med par gang byung du smra ba de la bsam blo gsar pa ga la zer/de la spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par zhig yod gi gong nas bshad pa ltar rig gnas gsar pa zhes brjod na spyi zhig red la/ bye brag tu babs na mi bu slong rgyu de red/slob grogs nya pa/ sku zhabs nyi gzhon gyis da snga bod kyi dus deb mang che ba ni rig gnas kyi gad snyigs red zer gyi 'dug 〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉dang〈bdag dpe tshogs〉sogs par skrun byas par rkyen byas te 'u cag gi rig gnas kyi sde na rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi gleng phyogs de ha cang shugs che gi khyed kyis bltas na da dung mu mthud du 'di ltar phyin na 'grig gam/ yang na 'di dag ni rig gnas kyi gad snyigs shig red 'dod gi de ni 'dri tshig dang po yin/ 'dri tshig gnyis pa ni rang mos gleng stegs 'di btsugs nas da lta'i bar lo ngo bzhi 'gor ba'i ring la zhib 'jug slob ma dang / dngos gzhi slob ma/ched sbyong slob ma bcas kyi bsam blo bcings 'grol dang rig gnas blo sbyong sogs kyi thad la nus pa bla med cig thon yod pa red/ des mi — 178 ge

sa sad dag ba 'bras blo migatshad dge slob phan tshun bar dang slob ma phan tshun bar la 'brel zam 'dzugs par yang nus pa gal chen thon yod pa red/ nga rang ni rgyun par rang mos gleng stegs la zhugs mkhan zhig yin pa dang / gleng stegs 'di'i steng nas blo bskyed kyang mi chung ba zhig thob song yin na'ang 'di dang 'brel yod kyi slob ma mang po 'ig rim bzhin mthar phyin pa'i rjes su/ rang mos gleng stegs 'di ga le ga ler nyams bzhin pa'i tshor pa zhig ster gi sngon gyi de lta bu'i gson shugs med pa 'dra/lhag par du lo ngo bzhi bo 'di'i ring la rang mos gleng stegs steng nas bud med cig gis gtam bshad pa ni ha lam mthong ma myong / khyed ni rang mos gleng stegs 'di thog mar 'dzugs mkhan gyi 'gan 'dzin pa'i gras yin par ma zad/ 'di'i thad nas rgyun par gtam bshad kyang mang po zhig gnangs myong / khyed kyis bltas na rang mos gleng stegs 'di la zhan cha ci zhig yod gi khyed rang mthar phyin te spyi tshogs steng song nas phyir 'khor te rang mos gleng stegs 'di la sems khur dang lta rtog yang na kha blta dang mig blta 'dra byas e myong / yang na da lta'i rang mos gleng stegs kyi 'gan 'dzin pa rnams la blo gsal 'dra phud e myong / (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)me lce/ red/ deng sang 'u cag la dus deb mang po yod gidus deb kyi rtags yod med gnyis ka ha cang mang gi ngas bltas na mi — 179 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/chos rig gnas gleng mkhan tsho'i kha gtad du gnyer ba'i dgon grong dus deb kha shas ma gtogs mang che ba ni rig gnas kyi gad snyigs red/kho tshos gzab nan gyi rig gnas dgag sgrub dang sdigs mo gnyis la dbye ba khor gi med pa 'dra/ spyir na dus deb cig gnyer rgyu ni las sla bo zhig min la/ 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ldan zhing gzab nan dpyod ldan gyi ngang nas dus deb cig gnyer rgyu ni de bas kyang sla mo zhig ma red/nga rang nyid la mtshon na'ang nam rgyun dus deb cig gnyer rgyu'i 'dun pa ha cang che/ des mi tshad 'di'i phyogs la bsam blo yang gtong gi yod/yin na'ang dus deb kyi 'gan 'khri de ha cang lce drags pas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag pa yin/ rjes phyogs e thub la blta/ gzhan sdigs mo dang mi gzhi khyad gsod ma yin pa'i rigs gzhung lta tshul dag ni mnyam gnas byas na 'grig gi ris med kun 'dus byas na 'grig girang mos gleng stegs 'di spyi lo2002lo'i zla12pa'i tshes8nyin 'go tshugs pa nas bzung / da lta'i bar du skabs30pa la bslebs 'dug lo ngo 'di dag gi ring la slob ma rnam dpyod can dang snying stobs can/ shes rab can mang po zhig skyed sring byas yod ni red/de ni bsnyon du med pa zhig yin ni red/ nga rang slob mthar phyin rjes nam rgyun rang mos gleng stegs 'di la sems khur byed gi yod/ des mi — 180 —

gas sad dgag ba — 'bras blo migatshad〈shar dung ri〉〉dus deb yin na 'dra/ bod yig sde khag gi slob ma rnams kyi slob gnyer byed tshul yin na 'dra/ de dag la dus dang rnam pa kun tu sems khur dang de'i skor rgyus lon byed ci thub byed gi yod/de ni gcig tu nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo ni nga'i ma yu/ma slob grwa yin pa dang / gnyis su slob grwa 'di'i slob sbyong gi khor yu/ga dang /bsam blo'i khor yug sogs nga la mtshon na bka' drin shin tu che ba yin/de'i rkyen gyis nga slob grwa 'di la sha tsha zhing sems gting nas ha cang dga' ba yin/ rang mos gleng stegs 'di la mtshon na yang / ngas rgyus lon byas pa ltar na na ning do tshigs kyi bar 'dir cung nyams bzhin pa'i tshor pa zhig ster gi sngon gyi de lta bu'i gson shugs dang sngon gyi de lta bu'i snying stobs med pa'i tshor pa zhig ster gi rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis ngas kha par dang skad skur gyi lam nas 'di ga'i 'gan 'dzin pa rnams dang / khyad par du zhib 'jug slob ma pad ma dbang rgyal lags la rang mos gleng stegs kyi rgyun mu mthud du skyong dgos tshul dang / rang mos gleng stegs kyi rtsa don nam yang 'bor mi nyan tshul gleng ba yin/ dus mtshungs su spyi tshogs steng nas kyang rig gnas pa rnams dang 'phrad na lan gru ru phyin tshe yin gcig min gnyis rang mos gleng stegs steng nas gtam bshad gnang dgos pa'i re ba yang yang zhus pa yin/ nga'i re ba yin na khyed rnam pas rang mos gleng stegs 'di ni — 181 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rang re'i slob grwa'i rtags mtshan dang‘‘gces nor’’zhig tu ngos bzung nas zhib 'jug slob ma rnams kyis kyang kho tshor rgyab skyor gang legs gnang rgyu dang / gzhan yang 'u cag la yod pa'i zhib 'jug slob ma'i thon khungs 'di bed spyad de/ skabs re re'i zhib 'jug slob ma rnams kyis res mos su gtam bshad gnang rgyu 'di yang rang mos gleng stegs la mtshon na gson shugs ldan pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar gdon mi za ba red/bud med tshos kyang rang mos gleng stegs kyi stegs bu 'di brgyud de rang nyid sbyong brdar byed pa dang / gtam bshad pa'i snying stobs skyed pa/tha na bud med kyi thob thang dang khe dbang sogs rtsod dgos pa red/yabhed de 'dra zhig red/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)me lce/ 'dir bzhugs kyi slob grogs rnam pas bltas na nga tsho'i phyogs na da dung mi 'dang sa dang skyon cha/ zhan cha/ yang na bris rtsom las gnad la phog gi med sa dang shod gi med sa sogs ci zhig yod giyang na de'i phyogs nas khyed tsho la bsam 'char ga 'dra yod/slob grogs ta pa/ khyed tsho rig gnas blo 'byed dang rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi lam bu 'di 'dra zhig la zhugs te ma mtha' yang lo ngo kha shas 'gor song zig lo ngo 'di dag gi ring la brtsams chos kyang mi nyung ba zhig bris yod gi yang de la spyi tshogs steng na dgag lan yang mang po zhig bris yod gi des na khyed tshos bltas na dgag lan de dag — 182 — —

sa sad dgag ba — 'bras blo migalas bris pa legs shos dang / bris pa 'grig yod sa de 'dra e yo/da gigal te de 'dra yod na khyed tshos kyang rang gi lta tshul de mkhregs 'dzin mi byed par yo bsrang byed rgyu dang / gzhan yang gzhug phyogs rtsom la 'jug pa'i dus su rang gi skyon cha de rang nyid kyis ngos len byed rgyu ni ha cang gal chen zhig red/ de ni nga'i re ba zhig kyang yin/(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)me lce/ bka' drin che/slob grogs da pa/ 'di nas nga rang gi dran tshul thung thung 'ig bshad/ slob ma mang po zhig slob chen du yod pa'i skabs su mi rigs kyi la rgya bshad rgyur dga' ba dang / mi rigs dang rig gnas kyi don du zhes kha pho ha cang che gi yin na'ang spyi tshogs steng zhugs rjes kha bshad chu yi lbu ba tsam red/ de bas kha nas bshad pa dang lag len gnyis thod mi thug gi kha nas bshad pa dang lag nas sgrub pa gnyis ni 'gal ba ltag sprod red/ nga rang spyi tshogs steng bya bar zhugs nas lo kha shas 'gor rjes slar yang slob sbyong zhig byed bsams nas 'di gar yong ba yin/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo ni spyi tshogs steng skad grags che bas re ba chen po zhig bcangs te 'dir yong ba yin/ rang mos gleng stegs la yang dus rgyun du zhugs gi yod/ rang mos gleng stegs kyis slob ma gang mang zhig la dngos gnas bsam gzhigre/ bi/ go — 183 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/skabs mang po bstsal song / da lta rim gyis bltas yong na rang mos gleng stegs 'di rtsod pa byed sa'i stegs bu zhig tu gyur 'dug 'di na rig gnas gsar rnying rtsod god gi lta ba gsar rnying rtsod god gigasar rnying gnyis rtsod pa las gnad don ci yang thag gcod gi med gigand don thag gcod pa'i steng la 'bab gi med gi des na rtsod stangs 'dis 'u cag gi mthun sgril la gnod e yong snyam gi dper na/na ning dgun khar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa pa gnyis 'dir phebs te/ rang mos gleng stegs steng gtam bshad nas 'u cag gi bar la phan tshun rgyus lon dang bsam 'char brje res byed pa'i mthun sgril gyi gser zam zhig 'dzugs dgos zer/ yin na'ang mjug mthar bgro gleng de rtsod pa dza drag gi ngang nas mjug bsdus pa red/ 'di ltar song tshe mthun sgril zhig ci ltar yong ngam/ de gcig yin/gnyis na deng sang khyed tsho la mtshon na bod kyi bsam blo pa'i 'thus tshab lta bur gyur 'dug khyed tshos bshad pa rnams ngas bltas na mtshan nyid rig pa'i shas che gi da do dgong khyed kyis bshad pa'i rtogs sad dang dgag sgrub/ rgyu 'bras blo mig bcas la mtshon na'ang mtshan nyid rig pa'i brda chad tag tag red/ de bas ngas ngo ma ha mi go gi 'di ni nub gling gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i brda chad de bsgyur pa yin pa 'dra/ deng rabs rig gnas dang srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bar — 184 —

rtogs sad dgag ba 'bras blo midu gzhi mthun sa zhig btsal rgyu e yo/da gi khyed tshos 'di'i phyogs la nges par du 'dang rgyag dgos gi 'di ni mi rigs nang khul gyi ma thun sgril dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa zhig red/ srol rgyun dang deng rabs zhes che sa dang mtho sa zhig mi rtsod par de gnyis kyi gzhi mthun sa dang 'bab sa zhig gi phyogs la 'dang rgyag dgos gi snyam/ khyed kyis bshad pa'i sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi dang mi bu kher tshugs can zhes pa de ga'i gang 'dra zhig gi steng nas bshad pa yin/ gal te tshang ma sger tshugs dang kher tshugs can tag tag yin tshe 'u cag gzhi gcig tu yong rgyu e red/mthun sgril gyi gong bu gcig gyur cig chags rgyu e red/ yang rang la bsam blo yo/da zer nas khyod kyis khyod kyi bsam tshul zhig bshad/ ngas nga'i bsam tshul zhig bshad na da thun mong gi lta tshul zhig yod gyi e red/des phan tshun la gnod kyi e red/ da mthun sgril zhig yong rgyu e red/nga 'di la dogs snang skye gi 'di'i phyogs la khyed tshos bsam blo 'ig btang na lam zhig e yod bsam gi phan thogs yo/da gyi red snyam gi(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)slob grogs kha pa/ ngas bltas na de la skrag mi dgos gi spyir lta tshul dang mthun sgril gnyis kha kha so so red/ rgyal khab cig la ma chon nas bshad na'ang lta tshul mi mthun pa'i skyid sdug gang mang mang yo/da pa red/ des/ rgyal khab kyi mthun sgril la gnod kyi mi 'dug lta tshul mi — 185 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/mthun pa yod pa ni mi'i rang gshis red/ gal te mi klad pa can zhig yin tshe de la lta tshul mi mthun pa zhig yod ni red/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i rjes 'jug pa thams cad kyang de 'dra red/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi bo yang rang rang gi lta ba rtsod pa'i ched du khyod shi nga gson byed pa lta bu red/ yin na'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i steng la tshang ma gzhi gcig tu 'bab ni red/ de bas lta tshul ni yod dgos/ thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod dgos/ tshugs thub cig yod dgos/ mi mthun pa yod dgos/ mang po yod dgos/ lta tshul dang mthun sgril gnyis ni rbad de kha kha so so red/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)me lce/ yad da dus tshod kyang mang po 'gor thal/ do dgong gi bgro gleng mtshams 'di nas 'jog khyed rnam pa bka' drin che/(nyan po'i thal mo rdob sgra)mgo 'dzin pa kirti skyabs/ ya—des na 'di nas ngas 'dir bozhugs kyi slob grogs rnams dang nged tsho rang mos gleng stegs chogs pa'i tshab byas te sku zhabs me lce lags 'dir 'ongs nas gtam bshad gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang / slad mar yang nged tsho la thugs khur dang rgyab skyor yang yang gnang ba'i re ba zhus pa yin/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)2006lo'i zla10pa'i tshes27nyin bshus tshar/ 2007lo'i zla5pa'i tshes21nyin snon 'phri cung zad dang bcas zhus thengs mtha' ma rdzogs te gtan la phab/— 186 —

sa rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi btsun/shes rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi grwa btsun/da wa nub byang mi rigs slob chen nas gtam bshad pa'i sgra phab bshus pa/spyi lo2006lo'i zla11pa'i tshes20nyin/(mgo 'dzin pa gu ru rgya ma tsho lags kyi dbu mdzad gleng tshig3slob grogs rnam pa/ do dgong nga tshos〈khu sim khad kyis dgrog〉gi rtsom pa po sku zhabs me lce lags 'dir gdan 'dren byas te/ nged cag gi〈lam gyi gleng gzhi〉chogs thengs bcu gcig pa ru ched du bkod sgrig byas nas 'chad khrid zhu ru 'jug rgyu yin/ des na/ do dgong gi 'chad khrid kyi nang don ni2006lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gsum pa'i steng gi rig ldan rgya mcho'i〈gna' grong〉dang bkra bha'i〈me long〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung gnyis la dpyad brjod spel rgyu yin pa dang /bshad tshar rjes slob grogs rnams kyis 'dri chig 'dri ba dang khong dang mnyam du bgro gleng byed chog zhol nas 'chad khrid kyi 'go rtsom rgyu bya'o/ /(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)yad da 'u cag gis kha brda'i 'go rtsom rgyu byed/ sgo sam du‘‘brtsams sgrung〈gna' grong〉dang〈me long〉las 'phros pa'i dpyad pa’’zhes bris 'dug nga'i do dgong gi gtam bshad kyi kha byang la〈〈shes — 187 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi grwa btsun〉zer/ gsham nas brjod gzhi 'di don tshan lnga yi steng nas bshad rgyu yin/dang po/ gleng slong ba/gza' 'khor gnyis lhag gi yar sngon la nga rang sger don zhig gi ched du zi ling du thengs gcig song ba yin/ zi ling nas grogs po zhig gis da so ma dpar ma thag pa'i da lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gsum pa 'ig legs skyes kyi tshul du gnangs byung / spyir yin na nga rang 'u cag gi 〈sbrang char〉the ba'i dus deb mang po zhig la blta 'dod chen po mi 'dug yin na'ang phyir yong khar lam bar du grogs pos gnangs pa'i〈sbrang char〉la phar slog tshur slog byas shing dkar chag las brtsams sgrung〈gna' grong〉de bklag 'dod skyes/ phyir lan gru ru thon nas〈〈gna' grong〉〉de zhib tu bklags pa dang / der mthud nas〈me long〉〉yang bklags pa yin/ brtsams sgrung 'di gnyis bklags pas rang nyid la dran 'char mang po byung zhing rang re'i rtsom rig gsar pa 'di la slar yang ci zhig bshad 'dod kyi 'dun pa zhig 'gog med du skyes/ der brten/ khyed tsho'i gdan zhu dang du blangs te gtam bshad kyi brjod gzhi yang brtsams sgrung 'di gnyis byas pa yin/ngas dus rgyun rtsom rig dpyad brjod 'bri dus brtsams chos de — 188 —

shes rmongs kyi‘ gna' grong’’dang‘ me long’’nang gi btsun/las 'phros/ te bsam blo dang spyi chogs kyi cha de gtso bor 'dzin si yo da/yang na brtsams chos de las 'phros te bsam ga'ig gi sne mang po 'tshol ba dang / bsam gzhig gi sgo glegs mang po 'byed par smyug kha sgyur bzhin yo/da/ yin na yang grogs po dang klog pa po gang mang 'ig gis rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi rnam pa 'di la bsam 'char 'don gyi 'dugaskyon brjod byed kyi 'dug kho tshos6‘brtsams chos bor ba'i dpyad pa’’dang‘‘brtsams chos ni gzhung lugs 'grel rgyag byed dang rang gi lta tshul sgrub byed’’kho nar gyur 'dug zer/ kho bo lta tshul 'di'i rigs la mi 'thad de/ gal te brtsams chos rkyang rkyang la dpyad pa gtong dbos na brtsams chos(brtsams sgrung dang snyan ngag sogs)de ga bklags pas chog ste/dpyad brjod ces pa'i las 'di yang dgos don ci yang mi 'dug snyam/de bas nga rang ni bcoms chos de'i khyad du 'phags pa'i sgyu rtsal dang /ngo mtshar ba'i thabs rtsal/ go dka' ba'i nang don sogs la dbya/da pa gtong ba'i chig rkyang rang bzhin gyi dpyad brjod spel stangs(deng sa nga gi rtsom rig gi dpyad brjod phal che ba 'di'i rigs su gtogs)de las/ bas/ma blo dang spyi tshogs kyi cha de srog snying du 'dzin pa'i 'phro sa don rang ba'in gyi dpyad brjod spel stangs 'di la shin tu spro// khyad par du da lta 'i 'u cag gi rig gnas kyi gnas bab 'di la mtshon na dpyad brjod spel stangs phyi ma 'di ha cang gal che bar 'dod/ des na zhol nas 'chad — 189 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'gyur gyi〈gna' grong〉dang〈me long〉gnyis kyi dpyad pa yang dpyad brjod spel stangs phyi ma'i rigs 'di las ma 'das/ nga'i dpyad pa 'di ru rtsom pa po gnyis kyis bshad 'dod pa de ma shod sa yod na'ang thang / yang na rtsom pa po gnyis kyi sems la ma dran pa zhig ngas bshad yod na'ang thang / yang na 'dir bzhugs kyi slob grogs rnams kyi myong rol byed stangs de la phog thug bzo na'ang thang / de 'dra yod na mthol lo bshags/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)gnyis pa/ shes rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’rig ldan rgya mtsho lags kyi〈gna' grong〉de sgrung 'bring zhig red/brtsams sgrung 'di las ngas bltas na gsham gyi gnad don 'di dag chu la chu bzhag pa ltar du gsal por mtshon 'dug snyam/1 bod mi'i spyi tshogs kyi bsdus gzugs dang 'tsho ba'i gnas bab ngo ma de mtshon 'dug pa ste/ de ni dper na gna' grong la chu med pa dang / kha par med pa/ slob grwa med pa/ sman khang med pa/ sbrag khang med pa/ tshong khang med pa/ glog sgron med pa/ brnyan 'phrin med nga// gzhung lam med pa lta bu red/ gna' grong la mtshon na deng rabs shes rig gi rtags mtshan 'di dag ha cang cha rgyus med pa dang lkog gyur cig yin pa red/ yang mi sna gtso bo1zung zla ba khyim tshang su — 190 ge

shes rmongs kyi‘‘ na' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi btsun/tshang la song na'ang ja nag khu ma gtogs 'thung rgyu med pas 'tsho ba ngan ngon yin pa dang / gna' grong bi/ mkhar gyang rnams mthon po gnam la zug pa lta bu yin yang‘‘mkhar gyang rnying pa ni mi 'gyang bar rdib pa'i nyen kha gnas pa dngos su mthong thub’’pa lta bu'o/ /2 spyi tshogs dang shes yon can bar gyi 'gal ba dang / yang na mang tshogs dang shes yon can gnyis kyi bar thag mtshon 'dug ste/gcig nas sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skya ldang dang1zung zla ba gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba(gtsang bo'i 'gram nas chu 'dren 'khor lo 'dzugs ma thub pa dang / shing cha bed spyod byed par bkag 'gog byas pa/ sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang la snyan seng 'bul dgos pa sogs)dang / gnyis nas skya ldang ni blun rmongs dang mkhregs 'dzin/ kla klo dang rmongs 'thom sogs mtshon byed(dper na/ ‘‘gna' grong ni da dung rig gsar gyi mjug 'gril ma khad kyi dus skabs ji bzhin gnas shing / skya ldang ni da dung spyi tshogs gsararmo pa'i 'od snang ma phog pa'i skabs kyi gnya' gnon mkhan nam bshu gzhog mkhan 'ig dang 'dra’’zhes dang / ‘‘skya ldang gis gna' grong gi rig gnas 'phel rgyas dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas phyogs su nus pa phran bu'ang 'don gyin med par ma zad/ chu 'dren 'khor lo zhig 'dzugs rgyur yang rdul phran mchon cha zhig bzo ba lta bu'i dogs zon byed’’lta bu/ da 〈sbrang char〉gyi shog ngos70par gsal) cig dang /1zung zla ba ni rtogs sad dang glod grol/ gsar gtod dang bcos — 191 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/sgyur sogs kyi mtshon byed cig red/ 1zung zla bas gna' grong gi skyo la sdug pa'i gnas bab de mthong bas sems nas ma bzod pa dang / shes yon can zhig gi 'gan 'khri phrag tu blangs nas a stag ma smad gnyis gtso byas pa'i thabs chag gi 'tsho ba de legs bcos dang thon skyed nus shugs bcos sgyur byed pa'i phyogs la hur brtson byas pa dper na/bzod pa ngo lug tshang gi shing bzo'i yo byad dag slar yang bkol spyod byed du bcug pa dang / a stag tshang gi thags khri rnying pa de mthong nas der zhig gso byed pa'i blo skyes pa lta bu/ lhag par du kho la gsar gtod kyi 'du shes drag po 'dug pa de‘‘gsar gtod ni mi rnams kyis go la 'di'i sgang nas mu mthud du 'tsho ba rol ba'i dgos dbang can gyi shes rig 'ba' zhig yin la/ gsar gtod kyis da gzod rang nyid byol song ma yin pa'i sgrub byed ha cang mang po sngog 'don byed srid cing /de la brten nas mi dang mi'i bar du khyad par sna tshogs byung bar ma zad/mi rigs bar dang rgyal khab bar gyi dar rgyas kyi chu tshad kyang gsar gtod la mthong chen byas min dbang gis byung’’(〈sbrang char〉gyi shog ngos33—34paragasal)zhes pa sogs las gsal por mthong thub/gsum nas gna' grong gi mi ni mi rgyus med dang mi cha med la shin tu sdang ba zhig red/ ‘‘gna' grong gi mi phal mo che ni mi rgyus med la mi rlom zhing / mi rgyus med kyi skad char nyan rgyu mi dga' bar ma zad/bhe 192 —
