shes rmongs kyi ‘gna' grong’’dang‘ me long’’nang gi btsun/mi rgyus med mthong na zhed snang yang skye srid’’(〈〈sbrang char〉gyi shog ngos59—60par gsal)pa dang / tha na a khu bsam gtan gyi bu mos1zung zla ba'i gam nas mo'i a pha la‘‘a pha/ khyod kyis kho thu zung zer ba de min nam/ khyod kyis yid ches sam/ khos ngo lug kyang btson la rdzong ba'i nyen kha che zer ba ma thos sam ’’(〈〈sbrang char〉gyi shog ngos75par gsal)zhes kyang smras pa red/ yad da khyed tshos ltos dang / gna' grong ni shes rmongs kyi gna' grong 'ig e red/ yang na deng rabs shes rig gi nyi 'od ma phog pa'i gna' grong zhig e red/ yang na rig gnas gsar pa'i me tog gi dri ngad ma ldang ba'i gna' grong zhig e red/ de bas gna' grong ni kha rub kyi spyi tshogs shig yin pa dang / shes rig gsar pa dang phyi phyogs rig gnas 'phud rgyag gtong zhing / srol rgyun rnying pa dang nang gi rig gnas srung sdom byed pa'i kha rub kyi spyi tshogs shig yin par 'dod/ 'di lta bu'i shes rmongs kyi gna' grong zhig nas1zung zla ba pham par brgyab song ba red/ 'di ni da lta'i bod spyi tshogs dang shes yo/na can bar gyi 'gal ba red la/ mang tshogs dang shes yo/na can gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba'ang red/ deng sang nga tshos 'u cag rjes lus red/ 'u cag rtogs pa sad dgos/ 'u cag la blo 'byed byed dgos zer gyin yo/da/ 'o na/ ‘‘gna' grong’’'di nas 'u cag la blo 'byed byed dgos na thog mar mang tshogs dang shes yo/na can bar gyi 'gal ba — 193 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/de ji ltar thag gcod byed/ nga tshos ji ltar blo 'byed byed/ skyagloko yi blo 'byed byed dam yang naskyalo/ ༄ yi blo 'byed byed/ 'di ni 'u cag la mtshon na nges par du bsam gzhig gtong dgos pa'i gnad don zhig red/'u cag gi nye rabs lo rgyus la bltas yong na/ lha sa'i sku drag gtso byas pa'i yon tan pa mang po zhig gis skabs thog der blo 'byed kyi las 'gan de phrag tu blangs zig des mi tshad rang rang gi ngos thad nas 'bad pa yang byas zig yin na'ang mtha' mjug tshang mas pham kha myangs song ba red/ de'i rkyen gyis da lta nga tshos ji ltar blo 'byed byed pa'i thad la bsam gzhig yang yang gtong dgos gi3 shes yon can gyi rang gzugs rma med pa zhig mthong thub ste/de ni1zung zla ba red/ 1zung zla ba ni mi ci 'dra zhig red ce na/gcig nas kho ni sger tshugs kyi mi gzhi ldan zhing sger gshis mnga' ba dang sger tshugs kyi bsam gzhig gtong mkhan zhig red/ (chu 'dren 'khor lo jus 'god byas pa dang / spyir kho rang gna' grong du gna' grong gi lcags ri rnying pa de 'tshol du yong na'ang / gna' grong gi skya zad sngo sdug gi 'tsho ba de mthong bas gdung sems chen po skyes pa/ da dung‘‘rang gshis dang 'gal ba'i bya ba sgrub mi srid pa ni kho'i 'jig rten du 'tsho ba'i rtsa don zhig yin’’pa) gnyis nas rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal zhing 'gan 'khra'i 'du shes ldan pa/ (drang bden gyi — 194 —

rīs rmongs kyi‘‘ na' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi btsun/ched du skya ldang gtsos pa'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la gdong gtug dang 'thab rtsod rab dang rim pa byas pa dang / rmo mo ma smad gnyis kyi nyam thag pa'i 'tsho bar gdung sems chen po skyes te a stag tshang gi rnang zhing la chu 'dren pa'i thad la hur brtson chen po byas pa) gsum nas bsam sbyor gnyis gzhi gcig tu 'dres shing kha bshad dang lag len gnyis thod thug pa/ 1zung zla ba'i bya spyod gang la bltas yong na kho ni kha bshad kho na tsam ma yin par lag len dngos la 'beb mkhan zhig red/ de bas kho ni bsam phod pa dang smra phod pa/ sgrub phod pa can zhig kyang red/ da lta 'u cag la mkho ba'ang1zung zla ba lta bu'i shes yon can red/ deng sang shes yon can du rlom pa mang po zhig gis dpa' gtam bsgrags pa dang rtsom rdzig po 'bri ba/cho lo gang mang thogs yod na'ang don dngos dang gnad 'gag gi skabs la thug yong na‘‘kha bshad chu yi lbu ba dang lag len gser gyi thigs pari’kho na las ma 'das/ de ni ci 'dra'i yid phangs pa zhig red ang / bzhi nas khrims kyi 'du shes dang ldan pa zhig yin pa/ (sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la〈snyan zhu yi ge〉phul ba dang/ 〈snyan zhu yi ge〉yi ngos su tham ga rgyag tu bcug pa sogs) ‘‘rgya yig thog dang bod tshig thog’’zer ba bzhin 'u cag la yig thog gi khrims kyi 'du shes ni drag po zhig mi 'dug khrims kyi 'du shes med tshe spyi tshogs kyi las gang zhig la 'jug na de'i mtha' mi 'khyol zhing rngo mi thogs par ma zad/ drang bden zhig gzhar yang yong — 195 —

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dka' ba red/ lhag par du da lta'i dus rabs dang spyi tshogs 'di'i nang du 'u cag la mtshon na spyi dmangs kyi 'du shes dang khrims kyi 'du shes gtsang ma zhig rgyud la 'khrungs rgyu ni shin tu nas/ gal che ba zhig red/4 zhar byung / ‘‘gna' grong’’gi sde dmangs u yo/na lhan khang yin na 'dra/ dbang cha'i rtags mtshan te skya ldang gi lag gi tham ga yin na 'dra/ de dag ni srid gzhung gi mtshon byed gtso bo zhig red/srid gzhung gi mtshon byed dang yang na tang gi srid jus de dag gna' grong du thon yo/da gi des mi tshad skya ldang sogs kyis‘‘lag bstar’’yang byed kyin 'dug yin na'ang mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba ni sngar bzhin rjes lus dang dbul phongs kyi gnas su gyar 'dug pa red/ de bas phyi'i cha nas khra khra rig rig yin yang don gyis gna' grong du srid jus lag len don 'khyol byed kyi med pa dang / mang tshogs kyi bde sdug kyang thag gcod byed thub kyi med pa de mtshon 'dug snyam/ nga la mtshon na 'di na dri rtags shig yo/da gi5 mjug bsdoms/ brtsams sgrung 'di bklags pa brgyud nga tshos shes rtogs thub pa ni/ gcig nas shes rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’du1zung zla ba lta bu'i mi bu shes rab can dang / mi bu spobs pa can/mi bu dpa' gdeng can/ mi bu rgyu 'bras can/ mi bu lag len pa ni gnas thabs ye nas yod pa ma red/ ‘‘gna' grong’’du kho'i las dbang da 196 da

shes rmongs kyi‘ gna' grong ’dang me long’’nang gi btsun/ni mabo bor rdo log gis shugs kyis brdab rgyu de red/ ya nga na blo pham dang bcas sa srod kyi dus su btsan gyis 'gro dgos pa de red/ de'i rkyen gyis ngas bshad 'dod pa ni 'u cag gi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khor yu/ga 'di'i khrod du1zung zla ba lta bu'i mi bu ni nam ya nga gnas thabs yo nga pa ma red/ 'u cag gi khor yu/ga 'di dang rig gnas 'di ni mi bu shes rab can dang mi bu rnam dpyod can/ mi bu spo bas pa can/ mi bu dpa' gdeng can/ mi bu sgal tshigs can/ mi bu rgyu 'bras can dag 'bur 'joms dang dmar gsod gtong byed cig red/ mdor na 'u cag gi srol rgyun rig gnas 'di ni shes yon can rnal ma 'bur 'joms gtong byed cig red/ nye dus kyi rig pa'i dpa' bo dge 'dun chos 'phel dang dpal don grub rgyal rnam pa gnyis kyang 'u cag gis btsan gyis lnga lam du brdzangs pa ma yin nam/ gnyis nas 'u cag gi/ yon tan pa rnams kyis nam yang‘‘gna' grong gi lcags ri rnying pa’’lta/ bu 'tshol ba dang / zhib 'jug bya gzhi zhig lag tu e rag la blta ba/bod rig pa'i ched mkhas kyi cho lo khyer nas phyi rgyal du 'gro e thub la blta ba/ yang na brda chad skam po spungs pa'i dpyad rtsom re bris te las thob e 'phar la blta ba sogs byed pa las mi ser dkyus ma'i bde sdug ni thed la bor 'dug kho tsho la gdung sems chen po mi 'duga'agan 'khri'i 'du shes mi 'dug rgyu 'bras blo mig mi 'dug der —— 197 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/brten/ 'u cag gis1zung zla ba la slob sbyong byas na ci 'dra/ 1zung zla ba mig dper bzung na ci 'dra/ gsum nas brtsams sgrung nga zhig la mtshon na kya kyu 'gug shugs ldan pa'i byung rim bkod sgrig dang / khyad 'phags rtser son gyi sgyu rtsal bzhengs skrun byed rgyu mi gtso bar gdung sems chen po dang na zug chen pos spyi tshogs kyi gnad don la kha gtad rgyu de ni brtsams chos la mtshon na bsam blos mngon par brgyan pa'i thabs lam nyag gcig yin pa red/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)gsum pa/ ‘‘me long’’nang gi grwa btsun/bkra bha lags kyi〈me long〉de sgrung thung zhig red/ da ni sgrung thung 'di la dpyad pa rags tsam spel na/1 ngas bltas na thog mar brtsams sgrung 'di'i brjod gzhi 'dem pa ha cang legs po red/ rgyu mtshan ni 'u cag gi spyi tshogs 'di ni skya ser gnyis mnyam sdod byas yod pa'i spyi tshogs shig red/ da snga yan chad du bris pa'i rtsom rig gsar pa'i brtsams chos dag ni grong pa'am skya bo'i skor brjod bya byas pa tag tag red/ grong pa'i sems kyi dga' skyo chags sdang dang 'tsho ba rol stangs de smyug rtse gtod sa gtso bo byas yod gi ltos bcas kyis ser mo pa'i 'tsho ba brjod bya byas te bris pa'i brtsams chos ni ha cang nyung nyung red/ rgya cung zad chung gi 'u cag — 198 —

shes rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi btsun/gi spyi tshogs la skya ser gnyis mnyam gnas byed pa'i khyad chos 'di ldan pas grong pas kyang ser mo pa'i 'tsho bar rgyus lon byas na 'grig gi 'dod/ lhag par du rtsom mkhan zhig la mtshon na ser mo pa'i 'jig rten 'di la rgyus lon dang lta zhib byas te smyug kha 'di'i phyogs la bsgyur na 'grig gi 'dod/ yang gcig bshad na ser mo pa'i 'jig rten 'di brjod bya byas nas brtsams sgrung sogs bris na 'u cag gi rtsom rig de phun sum je tshogs dang yar rgyas 'byung bar yang phan thogs yo/da pa red/deng sang grwa btsun rtsom mkhan gyi khrod na'ang rtsom rig gsar pa la 'jug mkhan skor zhig yod bi la shas kyis rang nyid la nyams myong dang gsal cha med pa ste/ dper na pho mo'i bar gyi brtse dung gi skor sogs kyang rang mos snyan ngag tu bris yod pa mthong rgyu yod gi de ni shin tu nas dgod bro ba zhig red/ khyod kyis rang la rgyus med pa zhig lab brdol 'byin pa las rang la rgyus yo/da pa'i ser mo pa'i 'jig rten de bris na mi legs sam/2 ‘‘me long’’'di yang da lta'i bod spyi tshogs kyi bsdus gzugs shig red/ bsdus gzugs de las grwa btsun zhig gi gzugs brnyan mthong yong / grwa btsun de ni ci 'dra zhig red ce na/ mi sna gtso bo grwa btsun bstan 'dzin 'jigs med ni gcig nas sems rgya chung zhing gu dog pa dang / kha nas chos gzhung gi tshig 'ga' re zlo na'ang don gyis — 199 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ci ya/nga mi shes pa zhig red/ (‘‘grub mtha' mi 'dra ba zhig dang mnyam du nad la gso bcos byas na 'chi ba las ci yo/da snyam pa’’dang / ‘8grub mtha' mi 'dra ba zhig dang mnyam du mal khang gcig tu bsdad na/ nad las thar thabs yod dam’’‘‘shu/grub mtha' mi 'dra ba zhig dang mnyam du mal khang gcig tu bsdad na/ shi rung thar ba zhig yo da dam’’da 〈sbrang char〉〉gyi shog ngos89par gsal/ yang‘‘chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba’’dang /‘‘bstan 'dzin 'jigs med kyis bon gyi grwa pa de gsum gyi rjes la bon gyi lha dang lha mo gang mang 'ig ded yo/da nges snyam pa na/ lus kyi p+tod smad thams cad gzugs med kyi dngos po zhig gis yo/ngas su mnan te dbugs kyang 'byin dka' ba'i tshor snang byung bas/ bon po rnams la rgyab gtad de skyabs 'gro yang nas yang du bzlas’’da 〈sbrang char〉gyi shog ngos89dang92par gsal) gnyis nas kho ni mi gtad so med pa zhig red/ 'di ni mo yang nas yang du btab pa dang /gnad 'gag gi skabs su dad pa med cing dad yu/la srung 'dzin ma byas pa'i steng nas mtshon thub ste/ thog mar grub mtha' mi gcig pa'i bon po'i grwa pa de'i steng la sdang na'ang / sems kyi 'jigs skrag(rmi ltas ngan pa)de sel ched‘‘ban chos spangs nas bon la zhugs kyang / bon gyi chos skyong srung ma ban las btsan par brjod pas/ srog la nyen pa'i chag sgo 'byung mi srid’’snyam zhor thog ma'i gnas skabs kyi‘‘dgra’’de‘‘mgon’’du bkur ba lta bu'o/ /yad da khyed tshos ltos dang / grwa btsun bstan 'dzin 'jigs — 200 ge

shes rmongs kyi‘ gna' grong’ dang‘6me long nang gi btsun/med ni dad pa can zhig e red/ kho'i dad pa de brtan po zhig e red/(nyan pos ma red/ ma red zer) dad pa zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di bod mi kun gyi kha na rlangs pa bzhin thul le le byed kyi yo/da pa zhig red/ khyod la dad pa yod dam zhes pa'i 'dri tshig 'di ni 'u cag bod mi rnam sa la mtshon na brnyas tshig cig red/ rgyu mtshan ni bod mi'i khrod na dad pa med mkhan zhig gang na yod/ tshang mas nga la dad pa yod ces brjod srid pa red/ yin na'ang mi zhig la dad pa yod med ni gnad 'gag gi skabs la thon na da gzod shes yong gi red/〈me long〉nang gi grwa btsun bstan 'dzin 'jigs med ni rtsom pa pos rtog bzo byas pa'i mi sna zhig yin du chugs kyang / 'u cag gi dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod du‘‘bstan 'dzin 'jigs med’’gang mang ma nga yo/da pa red/ ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen mo’’yi skabs su sto/na pa'i gsung rab me la bsregs shing / lha khang 'du khang rmang nas/ bshig pa dang rtsa ba'i bla mar 'thab rtsod byed mkhan rnams ni dad pa can du rlom pa'i‘‘bstan 'dzin 'jigs med’’dag gi byed las ma yi na nam/ de bas dad pa yo/da med de kha nas tshod tshod la bshad rgyu zhig ga la yin/gnad 'gag gi skabs su 'u cag la dad pa e yo/da/ kho bo shin tu nas the tshom za 'ong / ('dir ‘rig gsar’’skabs kyi skyi g.ya' ba'i 'thab rtsod krod du dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho lags kyis rang gi gces pa'i srog la babs kyang dad — 201 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/pa brtan po'i ngang rang lus kyi ston pa'i na bza' de bsrungs pa'i gtam rgyud gson po zhig bshad mod/ yig tshogs kyis mang bar dogs nas ma spros pa yin)3 spyi'i cha nas bltas na〈me long〉ni grwa btsun zhig gi snang brnyan dang gnas bab tsam zhig slar mtshon byas pa tsam las sgrung thung 'di la bsam blo'i zab tshad dang / bsam gzhig gi sgo glegs 'byed sa ni chen po zhig mi 'dug snyam/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)bzhi pa/ 〈gna' grong〉dang〈〈me long〉gnyis kyi gshib bsdur/gsham nas〈gna' grong〉〉dang〈me long〉gnyis la gshib bsdur rags tsam zhig byed/1 rtsom pa po'i phyogs nas/ 〈gna' grong〉〉gi rtsom pa po rig ldan rgya mtsho lags ni dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang du rang re'i rtsom stegs steng byung ba'i gsar skyes kyi rtsom pa po zhig red/ lo ngo 'di 'ga'i ring la〈sbrang char〉steng du snga phyir〈mig gsum pa〉dang〈〈a khu dpon〉sogs spel myong / 〈me long〉gi rtsom pa po bkra bha lags ni slob grogs rnams la cha rgyus yod ni red/ kho ni dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu pa nas bzung 'u cag gi rtsom stegs steng snyan grags cung che ba'i rtsom pa po zhig red/ 〈sgrol ma nyer gcig〉ni skabs de'i sgrung thung yig brgya ma thog ma yin par ma zad/ klog pa po rnams ches klog — 202 —

shes rmongs kyi‘‘ga 'a grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi btsun/spro ba'i sgrung thung deb cig kyang yin pa red/ 〈sbrang char〉〉steng du'ang snga phyir〈grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba〉dang〈〈a khu khyi skyag rta la dga'〉〉sogs spel myong ba red/ gcig ni lo tshod sum cu'i nang du yod pa'i na gzhon zhig red la/ cig shos ni lo tshod bzhi bcu yol ba'i dar ma zhig red/ngas bltas na rig ldan rgya mtsho gtsos pa'i gsar skyes kyi rtsom pa po dag la gdung sems kyi 'du shes dang 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ldan la/'tshol rtog snying stobs kyang ldan gi rgya'i na gzhon shes yon can wang kha'e ling lags kyis‘‘sems la 'gan 'khri med pa na/ sgyu rtsal zhes pa sbrum du med’’zer/ de ni ngo ma bden pa rang red/ bkra bha gcos pa'i dar ma'i rtsom pa po dag la gdung sems kyi 'du shes dang 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes med pas mi tshad/ 'tshol rtog snying stobs kyang ha cang zhan gi yang na‘‘rgas’’bzhin pa'i tshor pa ster gi kho tsho'i bsam blo nyams dmas su 'gro god gi snang brnyan can gyi skad cha zhig gis bshad na/ kho tsho'i brtsams chos ni‘‘snum shig shig’’cig ma yin par‘‘skya thal thal’’zhig red/ zhan cha 'di dag bkra bha kho na ma yin par dar ma'i rtsom pa po gzhan dag gi steng na'ang 'dug ste/ dper na/reb gong rdo rje mkhar dang stag 'bum rgyal/ a smyon bkra shis don grub/rang sgra sogs lta bu red/2 bsam blo'i phyogs nas/ 〈gna' grong〉du mi ser dkyus ma'i — 203 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dka' sdug la do khur byas yod pa dang rtsom pa po zhig gi dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri de'ang sha thon rus thon byas yod gi da dung drang bden skyong ba'i 'dun pa yang drag po mtshon yod gi spyir na rtsom rig brtsams chos gang zhig la mtshon na de'i brjod gzhi ni phal cher rtsom pa po gang de'i bsam blo yin pa red/ a ri'i brtsams sgrung mkhan he men weX/ lags kyis‘‘brtsams sgrung mkhan zhig la mtshon na kha nas mang po bshad dgos gi ma red/ rang gis bshad 'dod pa dang rang gi bsam blo de smyug kha nas bshad yod pa red’’ces brjod pa ba'in/ rtsom pa po rang gi bsam blo de brtsams chos su phyi gsal nang gsal gyis mtshon yo da pa red/〈me long〉du mi sna gtso bo bstan 'dzin 'jigs med yin na 'dra/rtsom pa po kho rang yin na 'dra/ thog mar nad pa es pa der myong rtog byas pa mi 'dang gi mi tshe'i go rim ste skye rga na 'chi las na ba zhes pa der gdung sems kyi cha med la/ lhag par du nad las rgyal ba'i bsam blo de bas kyang med pa red/ nad pa zhig la mtshon na rang gi sems pa de che ru btang nas sems kyis nad de thub dgos gi nad pa'i sems pa rgya ji ltar che na nad kyi dgra bo de ltar 'joms thub pa zhig yin par bgresdoṭ+wāṃngasdiñdzināsnre/〉rmelhasahābaṃgabatha51 rnyikyi sh+lausdo//snyo~Xhūṃmigyetswapy-i6shaṃlhazlo tā ne+e kha'i brtsams sgrung rme /ban/ brtsams chos /de rishārti()po/ dge wa7ri 04 /

shes rmongs kyi‘ gna' grong’’dang‘ me long’’nang gi btsun/grags/ bstan 'dzin 'jigs med la mtshon na rang sems kyis/ nad mi‘‘'dul’’bar bca' ba rim gro bsgrubs pa dang yang na nad grogs bon po la skyabs bcol ba lta bu red/ da dung〈me long〉du‘‘dgos med kyi lhag ma’’skor zhig kyang mthong thub ste/ gcig nas grwa btsun bstan 'dzin 'jigs med ni lha chos rig gnas kyi 'jig rten de la mtshon na6‘dgos med kyi lhag ma’’zhig ste/ khos ngur smrig gi chos gos shig lus la mnabs yo/da pa tsam las don gyis chos gzhung la blo sbyong til 'bru tsam yang med pa 'ig red/ de bas nang pa'i bstan pa 'di la mtshon na grwa btsun bstan 'dzin 'jigs med ni dngos gnas‘‘dgos med kyi lhag ma’’'ig red snyam/ gnyis nas grwa btsun bstan 'dzin 'jigs med kyis‘‘me long’’las mthong ba'i phyi rol gyi 'jig rten de'ang kho la mtshon na‘‘dgos med kyi lhag ma’’zhig ste/ zang zing gi 'jig rten dang mi tshogs kyis gang ba'i khrom gzhung sogs ni 'khor ba blos btang ba'i rab byung pa zhig gi ngos thad nas bshad na‘‘dgos med kyi lhag ma’’zhig ci la min/ gsum nas〈me long〉du‘‘bya mdo rab rgyas kyi snyan ngag〈nad pa dang me long〉zhes pa'i brjod bya la bzo bcos cung zad byas te brtsams pa yin’’zhes pa'i rtsom mkhan gyi gsal bshad cig spel 'dugangs bltas na sgrung thung 'di'i phyi'i thabs rtsal dang nang gi bsam blo gang la bltas yong na‘‘bya mdo rab rgyas kyi snyan ngag〈nad pa dang me long〉zhes — 205 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/pa'i brjod bya la bzo bcos cung zad byas te rtsom’’dgos pa de 'dra zhig gtan nas ma red 'dod/ snyan ngag〈nad pa dang me long〉zhes pa de 'dra zhig yod bzhin du da dung der bskyar zlos byas te yi ge'i gad snyigs spungs pa dang/ 〈sbrang char〉gyi shog ngos 'phro brlag tu btang nas ci zhig byed/ de bas〈me long〉〉'di'ang‘‘dgos med kyi lhag ma’’zhig yin pas mi tshad/ rtsom mkhan gyi gsal bshad de yang〈me long〉la mtshon na‘‘dgos med kyi lhag ma’’zhig red/〈me long〉la rnam pa'i steng nas 'tshol rtog gi cha mi ldan pa dang /bsam blo'i cha nas kyang de 'dra'i zab tshad yod pa zhig ma red/ 'di'i steng nas nga tshos gnad don zhig mthong thub pa ni/ bkra bha dang yang na kho tsho'i rabs gcig pa'i rtsom mkhan rnams kyi gsar gtod kyi nus pa dang bsam pa'i bkod pa de nyams dmas su 'gro bzhin pa de red/der brten/ kho bos〈me long〉ni snying po med pa'i brtsams chos shig red ces brjod pa yin/gong du brjod pa ltar rig ldan rgya mtsho sogs kyis mtshon pa'i gsar skyes kyi rtsom mkhan rnams dang / bkra bha sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dar ma'i rtsom mkhan rnams kyi bar na de 'dra'i bar khyad cig yod gi'o na/ de 'dra'i bar khyad cig ji ltar shor ba red ce na/ ngas bltas na gsham gyi rkyen 'di 'dra zhig la thug yod gi snyam/ gcig tu bod — 206 —

sa rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang gi btsun/rang gi dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab 'di la ngos zin rnal ma 'ig thob yod med dang / gnyis su bsam blo'i blo sbyong dang shes bya'i sgrig gzhi chig rkyang yin min/ gsum du rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal min/bzhi ru 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ldan min/ lnga ru sngon thon rig gnas tshur len gyi snying stobs ldan min bcas las bar khyad de 'dra zhig shor song bar 'dod/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)lnga pa/ mjug bsdu ba/mjug tu a me ri kha'i kha mtshar zhig gis kho bo'i gtam bshad kyi mjug bsdu bar bya ste/ nyin zhig tshoms khang chen mo zhig tu a ri'i glu len mkhan zhig gis glu gzhas kyi dbyangs rta dang po de blangs par nyan po rnams kyis dga' 'bod byas shing thal mo yang yang brdabs/nyan po tshos slar yang thengs gcig len dgos pa'i re ba zhus pa na/khos yang bskyar thengs shig blangs/ yin na'ang nyan po tshos da dung thengs gcig len pa'i re ba zhus/ khos yang bskyar nyams dang bcas thengs shig blangs/ yang nyan po tsho'i re ba ltar khos thengs gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ blangs/ mjug mthar/ kho ha cang thang chad cing ngal dub kyis mnar ba dang skad kyang 'gags te dbugs hal hal dang ngag tsir tsir gyis‘‘dbyangs rta 'di da ngas thengs ga tshod la len dgos’’— 207 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/zhes dris pa na/ nyan po tsho na re/ ‘‘rna bar snyan zhing yid la 'jebs pa dang tshad ldan yin rag bar du len rogs mdzod’’ces thal lo /(nyan po'i dgod sgra) 'u cag gi rtsom mkhan rnams kyi gnas tshul yang a ri'i glu pa 'di dang a na ma na red/ de ltar smra dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ngas bltas na 'u cag gi rtsom mkhan dag gis kyang‘‘gzhas’’tshad ldan zhig nam yang len gyi mi 'dug go/ yang na brtsams chos legs po zhig nam yang 'bri thub kyi mi 'dug go/ de'i rkyen gyis 'u cag gi rtsom mkhan dag gis kyang rang re'i klog po kun gyi dgos mkho skong thub kyin med pas na/ gong gi glu pa 'di ltar du da dung mu mthud du‘‘len’’dgos/mu mthud du 'bri dgos/ mu mthud du 'tshol rtog byed dgos/ (nyan po'i dgod sgra dang thal mo rdeb sgra)yad da do dgong gi nga'i gtam bshad mtshams 'di nas 'jogazhol nas slob grogs rnams kyis gong gi brtsams sgrung 'di gnyis bklags rjes kyi rang rang gi dran tshul dang / yang na 'dri tshig 'dra yod na 'dzem dogs med par dris dang ngas shes tshod kyis lan 'debs nges yin/ mi shes pa rnams 'u cag gis mnyam du slob sbyong byed chogathugs rje che/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)dri ba dris lan/ngag dri/ 〈snyan ngag me long〉ni bod kyi rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs shig yin — 208 —

rīs rmongs kyi‘ gna' grong’’dang‘ me long’’nang gi bcun/zhes deng sang mang pos bshad grod gi des na rtsom rig gzhung lugs 'di'i nang du 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes dang gdung sems kyi 'du shes/ bsam blo'i cha sogs gleng med gi 'dod/ khyed kyis gong du〈gna' grong〉la bsam slo'i rin thang yod pa dang/ 〈me long〉la bsam blo'i rin thang med gi zhes bshad thal/ ngas bltas na de ni bkra bha sogs la〈snyan ngag me long〉〉gi shan shugs thebs pa ha cang drag ngo yin nga sa red snyam/ khyed kyis bltas na ci 'dra zhig red/lan/ —1ma mkhan zhig la cha ma〉rton na 1dul sbyo/na 3) —1ma stangs de 64 phyir rtog byas pa mi 'dang ba dang / rig gnas gsar pa'i thon khungs sngog 'don dang tshur len byas pa mi 'dang ba sogs kyi rkyen yod gyi red/ngas bltas na rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal min dang 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ldan min/ dka' sdug la gdong gtod pa'i 'du shes yod med ni gtso bo red 'dod/spyir na brtsams sgrung gsar pa'am deng rabs brtsams sgrung zhes pa 'di ni spyi lo1719lor dbyin ji'i rtsom mkhan te h+phorjolags kyi〈༈1 ḍā rku/khā+ed+kukāpu〉spel ba nas bzung 'go tshugs pa dang / nub gling du da lta'i bar du phal cher lo ngo sum brgya'i lo rgyus yod par bshad/lha rgya nag la lu'u zhun lags kyi〈smyon pa'i zin tho〉dang〈ayigatam rgyud〉〉nas brtsis kā spru〉so lhas krodugi/ (2sku‘ji/2kyi (0ji li r+sā 1660—1731)dbyin ji'i rtsom ma khan/ brtsams chos 〈 tsho ༈r+sā 7 mi( ji hu ) gyi7 〈paṃ ༈shu4r+harki4ltaphre7phre1lko lko94rnye 73skyophro〉〈oṃṣ+ṭha 〉2007 21ze 40— 209 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/na phal cher lo ngo brgya tham pa'i lo rgyus yod pa red/ 'u cag la don grub rgyal lags kyi〈'brong stag thang〉nas brtsis na da lta'i bar du lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi lo rgyus yod gi 'u cag gi lo ngo nyi shu'i ring gi brtsams sgrung la phyir lta zhig byas na brtsams sgrung gi rang mdangs ngo ma bo dang da dung bar thag ha cang ring gi 'dod/ mi rigs gzhan la lo ngo brgya phrag du ma'i lo rgyus ldan gi 'u cag la mtshon na lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi lo rgyus ma gtogs med pas bar thag de 'dra zhig 'dug pa ni ha cang rgyun ldan red/brtsams sgrung gsar pas do snang byed sa'ang 'jig rten pa'i dngos yod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang / mi ser dkyus ma'i las dbang dang dka' sdug de yin 'dug de bas 'u cag gis dus rgyun phul byung brtsams sgrung du ngom so byas pa'i〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉dang〈bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod〉lta bu ni brtsams sgrung du rtsi mi rung ba red/ lhag par du deng sang rtsom stegs su sgyu 'phrul dngos yod ring lugs dang / deng rabs ring lugs/ deng rabs phyi ma'i ring lugs sogs kyi kha g.yang sgrog pa dang der mthun gyi brtsams chos 'bri ba ni ngo ma dgod bro ba zhig red/ 'di'i ngos thad nas 'u cag gi rtsom pa po dag la hol rgyug dang rmongs 'thom/ 'khrul shes dang a gsar sogs kyi cha mang po yod gi 'dod/ 'di ni 'u cag gis nges par du — 210 —

sa rmongs kyi‘‘ na' grong’’dang‘‘me long’’nang btsun/mnyam 'jog dgos pa'i gnad don zhig red/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)slob grogs ka pa/ 'chad khrid kyi brda rgyur mthong bas ngas kyang〈sbrang chan〉steng gi brtsams sgrung de gnyis bklags pa yin/ do dgong me lce lags kyis bshad pa dang nga'i sems kyi dran tshul gnyis phal cher 'dra gi khyed kyis gong du brjod pa ltar deng sang shes yon can gyi sde na rtsom rig dpyad brjod spel stangs sna kha gnyis yod gi gcig ni brtsams chos kho na la dpyad pa spel ba dang / cig shos ni brtsams chos de las 'phros te zur mang po la dpyad pa spel ba'o/ /yang klog pa po'i sde na'ang la shas ni snga ma'i dpyad pa spel stangs la dga' ba dang / la shas ni phyi ma'i dpyad pa spel stangs la spro ba red/ nga rang nyid la mchon na brtsams chos las 'phros pa'i 'phros don rang bzhin gyi dpyad brjod kyi rigs de la ha cang dga' po yod/ do dgong gi 'chad khrid 'di la mchon na brtsams sgrung de gnyis las 'phros te dpyad pa mang po btang song bas shin tu legs po red snyam/1zung zla ba ni shes yon can gyi snang brnyan zhig red/ rtsom pa pos ched du rus ming du1zhes pa bris yod pa des mi sna gtso bo kho rang gi rig gnas 'brel 'dris dang rig gnas rgyab ljongs de mchon 'dug snyam pa dang / yang tsom pa pos mi sna 'di 'dra zhig 'bri bzhengs byed dus de ba nan mo bzung ba dang bsam gzhig zhib mo btang yod pa shes thub gi 1ni phyi gling gi yi ge zhig red/ 'dis shes yon can gyi snang brnyan1zung zla ba'i shes bya'i sgrig gzhi de bod rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas kho na ma yin par phyi gling gi rig gnas la'ang blo sbyong yod pa zhig yin pa shes gi shes bya'i sgrig gzhi de 'dra zhig yin pa'i dbang gis khyed kyis — 211 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rjod bzhin pa'i rtogs sad dang blo 'byed/ 'gan 'khri dang rgyu 'bras blo mig sogs thon song ba red/ shes bya'i sgrig gzhi chig rkyang ba zhig yin che rgyu 'bras blo mig sogs 'ong dka' bar 'dod/1zung zla ba ni thog mar gna' grong du lcags ri 'chol du song ba dang / yang na yon tan pa'i sde na grags che ba'i lcags ri de'i bslu brid kyi dbang gis gna' grong du bslebs pa red/ gna' grong du bslebs rjes lcags ri de 'dra zhig don dngos su med pa shes/ de las gcig nas da lta'i 'u cag gi yon tan pa'i sde yi mkhas pa rnams kyis rang mi rigs kyi‘‘'od stong ldan pa'i rig gnas’’de phyi la sgrog pa las mang chogs kyi dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba de la do khur byed mkhan nyung ba dang /gnyis nas1zung zla ba lta bu'i lag len dngos la zhugs nas lcags ri med pa de bden dpang byed mkhan ha cang nyung ba shes thub gi 1zung zla bas lag len dngos kyis lcags ri de med pa bden dpang byas 'dug 'di las shes yon can gyi gnyer bya ci zhig yin pa'ang khyed kyis bshad pa ltar gsal po byas yod ging la mtshon na〈gna' grong〉'di'i nang du ches 'dang rgyag rgyu'i chig dum zhig yod pa ni/ ‘‘ci'i phyir gna' grong du kho sa la 'gyel pa yin nam/ ci'i phyir gnas mo tshang gi dkar khung ni 'di ltar chung ngam’’(〈sbrang char〉gyi shog ngos85par gsal)zhes pa 'di red/ da lta 'u cag gis 'dri chig 'di gnyis la lan 'debs thub song che1zung zla bas gna' grong du pham kha nyo dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / ci'i phyir sa la 'argyal dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang shes thub gi dus mtshungs su 'u cag gi yon tan pa'i sde yi kha gtad so yang 'dri chig 'di gnyis kyi — 212 —lke

shes rmongs kyi gna' grong ’dang me long’’nang gi btsun/steng du babs pa yin na yod tshad je gsal la bud 'gro gi red/〈〈me long〉la mtshon na 'bri thabs kyi cha nas 'du shes 'phro ba'i 'bri thabs lhur len byas yod gi spyir na 'u cag la grwa btsun gyi brjod gzhi gtso byas nga 'i brtsams sgrung shin tu nyung gi 'di'i yar sngon du phal cher sku zhabs don grub rgyal gyi〈sprul sku〉ma gtogs med gi 〈me long〉〉du grwa btsun gyi brjod gzhi lhur blangs yod na'ang de 'dra'i gson nyams dod pa dang legs po zhig ma red/ da ci gong du khyed kyis bshad pa ltan rdzus ma'i snang ba zhig ster gi nga rang nyid la'ang de lta bu'i chor pa ster gi grwa btsun yin na grwa btsun gyi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dang /grong pa yin na grong pa'i 'cho ba'i nyams myong / slob ma yin na slob ma'i 'tsho ba'i nyams myong 'bri ba ste rang nyid gang la gtogs na de'i skor 'bri ba las/ rang gi khrab khongs de las brgal te bris na de 'dra'i legs po zhig mi 'khyongs gi yang na rdzus ma yin pa'i snang ba ster gi bkra bha'i〈me long〉las zhan cha de dag mngon gsal gyis mthong thub gi tre+om mkhan gyi gsal bshad de'ang ngas bltas na rtsom pa pos dogs snang dang the tshom zhig gi ngang nas bris pa zhig red snyam gi rgyu ma tshan ni rtsom pa po kho rang grwa btsun gyi 'tsho bar de 'dra'i zhib cha med nga sa gsal bshad de 'dra zhig dogs snang gis bris pa red/khyed kyis gong du bshad pa bzhin du〈gna' grong〉dang〈me long〉gnyis kyi rtsom pa po gnyis la bar khyad yod par ma zad/ gzhon skyes dang dar ma'i tsom pa po gnyis la'ang bar khrad yod pa red/ gzhug phyogs 'u cag gi rtsom mkhan rnams kyis dngos yod kyi spyo tshogs 'cho bar kha gtad de gdung sems chen po yod pa dang /— 213 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ldan pa/ do khur gyi 'du shes ldan pa/ rgyu 'bras blo mig ldan par byas na gzhon skyes dang dar ma'i rtsom pa po'i bar gyi bar thag de bstung thub pas mi tshad/ phul byung brtsams chos kyang 'byung thub pa'i yid ches nga la yod/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)yig dri/ khyod kyis bshad pa ltar deng sang 'u cag la dus deb ni char rjes kyi sha mo brdol ba bzhin du mang po 'byung gi yod pa red/ de dag la blta 'dod med pa dang spro ba mi 'dug ces pa ni khyed rang gcig bu ma yin par mi mang po zhig la de 'dra'i lta chul 'dug 'o na ci lta bu'i dus deb cig bsgrub pa'i phyogs la 'bad 'bungs byed dgos pa dang / ji ltar byas na da gzod klog pa po la 'gug shugs ldan pa'i dus deb cig gnyer thub bam/lan/ nga rang gi dus deb gnyer stangs thad kyi bsam blo de sngon chad kyang mang po bshad myong ba yin/ dus deb yin na 'dra/ tshags par yin na 'dra/ dra tshigs yin na 'dra/ rlung 'phrin yin na 'dra/brnyan 'phrin yin na 'dra/ gsar lam gyi las rigs 'di dag deng rabs shes rig gi grub cha gal chen tag tag yin pa red/ shes yon can zhig la mtshon na dus deb dang tshags par gang rung zhig gnyer rgyu ni shin tu nas gal che zhing / smra brjod kyi stobs shugs gang des spyi tshogs la shugs rkyen bzo dgos par 'dod/ phyi gling gi shes yon can dang rgya nag gi shes yon can gyi lo rgyus gang la bltas yong na/ shes yon can rnal ma phal che bas dus deb dang tshags par gang rung zhig — 214 —

shes rmongs kyi gna' grong dang me long nang gi bcun/bsgrubs myong ba red/ dper na/ rgya nag lta bu la mtshon na'ang khren tu'u zhi'u lags kyis〈na gzhon gsar pa〉bsgrubs pa dang / hu'u hri lags kyis snga gzhug tu〈brtson pa〉dang〈zla gsar〉〉〈〈sger tshugs dpyad brjod〉sogs bsgrubs pa/ khru'u an phingadulags kyis〈lta 'ib〉〉bsgrubs pa/ khren khu'e te②lags kyis〈〈bsam blo mkhan〉〉bsgrubs pa lta bu red/ dus deb 'di dag gis rgya nag gi bsam blo dang spyi tshogs yar rgyas kyi phyogs la nus pa bla na med pa bton myong ba red/ yang gcig bshad na 'u cag gi rtsom sgrig pa dag gis kyang bod rang gi spyi tshogs dang sbyar nas gong gi dus deb 'di lta bu gnyer ba'i phyogs la bsam blo 'khor na ci 'dra'i bzang ang /kho bos nub byang mi rigs slob chen du zhib 'jug slob ma'i sbyang bya gnyer dus〈bsam gzhig〉ces pa'i dus deb cig gnyer rgyu'i gra sgrig byas te rtsom bsdu'i brda tho yang grogs po tsho'i nang khul du bkram myong /yin na'ang rgyu rkyen du ma'i dbang gis dus deb de bsgrub thub ma song /dus deb cig gnyer rgyu'i 'dun pa ni dus da lta yin yang da dung sems na chu khol ltar du gdu bzhin 'dug da lo yang nga tshos dus deb cig chos stsin lji sdiswā spya sdidā/sdos+hosdispyon ji 9shā9rbe1ram̐lhu r+bhang spyar+sha r+shaju razlosna /sna 'i mkhan dang / mkhas pa/ brtsams sri kyisno khrenakhunāte/ (ltocho.oṃ1946—)krung 'i deng rabs kyi mkhas pa/ brtsams chosri nye rabs rtsa khrims chab da ma 'gyurarigs 'dug da 215 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bsgru ba rgyu'i thad la bas ma gzhig gtong gi yod/ go skabs shig byung tshe dus deb cig gnyer 'dod shin tu che/ gal te kho bos dus deb cig bsgrub pa'i dbang du btang na/ dus deb kyi rtsa don ni bsam blo rang dbang dang mi gzhi sger tshugs gnyis yin la/ dus deb kyi kha gtad sa ni dngos yod spyi tshogs dang rtsom lus ni 'bol rtsom dang thol rtsom/skabasatshodon dpyad brjod gsum gtso bor 'dzin nges yin/ dus mtshungs su gtam gleng dang bcar 'dri'i rtsom yig sogs kyis kyang zur brgyan pa ni smos ma dgos/ de lta bu'i mi ser dkyus ma'i bde sdug la do khur byed pa'i dus deb dang tshags par zhig yin tshe klog pa po la 'gug shugs kyang rang bzhin gyis ldan song ba ma yin nam/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)ngag dri/ 1zung zla ba ni khyed kyis gong du bshad pa ltar mi bu spobs pa can dang / mi bu shes rab can/ mi bu dpa' gdeng can/ mi bu sgal chigs can zhig red/ yin na'ang gna' grong du mi bu 'di lta bu la brtsi bkur dang dang len byed rgyu phar zhog de las ldog ste 'bur 'joms gtong ba dang mgo la rdo log gis gzhus pa red/ der brten/ khyed kyis bltas na shes yon can dang mang tshogs bar gyi 'gal ba dang bar thag de ji ltar sel dgos/lan/ khyed kyi 'dri tshig 'di la lan gsal thag chod pa zhig 'debs rgyu ni ha cang dka' mo zhig red/ de ni ngas bshad thub pa — 216 —

ris rmongs kyi gna' grong dang me long nang gi btsun/zhig kyang ma red/ yin na'ang de 'brel gyi nga'i dran tshul thung thung 'ig bshad na chog gi 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi 'o/ rgyus thog gsar gtod pa dang bsam blo pa/ sngon skyod pa gang 'ig yin yang khong rnams ni nam yang sdug bsngal myong mkhan yin pa red/ sto/na pa ye shudurdzo gcer bur sbyar shing gi rtse la bskyon myong la/ dbyi tha li'i mtshan nyid rig pa mkhan pi ru'u no①yang gson sreg byas myong / da dung rgya nag bi ku'u krun④ dang lin kra'odhi/ la sogs/ pa ya nga sdug la ma sbyar pa gcig kyang med/shes yo/na can rnal ma rnams kyis ma nga tshogs dang bden jon gyi ched du 'phag 'tshag gang mang brgyab na'ang / ma nga ②ོgas rnams kyis ldog ste khong rnams btsan gyis 'chi lam du brdzangs par ram 'degs byas pa red/ 'di ni shes yon can rnams la mtshon na ches skyi g.ya 'a zhing zur za chen po zhig ci la min/ yin na'ang lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo chen mo de 'di ltar mdun nas/ mdun du skyod nges pa red/ de ni lo rgyus kyi chos nyid cig kyang yin pa red/da lta'i 'u cag gi shes yo/na can rnams kyi 'gan 'khri gtso bo ni blo ༵/ n+d+ras+t+waṃ/'usnoX/ (ceyotram̐lko/baṭ+wāṃlarterūsni~Xsdohā 4༵lngo |༵ tsheḍi) sdo tram̐chi khrildi ༵ tsha snajismrad rte ñdzakaskyo zlo zlo j-irno/ sdon rbo/rtsa/ma sa chor gaXspyarnyi ༵ rjoX ṭ+wāṃk+ta/ /ṭ+wāṃ’ kau dīs pri snro dhi ༵dha r+sha/ngakru dā' r+sā da ram̐ ṣ+ṭṛ rnobashā kau py-ir+sha shā blo ma khan/ brtsa mas ros ku'u krun gyi —dī ḍiki ston ljishaṃ/rter+ṣarīkhri k+ṣe(9 3 rmye—1968kroh+phing gā'i deng rabs kyi bud med bas ma blo pa/ 99nilo/'i zla/pa 'i tshesri 231na gas ra ba /ga pa 1sa nga bkal to ga ga btang / da 217 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'byed byed rgyu de red/ mang tshogs la blo 'byed byed pa dang spyi dmangs slob gso(yiṭha7r+sā)khyab gdal du gtong rgyu ni 'u cag gi shes yon can rnams kyi 'gan 'khri nyag gcig yin pa red/ dus mtshungs su mang tshogs kyi dka' sdug la dus rtag tu do khur dang de'i ngos thad nas drang bden skyong zhing drang gtam brjod dgos gi de ltar byas tshe shes yon can dang mang tshogs gnyis kyi bar thag kyang je nyer 'gro thub par bdag la yid ches yod/ bar thag de bstung ba la dus yun ring mo zhig 'gor dgos pa red/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdob sgra)(skabs 'di'i slob grogs shig gi skad cha sgra phab kyi dbang gis mi gsal)slob grogs kha pa/ ngas bltas na〈me long〉nang gi rtsom mkhan gyi gsal bshad de ni‘‘dgos med kyi lhag ma’’zhig ma red 'dod/ rgyu mtshan ni rtsom pa po la khrims kyi 'du shes yod gi rtsom pa pos bya mdo rab rgyas kyi snyan ngag de'i brjod bya la bzo bcos cung zad byas te brtsams pa yin pas de la dmigs nas gsal bshad byas pa red/ rtsom dbang gi khrims de brtsi srung byas 'dug snyam/ (nyan po'i thal mo deb sgra)slob grogs ga pa/ khyed kyis gong du〈me long〉ni bsam blo'i ngos nas chig rkyang ba zhig red zer/ nga'i bsam tshul yin na〈me long〉ni bsam blo'i ngos nas chig rkyang ba zhig min par 'dod/ de ni gcig tu mi sna gtso bo grwa btsun bstan 'dzin 'jigs med ni bod mi'i rang gzugs shig red/ de ni rnam rtog gi dbang — 218 ge

shes rmongs kyi‘‘gna' grong’’dang‘ me long’’nang gi btsun/du song ba'i bod mi'i rang gzugs shig red/ kha dper‘‘bod rnam rtog gis 'chi/rgya slo thog gis 'chi’’zhes pa ltar grwa btsun bstan 'dzin 'jigs med ni rnam rtog can zhig yin pa bstan 'dug gnyis su‘‘skabs shig la/ khos ci dran 'di dran med par sman chu ser po de sbya gu brgyud nas bstan 'dzin 'jigs med kyi rtsa lam la bzhur bzhin gda'’’(〈sbrang char〉gyi shog ngos91da 92par gsal)zhes pa'i dum mtshams 'dis grwa btsun kho'i sems kyi 'chan sgo sna chogs bstan 'dug pas de yang phun sum chogs pa zhig red 'dod gi(nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)red/ rang rang gi myong rol byed stangs dang bsam gzhig gtong stangs de bshad chog chog red/ de shin tu bzang gi yad dus tshod kyang mang po 'gor thal/ do dgong gi bgro gleng mtshams 'di nas 'jog par bya/ khyed rnam par bka' drin che/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb ༷/)(mgo 'dzin pa'i mjug bsdu ba'i gtam3do dgong sku zhabs me lce lags kyis sku ngal la ma 'dzems par nged cag la 'chad khrid gnang bar kho bos 'din bzhugs slob grogs yongs kyi tshab byas te khong la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhus pa yin/ gzhug phyogs kyang khyed rang khom pa re byung che nged cag la 'chad khrid de gnang rgyu dang / dpe cha legs shos skor re 'os sbyor bya rgyu'i re ba zhus pa yin/ ya—da do dgong gi 'chad khrid 'di nas — 219 —
mjug bsdu bar bya/ (nyan po'i thal mo rdeb sgra)2007lo'i zla4pa'i tshes3nyin bshus tshar/ 2007lo'i zla5pa'i tshes21nyin snon 'phri cung zad dang bcas zhus thengs mtha' ma rdzogs te gtan la phab/

dpa' dar ring mo/dpa' dar ring mo/da wadapal don grub rgyal sku gshegs nas lo 'khor20lon pa'i dus dran du/dus chod/ 2005lo'i zla11pa'i ches30nyin/sa cha/ zi ling gi ja khang zhigami sna/ nyi gzhon/ byang skar/ me lce/ zhogs dung /me lce/ de sngon gyi nga tsho'i gros chad ltar/ de ring ni nga tshos dpal don grub rgyal sku gshegs nas lo 'khor20lon par rjes dran zhu ba'i nyin mo red/ spyi lo1985lo'i zla11pa'i tshes30nyin khong nyid 'jig rten mi yul dang zhal gyes song / de ring gi bar du tag tag lo ngo20'gor 'dug 'og nas so sos rjes dran gyi gtam gleng ba'i 'go rtsom rgyu byed/ khong nyid la rjes dran byed ched/ ngas〈mi yul gyi don grub rgyald dpal don grub rgyal sku gshegs nas lo 'khor20lon par rjes dran dang de 'brel gyi gtam〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig cig bris yod/des na/ ngas thog mar rtsom yig 'di rjes dran gyi sa bon nam gleng slong ba'i gtam gyi tshul du klog 'don byed rgyu yin/— 221 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dang po/ gleng slong ba'i rtsom/mi yul gyi don grub rgyal/da wadapal don grub rgyal sku gshegs nas lo 'khor20lon par rjes dran dang de 'brel gyi gtam/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang du 'u cag la skar chen lta bu'i skyes bu zhig byon myong / skar chen lta bu'i skyes bu des rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus/ rtsom rig sogs kyi 'phel rgyas kyi don du rang srog blos gtong gi snying stobs bskyed nas hur brtson chen po byas/ khong gi 'phrin las dang snyan grags ha cang rgyas pa'i sgang la glo bur du 'jig rten mi yul dang zhal gyes pa'i skyo gar byung / de ni mtshan mo'i nam mkha' 'od kyis gshags nas yal ba'i skar mda' dang mtshungs shing / brag ngos gzar po na chal chil du 'bab pa'i rbab chu de dgun gyi 'khyags pas bsdams pa dang 'dra/ skar chen lta bu'i skyes bu de'i ming la don grub rgyal zer zhing / smyug ming la rang grol du 'bod/ lo ngo nyi shu'i sngon gyi de ring gi nyin mo ste spyi lo1985lo'i zla11pa'i tshes30nyin mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho lho khul chab cha grong rdal gyi rang shag tu rang srog bcad de rang gi tshe srog gis mi rigs 'di la dung — 222 —

dpa' dar ring mo/brda brgyab/ lo ngo nyi shu 'gor ba'i de ring gi nyin mo 'dir kho bos 'das po khong la rjes dran bya phyir/ rtsom thung 'di 'bri ba'i khur ma bskul dang blangs kyis phrag tu blangs/ gsham du drang po drang gzhag dang bden pa bden thub kyi sgo nas khong nyid gleng rgyu yin/gcig don grub rgyal gyi mdzad rjes/ngas bltas na don grub rgyal gyi mdzad rjes la gdeng 'jog byed na yin 'jog byed dgos sa gtso bo phyogs gsum na 'dug ste/ dang po ni khong gi gsar gtod kyi snying stobs red/ gsar gtod kyi snying stobs 'di khong nyid rtsom rig gsar pa'i lam bur zhugs pa'i sgul shugs red/‘‘gsar byung gi stobs shugs med pa yin na/ rgya mtsho yin kyang rul bar 'gyur la/ gsar gtod kyi snying stobs med pa yin na/ gsar pa yin kyang snying po ga la yod’’(〈goms gshis lags/ bdag gi snying gtam 'di la gson〉)ces dang / ‘‘gsar gtod kyi stobs med na/ drang bden zer ba yang med la/ rgyu 'bras zer ba yang skyag rdzun red’’(〈'di na yang drag tu mchong lding byed bzhin pa'i snying gson po zhig 'dug〉)ces brjod pa sogs las khong gi gsar gtod kyi snying stobs de gsal por mthong thub/ gnyis pa ni brtsi 'khur mi byed pa'i snying stobs(rkoshāṣ+ṭha— 223 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ṇ+ḍaṃshāloltasde)red/ 'dir brjod pa'i‘‘brtsi 'khur mi byed pa'i snying stobs’’ni rig gnas kyi ngos nas tshad ma'i skyes bu khas mi len pa dang /dbang gragasasmomi brtsi ba sogs la go ba las/ chab srid thad kyi spyi dmangs kyis brtsi 'khur mi byed pa dang‘‘rgyu 'bras blo mig gis brtsi 'khur mi byed pa’’la go na mi 'grig pa yin/ don grub rgyal gyi brtsi 'khur mi byed pa'i snying stobs mngon tshul ni/ khong gis 'u cag gi sngon byon mkhas pa rnams la rmongs dad mi byed pa dang / skabs der bzhugs pa'i mkhas pa rgan gras rnams la yang bden pa bdar ba red/dus rabs snga ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉〉ha cang dar ba'i tshod red/ de la khong gis mi mang po〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉la hang sang gi 'dug kyang / de la hang sang dgos don ci yang mi 'dug de ni ston pa shākya thub pa'i skyes rabs sogs las gna' rabs rgya gar gyi mi tshe skyel stangs kyi sgrom zhig blangs/de'i nang la rgya gar nas yong ba'i snyan ngag me long ma'i 'bri srol gyi tshig sbyor gyis brgyangs nas grub pa red/ 'di'i steng nas mdo mkhar ba zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal ni snyan ngag me long ma'i tshig rgyan tsam la mkhas pa ma gtogs/ khong ni rlabs chen gyi rtsom mkhan zhig yin pa mthong mi thub ces brjod pa red/ de'i skor pad ma 'bum lags kyi— 224 —

dpa' dar ring mo/〈don grub rgyal gyi mi tshe〉zhes pa sogs la bltas na ha cang gsal po red/gsum pa ni ngo log gam rgyab gtod kyi snying stobs red/ khong gis rgyu rngam can gyi bla sprul rnams la mtshang 'byin byed pa'i brtsams sgrung〈〈sprul sku〉bris shing / 〈sprul sku〉〉bris pas spyi tshogs steng khong la‘‘lta logari’dang‘‘bstan bshig’’sogs kyi ming ngan yang sna tshogs byung ba red/ des mi tshad khong gi 'phrin yig cig tu‘‘ngag las sems can thams cad kyi 'phrin las sgrub par khas 'ches kyang / don la rang don 'ba' zhig ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa'i ser mo pa 'di dag gi nang du/ rgod bro ba'i a tsa ra shin tu mang ste/ gdong la 'bag gyon nas 'cham byed mkhan dang phyogs mtshungs pas so/ /kho bo ni bstod smad kyi 'ben du gyur kyang rung gis tshe 'dir ni de dag gi ldog zlar mtha' gcig tu langs rtsis yod’’bu ces brjod yod pa dang / gzhan yang〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉las srol rgyun gyi gnyen sgrig lugs srol la dgag sgrub byas pa dang / ‘‘mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i sngon chad kyis da lta'i tshab byed mi rung la/ ba tshwa'i dri dang 'grogs pa'i kha sang gis de ring gi skom pa ga la sod’’(〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉)ces brjod pa sogs las kyā'izlo1spyazlosh+lau 5shā grut+na snalja sni k+tak+ṣiṃr r+shagānā pod drug pa (thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs) mi rigs dpe skrun khang 1sbyon9brte / / ———— shārti73/) ————

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bla ma sprul sku dang goms srol rnying pa/ srol rgyun rig gnas bcas la ngo log gam rgyab gtod kyi 'du shes drag po zhig bzung yod pa rtogs thub/gnyis/ don grub rgyal gyi mi 'dang sa/don grub rgyal gyi mi 'dang sa de gtso bo bsam blo'i ngos thad nas gleng dgos la/ bsam blo'i rgya ma'i steng du khong nyid kyi ljid tshad ga 'dra yin pa 'jal dgos/ 'di ni don grub rgyal la bden pa bden thub kyis lo rgyus dang dus rabs kyi ngos zur nas gdeng 'jog byed pa'i rnam pa zhig kyang red/ khong gi mi 'dang sa dang po ni bsam blo pa'i brtul zhugs bzung med pa de red/ de gang gis mtshon thub ce na/khong gis spyi tshogs dang rig gnas kyi gnad don gang zhig gleng na'ang /phyi tshul gyi rnam pa zhig las de'i ngo bo'am rgyu rkyen la nam yang mi dpyod pa red/ de yang kho bos de sngon bris pa nang bzhin‘‘kha dper/ a pha'i kha phor gtsang ma min yang dungs zhen los yod zer ba ltar gnad don de'i ngo bo'am rgyu rkyen la dpyad pa gtong ba'i tshe khong phyi nur byas yod pa red/ des mi tshad don grub rgyal ni lo rgyus rig pa mkhan red/btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus la dpyad pa btang ba yin na'ang 'dra/— 226 —

dpa' dar ring mo/〈thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs〉bsgyur pa yin na'ang 'dra/ khong lo rgyus la ha cang mkhas gi 'on kyang lo rgyus zhib 'bri byas pa las lo rgyus la phyir rtog byas pa nyung gi thu bhod rgyal rabs nyams nub tu gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen dang de'i lo rgyus la phyir rtog byas mi 'dug 'u cag rjes lus yin pa'ang khong gis shes gi yin na'ang ji ltar rjes lus thebs pa'i rgyu rkyen la nam yang dpyad pa btang med gi’’dhiyang〈sprul sku〉lta bur mtshon na sprul sku rdzus ma'i bya spyod la dgag pa dang sun 'byin byas 'dug pa las/ 'u cag gi chos lugs rig gnas kyi mtshon byed dang tog lta bur gyur pa'i bla sprul ngo ma la dpyod shes kyis bsam gzhig btang med pa red/ bla sprul gyi byung ba dang de'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs/ des bzos pa'i mjug 'bras la phyir rtog byas mi 'dugarjo bsam blo pa zhig yin na rang gi blo dang rigs pa/ shes rab/dpyod shes bcas la brten te gnad don gyi 'du shes zab gsal cig yod pa'i sgo nas dgag sgrub dang dogs slong / phyir rtog sogs kyi bsam gzhig gi las la yang nas yang du 'jug pa red/ don grub rgyal 211—lha12nā sdosgosasmi/ ga'i'i snying stobs yu na nan mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 2003lo'i zla6pa'i par/ shog ngos212pahā ga~X lce/'i mi ga'i'i snying stobs yu na nan mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 2003lo'i zla6pa'i par/ shog ngos— 227 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/gyis dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi gnad don la bsam gzhig gtong gi yod na'ang / skabs de'i‘‘mi rigs’’dang‘‘mi rigs kyi la rgya’’‘‘bod kyi rig gnas’’sogs bajid cing lhing ba dang 'od mdangs 'tsher ba'i seng ras mdzes po des khong gi mthong lam yongs su bsgribs te bsam blo pa'i las su gzhol bar gegs su gyur 'dug pa red/ don grub rgyal gson skabs kyi lo rabs brgyad cu pa ni mi rigs kyi bsam blo dang mi rigs kyi la rgya'i khog dpung rba rlabs bzhin 'phyo ba'i dus rabs shig red/yang na tshogs spyi dang thun mong gi 'du shes shugs drags pa'i dus rabs shig red/ khong ni dus skabs de'i bsam blo'i gtso 'dzin mi sna dang dar cha lta bu red la/ rtsom rig gi lam nas mi rigs kyi la rgya dang /mi rigs kyi khog dpung / mi rigs kyi re ba/ mi rigs kyi 'phel rgyas/mi rigs kyi mdun lam/ mi rigs kyi rig gnas sogs ches mang po brjod mkhan yang red/ mdor na/ mi rigs zhes pa de don grub rgyal dang yang na skabs de'i yon tan pa'i sde'i bsam blo'i srog shing lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug der brten/ khong gi bsam gzhig gi mda' kha de spyi bam po zhig dang mi rigs/ rig gnas bcas las bye brag gi mi bu re re'i steng la 'bab ma thub pa'i tshad bkag de byung song ba red/khong gi mi 'dang sa gnyis pa ni rang dbang shes yon can rnal ma — 228 —

dpa' dar ring mo/zhig ma yin pa de red/ don grub rgyal gyi brtsams chos dag las rang dbang gi snying stobs shig thog mtha' bar gsum du mngon gyi 'dug na'ang / khong ni rang dbang ring lugs la blo sbyong yod pa'i rang dbang shes yon can rnal ma zhig ma yin te/ gcig tu khong gi rtsom yig tu dbang sgyur pa la bstod pa sna tshogs phul yod pa dang / gnyis su rang dbang ring lugs kyi rmang rdo ste bdag gi tshe srog dang / bdag gi rang dbang / bdag gi khe dbang/ bdag gi rin thang sogs ni rgyal khab dang mi rigs/ spyi tshogs/ thun mong sogs yod tshad kyi gong du yod pa dang 'phrog tu med pa der ngos zin thob mi 'dug dper na khong gis rang gi rang srog bcad pa de las kyang gsal por mtshon pa red/der ma zad/ khong gis rnying zhen dang / le lo/ sgyid lug bag 'khums sogs bzlog pa tsam gyis mi rigs 'di 'phel rgyas su 'gro thub par snyam gyi 'dug don dngos su mi rigs shig 'phel 'ing dar dgos na thog mar bye brag gi mi bu re re'am‘‘bdag’’re re yar slong ba dang yod tshad kyi yod tshad‘‘bdag’’nas 'go rtsom dgos pa red/gnyis pa/ gleng slong ba'i rtsom bshad pa/zhogs dung / red/ gcod pa'i rtsom yig 'di'i nang du don tshan — 229 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/chen po gnyis bkar 'dug don tshan dang po don grub rgyal gyi mdzad rjes gleng skabs/ gcig ni gsar gtod kyi snying stobs bshad 'duga'adi gleng ba'i skabs su〈rkang lam phra mo〉〉bshad na shod kyi red snyam/〈rkang lam phra mo〉ni don grub rgyal gyi 'thus tshab brtsams chos shig red/der rkang lam bskyur nas mjug mthar gzhung lam steng du gom pa spos byung ba de ni khong gi bsam blo gtso bo red/ de khyod kyi rtsom du bris na legs snyam/de'i 'phror brtsi 'khur mi byed pa'i snying stobs bshad 'dugabartsi 'khur mi byed pa'i snying stobs 'di dbang grags ltar snang dang gnas lugs med pa zhig la brtsi 'khur mi byed pa der go dgos rgyu red/kho bo ni tshad ma yin/ khos bshad pa bden pa yin zhes bshad pa'i zhor la rdzun smras na'ang brtsi 'khur byed dgos tshe de gtan nas 'grig yod pa ma red/ brtsi 'khur mi byed pa'i snying stobs zhes brjod na 'byor min mi shes/ de la bzo bcos 'dra brgyab na ci 'dra red/gang zhig la brtsi 'khur byed dgos pa dang / gang zhig la brtsi 'khur byed mi dgos pa de je gsal la gtong thub na rab red/de'i 'phror ngo log gam rgyab gtod kyi snying stobs bshad 'dugashes yon can zhig yin na/ srol rgyun rig gnas yin na'ang 'dra/— 230 ge

dpa' dar ring mo/deng rabs rig gnas yin na'ang 'dra/ rjes lus kyi cha la ngo log byed dgos sa nas ngo log byed dgos rgyu red/ rgyab gtod dgos sa nas rgyab gtod dgos rgyu red/ dgag pa rgyag dgos sa nas dgag pa rgyag dgos rgyu red/ don grub rgyal la ngo log gam rgyab gtod kyi snying stobs 'dug ces zer chog chog red/don tshan gnyis pa don grub rgyal gyi mi 'dang sa rjod kyin yo/da pa 'di ni/ mi sna su yang lo rgyus kyi khor yu/ga nges can zhig nas skyes pa red/ des na lo rgyus kyi khor yug de la bsam blo gtong rgyu ni thi/na tu gal chen po red/ lo ngo nyi shu'i sngon gyi mi sna zhig la lo ngo nyi shu'i gzhug gam deng sang gi bsam blo ldan dgos zhes bshad na u tshugs shig los yin snyam pa 'dugaspyir bshad na rtsom thung 'di bris pa ha cang legs/ nga rang nyid kyis brjod bya 'di lta bu zhig dang / shes yon can gyi mi sna 'di lta bu zhig snying stobs 'di 'dra mnga' ba zhig 'bri ba'i dbang du btang na/za zur thon pa dang ring mo zhig 'bri dgos rgyu red/ yin na'ang rtsom thung zhig gi ngos nas bltas na khyod kyis bris pa shin tu legs po red/byang skar/ gcod pa'i rtsom du brjod pa'i brtsi 'khur mi byed pa'i snying stobs dang / rang dbang ring lugs kyi skor na cung tsam mi 'tsham — 231 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/sa dang / btsan sprod kyi cha yang cung zad 'dug pa 'dra/ 'on kyang /nga tshos mi bu zhig la rjes dran byed pa 'di mi bu de kho na'i ched du rjes dran byed pa tsam ma reng/ de ni ma 'ongs pa'i ched du rjes dran byed dgos pa red/ don grub rgyal gyi rin thang rtogs tshe ma 'ongs pa'i mi rnams la rting skul gyi nus pa yo da pa'i cha nas bshad na/ de yang mi 'grig rgyu med gi 'dod/nyi gzhon/ red ya/ de ring gi nyin mo 'di la rtsom 'di 'dra zhig 'bri rgyu ni ha cang gal chen red/ 'u tsho'i lo rgyus steng du mi bo che 'di 'dra byung na phyi rabs pa tshang mar rjes dran byed pa'i 'du shes shig dang /phar ded na snying stobs shig dgos pa 'di yang deng sang gi dus 'dir mtshon na ha cang gal che ba'i tshod red/ khyod kyis khong gi mdzad rjes de phyogs gsum gyi thad nas brjod 'dug 'u tsho'i shes yon can gyi sde na'ang don grub rgyal gyi mdzad rjes dang / shes yon/ mi gzhi/snying stobs sogs phyogs so so nas phyogs sdom dang gdeng 'jogadabye zhib sogs byed gi 'dug de ha cang gal chen red 'dod/ de gcig yin/khyod kyi rtsom las bshad pa shin tu bden pa red/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi shes rig lo rgyus la bltas na/ spyi tshogs dang thun mong / mi — 232 —

dpa' dar ring mo/rigs nas bye brag gi mi bu re re'am‘‘bdag’’gi steng la babs pa'i go rim zhig brgyud yong ba red/ mi rigs gang yang go rim 'di nges par du brgyud dgos pa zhig red/ de gnyis yin/gsum nas/ don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs de dus nges can 'ig gi khrod nas gleng dgos zer ba de bden pa red 'dod/ 'on kyang /gong du brjod pa ltar don grub rgyal bshad pa de don grub rgyal khong rang nyid bshad pa tsam ma yin par/ khong nyid 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi rig gnas khor yug de la gzhan mi rigs ltar du bsam blo de 'dra med gi zhes bshad na'ang mi chog rgyu med gi snyam/gsum pa/ don grub rgyal ni snying stobs shig yin tshul bshad pa/zhogs dung / gcod pa'i rtsom du don grub rgyal gyi gsar gtod kyi snying stobs dang / brtsi 'khur mi byed pa'i snying stobs/ ngo log gam rgyab gtod kyi snying stobs sogs gleng 'dug pa de bzhin mi gzhan gyis kyang khong gi rtsom la dpyad pa btang ba mang po 'dug khong gi mi tshe dang brtsams chos/ lo rgyus sogs la zhib 'jug byas te dpe cha bris pa yang yod 'dug nga tshos phyogs gang nas bltas kyang / don grub rgyal la gsar gtod kyi snying stobs yod pa dang / rigs gzhung zhib — 233 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'jug dang shes rig zhib 'jug gi thabs rtsal ldan pa sogs yon tan mang po 'dug de las gtso che ba rtsom rig gsar pa'i phyogs kyi mdzad rjes red/ rtsom rig gsar pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed red ce na mi chog rgyu yod pa ma red/ rig gnas gsar pa'i ngos thad nas bshad na yang dar cha chen po red zer na mi chog rgyu yod pa ma red/ ngas de sogs la bsams nas sngon chad kyi rtsom du'ang de ltar gdeng 'jog byas yod/rgyu mtshan ni rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang rigs gzhung zhib 'jugagasar gtod snying stobs sogs kyi cha nas de ltar gdeng 'jog byas pa dang che ba brjod pa yin/ de don dngos kyang red/ nga tshos slar yang che ba zhig brjod pa'i dbang du btang na/ don grub rgyal ni snying stobs shig yin zhes brjod na chog gi rgyu mtshan ci yin zer na/ de ni ya nga ba'i‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen mo’’yi mjug tag tag tu 'di 'dra'i blo spobs can dang / dpa' gdeng can/ blo gros can/ rig pa can gyi skyes bu zhig 'khrungs pa 'di rtsom rig dang rigs gzhung gi ngos nas dar cha zhig yin par ma zad/ 'u tsho'i snying stobs shig kyang red ce na mi chog rgyu yod ni ma red/ de yang bden don gyi ched du 'chi thub pa'i snying stobs shig red/ de 'dra 'u tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i lo rgyus steng byung ma myong ba zhig yin gyi red/ shes yon can zhig gi ngos nas bltas na/— 234 —

dpa' dar ring mo/bden don gyi ched du rang gi gces srog 'bul ba shin tu nyung nyung yin gyi red/ des na rang shi brgyab pa de rlabs chen gyi las shig yin par ma zad/ mi rigs 'di'i snying stobs shig kyang red/ bden don gyi ched du rang shi brgyab tshul ni khong gi kha chems las gsal ba ltar red/kha chems kyi nang don ni/ khos mi rigs 'di'i blun rmongs sel ba'i ched du/ rtsom mang po bris pa yin/ yin na'ang bris bris pa'i mtha' mar mi rigs 'di rmongs gnyid las sad du 'jug ma thub/ de'i rkyen gyis rang gi tshe srog gis dril zhig bsgrags pa yin/ nyen brda zhig brgyab pa yin zhes brjod 'dugamelce/ red/ kha chems yi ge cha tshang ni gsham gyi 'di 'dra red/‘‘sems pa 'di sdug bsngal gyis yongs su mnan te ljid tig tig gi ngang khyed dang gyes phyag phul ba yin/ kho bos lam 'di 'dra zhig bdams pa'i gtam ngan 'di go dus khyed nyid ha las shing hang sang bas mi tshad/bdag gi nor 'khrul zhig tu brtsi na'ang thang mod/ gal srid khyed kyis sems rnal la phab ste kho bo'i shi rkyen 'dir zhib 'dang re brgyab tshe/mtha' mjug gi gyes phyag phul don la'ang rgyu mtshan ye nas med pa ma yin pa'i nges shes 'drong 'ong gi red/ khyed dang gtan bral du 'gyur ba'i skabs 'dir/ nga ni khyed dang mjal 'dod ji 'dra che ang /— 235 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/yin na'ang de ni srid pa zhig ma yin te/ de ring ngas da dung khyed la glog 'phrin zhig btang don ni/ myur du las gnas spor ba'i brda yig cig 'byor bar re ba che bas yin/ 'on kyang / ngas bsam gzhig zhib mo zhig btang ba na/ rang rigs 'di sngar bzhin blun rmongs dang rjes lus kyi klong du 'khyams shing / de'i don du kho bos kyang rtsom yig kha grangs longs pa zhig bris te kho pa tsho'i go rtogs de sad na snyam yang /pham kha ni rang gis nyo dgos byung rkyen/ ngas rang nyid kyi nyam chung ba'i tshe srog blos btang ste dung brda gsal po zhig bsgrags pa yin/’’ kha chems yi ge 'di rgya yig gi lam nas khong gi grogs po zla ba blo gros la bzhag pa red/zhogs dung / red/ 'di'i ngos thad nas bsam blo re btang na/'di 'dra'i snying stobs ldan pa dang / 'di 'dra'i dpa' gdeng yod pa/'di 'dra'i spobs pa yod pa zhig go rtogs mtho ba'i mi rigs gzhan gyi khrod na'ang nyung nyung yin gyi red/ gnad 'gag gi skabs la 'di lta bu'i bgyi ba lhur len pa'i skyes bu de tag tag 'u tsho'i nang du 'khrungs myong ba red/ 'u tsho nyam chung ba ltar snang yang shes rig la dga' ba'i mi rigs shig yin pa'i rkyen gyis rig gnas kyi dpa' bo'i skyes bu de 'dra 'khrungs pa ni shin tu ngo mtshar ba red/ 'di 'dra byung na mi — 236 —

dpa' dar ring mo/rigs 'di la yang 'phel rgyas yod gyi red/ mi sger gyi ngos nas kyang 'phel rgyas yod gyi red/ bden don gyi ched du 'chi thub pa'i snying stobs 'di rlabs chen zhig yin pa'i rkyen gyis/ 'u tshos khong gi mi tshe hril po snying stobs shig tu brtsis nas rgyun 'dzin byed dgos pa red/byang skar/ lo ngo du ma zhig gi yar sngon la/ bkra rgyal dang nged gnyis bya ba zhig gi ched du lan gru la song dus/ kho'i grogs po zhig gi khyim du zhag 'dug byas pa yin/ dgong mo der na mnyam gyi gsar bu kha shas dang mnyam du kha brda byas/ mtshams shig la gleng bya de don grub rgyal gyi steng la babs thal/ skabs der ngas skad cha 'di 'dra zhig bshad myong / mi mang po zhig gis don grub rgyal shi ba de 'grig med/bod kha ba can la gyong reg song / gal te don grub rgyal da lta yod pa yin na khong gis byas rjes ji 'dra bzhag yod gyi red ang / zhes dang /yang don grub rgyal sku gshegs med/ sa cha ga ge mo na 'dug mi che ge mo dang phrad pa red sogs zer/ de'i phu ci red zer na/ bsam pa dkar po yin gyi red/ skyes bu chen po de da dung mu mthud du 'tsho bzhugs gnang yod na ci ma rung ang snyam pa'i sems khams de yin gyi red/ 'on kyang / ngas bltas na don grub rgyal sku gshegs song ba de 'grig song ni red/ don grub rgyal sku ma gshegs na khong gi kha chems — 237 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/las brjod pa ltar/ 'u tsho rmongs gnyid kyi gnas bab las mu mthud du sad gi yod gyi ma red ces bshad pa yin/'di nas 'chi ba'i lta stangs shig gleng dgos 'dug 'u tshor mtshon na sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi 'chi ba'i lta stangs de'i shan shugs ha cang che ba red/ btsan po'i rgyal rabs mjug gril ba'i rjes su/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lta bas dbang bsgyur pa red/ de dang mnyam du btsan po'i skabs kyi snying stobs de nyams song ba red/ don grub rgyal ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis bsdus pa'i rig gnas bcu bo la dga' zhen tshad med yod pa'i mi zhig yin pa khong gi〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉dang brtsams chos gzhan sogs las skabs dang skabs su gsal por mtshon gi 'dug mod/ 'on kyang khong gi bsam blo'i gting rim la shan chen po thebs pa gang red ce na/ bden pa'i ched du 'chi phod pa'i btsan po'i skabs kyi snying stobs de red/ yang na de'i bag chags sad pa 'dra/ bag chags de ni da lta'i 'u tsho yin na'ang 'dra/ ma 'ongs par skye 'gyur gyi mi rnams yin na'ang 'dra/ tshang ma'i rgyud na yod ni red/ yod pas mi chog sad kyang dgos ni red/bden don gyi ched du rang gi gces pa'i tshe srog blos gtong thub pa 'di 'dra ni 'dzam gling gi mi grangs kyi lnga cha'i gcig zin pa'i rgya mi — 238 —

dpa' dar ring mo/rigs la mtshon na'ang / kho tsho'i mi grangs dang bsdur na ha cang nyung nyung red/ de bas/ bden don gyi ched du rang srog blos gtong ba de ha cang gal chen zhig red/ dkon po zhig red/ mchog tu gyur pa zhig red/ 'u chos snying stobs de 'dra bskyed thub na ma 'ongs par re ba yod gyi red/ de'i rkyen gyis snying stobs kyi mi tshe de la rjes su yi rang byed dgos/ gna' snga mo nas yod pa'i bag chags de nges par du sad du 'jug dgos/ ma 'ongs pa'i ched du bsam na/ gzhan gyis bshad dka' ba'i snying stobs 'di btang snyoms su 'jog mi nyan pa zhig red/nyi gzhon/ don grub rgyal gyi rigs gzhung thad kyi mdzad rjes de 'u tsho tshang ma'i kha thog mig thog tu gyur yod pa de red/ nga tshos da lta don grub rgyal la rjes dran byed pa'i snying po ni/ deng sang gi dus 'dir rjes dran bya yul don grub rgyal lta bu mkho song ba'i rkyen gyis red/rang shi brgyab pa de khong gi snying stobs shig tu phyogs bsdoms byas yo/da/snying stobs ci zhig red ce na/ bden pa'i don du/ gnas lugs kyi don du rang shi brgyab pa de red/ 'jig rten 'di na tshe srog gi yan gyi rtsa chen zhig yod ni ma red/ khong la mtshon na tshe srog las kyang gal che ba ni gnas lugs yin song ni red/ khong gi bsam blo na ha cang rtsa che — 239 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ba'i tshe srog kyang gtong dgos pa'i gnas lugs kyi ma mtha'i tshad gzhi zhig yod song ni red/ de'i phan chad la brgal song tshe tshe srog yin kyang gtong dgos song ni red/ spyir rang shi rgyag pa'i ngos thad nas bshad na/ de nga tshos yin 'jog byed rgyu zhig ma red/ nga yin na dgag pa rgyag rgyu red/ 'on kyang / rang shi ci zhig la rgyag dgos song ni red/ rang shi rgyag pa'i rgyu dang rkyen btsal dgos/ don dam du don grub rgyal gyis rang shi brgyab pa de rang 'gul gyis srog btang ba zhig e red ce na/ rnam pa'i steng nas de 'dra zhig yin na'ang / snang tshul de brtol nas phar nang la bltas na/ de rang 'gul gyis rang shi brgyab pa'i don dag cig ma red/ de ni khor yug dang rig gnas sogs kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa zhig red/ 'on kyang 'di ru khor yug dang rig gnas zhes na spyi bam po zhig red/ bye brag tu bshad na nga rang nyid kyang the ba'i 'u tsho mi tshang mas khong 'chi lam du brdzangs pa red/khong nyid rang sems kyi ma mtha'i tshad gzhi las 'da' ma 'dod pas 'chi lam bdams pa red/ nga tshos da lta ma mtha'i tshad gzhi de khyer nas shes yon can gyi sde la bltas na/ 'u tsho su la'ang rgyu 'bras blo mig zer na 'dra/ gnas lugs zer na 'dra/ bden pa zer na 'dra/ gang dang gang gi thad du ma mtha'i tshad gzhi yod ni ma red/ nga rang nyid la — 240 —

dpa' dar ring mo/mtshon na/ gnas lugs shig gi ched du rang nyid kyi tshe srog rin po che yang gtong dgos rgyu red ces kha nas de ltar bshad thub na'ang / snying stobs de 'dra yod ni ma red/ de'i rkyen gyis bden pa dang gnas lugs sogs la ma mtha'i tshad gzhi med pa'i nga rang nyid kyang 'dus pa'i 'u tshos don grub rgyal 'chi lam du brdzangs pa red zer ba yin/spyir na nga tshos don grub rgyal la rjes dran byed na'ang 'dra/ khong gi snying stobs la gdeng 'jog byed na'ang 'dra/ khong rang nyid rang shi brgyab pa'i rgyu 'bras dang ngo bo la dpyad pa gtong ba gang yin kyang /phar ded de song na gzhan ci yang 'ded sa mi 'dug bye brag mi rang nyid kyi steng la babs 'dug deng sang tshang mas don grub rgyal la rjes dran byed dgos/ don grub rgyal mi bo che yin zhes don grub rgyal gyi dar cha de rgan gzhon tshang ma'i lag tu thogs nas 'gro gi 'dug mod/don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs de lta bu 'u tsho'i khor yug tu gnas mi chog pa'i bsam blo zhig yod pa de ci mi snyam par bzhag 'dug ngas bltas na de ring nga tshos don grub rgyal la rjes dran byed pa'i nyin mo 'dir/don grub rgyal gyi 'chi rkyen ded de‘‘'di 'dra zhig ci la byung song’’zhes rang gis rang la tsha 'dri zhig byed rgyu yang ha cang gal chen po red/ 'u tshor mi bo che byung ba'i cha nas bltas na/ gzhan da rung dge 'dun — 241 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/chos 'phel dang / lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal yang byung myong / dge chos dang lung shar gnyis ni gzhan dbang gis btson khang du bcug nas mnar gcod gang mang btang ste mtha' mar tshe rdzogs su bcug dge chos dang lung shar lta bur mtshon na/ phyi lus kyi cha nas dngos su btson khang du bsdad myong ba red/ 'on kyang / don grub rgyal la mtshon na phyi lus kyi cha nas btson khang du bsdad ma myong na'ang / khong gi kha chems dang lhag par du rang shi brgyab pa sogs la bltas na/don grub rgyal gyi nang sems tshe gang bor btson khang du tshud 'dug pa red/ de ni 'u tshos btsan gyis bcug pa red/me lce/ gong nas khyod tshos don grub rgyal rang shi brgyab par don snying che tshul bshad thal/ yin na'ang / don grub rgyal gyis rang srog bcad pa der nga rang mi 'thad gi mi mang po zhig gis don grub rgyal gyis rang srog bcad pa de 'u tshos shes dgos/ dang len byed dgos/dang len ma byas sa mi 'gro zhes zer gi yod pa red/ 'on kyang /ngas bltas na/ khong gis rang srog bcad pa de pham kha zhig red ces bshad na'ang mi chog rgyu med gi nga tshos khong gi gsung rtsom tshang ma bklags tshe/ myong tshor ci zhig ster gi zer na/ skyes bu de'i shes yon dang / rnam dpyod/ shes rab/ snying stobs/ spobs pa ni mi rang — 242 —

dpa' dar ring mo/ga ba su zhig gis kyang tshab byed mi thub pa zhig red/ de lta bu'i skyes bu chen po zhig gis skabs der rang shi brgyab pa ni gyong chen po red 'dod/pham kha yang red 'dod/ rgya nag gi mkhas pa chen po lu'u zhun lta bur mtshon na/ rtsom rig dang bsam blo/ sgyu rtsal sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas tshang mas yin 'jog byed bzhin pa'i skyes bu chen po zhig red/lu'u zhun khong la yang skabs der phyi'i gnod 'tshe dang nang sems kyi sdug bsngal gang mang byung myong ba red/ yin na'ang / khong gis pha rol dgra las rgyal dgos na/ yang na rig gnas dang khor yug dbang grags sogs kyi mdung rtse sna tshogs rang nyid la gtad pa las rgyal dgos na/ thog mar rang nyid rang las rgyal dgos/ rang nyid rang las rgyal dgos zhes pa'i snying stobs shig yid la brtan por bcangs pa dang /rang gis rang la snying phur de 'dra zhig brdabs pas rang shi ma brgyab pa red/ don grub rgyal la mtshon na/ khong ni de 'dra'i shes rab can dang / snying stobs can/ spobs pa can zhig red/ skabs der khong gis kyang rang nyid rang las rgyal ba'i snying stobs shig yid la bcangs pa dang / snying phur de 'dra zhig brdabs yod gyi na/ rang shi brgyab pa'i skyo gar 'byung rgyu ma red/ 'di ltar bshad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni deng sang gi shes yon can rnams kyis 'di'i phyogs la bsam — 243 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/gzhig gnad du things pa gtong ba'i dgos gal dang don snying che gi zer ba yin/ rang shi rgyag pa 'di la yang 'dang rgyag rgyu mang po 'dugagazhan gyis zhib 'jug byas pa ltar na/ sgyu rtsal pa'i gras na rang shi rgyag mkhan cung mang po yod pa red/ de ni kho tshor dungs zhen che ba dang / 'char yan dang tshor shes kyi shugs che ba'i rkyen gyis red zer/sgyu rtsal pa dang bsam blo pa gang yin yang bden pa dang rang dbang /khe dbang sogs kyi ched du sger gcod kyi dbang sgyur pa la ngo rgol dang 'thab rtsod byas te 'chi phod pa'i snying stobs de ni da gzod rlabs chen red 'dod/gong du phag mos don grub rgyal mi yul nas btsan gyis 'chi lam du brdzangs pa'i nyes dmigs de 'u tsho tshang ma la yod ces brjod pa de ha cang gal chen red/ rgya'i na gzhon rang dbang shes yon can yus ce yis‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen mo’’zhes skyi g.ya' ba'i god chag byung ba de mi che ge mo zhig la khag 'gel rgyu med par mi tshang mar de'i nyes dmigs dang 'gan khur yod pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis‘‘'u tsho la nag nyes yod/ 'u tshos 'gyod bshags byed’’ces yang yang brjod pa red/nyes dmigs de la mi bu re re'i ngos thad nas 'gyod bshags byed pa de yang snying stobs shig red/ snying stobs 'di 'dra 'u tsho la mtshon na'ang — 244 —

dpa' dar ring mo/shin tu gal chen red/ dge 'dun chos 'phel ni skabs de'i dbang 'dzin pas khri mun du bcug ste mnar gcod yang yang btang mthar mi yul nas bskrad pa red/ lung shar yang gsar brje par brtsis te btson du bcug rjes mig 'bras bton/ don grub rgyal ni mi rnams rmongs gnyid las sad du 'jug pa'i phyir du rang shi brgyab zin/ khong tsho 'jig rten mi yul nas bskrad pa'i rnam pa mi 'dra na'ang / nag nyes de 'u tsho tshang ma'i steng du yod ni red/ de nas nyes dmigs de ngos zin te 'gyod bshags byed dgos pa dang / rang sems la tsha 'dri yang yang gtong dgos pa red/ snying stobs de lta bu zhig yod tshe ma 'ongs par 'u tsho'i skar chen lta bu'i skyes chen dag gi steng la skyo gar 'di 'dra mi 'byung ba dang / mi rigs la chag 'jig de 'dra mi 'byung bar phan thogs chen po yod pa red/zhogs dung / gang ltar kyang / don grub rgyal rang shi rgyag tu 'jug mkhan su yin pa de ni gnad don gyi gtso bo red/ don grub rgyal ni slob grwa chen mo 'grim dus nas rtsom la 'jug 'go tshugs pa dang grub 'bras thon pa zhig red/ pe cin nas dge rgan gyi bya ba gnyer na'ang mtsho sngon ni 'u tsho'i rig gnas dar sa yin pa'i rkyen gyis/ phyir mtsho sngon du log ste rigs gzhung zhib 'jug dang / slob ma skyong ba'i — 245 —

cher ma'i lam rgya nga ro/'dun pa yod gyi red/ go thos su spyi lo1985lor khong gis zi ling nas snga phyir las khungs gang mang zhig la 'brel gtugs byas kyang blo ngor mi shong ba zhig ni/ las khungs gcig gis kyang dang len byas ma song zer/zi ling nas de ltar bya ba ma rag pas phyir chab cha la song nas cang ma 'gor bar rang srog bcad pa red/ ngan bshad dang than bshad/kha yan sna tshogs ga sar khyab pa'i spyi tshogs kyi khor yug de 'dra nas khong lta bu'i tshor shes rnon po'i skyes bu zhig 'tsho ba shin tu dka' ni red/'dir bshad 'dod pa ni 'u tsho'i gtso rgyugs rig gnas de 'grig med zer rgyu yin/ gtso rgyugs rig gnas de ma 'grig tshe mi rnams kyang 'grig yod pa ma red/ khong gi snyan ngag 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉 ru/‘‘rnying zhen dang bag 'khum/ rmongs dad/ le lo/ rjes lus sogs nga tsho'i mi rabs 'dir 'jug yul gtan nas med’’ces brjod 'dug kyang / de ni khong gi 'dun pa tsam red/ don gyis gsar gtod kyi snying stobs can dang / dbang grags ltar snang la brtsi 'khur mi byed pa/ngo log gam rgyab gtod kyi blo spobs yod mkhan ni dus rabs der gnas sa gtan nas med song ba red/ de ni zur za chen po zhig ma yin nam/'u tsho'i rig gnas/ bsam blo/ bsam gzhig gtong stangs/ khor yug sogs kyi nang du don grub rgyal sogs ni rigs gzhan zhig tu gyur — 246 —

dpa' dar ring mo/yod pa red/ de 'dra zhig tu gyur tshe 'bur 'joms gtong ba kho thag yin ni red/ kha dpe la/ chu thom gang nang du nya 'dom gang mi shong zer ba ltar red/ skabs thog de phar zhog da lta'i dus na yang rang dbang bshad/ mang gtso bshad/ bdag bshad na da dung rtogs gi med pa gang mang mang red/ de'i rkyen gyis/ ltos bcas kyis bshad na/ 'u tsho'i rig gnas 'di/ mi bu shes rab can dang / mi bu spobs pa can/ mi bu dpa' gdeng can/ mi bu snying stobs can/rlabs chen gyi mi bu de dag gsod spyad kyi rig gnas shig red/ 'u tsho'i srol rgyun rig gnas zer na'ang 'dra/ chos lugs rig gnas zer na'ang 'dra/ goms srol rig gnas zer na'ang 'dra/ de tshang ma rkya 'thab ste gsar pa zhig dang / mi mtshungs pa zhig gnas sa med par byas 'gro/ shes yon can zhig la mtshon na/ mi bu de 'dra gso skyong dang 'tshar longs 'byung du 'jug pa'i rig gnas gsar pa zhig 'byung phyir/ sngon gyi rig gnas rnying pa la phyir rtog byed mi dgos sam/nges par du phyir rtog byed dgos pa zhig red/ shes yon can zhig gleng ba'i skabs su/ de lo rgyus nges can zhig dang dus nges can zhigakhor yug nges can zhig gi khrod nas gleng dgos pa bden na'ang / de la lta byed ni rig gnas gang de la phyir rtog byed pa'i spyan mig dgos pa — 247 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ma yin nam/ dus mtshungs su rang sems la tsha 'dri gtong dgos pa'ang gzhir bzhag red/nyi gzhon/ 'o le/ de 'dra yin pa'i rkyen gyis 'u tsho'i rig gnas na khe dbang dang / 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes kyang yod ni ma red/ don grub rgyal la mtshon na khe dbang dang 'gan 'khri'i bag chags sad yod pa red/ de yang khong gi rang nyid nas 'go rtsom pa'i snying stobs las rig thub pa red/ kha chems yi ge ltar na/ mi rigs zer ba'i spyi bam po nas 'go brtsams 'dug mod/ 'u tshos shes dgos pa ni/ don grub rgyal gyi rang nyid nas 'go rtsom pa'i snying stobs de red/ rang nyid nas 'go rtsom pa ni khong la 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes yod pa'i rtags red/'gan 'khri dang 'grogs nas yod pa ni khe dbang gi 'du shes yin ni red/ dper na bya zhig la cha bzhag na/ khe dbang ni gshog pa ya gcig dang / 'gan 'khri ni gshog pa ya cig shos de yin pa lta bu red/der ma zad don grung/ rgyal gyis rang gi 'gan 'khri de shes yon can gyi 'gan 'khri zhig tu go ba blangs yod pa red/ 'gan 'khri de gang red zer na/ khong rang nyid dang bcas pa'i mi rigs 'di la blo 'byed byed rgyu de red/mi nyid kyi khe dbang dang mi nyid kyi 'gan 'khri zhes pa bye brag tu — 248 ge

dpa' dar ring mo/'bab dgos ni red/ mi bu rang nyid kyi steng du 'bab dgos ni red/yin na'ang / 'u tsho tshang ma'i bag chags kyi gting rim na don grub rgyal gyi khe dbang dang / don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs la yin 'khrog dang dang len byas med pa 'dra/ de yang gtso bo 'u tshos rang gi khe dbang dang rang gi 'gan 'khri la nges shes zab gsal cig rnyed med pas lan pa red/byang skar/ kho tshos yin 'jog byed pa ni/ don grub rgyal gyi gsung rtsom po ti drug po red/ de ma gtogs don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs la yin 'jog byed gi yod pa ma red/ gal te 'u tshos don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs ngos zin nas de la yin 'jog byed thub song na/ma 'ongs par 'u tsho la skyo gar de 'dra yang bskyar 'byung rgyu ma red/ de ha cang gal chen po red/ khong gi mdzad rjes la bltos pas don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs rtsa che don ni/ nam zhig 'u tsho la don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs/ de 'dra yod byung na/ don grub rgyal lta bu'am/ ya nga na don grub rgyal las lhag pa'i skyes bu chen po mang mang 'byung ni red/nyi gzhon/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ don grub rgyal 'chi lam du brdzangs pa la/ nga / khyod/ kho/ 'u tsho mi re res 'gan 'khur dgos ni red/ sus kyang g.yol sa 'gro ni ma red/ yin yang 'u tsho'i — 249 —

dpa' dar ring mo/bden pa'i ched du dbang grags gang la yang rung bstun byed gi ma red/gnas lugs mig 'bras bzhin du bsrungs te bden pa'i don du u tshugs mthar skyel byas na/ nam zhig rang gi gces srog yin yang 'dor dgos pa'i tshad la slebs rgyu red/ skabs der 'u tshos ci zer rgyu/'chi nyan gi ma red/ srog la babs na gnas lugs g.yu/gas zhog zer rgyu e yin/ bden pa'i u tshugs kyi snying stobs ni/ dka' ba lhur len gyi snying stobs red/ rang srog blos gtong gi snying stobs red/de gang gis shes zer na/ bden pa'i u tshugs skyong mkhan tsho'i kha g.yang zhig gis gsal po bstan yod pa red/ dper na/ khyod tsho'i btson khang gi sgo phyes dang / nga tshos khyod tsho'i blo kha rdzogs/ zer ba lta bu red/ 'o na bden pa'i u tshugs byed mkhan tshor snying stobs de 'dra zhig gang nas yong ba red zer na/ kho pa tsho'i snang ngor btson khang du sdod pa las kyang lhag pa dang / rang gi tshe srog las kyang gces pa'i rin thang zhig yod kho thag red/ rin thang de las snying stobs de 'dra byung ba red/ mi rigs ga'/na gyis bden pa'i u tshugs lag len du bstar nas 'bras bu'ang thob dang 'thob gi yod na'ang / 'u tshor snying stobs de dar thub gi yod pa ma red/ de 'u tshos nges par du shes dgos gi red/— 251 —

cher ma'i lam gyi ngaro/btsan po'i skabs su 'u tshor bshad tshul 'di 'dra zhig yod pa red/wa rnga ma shal ler gson pa las/ stag 'dzum drug nyil ler shi na dga' zer ba red/ de las ci ston gi yod pa red zer na/ sdar ma byed pa las srog 'dor ba dga' zer gi yod pa red/ de lta'i bden pa'i u tshugs byed mkhan tshos bden pa dang gnas lugs kyi ched du gces srog 'dor ba red/ yin yang 'u tsho'i thu bhod kyi skabs su bden pa dang gnas lugs kyi dod du mtshan lar(༅tshi)bzhag yod pa red/mtshan lar gyi don du gces srog yin kyang 'dor dgos zer ba red/de ni 'u tsho'i srol rgyun yag po zhig red/ don grub rgyal gyis rang nyid shes yon can zhig gi tshad nas srol rgyun de rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel btang yod pa red/me lce/ de red/ tun hong gi gna' yig〈phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo〉 zhes pa'i nang du/ ‘‘don yod de/srog ri ba tsham gyi tshod na/ gdod lus myi phangs sori’zhes 'khod 'dugade ni 'u tsho la'ang don chen po zhig gi ched du gces srog 'dor thub pa'i snying stobs yod pa'i rtags red/ thu bhod rgyal rabs sil bur thor rjes snying stobs de'ang rgyun chad pa red/ de rgyun chad pa'i rgyu mtshan phag mos bris pa'i〈thu bhod kyi rig sa/nas snying stobs〉zhes par gsal po — 252 bhe

dpa' dar ring mo/bshad yod pa de ltar red/ de min/ nga'o snyam pa de'ang don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs shig red/ mi zhig la mtshon na/ nga'o snyam pa'i blo de ha cang gal chen po red/ go thos su khong gis rgyun du nga rgyal yod dgos/ khengs dregs spang dgos zhes bshad pa dang / yang gzhan gyis khong nga rgyal che tshul lab par/ khong gis lan du/ mi la nga rgyal med na gzhan gyi mthong chung myong dgos/ mi re re'i nga rgyal bsogs na mi rigs kyi nga rgyal chags 'ong zhes bshad pa red zer/zhogs dung / red/ de ni nga rang nga rgyal mi che mod/ nga'o snyam pa nga la yo/da zer ba de red/ nga'o snyam pa 'di nga tshos bshad pa'i‘‘bdag’’dang rang nyid dang don gcig red/ nga'o snyam par‘‘nga’’gtso bo yin ni red/ ‘‘bdag’’gtso bo yin ni red/me lce/ don grub rgyal gyi nga'o snyam pa'i blo las nga tshos khong la bran gshis med pa de shes thub pa red/ khong bla ma dpon po mkhas pa su la thug na'ang / mgo sgur sgur dang nywa ltem lhom/ sgyid pa zhum zhum mi byed par/ thams cad 'dra mnyam du lta ba red zer/ khong lta bu'i bran gshis med pa'i shes yon can da lta'ang ha cang dkon pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal red/bzhi pa/ don grub rgyal dang 'brel nas blo 'byed — 253 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bsam blo bshad pa/byang skar/ gong du gcod pas don grub rgyal la bran gshis mi 'dug zer/ de la rgyu mtshan zhig yod gyi red/ rgyu mtshan de blo 'byed kyi thad nas bshad na ha cang gsal po red/ rang nyid le lo bag 'khums kyi dbang du song / tshad ma'i skyes bu'am tshad ma'i gsung(lung) gang rung zhig gi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i/ gzhan dbang shugs che ba'i blo de rang nyid kyis zlog par byed pa la blo 'byed zer/tshig gzhan zhig gis bshad na/ rang blo rang 'byed kyis rtogs pa nang nas sad de/ mang mang gis tshad mar 'dzin pa'i zer rjes mi 'brang bar rang gi rig stobs kyis chos kun la dpyad 'jog byed pa la blo 'byed zer/ mdor na/ rang gis rang nyid gzhan dbang las grol bar byas te rang dbang du gnas par byed pa la blo 'byed zer ba red/don grub rgyal la mtshon na/ rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas la sbyangs pa song ba gzhir byas/ mi chos rig gnas la'ang sbyangs pa song ba'i 'u tsho'i mkhas pa dang po red/ khong gis mi chos rig gnas la thos bsam rtsom gsum byas pa dang 'brel nas/ srol rgyun chos lugs rig gnas la phyir rtog byed thub song ba red/ de'i rkyen gyis khong ni ltos bcas kyis 'u tsho'i gtso rgyugs rig gnas kyi gzhan dbang las grol — 254 —

dpa' dar ring mo/song ni red/ de khong gi snyug ming la rang grol lam drag btsan rang grol zer ba las kyang rtogs thub pa red/ snyug ming de la bkrol klog byas na go rgyu gsum 'dugagacig khong gis gtso bo rang nyid la pho tshod med song bas gzhan dbang du tshud song ba rtogs 'dug pa red/ gnyis/ khong gis gzhan dbang gi bcings pa de las 'grol mkhan zhig gud du med par rang gis rang nyid 'grol dgos pa rtogs 'dug pa red/ gsum/khong gis gzhan dbang de dbang btsan pa rtogs nas skabs rer‘‘rang grol’’gyi gong du‘‘drag btsan’’zhes pa'i yig 'bru 'di gnyis bsnan yod pa red/ yang tshig gzhan gyis bshad na/ khong gis rigs shes la brten nas rang gi rtogs pa nang nas sad thub song ni red/ khong la bran gshis med pa'i rtsa ba'ang de la thug yod gyi red/ des mi tshad/khong gi bsam sbyor gyi dbang gis 'u tsho'i‘‘rigs kyi 'du shes’’sad 'go tshugs pa dang / khong gi dbang gis dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa de‘‘la rgya'i dus rabs’’su gyur pa red/me lce/ khong la blo 'byed kyi bsam blo ldan pa khong gi kha chems nang du'ang gsal po red/ kha chems nang‘‘rang rigs 'di sngar bzhin blun rmongs dang rjes lus kyi klong du 'khyams shing / der dmigs nas kho — 255 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bos rtsom yig kha grangs longs pa zhig bris te/ kho pa tsho'i go rtogs de sa da na snyam’’zhes bris 'dug 'di ni khong rtsom la 'jug pa'i dmigs yul mthar thug red/ rtsom yig gang la bltas kyang / rang rigs rmongs gnyid las dkrog pa dang / le lo bag 'khums kyi rmongs pa sel 'dod pa'i khong gi kun slong de sha thon rus thon du tshor yong ba red/byang skar/ don grub rgyal ni 'u tsho'i lo rgyus steng blo 'byed bsam blo pa dang po red snyam/ khong gis rang mi rigs kyi lo rgyus ngo ma'i khrag rgyun yang bskyar mthud pa red/ mtshams 'di nas 'u tsho'i bsam blo'i lo rgyus la dbye mtshams shig 'byed dgos tshod red/ btsan po'i rgyal rabs sil bur thor ba'i yar sngon ni ‘‘mi chos dus rabs’’ red/btsan po'i rgyal rabs sil bur thor ba nas don grub rgyal rtsom la zhugs pa'i bar ni‘‘lha chos dus rabs’’red/ don grub rgyal rtsom la zhugs pa nas yang bskyar‘‘mi chos dus rabs’’kyi rgyun mthud pa red/ 'o na/don grub rgyal gyis 'u tsho'i mi chos lo rgyus kyi rgyun mthud pa dang blo 'byed gnyis la 'brel ba yod dam zer na/ de los yod/ blo 'byed bsam blo'i rtsa don gcig ni/ mi bu yin 'jog byed pa dang mi bu dmigs yul mthar thug tu 'dzin pa de red/ don grub rgyal gyi brtsams chos mtha' dag gi brjod bya mi don dang brjod snying mi bu red/ des mi — 256 —
