dpa' dar ring mo/tshad/ rtsom tshang ma‘‘mi skad’’ (bkra rgyal gyi tshig) rkyang rkyang gi lam nas bris 'dug khong gis 'u tsho'i mi rigs rnyed pa red/ rnyed par ma zad thams cad rmongs gnyid du yur 'dug pa gzigs nas blo 'byed byas pa red/ khong dang 'u tsho'i mkhas pa gzhan dag bsdur na khyad chos de 'bur du thon yong ba red/ chos pa mkhas pa rnams phar zhogachos pa ma yin pa'i mkhas pa mdo mkhar pa tshe ring dbang rgyal dang dga' bzhi pa bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor lta bu yin na'ang / rin thang lta tshul thad nas chos pa kho thag red/ kho tsho dang kho tsho 'dra bas lha yin 'jog byed pa las mi yin 'jog byed ni ma red/ tshad 'di nas bltas na'ang don grub rgyal ni blo 'byed bsam blo pa yin pa bsnyon med red/zhogs dung / blo 'byed ces pa 'di nub gling nas dar yong ba'i tha snyad cig red/ kho tshor‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’byung nas kyang lo ngo bzhi brgya lnga brgya 'gor song ba red/ da lta nga tshos kyang blo 'byed 'di mang po bshad gi yod ni red/ tha snyad 'di don grub rgyal gyi rtsom yig tu tshig zin la ha lam thon med pa 'dra/ khong gi skad cha ltar na/ mi rnams‘‘rmongs gnyid las sad du 'jug pa’’zer ba red/ de dang blo 'byed gnyis go don phal cher gcig red/ de'i rkyen gyis blo 'byed bsam blo yo/da pa'ang nga tshos khong gi mdzad rjes su bgrangs ni yin/— 257 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dper na/ 〈〈rkang lam phra mo〉la mtshon na/ ‘‘rkang lam’’bskyur te mthar thug‘‘gzhung lam’’la zhugs pa bstan yod pa red/ de'i shugs nas mi rigs yin na 'dra/ yig rigs 'di shes mkhan thams cad po‘‘gzhung lam’’la 'jug dgos pa'i blo 'byed byas ni red/ de'i 'phror/khong gis〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉brtsams pa nas bzung / rang mos snyan ngag la 'jug mkhan je mang nas je mang red/ de yang khong gi snyan ngag thad kyi blo 'byed kyi 'bras rtags min zer sa 'gro ni ma red/nyi gzhon/ gong du don grub rgyal gyis mi la nga rgyal yod dgos/mi re re'i nga rgyal bsogs na mi rigs kyi nga rgyal chags yong zer/ de ni spyi bam po mi rigs nas bye brag gi mi nyid kyi steng la babs 'dug pa red/ blo 'byed kyi cha nas bltas na 'di ni zab sa nas bshad pa red/gting sa nas bshad pa red/ che sa nas bshad pa red/ de min/〈rkang lam phra mo'i〉nang du/ ‘‘nga’’yis‘‘rkang lam phra mo’’bskyur te‘‘gzhung lam’’du zhugs zhes bris 'dug de ni kho rang nyid kyi rtogs pa nang nas sad pa'i rtags mtshan red/blo 'byed bsam blo'i rtsa don ltar na/ gzhan la btsan tshugs kyis go bskon slob gso byed pa ma yin par/ thog mar rang gi blo sgo rang gis 'byed pa dang / de nas rang gi bsam gzhig gtong stangs — 258 —

dpa' dar ring mo/des gzhan la shan 'jug pa de red/ don grub rgyal gyis kyang tag tag bgyi ba de 'dra zhig lhur blangs yod pa red/ de yin kyang / ngas bltas na don grub rgyal gyi skabs su blo 'byed kyi las de 'go brtsams pa tsam red/ sa bon btab pa tsam red/ da lta nga tsho'i las 'gan ni khong gi blo 'byed bsam blo de rgyun 'dzin byas thog dar spel gtong rgyu de red/zhogs dung / spyir na de 'dra yin dgos rgyu red/ yin na yang /'u tsho'i shes yon can gyi sde na de las log pa'i lta tshul gzhan zhig yo/da pa red/ kho tshos yo rob kyi‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’ rgya nag gi‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’bcas 'u tshor mi 'tsham zer gi 'dug skad cha de 'dra bshad mkhan yang shes bya yon tan gyis phyug pa dang rtogs pa mthon po chags yod zer ba'i sgra yangs 'jug gi shes yon can skad grags che ba skor zhig red/ ngas bsams na kho tshos de mi 'tsham zer ba la rgyu mtshan yod gyi red/ de'i skor gyi rang lugs lta ba yig lam du gsal por bkod pa da snga ma mthong yang / ngas dbye zhib byas na/ phal cher yul dus gnas bab gsum gang rung gi ngos nas bshad pa yin gyi red/ yul gyi ngos nas/ bod 'di yul mtha' 'khob red/ yo rob dang yul gyis bskal ba'i rkyen gyis mi 'tsham zer — 259 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ba e yin nam/ ngas bltas na de yin gyi ma red/ de ltar bsam na de byis blo red/ dus kyi ngos nas/ ‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’sogs ni lo ngo bzhi brgya lnga brgya'i sngon du byung ba'i don dag red/ snga mo nas 'das tshar song / da lta dang dus kyis bskal ba'i rkyen gyis mi 'tsham zer ba e yin nam/ de yin gyi ma red/ yin na de'ang byis blo red/de gnyis ka min na/ phal cher gnas bab kyi ngos nas bshad ni yin gyi red/ gnas bab ltar na 'u tshor da rung blo 'byed kyi cha rkyen mi tshang zer ba yin gyi red/gang ltar kyang blo 'byed bsam blo'i thad la gsal kha zhig 'byed dgos pa kho thag red/ des na nga tshos 'di nas‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang / ‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’bcas kyi rgyu rkyen dang 'bras bu dang dgos pa dang don snying sogs cig bshad dgos rgyu red/byang skar/ ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’zhes pa'i nub gling skad kyi phyi mo'i go don ni‘‘bskyar gson’’red/ ke ri se dang ro ma'i gna' lugs rig gnas bskyar gson byung ba la zer ba red/ rig rtsal bskyar dar ni brgya lo14par dbyi tha li ru thog mar byung ba red/ snga phyir khyon bsdoms mi lo300tsam song / de'i nang don gtso bo la rtsom rig sgyu — 260 ge

dpa' dar ring mo/rtsal gsar rtsom dang / chos lugs bcos sgyur/ tshan rig brtag dpyad/ gling chen po gsar rnyed sogs 'dug pa red/‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’ma byung gong la dus rabs bar ma zer/mi lo1000la nye ba'i dus rabs bar mar‘‘mun nag gi dus rabs’’zer ba red/ de la‘‘mun nag gi dus rabs’’zer don ni/ mi la nyes bshags byed rgyu ma gtogs rang dbang gzhan gang yang med par/thams cad po chos srid gnyis ka'i gzhan dbang sger gcod kyi mun nag tu tshud 'dug pa bstan pa red/‘‘mi tshul ring lugs’’ni‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’gyi srog snying red/dus rabs bar ma'i skabs su dkon mchog(rngulko)lte bar 'jog pa dang /'jig rten yin dgag byed pa/ 〈dam pa'i gsung rab〉tshad mar 'dzin pa red/ mi tshul ring lugs pas mi lte bar 'jog pa dang /'jig rten yin 'jog byed pa/ mi'i rigs shes tshad gzhir 'dzin pa red/ de'i dgongs pa mi tshul ring lugs pa tsho'i gsung tshig re gnyis kyis kyang ha go yong / phe thi ra khi④na re/ ‘‘nga ni so so skye bo yin/ngag tshini rkabye s+t+ricarā trī/ klo〉pri:sgoshā kroshāprusnyo༈sh+tsa1 rwam 1304—1374)dbyi tha li'i snyan ngag mkhan/ brtsam sa chos〈〈snyan ༄ da 261 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ngas 'dod pa yang so skye'i bde skyid rkyang yin’’zer/ ta h+phen chidun re/‘su zhig tshad ma'i lung gis brgal brtag byed tshe/ gang des rang gi rigs shes bed chod med do’’zer/ shig se pheradun re/ ‘‘mi ni phyi 'jig rten gyi thig le dang nang sems can gyi prog zhu red’’zer/ ra pe la'edun re/ ‘‘kye/ khyed ca ga shes bya yon tan la ci dgar spyod cig(dad pa dag snang sbyong ba kho na ma yin pad bshadapapo'i mchan)bdenapa bden don la ci dgar spyod cig(bka' lung tshad mar 'dzin pa kho na ma yin pa—bshadapapo'i mchan) 'jig rten brtse dga' la ci dgar spyod cig(lhan skyes 'dod pa gnon sdom byed pa ma yin pad bshad pa po'i mchan) zer ba red/ mi tshul ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i shan stobs la brten nas/nub gling pas chos lugs bcos sgyur byas pa dang / tshan rig gis brtag dpyad byas pa/ gling chen po gsar du rnyed pa red/1517lor mar thin lu siradu gyis〈gleng bya'i rtsa 'dzin don tshan95〉zhes pa spel/ de ru zerdo ma byebyes gzhung gi gong sa chen cesas byebyes la mkhan spring /spratī rnyi/nga rme ram̐r+sha rmikhrikhun/cabarmā ṭ+wāṃ gyi~X/ 1n+dha/pritrī stu hūṃñtsā 3 /kāṭ+wāṃzlo k+ṣiṃzlo')r+shaskabs kyi ri mo kyi zlosalha ra skyuṭ+wāṃ rnoṅge zlokha/na sdoskru rno ṣ+ṭalha trikhaṃt+natha/dz+rakhurkyurtes rtekā〈 〈kautsho slo ṅgā//byepredāwar+sha 'a —ga rtsalabaskyaṭ+wāṃ pyir skabs brtsamaṭā chosarāmi lha spya/'i( /ma tāsngutrītāk+ka sa snro/nitsho 1494—1553)h+pha ran — rig rtsal bskyar dar skabs — —ma mkhan/sgyur lahā 'a/zlo ṭ+wāṃtra sdu/sdir// (lo'i‘bakhyi5 khyidzirnga h+phuko lko.oṃ1483—1546)'jar man gyi chos lugs bcos — 262—

dpa' dar ring mo/ming btags nas log par 'tsho ba'i bsam sbyor dang btsan shed gcig gcod kyi lta spyod la sun 'byin byas 'dug de dang 'brel nas mi re rer dad mos kyi rang dbang thob ste chos pa'i gzhan dbang las thar ba dang / chos dad kyis tshan rtsal brtag dpyad la gegs byed pa'ang yu/na gyis sel ba red/1530lor kho pher ni khi sidhiyis〈〈skar ma'i go la 'khor skyod rnam bshad〉brtsams te grub/ nyi ma lte bar 'dod pa'i lta ba bton nas sa sgang lte bar 'dod pa'i‘‘tshad ma'i gsung’’der dag ther mdzad/ sir we thu'u si⑫yis‘‘zungs khrag 'khor rgyu'i’’gnas tshul gsar du rtogs/we sa li'u siduyis〈mi lus chags gzhi'i rnam bshad〉kyi deb bkram ste gshags 'byed rig pa dang skye lugs rig pa'i srol phyes pa red/ phyi rol yul la dpyod pa yin na 'dra/ yul can rang la dpyod pa yin na 'dra/ thams cad po mi kho na nyid tshad gzhir 'dzin pa/'am/ yang na rang gi rigs shes la brten nas brtag dpyad mdzad pa'i grub 'bras red/ de yis mi'i srol rgyun gyi bsam gzhig gtong stangs rtsa ba nas nyim8raṭ+wās+hon+dhazlosh+lau /bye/da4khosgod+dhimishāchiyāhūṃskasdi~Xkhu~Xshāk+ṣiṃr+shaskyo1rdosnosmi/sha ldaswā 〉sdi snar+shaṭā 3k+ta rig nga mkhan dang cho ② ste rawe’'ugyi/ (/lobya2lhu0 5richiṇ+ḍaṃkhri a 6 1511— 1 553 )si phen rigyi gso greg mkhan/ brtsams ṭ+wāṃ〈〈zungs k+tashā snri'irā skya/tā nām shāṭ+wāṃspya/〉/〉 rigasmu 〉dru spyulo1514—1564)dbyi tha li'i gso rig mkhan/ brtsam sa chos〈〈 lus chags ga 'a rnam bshad〉〉 gas 'dug da 263 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/'gyur 'go tshugs pa red/gzhan da rung / gru gzings bzo ba'i shes bya dang sa rgyus kyi shes bya mang du song ba dang / sa sgang zlum ril yin pa'i lta ba chags pa/chu tshod 'khor lo gsar du btod pa/ phyogs ston 'khor lo legs bcos byas par brten nas/ 1498lor ta' ka ma'adu a h+phe ri kha lho'i glang sne bskor te rgya gar du 'byor/ 1492lor kho lom po① a me ri kha gling du 'byor/ 1519lo nas1522lor ma rja lidu yis mtsho thog nas sa'i go lar dkris skor brgyab ste go la zlum ril yin pa mngon sum du ra sprod byas/ 1642lo nas1643lor tha si mnadu o si khru li ya dang ne'u tsi lan du 'byor ba red/ gling chen po gsar du rnyed pas mi'i sngon goms kyi bskal pa'i lta ba rbad de 'gyur ba red/ ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’gyi gnas tshul rob tsam bshad na de 'dra red/gsham nas‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’gyi skor rags rim zhig bshad/blo 'byed ces pa'i nub gling skad kyi phyi mo'i don ni‘‘gsal bar byed pa'am snang bar byed pa’’zhes pa red/ de bzhin du‘‘blo 'byed dus 8 ṇ+ḍaṃṭ+wāshā sna'/sdoskrukhuspyaskya/0hātsho3lha tsho0stu5/46pyiche/t+tadziphehārāsdisbri kyākā sdi shāsdu shāṇ+ḍaṃl mkhan/skye ma dzñā li/(stuphoskutha'i/trelngakhuri cho31྅1480—1521)phok+ta spre'u k+tal snro mtsho glesmil ma /na/da 2༵4man /(sa)1skurih+phu3ba ’ṣ+ṭha4632 1603—1659) lan ma 'grul khan/

dpa' dar ring mo/rabs’’zer ba'ang‘‘'od snang gi dus rabs’’zhes pa'i don red/ dus kyi cha nas bshad na brgya lo17pa dang18pa'i skabs red/ blo 'byed la mtshan nyid bzhag pa kha shas 'dug kyang kun gyis khas len pa ni khan thiduyis bzhag pa'i mtshan nyid red/ khong na re/ ‘‘blo 'byed ces pa ni 'gro ba mi rang gis rang la bzos pa'i byis pa'i tshul bab las thar ba la go byis pa'i tshul bab ni gzhan gyi mdzub khrid la ma bltos par rang gi rigs shes kyis dpyad 'jog mi btub pa'o/ /de yang skye bo rnams rigs shes kyi blo rig gis dbul song bas ma red/ gzhan gyi mdzub khrid med tshe rang blos dpyad 'jog gi pho tshod dang chod sems kyis phongs song bas red/ des na byis pa'i tshul bab de ni rang gis rang la bzos pa sha stag red’’zer/(zhib tu shes 'dod na/ kho bos bsgyur pa'i〈khan this sbar ba'i blo 'byed kyi me phung〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig la gzigs chog rnga ba nas slar 'don byas pa'i dus deb2005lo'i〈〈spang ljongs〉su gsal)'gro ba mi'i gnas tshul ltar na/ mi bu re re'i blo ni ma rig pa'am gti mug gam ma sangs par gnas 'dug pa red/ de gang gis byas pa red zer na/ mthar gtugs tshe sger gcod kyis byas pa red/brtsamahrichosajishātsā/ngarlosgozlor+ghaṃsngurdu'ak+tosa.ā+oṃg1shāṭ+wāṃ4hesdo8snraram̐)྅r+shar+sha zlon+d+ra rno bsam blo mkhan dang mtshan nyid rig pa mkhan/ 〉〉 da 265 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/sger gcod la dbye na gnyis yod pa red/ chos kyi sger gcod dang srid kyi sger gcod red/ rang nyid kyi blo rmongs pa'i dbang gis/ spang blang go 'dzol nas dbang grags de dag gi gzhan dbang du tshud pa red/'o na rang nyid gzhan dbang de las 'grol mkhan zhig logs su yod dam zer na/ yod pa ma red/ thabs lam nyag gcig ni/ so so thos pa la gzhol te‘‘rang tshad ma gzhan log rtog’’gam yang na‘‘rang yang dag gzhan gti mug’’tu 'dod pa'i 'khrul shes las rang nyid rang gis thar bar byed dgos pa red/ de'i phyir na/ deng rabs bsam blo mkhan khal pho phuradugyis kyang / thos pa'i yon tan gyis rang nyid 'grol bar byed pa ni blo 'byed bsam blo'i srog snying du bzhed pa red/ de yang blo 'byed kyi go rim 'di ltar red/ dang po thos pa la brten nas rmongs pa sel te rang blo'i bag 'khums zlog pa/ bar du rang nyid kyi rtogs pa nang nas sad de dpyod shes kyi blo rig skye ba/ tha mar mtha' dpyod dang bcas rang lugs bzhag ste tshad ma ltar snang la dgag sgrub byed pa red/gong du ngas sger gcod gleng tsam byas yod/ sger gcod la tha nyidarinipayik+ṣiṃrnophurā/rtsamasgospyashānyush+laulda0rmilakhā+elcogasaldakyaisnyosdolhalbi2snelhakauram̐ngh+rut+nabyin ji'i bsam blo mkhan dang mtshan ———— tswa/rdo /༷///// /la byung )mi)mi

dpa' dar ring mo/snyad kyi khyad par phye na gnyis 'byung / gcig ni‘‘sger gcod bsam blo’’dang cig shos ni‘‘bsam blo sger gcod’’red/ blo 'byed bsam blo pa rnams kyis‘‘bsam blo sger gcod’’la dgag pa rkyen byas te/ mthar thug ‘‘sger gcod bsam blo’’tshar gcod rtsom pa red/ sger gcod bsam blo zer ba ni/ sger gcod yod tshad kyi 'byung gzhir gyur pa'i bsam blo de la zer ba red/ bsam blo de 'dra sger gcod byed mkhan gyi rgyud la yod pas mi tshad/ sger gcod myong mkhan gyi rgyud la'ang yo/da pa red/ sger gcod kyi bag chags sa bon dang bcas pa tshar gcod rtsom pa ni blo 'byed las 'gul gyi dmigs yul mthar thug red/ des na/ mi re re'i rgyud kyi bag chags ngan pa de tshar ma chod bar du blo 'byed las 'gul la'ang rdzogs mtha' med zer ni red/zhogs dung / 'gro ba mi'i shes rig lo rgyus kyi ngos nas bshad na/blo 'byed la dus rim gsum byung myong zer ba red/ spyi lo sngon gyi brgya lo5par ke ri se'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mi'i blo sgo phye ba ni dus rim dang por 'jog pa red/ ‘‘mun nag gi dus rabs bar ma’’yi skabs su blo 'byed de'i mtshams chad pa red/ skabs der mi rnams chos lugs kyi dbang du song nas mi ni mi ma yin du gyur song zer ni red/ blo 'byed kyi dus rim gnyis pa‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’skabs la ngos 'dzin pa red/— 267 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/de yang thog mar gna' rabs ke ri se'i rig gnas bskyar gso byas pa la brten nas/ mi bus rang nyid mi ru ngos zin song zer ni red/dus rim gsum par yo rob nas dar ba'i‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’'jog pa red/dus rabs bar ma'i mi lo chig stong ring la/ mi tshang mas lha'i rig gnas bsgrubs pa red/ ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’skabs nas bzung / lha chos rig gnas la dgag ste lo rgyus kyi gar stegs steng 'jig rten mi bu yar bslangs pa red/ pir khi har tadadhikyis skad cha 'di 'dra zhig bshad 'dug khong na re/ ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar skabs su 'dzam gling rnyed byung / mi bu rnyed byung’’gsungs/ dus de nas bzung / 'gro ba mis 'dzam gling ji lta bu yin pa ngos zin pa red/mi rang nyid ji lta bu yin pa ngos zin pa red/‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’gyi don snying ni/ gtso bo blun rmongs dang kla klo/ blo ma rgyas pa sogs 'joms pa la zer ba red/ der phyogs bsdoms shig byas na/ gcig 'dra mnyam dang rang dbang / mang gtso sogs kyi cha nas mi la go thang med pa de yod par byas pa/ de labartsamahrichosasgri〈r+shañdzusnaṭ+wāṃ 'itasdog/rāshābarnyiram̐khurdosdoskuprushārdutram̐ldor+sha༈sa〉ོsonisprushābyeg1897)su'e tser gyi lo rgyus rig pa mkhan/la —— /skyi)/rdo)/ji) —— —— )mi

dpa' dar ring mo/‘‘mi'i dpal yo/na’’zer ba red/ gnyis/ tshad ma dang ltos med kyi bden pa'am/ yang na mi rnams sger gcod bsam blo las grol bar byas pa/ de la ‘‘bsam blo'i dpal yon’’ zer ba red/ gsum/rgyal po tshos rang nyid khrims yin zer ba la rgol ba dang / gzhan dag la'ang khrims kyi 'du shes yang dag cig bskyed thog srid dbang gi sger gcod gtor ba/ de la‘‘lam lugs bcos sgyur gyi dpal yon’’zer ba red/ bzhi/ rgyu nor dang / rgyu nor skrun mkhan/ rgyu nor gsog mkhan tha shal du lta ba'i blo bsgyur pa dang / rje bo dang chos pa kho nas rgyu nor bdag tu 'dzin pa'i‘‘rgyu nor sger gcod’’las thar bar byas pa/ de la‘‘dngos po'i dpal yon’’zer ba bcas red/‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’gyi don snying ni tshig gcig gis bshad na mi tshul ring lugs red/ de yang rgya yig larkisprachakro(mi tshularing lugs)dngarki.oṃrtsakro(mi rkang ring lugs)rki)ṣ+ṭharwaspra(mi lugs ring lugs)sogs tha snyad gcig la 'gyur mi 'dra ba mang rabs yod pa de red/ de dag gang yin yang mdor ded na‘‘mi'i rig pa’’yin zer ba red/ mi'i rig pa de ru rtsom rig yin na 'dra/ sgyu rtsal yin na 'dra/ mtshan nyid rig pa yin na 'dra/ thams cad kyi brjod gzhi mi bu rang yin pa red/ de 'dra yin phyin/ ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar da 269 da

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’'u tsho la mi 'tsham zer na/ skad cha de'i rgyu 'bras rkyen gsum la tshang mas bsam blo zhib tu gtong dgos rgyu red/nyi gzhon/ brgya lo17pa'i dus mjug tu tshan rig gsar brje'i rlabs rgyun gsar pa zhig 'phyur pa des/ de'i gzhug gi brgya lo18pa'i‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’la sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen bskrun yod pa red/ lhag par du lo mang po'i sngon gyi kho pher ni khi si nas bzung ste ni'u thinadudang pa khonarjote khararjosogs kyi tshan rig snying stobs kyi bsam blos thad kar du‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’bslangs pa red/ ‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’de las 'gul zhig gi cha nas bshad na phal cher dus rabs phyed ka tsam la rgyun bskyangs mthar/ 1790lo'i yas mas su h+pha ran si'i gsar brje chen mo'i drag rlabs dgung du 'phyur pa dang tshor shes 'char yan sgyu rtsal bsam blo ches cher dar bas/ ‘blo 'byed las 'gul’gyi tshan rig dpyod shes kyi snying stobs de'i mgo phal cher mnan song ba 'dra/ yin na'ang gong nas bshad pa ltar blo 'byed bsam blo'i rgyun chad yod pa ma 'dren sbyigasasnyi nāl+lī/ rnyedzo mkhasna/khute/tram̐maṭ+wāṃ ñtsha〈/slosdo 2be pyopy-ithejinā glisnyu lha'i dngos lugs rig pa mkhan/ kun ldan ri girta blosh+laun/(stusnyi3khu0basbyichots+tsha56hūṃḍā༈2dzit+yābyitā jisdomashān+t+ra hād+ngha rishā pya rtsan+t+rashā/sosnas snasdug tshod lta tshan ga sa te khanā pa/྅ zloshashā/rikhu3༵0snarnyi snyarnyi/ smru~X — 1tā 50t+ta h+pha dā na si'icho ma~Xn ñtsād tre+eg 〉r+sha sprakhan dat+ta / dngos lugs rag2 kā ༵khan / rtsis rig mkhan/ skya khams rag pa mkhan/ brtsams sa〈〈'ag rtan dpyad pa〉〉gas 'dug

dpa' dar ring mo/red/ ngas bshad 'dod pa ni‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’skabs kyi bsam blo mkhan mang che ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba 'grub byed kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo gcig ni tshan rig snying stobs red/yang na blo 'byed bsam blo'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni tshan rig red zer ba yin/ 〈'dzam gling shes rig 'phel ba'i lo rgyus〉na'ang kho tsho'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba'i sngon 'gro bshad skabs/ ‘‘'jig rten snod bcud thams cad so skye'i blo yis 'jal thub pa yin te/ de ni rang byung chos nyid kyis grub pa zhig yin pa ma gtogs rang byung chos nyid las 'gongs pa'i stobs khyad par can gyis bskyed pa ni ma yin pas’’zhes dang / yang‘‘tshan rig gi thabs shes legs par spyad pa dang ji bzhin du spyad pa yin na zhib 'jug bya yul gyi gnad don phal che ba thag chod pa yin’’zhes bshad 'dug de bas‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’skabs kyi bsam blo mkhan dag gi rig gnas snying stobs ni gtso cher tshan rig dpyod shes red ces bshad chog gi rjes su khan thi'i gzhung lugs ni zab rgya dang khyab rgya gang thad nas tshan rig dpyod shes kyi snying stobs tsam las ring du 'phags yod na'ang / khong gi bsam blo'i gzhung rkang ni sngar bzhin blo 'byed red/ 'o na nyi zla lta bu'i rig pa mkhan de dag gi bsam blo'i gzhung shing blo 'byed kyi steng du 'jog don — 271 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/ci red zer na/ gcig nas khan this gsung ba ji bzhin‘‘yod tshad kyi dmigs yul mi nyid’’yin pa dang mis rang ngo zin pa las 'phros te rang byung dang rang byung las 'gongs pa'i gzhal bya dag la rtog 'jug byed pa/gnyis nas 'gro ba mi 'di bsam blo sger gcod dang chab srid sger gcod las thar bar byed rgyu de red/ de 'dra yong dgos na li hren kri yis bshad pa ltar/ ‘‘blo 'byed ni sger gcod las thar ba'i thabs lam nyag gcig red’’zer ba lta bu red/‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’gyi bsam blo'i gzhi 'dzin sa‘‘mi nyid’’red/ mi nyid gzhir bzhag dang mi nyid dmigs yul du bzung ste mi don bshad pa red/ mi don de yang 'jig rten khams kyi mi spyi la khyab pa'i cha nas bshad yod ni red/ deng sang nga tshos kyang mi'i khe dbang dang mi'i 'dra mnyam/ mi'i rtsis thang sogs bshad gi yod pa red/ de tshang ma'i 'byung khungs‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’red/ gal te 'u tshos rang nyid mi rigs gzhan dag las yan gar ba zhig tu 'dod na ma gtogs/‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’dag gi bsam blo mi 'tsham zer sa 'gro rgyu ma red snyam/zhogs dung / rang dbang / 'dra mnyam/ khe dbang / mang — 272 —

dpa' dar ring mo/gtso/ khrims lugs/ dbang cha sum bgos sogs kyi bsam blo phal cher‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’skabs su thog mar byung ba red/ byung ba tsam gyis tshad ni ma red/ de dag h+pha ran sir〈'gro ba mi'i khe dbang gi bsgrags gtam〉du 'khod 'dug a rir〈〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam〉du 'khod 'dug de ltar de tshang ma khrims su bcas yod ni red/ da lta bltas na/ yo rob dang a ri'i dpal yon ni ltos bcas kyis sngon thon yin pa red/ de kun gyis khas len ni red/ sngon thon de ni glo bur du byung ba zhig ma red/ rgyu med rkyen med du byung ba zhig kyang ma red/ de ni lo ngo bzhi brgya lnga brgya'i yar sngon nas mkhas pa rnams kyis rang dbang sogs kha nas bshad/ yi ger bris/ khrims su bcas/ mthar thug dmangs byings kyi goms srol du chags pa la brten nas rim gyis byung ba zhig red/ de bas yo rob dang a ri ni gzhan dag las gong du 'phags pa red/ tshad de nas bltas na/ 'u tsho la'ang bsam blo de 'dra 'byung dgos pa kho thag red/ de la 'tsham dang mi 'tsham gyi rtsod pa yod pa ma red/ yod na 'grig pa'ang ma red stumimyo//byang skar/ de red/ ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’'u tshor mi 'tsham zer ba la gnas lugs yod med de‘‘rig rtsal — 273 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’skabs kyi kha g.yang gnyis tshad gzhir bzung ste bltas na'ang shes thub gi red/ ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’skabs su/ ‘‘nga ni mi yin/ mi'i 'byung gshis bzang ngan gang yang nga la rang chas su grub yod’’zer ba red/ tshang mas bsam blo zhig thongs dang / 'u tsho'ang gzhan zhig ma red mi rang red/ 'u tshos khong tsho ltar mi bu yin 'jog byas e yod/ 'u tshor mi'i rtsis thang e dgos/'u tsho mi bzhin du 'tsho na e 'dod/ gal te 'dod na/ ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’gyi bsam blo 'u tshor mi 'tsham zer sa mi 'gro ba ma yin nam/‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’gyi kha g.yang ni/ ‘‘rang dbang / 'dra mnyam/mdza' brtse’’red/ rang dbang gi khongs su khe dbang yod pa red/'dra mnyam gyi khongs su drang gzhag yod pa red/ mdza' brtse'i khongs su zhi bde yod pa red/ yang tshang mas bsam blo zhig thongs dang / 'u tshor rang dbang dang khe dbang e dgos/ 'dra mnyam dang drang gzhag e dgos/ mdza' brtse dang zhi bde e dgos/ gal te dgos na/‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’gyi bsam blo 'u tshor mi 'tsham zer sa mi 'gro ba ma 6pen nam/nyi gzhon/ gong du nga tshos‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’skor bshad ni red/ gsham nas rgya nag gi‘‘lnga bzhi las da 274 da

dpa' dar ring mo/'gul’’cig bshad/ rgya nag tu‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’byung nas ha lam lo ngo brgya tsam 'gor gi yod pa red/ ‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’la go ba len stangs mi 'dra ba gnyis 'dug gcig ni1919lo'i‘‘lnga bzhi don rkyen’’red/ cig shos ni1915lor khren tu'u zhi'u yis〈na gzhon gsar pa〉spel pa nas brtsams te mang gtso srog tu byas pa'i‘‘lnga bzhi rig gnas gsar pa'i las 'gul’’red/ nga tshos yin 'jog dang rtsis chen byed pa ni phyi ma de yin/ ‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’gyi snying stobs kyang blo 'byed yin zer ni red/ ‘‘blo 'byed de ni/ mi lo stong phrag du mar krung go pa'i bsam blo 'ching bar byed pa'i sger gcod ring lugs dang blun rmongs ring lugs gnyis dpyod shes snying stobs kyis tshar gcod pa la go’’gi yod pa red/ yang na deng sang gi skad cha ltar bshad na/‘‘deng rabs shes yon tshad gzhir bzung ste/ srol rgyun gyi rin thang yod tshad la slar yang tshad 'jal byed pa'i lta stangs gsar pa zhig la go’’zer ba red/ des na‘‘lnga bzhi'i’’bsam blo pa dag gis tshar gcad yul ni sger gcod ring lugs dang blun rmongs ring lugs gnyis red/ de dag gi gnyen por kho tshos so sor mang gtso dang tshan rig gnyis tshur len byas 'dug pa red/ ‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’ni rgya nag pa tshos rang dbang dang / rang tshugs dang / 'dra mnyam dang / dkyel yangs — 275 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/sogs yongs khyab rin thang la go ba len pa'i gom pa dang po spos pa'i mtshon rtags red/ spyir rgya nag rig gnas la mtshon na skabs der kho tshos/ ‘‘dus kyi cha nas lo ngo stong phrag lnga'i lo rgyus yod pa/ yul gyi cha nas 'phred gzhung le dbar dgu khrir khyab pa/ de 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mkhan mi grangs khri tsho bzhi khri zin pa’’zhes bshad ni red/der ma zad kho tsho'i rig gnas de la mi gtogs pa'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dag na gnas pa mtha' dag kla klo rmongs 'thoms kyi rig gnas kho nar brtsis ni red/ chan na'ang yan h+phudhinas bzung ste gzhug gi blo 'byed bsam blo mkhan tshos bltas na kho tsho'i lo ngo stong phrag lnga'i lo rgyus yod pa'i rig gnas de'i nang snying ni phar ded na‘‘sger gcod ring lugs srog shing du byas pa'i rmongs mun ring lugs red/’’ de bas‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’gyi bsam blo'i rkang 'dzin mkhan hu'u hri dang / khren tu'u zhi'u/ tsha'e yon phedulu'u zhun sogs kyis rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas la dgag gzhag tsha nan byas ni red/ 'o na de dag gis rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas yongs khyab tu dgag ste ci zhig bzhag pa red zer mkhanadhi/ bapakyāglu /chosbrihūṃkauḍā rno shākaur+ṣa kauṭ+wāṃsdijirmikhri hāṭā spyit+na sgosprasnra : 〉smri 'añtsāspyar bsnasnas snyi rdzulhan dang mat+t+waṃs pa/so lotsā brtsamahri chosadzāṅgetram̐ t+nazlo t+ma cho8 rna kleṇ+ḍaṃ spya /nātrīṭ+wāṃbeshā sprushulhakrung go' mang gardza gsar ba— pa dang / —ba ga mkhan/— 276 —

dpa' dar ring mo/na/ da gong nas bshad pa'i rang dbang dang mang gtso dang / tshan rig la sogs bzhag pa red/ kho tshos bltas na rang dbang gi de'i rtsa ba'i 'bab sa mi nyid kyi bsam blo'i sger tshugs su 'dod pa red/ deng sang gi skad chas bshad na mi nyid kyi rin thang dang rtsis thang yin 'jog dang / mi nyid kyi khe dbang dang khe phan brtsi 'jog dang srung skyob byed pa'i 'du shes de la zer ba red/ des na mi nyid kyi khe dbang dang rtsis thang sogs yongs khyab rin thang gi lta ba nang 'dren byed pa la bkag 'gog dang / yang na de dag khas mi len pa'i spyi tshogs dang rig gnas lta ba gang zhig yin yang de la kho tshos mtha' gcig tu dgag pa gnad smin brgyab 'dug dper na hu'u hris‘‘spyi tshogs shig la mtshon na mi nyid kyi rang gshis med par byed pa dang / de rang dbang gis 'phel rgyas 'byung bar bkag 'gog byed pa de las lci ba'i nag nyes shig yod pa ma yin no’’zhes dang / yang‘‘mi nyid kyi rang gshis de rang dbang gis 'phel rgyas 'byung ba la sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gnyis yod de/gcig ni mi rang nyid la rang dbang gi blo mos yod pa/ gnyis ni rang nyid la 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes yod pa’’zhes mi nyid ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i go don de ltar gsed 'grol byas/ lhag par du hu'u hris 'di 'dra'i skad grags che ba'i skad cha zhig bshad myong ste/ ‘‘da lta mi la las rgyal — 277 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/khab kyi rang dbang gi ched du nga tsho rang nyid kyi rang dbang thed la 'dor dgos zhes bshad kyin 'dug de las ldog ste ngas khyod tshor 'di ltar bshad gi yin/ khyod rang nyid kyi rang dbang brtson len byed pa ni don la rgyal khab kyi rang dbang brtson len byed pa yin/ khyod rang nyid kyi mi gzhi srung 'dzin byed pa ni don la rgyal khab kyi ched du mi gzhi srung 'dzin byed pa yin/ ci'i phyir zer na/ rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam gyi rgyal khab cig ni rkub g.yog(smo.oṃ)skor zhig gis 'dzugs thub pa zhig gtan nas ma yin no’’zhes bshad/ deng sang rgya nag gi mkhas pa tshos skad cha 'di ni hu'u hri'i dgongs pa'i nying bcud red zer/1998lor a ri'i srid 'dzin khi lin thinadugyis pe cing slob chen nas gtam bshad spel skabs kyang skad cha 'di ched du drangs 'dugagazhan yang khren tu'u zhi'u yis‘‘kun spyod dang / mi chos bsam blo dang /chab srid dang / khrims lugs dang / spyi tshogs dang / rgyal khab kyi legs nyes yod tshad bsam blo rang dbang yin min gyis thag chod pa yin’’zhes dang / ‘‘bltas tshod kyis mi nyid kyi khe phan gyis rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs kyi khe phan la gnod 'gro ba ltar snang yang / don la rgyal chos〈〈mi yi /tshosngu na shār+sha/sa 'at+t+waṃlhakhu baspyo0ba ṭ+wāṃ.oṃr+sā1946—)1992—2000lo bar gyi a ri'i srid 'dzin/ brtsams — 278 bhe

dpa' dar ring mo/khab dang spyi tshogs kyi khe phan ni mi nyid kyi khe phan gzhi rtsar byas te 'byung dgos pa zlog med kyi gnas lugs red’’ces bshad myong / tsha'e yon phe yis kyang‘‘kun spyod bsam blo'i gnad ka ni bsam blo rang dbang la thug yod’’ces dang / lu'u zhun gyis‘‘rgyal khab stobs ldan tshugs thub cig yong dgos na thog mar nges par du mi bu stobs ldan tshugs thub cig slong dgos’’zhes bshad 'dug skad cha 'di dag‘‘lnga bzhi blo 'byed las 'gul’’ gyi bsam blo'i mtshan gzhir gyur yod pa dang /‘‘rig gnas gsar pa'i las 'gul’’gyi bsam blo'i gzhung rkang red ces bshad chog gi skad cha 'di bshad mkhan gyi mkhas pa de dag ni skabs de'i rig gnas gsar pa'i shing rta chen po dag red/ ngas 'di ru bshad 'dod pa ni deng sang‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’la zhib 'jug byed mkhan mang po yod par ma zad/ de dag gis phyogs dang zur so so nas lta tshul 'dra min gang mang bshad kyin 'dug gang ltar‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’slong mkhan shing rta chen po de dag gis lo ngo sum brgya bzhi brgya sngon gyi nub phyogs kyi mi nyid ring lugs dang rang dbang ring lugs kyi rin thang lta tshul de thog mar rgya nag la drangs pa red/ yid phangs pa zhig ni las 'gul de pham song ba red/ yin na'ang‘‘lnga bzhi blo 'byed las 'gul’’gyi rgyun de chad yod pa ma red/— 279 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/brgya lo sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung yang bskyar blo 'byed las 'gul gsar pa zhig gi rlabs rgyun 'phyur myong ba nga tshor gsal ni red/ cha gcig nas bshad na don grub rgyal gyi blo 'byed bsam blo de skabs de'i khor yug dang 'brel ba 'dug kyang srid/zhogs dung / ‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’zhes pa tshig gcig gis bsdus te bshad na/ bsam blo bcos sgyur gyi las 'gul zhig red zer giskabs der blo 'byed bsam blo pa la las srol rgyun gyi kun spyod la dgag yod pa red/ la las srol rgyun gyi rig gnas la dgag yod pa red/la las slob gso bcos sgyur byed dgos tshul bshad yod pa red/ la las bud med bcings 'grol gtong dgos tshul bshad yod pa red/yang la las tshad ma'i skyes bu dang tshad ma'i gsung med tshul/ dpyod shes dang rang dbang / 'dra mnyam sogs dgos tshul bshad yod pa red/ dper na/ lu'u zhun gyis krung go'i mi lo lnga stong gi rig gnas ni‘‘mi bu za byed’’kyi rig gnas shig red ces dgag yod pa red/wu'u yusadukyis krung go'i gus lugs ni‘‘mi bu 'dul byed’’kyi rig gnas shig red ces dgag yod pa red/ khong tsho la sogs pas rang gi srol sger gakyād 〉'u sgri sa/ t+t+waṃsbri sdo rdo sdur+ghaṃ nākā kau shārtiṭ+wāṃ.idā gā'i lha rabs kyi rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chos〈〈khyim rgyud lam lugs ni da 280 da ༄

dpa' dar ring mo/rgyun rig gnas yod tshad la phyir rtog gnad smin gyis dgag sgrub byas yod pa red/ yang hu'u hri lta bur mtshon na/ mi nyid dmigs yu/la du bzung ste rang dbang dang khe dbang rtsod dgos tshul sogs rang dbang ring lugs kyi lta dgongs spyod gsum bshad 'dug pa lta bu red/ der ma zad/ skabs der khong tsho la mthun pa sgrog mkhan yang mang po byung ba red zer gime lce/ ‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’skabs su bsam blo gsar pa spel sa gtso bo gnyis 'dug gcig ni khren tu'u zhi'u yis bton pa'i〈na gzhon gsar pa〉red/ dus deb de la rtsa don lnga gtan 'khel byas 'dug ( 1) rang dbang can las gzhan dbang can ma yin pa/ (2) gsar snyeg can las rnying zhen can ma yin pa/ (3) brtson sems can las yid 'byung can ma yin pa/ (4)kun sdud can las gzhan gcod can ma yin pa/ (5)tshan rig can las rtog btags can ma yin pa'o/ / dus deb des blo 'byed thad phan nus ga tsam thon 'dug zer na/ lo rgyus smra pa po zhig gis/ rig gnas gsar pa dar spel thad〈na gzhon gsar pa〉dang pe cing slob chen gnyis kyi phan nus do mnyam red ces bshad 'dug gzhan gcig ni tsha'e yon phe yis slob gtso mdzad skabs kyi pe cing slob chen red/ ‘‘bsam blo rang dbang — 281 —

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/dang ris med kun 'dus’’ni khong gi slob sgrub rtsa 'dzin red/ slob chen de dang〈na gzhon gsar pa〉〉gnyis gtso byas nas srol rgyun dgag sgrub dang rig gsar dar spel byas par brten/ rgya nag mi mang gi bkas bkod bsam blo la 'gyur ba chen po byung song zer gi 'dugazhogs dung / ‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’skabs kyi mi tshul ring lugs pa yin na 'dra/ ‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’skabs kyi blo 'byed bsam blo mkhan yin na 'dra/ ‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’skabs kyi rgya nag mkhas pa rnams yin na 'dra/ 'u tsho'i dpa' bo don grub rgyal yin na'ang 'dra/khong tsho la thun mong gi nges shes shig 'drongs yod kho thag red/ nges shes de'ang gcig gis gcig la lad mo byas nas byung ba zhig ma red/de ni so so'i spyi tshogs su mi bu rnams rmongs par tshud 'dug pa'i tshul bab kyis thag bcad pa zhig red/ 'di ru bshad pa'i rmongs pa zer ba chos lugs su bshad pa'i rmongs pa de min/ 'jig rten gyi mis rang ngo zin gyi mi 'dug zer ba de la go dgos gi red/ 'u tsho'i da lta'i gnas tshul la bltas na'ang / nga dang bcas pa'i skye bo phal mo che sngar bzhin rmongs par tshud 'dug pa mngon sum red/ rmongs pa'i gnyen po la gna' deng phyi nang gi bsam blo pa mang mang gis blo 'byed bsten pa red/de gzhir bzhag nas nga tshos don grub rgyal gyis dbu brtsams pa'i blo — 282 —

dpa' dar ring mo/'byed kyi rgyun skyong dgos tshul bshad ni red/ bshad pas mi tshad rang gzhan blo 'byed kyi las de gnyer gi'ang yod pa yin/ der ma zad/ngas bltas na shes yon can gyi las ka gtso bo la blo 'byed kyi las ka ma gtogs gzhan zhig 'jog rgyu mi 'dug snyam/lnga pa/ don grub rgyal dang 'brel nas deng gi shes yon can gyi sde gleng ba/zhogs dung / ya/ gong nas nga tshos blo 'byed bsam blo'i go don rags rim tsam bshad ni red/ 'og nas don grub rgyal dang 'brel nas deng gi shes yon can gyi sde'i gnas tshul cig bshad/ sgra yangs 'jug gi shes yon can zer na'ang 'dra/ shes yon can gyi sde zer na'ang 'dra/ kho tshos don ngo mar bya ba ci zhig sgrub kyin 'dug gam/ngas bltas na mang che ba zhig gi las ka ni rgyu cha phyogs bsgrigs byed pa tsam red/ rgyu cha phyogs bsgrigs sus kyang byed shes pa red/ rgyu cha phyogs bsgrigs byed shes mkhan de dag shes yon can yin phyin/ 'u tsho la shes yo/na can mang gi don du 'u tsho'i shes yon can de dag gis zhib 'jug bya gzhi las pa dang / yang na gong rim gyi bya dga' 'ig e lon la lta ba/ yang na las thob mthon po zhig e rag la lta ba'i ched du — 283 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/rtsom 'bri ba red/ dpe cha 'bri ba red/ rgyu cha phyogs bsgrigs byed pa red/ des na nga tshos gong nas bshad pa ltar rang gzhan gnyis kyi blo sgo 'byed mi dgos sam/ bsam gzhig gtong shes su 'jug mi dgos sam/ gnas lugs de kho tshos kyang shes rgyu red/ yin na'ang /las ka de mi sgrub pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig red/byang skar/ de ni shes yon can gyi las rigs ni nyen kha che ba'i rkyen gyis yin rgyu red/me lce/ shes yon can zhig yin na rang gi 'gan 'khri de rang gis ngos zin dgos pa dang / rang gi 'gan 'khri de rang gis phrag tu len dgos gi bye brag la 'bab dgos gi bye brag la babs na gnad don de je gsal du 'gro ba red/zhogs dung / da lo dbyar khar zi ling du 'tshogs pa'i‘‘skabs bzhi pa'i rgyal yongs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig slob khrid dpyad gleng tshogs 'du’’yi steng du/ dge rgan chen mo zhig gis da lta'i 'u tsho'i rig gnas kyi sde dang slob gso'i sde yi mi skor zhig brtsis te/ de dag ka ba gdung ma yin tshul brjod 'dug skad cha de ltar bshad chog na thang / khos brtsis pa'i ka ba gdung ma de dag phal che ba don grub rgyal gyi slob grogs dang grogs po red/ yin na'ang kho tshor ka ba gdung ma zhes brjod na — 284 —

dpa' dar ring mo/mi rnams kyis ngang ngam shugs kyis mi de dag don grub rgyal dang gshib bsdur zhig byed nges red/ de ltar gshib bsdur byas tshe 'di 'dra'i lta tshul zhig zlog med du thon nges/ mi de dag ka ba gdung ma yin zer na/ka ba gdung ma'i tshad gzhi zhig dgos rgyu red/ tshad gzhi ci zhig 'jog rgyu yin/ 'o/ mgo khrid cig yin pa'i cha nas ka ba gdung ma red zer ba yin nam/ yang na las thob yod pas ka ba gdung ma red zer ba yin nam/ ka ba gdung ma'i rtags shig ston dgos rgyu red/ ka ba gdung ma'i tshod kyi lag rjes shig yod dgos rgyu red/ spyir bshad na de dag ka ba gdung ma red ces na mi chog rgyu med na thang / yin na'ang /shes yon can gyi rin thang gi thad nas bsdur na gnam sa'i khyad par yod pa ma yin nam/ mi tshang ma don grub rgyal lta bur 'gyur thub pa'i nges pa med na'ang / ka ba gdung ma de dag gi khrod du don grub rgyal lta bu mi gcig yod na'ang 'u tsho'i sems kyi 'dod ma yin nam/ don grub rgyal gyi slob grogs dang grogs po de dag gi steng du don grub rgyal gyi mi gzhi dang / shes rab/ snying stobs sogs kyi shan cung zad tsam yang mthong rgyu med pa de ngo mas ya mtshan red/ deng sang gi dge rgan chen mo dang dge rgan chen mo gzhon pa/ yang na rig gnas kyi sde yi rkang 'dzin pa dang / zhib 'jug pa/ 'bum rams pa/ rab 'byams — 285 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/pa/ dbang cha can sogs sngo lo'i rgyal mtshan can gang mang mang red/de dag gis da lta ci zhig sgrub kyin 'dug gam/ nga'i skad cha 'di cung thal drags song na thang yang / mi de dag gis don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs dang ldog zla rkyang rkyang sgrub pa'i snang tshul zhig 'dug ci'i phyir zhe na/ deng sang slob ma dang na gzhon gyi khrod na bsam blo gsar pa yod mkhan dang / lta tshul gsar pa bshad mkhan/ rig gnas gsar pa la dga' mkhan/ yang na snying stobs can dang / dpa' spobs can mang po 'byung gi 'dug de 'dra 'byung yang 'byung ni red/'on kyang ka ba gdung ma de dag gis na gzhon tshor ci zhig bshad kyin 'dug zer na/ ‘‘khyod tshos srol rgyun rig gnas dang chos lugs rig gnas sbyangs na rang gi kha gso spyad kyi go yang chod/ mi rigs la yang phan’’zhes rang gi rig gnas kyi shes bya rkyang rkyang ma gtogs/ bsam blo gsar pa dang / bsam gzhig gtong stangs gsar pa til 'bru tsam yang mi bshad par ma zad/ da dung mu mthud du sgo rgyag pa dang mgo gnon bzhin 'dug rgyu rkyen gang zhig gis de ltar byas song ba red/nga tsho la mtshon na 'di ni bshad dgos pa'i gnad cig red la/ dpyad pa gtong dgos pa'i gnad cig kyang red/byang skar/ gong du bkra rgyal gyis ka ba gdung ma de dag gis do na — 286 —

dpa' dar ring mo/grub rgyal gyi gdung 'tshob nyan mi 'dug zer/ de ltar bshad don ni/khong gi rgyun 'dzin mkhan du gyur mi 'dug zer ba red/ khong la gong du nga tshos ma bshad pa'i snying stobs gzhan pa zhig yod pa red/ de ni sgam dkyel gyi snying stobs red/ sgam dkyel gyi snying stobs kyi ngos nas bshad na'ang khong ni slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gzhan pa dang mi mtshungs pa red/ khong gis slob ma tsho'i rgyud la 'jog pa ni dpe cha gsar par lta ba/ bsam blo gsar pa snyeg pa/ 'u tsho la med pa'i mi rigs gzhan gyi dpe cha legs po gang mang la ltos zer ba red/ de'i phyogs nas khong gis dus rgyun du slob ma tshor skul lcag gtong ba dang dpe cha 'os sbyor yang byed bzhin 'dug dpe zhig drangs te bshad na/ nga rang nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo ru yod dus shig la/ phal cher spyi lo1984lo'i nyin zhig khong slob grwar 'byor ba thos te nga'i grogs po dang nged gnyis khong la lta ru song ba yin/ skabs der khong gi lag tu h+pha ran si'i bsam blo mkhan ru sodhiyi〈'gyod bshags reg zig〉〉zer ba'i dpe cha de bzung 'dug de nas kha brda byed bzhin byed bzhin khong gis‘‘dpe cha 'di khyad par ba yin pa red/ rnam thar khyad par ba tshogs nin r+ṣasbo/ rnam t+t+waṃshā da/〉〉n+nisgiyā k+ṣiṃjirgiṇaṣ+ṭha 1712—1778)h+pha ran si'i bsam blo mkhan/ brtsams chos〈〈spyi — 287 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/yin pa red/ 'di lta bu'i rnam thar gzhan gyis brtsams yod pa ma red’’zer/ tshig shugs su nged cag la dpe cha de 'os sbyor byas 'dugami rigs gzhan gyi shes rig phul byung dag tshur len byed dgos pa dang /de'i phyogs la 'bad pa byed dgos par skul lcag btang 'dugaskabs thog der nga rang lo nyer gcig tsam yin na'ang de don yongs su ha go byung / de nas nga'i mi tshe 'di'i 'tshol rtog gi blo kha nub phyogs kyi rig gnas bsam blo'i steng bsgyur pa'ang khong gi skad cha de rgyu rkyen gcig yin gyi red 'dod gi 'on kyang / deng sang gi dge rgan chen mo kha cig gis slob ma tshos dpe cha gang dang ci zhig la lta ba'i thad la'ang the gtogs byed bzhin yod tshod red/ kho rang nyid mi dga' ba'i dpe cha zhig yin tshe/ 'di la bltas te ci zhig byed/ de la bltas te ci zhig byed/ tha na blta mi chog ces kyang zer gyin 'dug pa thos/nyi gzhon/ don grub rgyal gyi brtsams chos dang don grub rgyal slob chen dge rgan byed par dga' ba la bsams na/ khong gis mi mang la bsam gzhig gtong stangs gsar pa zhig slob gi yod pa shes gigasar pa zer don/ de ni rang dbang gi bsam gzhig gtong stangs shig yin pa bstan pa yin/ 'o na 'u tsho'i dge rgan chen mo dag gis slob ma tshor ci zhig slob gi yod pa red zer na/ sngon chad mi gzhan — 288 —

dpa' dar ring mo/gyis bsam blo btang zin pa zhig slob gi yod pa red/ rigs lam rnying pa zhig slob gi yod pa red/melce/ thengs shig grwa pa ngo shes shig dang nged gnyis kha brda byed skabs/ khos 'di 'dra zhig bshad byung / 〈 bdag dpe tshogs〉bkram nas yun ring ma lon pa'i skabs shig khos dpe tshogs de khyer nas mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling du song ba na/ slob chen pa zhig gis de mthong ma thag ha las hang sang mdog gis/ khyod kyis de nyos nas ci byed zer/ khos de'i lan du ci yang ma bshad rung sems su/ khyod tsho ni deng rabs slob chen pa red/ bsam blo mi mthun pa de tsam yang khog la mi shong na ngo ma 'grig yod pa ma red snyam pa yin zer/ de las ci shes thub zer na/ slob grwa de'i bsam blo'i khor yug shes thub pa red/ dge rgan rnams kyi slob gso gtong tshul shes thub pa red/slob ma mang po'i bsam blo'i 'khor rgya shes thub pa red/ deng sang 'u tsho'i slob chen du slob ma tshos dpyad rtsom 'bri ba'i skabs su gnad don la do khur byed pa dang rang dbang du bsam gzhig gtong ba shin tu nyung nyung red/ dge rgan gyi khrod na yang de 'dra'i bsam blo can dkon po red/ de tshang ma sus bskyed pa red/ gong du bshad pa'i‘‘ka ba gdung ma’’tshos bskyed pa red/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i nang du su zhig — 289 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/gis rang dbang du bsam blo btang nas dpyad rtsom zhig bris tshe/ de la 'khrol cha thob ni ma red/ skar ma ster ni ma red/ de'i mjug 'bras ni slob ma tsho'i bsam blo sngar bzhin gu dog por btang song ni red/nyi gzhon/ don du de ni mi'i bsam blo'i khe dbang btsan 'phrog byas ni red/ de las ya nga ba zhig yod ni ma red/ der ma zad de ni sger gcod kyi rmang gzhi red/ rgyu mtshan de'i rkyen gyis rang dbang gis bsam gzhig byed du 'jug rgyu ni ha cang gal che ba red/me lce/ bsam blo sger gcod byed pa dang bsam blo gsar pa 'bur 'joms byed pa la 'u tsho tshang mas dgag pa tsha nan gtong dgos pa red/zhogs dung / don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung〈〈sprul sku〉〉la mtshon nas bshad na/ khos 'u tsho'i spyi tshogs su sprul sku rdzus mas mang tshogs la mgo g.yog mgo skor gtong gi yod pa de bris yod pa red/ de ni 'u tsho'i spyi tshogs su mngon sum du gnas pa'i gnad don zhig red/ de bzhin du〈rkang lam phra mo〉yin na'ang de 'dra red/ de'i nang du rig gnas gsar rnying gnyis kyi 'dam ga'i gnad don bris yod pa red/de ni don grub rgyal gyis rang nyid shes yon can zhig gi tshad nas spyi la do khur byed pa dang / spyi tshogs la 'jug pa'i snying stobs red/ da lta'i shes yon can la mtshon na/ kho tshos de dang de 'dra ba'i gnad don — 290 —

dpa' dar ring mo/rig gi med pa e red/ de'i tshabs chen rang bzhin shes gi med pa e red/ de rtsa ba nyid nas yin ni ma red/ dper na/ slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan mkhas pa rnams kyis rang gi slob ma tshor bya ba rag gi med pa mngon sum mthong bzhin du snang med du 'jog gi yod pa lta bu red/mkhas pa de dag gis lag nas de ltar sgrub ba'in du/ kha nas da rung rang gi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed gi yod tshul dang / rang gi rigs la sha tsha ba dang sri zhu sgrub gi yo/da tshul sogs mang po lab gi 'dug yin na'ang nga de tshang mar dogs pa za gi ngas bsam na bsam blo cung zad gtong mkhan zhig yin na der dogs pa mi za rang za red/ me lce/ don grub rgyal gyis gong du bshad pa'i gnad don de dag rnyed yod pas mi tshad/ gzhan da rung gnyen sgrig rang dbang min pa'i gnad don dang rtswa sa rtsod gleng gi gnad don/ mkhas pa rnams kyis bap+tod rtsom rkyang rkyang 'bri ba sogs gnad don mang po rtsom du bris 'dugayin yang lo nyi shu'i rjes kyi de ring / 'u tsho'i mkhas pa mang shos kyis rang nyid gnad don la phrad bzhin du da dung mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs bzung 'dug pa red/ ngas bltas na de ni nag nyes shig red/ gu yangs gtong du med pa'i nag nyes shig red/ nag nyes de la phyi rabs — 291 —

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/pa rnams kyis nam zhig ra sprags gtong kho thag yin ni red/drug pa/ don grub rgyal dang 'brel nas shes yon can gyi ltung nyes bshad pa/zhogs dung / 'di nas nga tshos 'u tsho'i shes yon can gyi skor gleng gi yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ shes yon can gyi 'gan 'khri 'di gleng rgyu ni shin tu gal chen red/ 'jig rten khams kyi mi re re la spyi tshogs kyi ngos thad nas 'gan 'khri yod gyi red/ khyim tshang gi ngos thad nas 'gan 'khri yod gyi red/ las khungs kyi bya ba'i ngos thad nas kyang 'gan 'khri yod gyi red/ de la sogs pa'i 'gan 'khri gang mang mang yod gyi red/ngas shes yon can gyi skor la〈dogs slong snying stobs〉nang du‘‘yon tan pa dang shes yon can gleng ba’’zhes par mtshan zur lnga bshad yod/ de ni sgra dog 'jug gi shes yon can rnal ma'i ngos nas bshad pa yin/de dag ni rang rkya thub pa'i 'greng tshugs dang / spyi gzhung do khur rang bzhin/ dogs slong dang dgag sgrub snying stobs/ rgyu 'bras blo migaspyi tshogs la 'jug pa'i hur brtson bcas yin/ shes yon can zhig yin na 'di dag nges par du 'dzoms dgos/ des mi tshad shes yon can gyi go don gang mang mang yod gyi red/ khyad par du a ri'i mkhas — 292 —

dpa' dar ring mo/pa sa'is ti①yis/ shes yon can zhig yin na bden don gyi ched du srog 'dor thub dgos zhes brjod 'dug de 'dra ni ha cang tshad mthon po yin pa red/ gong du 'u tsho'i shes yon can la dge 'dun chos 'phel dang / lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal/ don grub rgyal sogs rtsi bzhin 'dug de 'dra'i skyes bu shes rab can dang mdzad rjes can yod gi de dag gis shes yon can gyi 'gan 'khri rdzogs phyir dang /yang na bden don gyi ched du gces pa'i srog kyang dor ba red/ deng sang gces pa'i srog 'dor thub mkhan phar zhog ngas brjod pa'i shes yon can gyi khyad chos lnga po de'i ngos thad nas bshad na'ang shin tu nyung nyung red/ shes yon can gyis rang gi 'gan 'khri ngos ma zin na nyen kha chen po 'byung na thang gi nyen kha gang red zer na/ shes yon can de chab srid kyi lag cha ru 'gyur ba'i nyen kha che gi 'u tsho'i lo rgyus steng chab srid kyi lag cha ru gyur pa'i bla ma dang dge bshes/ mkhas pa gang mang mang yod pa ma yin nam/ nga tsho mi rang nyid la mtshon na'ang /ha cang gzab gzab byed dgos pa'i don dag cig red/ shes yon can zhig yin na/ ches mtha' ma'i 'bab sa ni rang gis rang blo 'byed rnam pahā ba// sna〉 /so/gas trīd+dhisna bya'ispu s+dza5oṃ 1935—2003)a ri'i mkhas pa/ brtsams chos 〈〈shes yo na can — 293 —

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog mi mang po la bsam gzhig gtong shes su 'jug pa dang / drang gtam bshad de mi mang po zhig gi blo kha 'byed rgyu de'i steng la 'bab dgos rgyu red/ chab srid kyi dbang cha zhig dang / yang na mtshan snyan grags kyi ched du skad cha bshad/ rgyu mtshan brjod na 'u tsho'i shes yon can gyi sde 'di la nyen kha che gi snyam/me lce/ de 'dra red/ shes yon can gyi lo rgyus la bltas yong na'ang / shes yon can chab srid kyi lag char gyur pa'i dpe mang po 'dug shes yon can dang mi sna ming grags can chab srid kyi lag char gyur pa yin na/ mi mang pos rang nyid kyi khe dbang brtson len byed pa la dka' khag chen po 'byung ni red/ sger gcod srid dbang la mtshon na de 'dra'i shes yon can mkho ba red/nyi gzhon/ sger gcod pa dang de 'dra'i shes yon can ni gcig grogs gcig 'char yin pa red/ shes yon can mang shos shig sger gcod dbang 'og tu zhugs pa'ang btsan shed kho nas byas pa zhig ma red/gcig nas de 'dra'i shes yon can gyi sems rgyud na sger gcod bsam blo'i bag chags mthug pa dang / gnyis nas khe phan tog tsam gyi don du shes yon can rang nyid kyi 'gan 'khri dang rtsis thang dor ba red la/tha na bla srog kyang btsong ba red/ de bas shes yon can chab srid kyi — 294 —

dpa' dar ring mo/lag char gyur pa de ni tshad nges can gyi steng du rang 'gul gyis dang du blangs pa zhig red/ de lta ma yin par shes yon can rnal ma zhig dang mi bu rang tshugs can/ bsam blo rang dbang can zhig yin na sger gcod btsan shed kyis bsgyur ga la tshugs/ de 'dra'i dpe mang po yod pa red/byangabor/ don grub rgyal lta bur mtshon na/ khong ni nges pa don gyi shes yon can red/ gong nas brjod pa bzhin dbang dang grags pa ltar snang la brtsi 'khur byed ni ma red/ chab srid kyi lag char yang ma gyur pa red/ de ni khong gi rtsom dag las kyang shes gi shes yon can zhig la mtshon na/ dbang grags ltar snang sogs la brtsi 'khur byed pa ni de yi bran gshis kyang yin ni red/ bran gshis de don grub rgyal gyi steng na phal cher med pa 'dra/zhogs dung / phyogs gcig nas bshad na skad cha drang gtam brjod pa dang / spyi tshogs la dgag sgrub byed pa sogs ni sger gcod kyi srid dbang de la 'tsham ni ma red/ skad cha drang mo bshad tshe kho pa tsho'i dbang sgyur la gnod 'gro ni red/ de'i rkyen gyis shes yon can 'a/ mtshon na skad cha drang mo brjod 'dod kyang de'i khe dbang rtsa ba nas ster ba ma red/— 295 —

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/me lce/ yin na'ang shes yon can zhig yin na thog mar mi rang nyid nas 'go brtsams te drang gtam brjod dgos pa red/ drang gtam brjod pa'i spobs pa ldan dgos pa red/ de 'dra zhig la dmigs te yo rob shar ma'i ce khe dang po lan sogs kyi rang dbang shes yon can dang bsam blo pa tshos rdzun gtam zlog pa'i thad la hur brtson chen po byas dang byed gi yod pa red/byang skar/ yang gcig bshad na/ shes yon can rnal ma zhig yin tshe chab srid kyi lag cha ru 'gyur srid ni ma red/ gal te khyod rang chab srid kyi lag char 'gyur gyi yod na/ khyod nges pa don gyi shes yon can zhig min pa'i rtags red/ 'u tsho'i gnas tshul la bltas na/slob grwa chen mo nas mthar phyin rjes tshang ma snyan ngag pa yin pa lta bu/tshang ma brtsams sgrung pa yin pa lta bu/ tshang ma shes yon can yin pa lta bu'i snang ba yod gi de nas na tshod smin nas chab srid kyi 'gro lugs cung zad rgyus lon pa'i skabs su/ rang rang so so'i shun pa bshus nas gdong ras ngo ma bo de lhang la 'bud pa red/ skabs der tshang ma chab srid pa yin pa lta bu'i snang ba ster/ rgya mi rigs la mtshon na kho tshos rig gnas shes bya sbyong ba de ma 'ongs pa na dpon sa zhig snyeg pa'i dmigs yul yin pa red/ 'u tsho la mtshon na'ang / deng sang de'i — 296 —

dpa' dar ring mo/shan shugs thebs pa ha cang tshabs chen red/ nang sgos su gzhi rim gyi yul tsho rim pa dang / rdzong rim pa/ khul rim pa na shan shugs de thebs pa ha cang tshabs chen red/me lce/ de ni shes yon can la rgyu 'bras blo mig med pa'i rkyen gyis red/ shes yon can rdzus ma rnams gang du brin pa red ce na/ rdzun gyi thang ma brdal ba'i spyi tshogs kyi nang du brin pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis/'u tsho'i shes yon can du rlom pa skor zhig gis 'bri rgyu snyan ngag cig bris na'ang / don du chab srid pa'i gtam bshad spel ba lta bur gyur 'dug pa'ang de la thug yod pa red/ kho tsho la rtsis thang yod pa ma red/ mi gzhi yod pa ma red/ rgyu 'bras blo mig lhag tu yod pa ma red/zhogs dung / nga tshos 'di ru bshad bzhin pa ni/ shes yon can gyi mtshan nyid dang go don gang mang mang yod pa las/ 'u tsho la sgra dog 'jug gi shes yon can rnal ma shin tu dkon zer ba yin/ nga tsho yang shes yon can rnal ma'i nang du the ba yin zer rgyu dka' mo red/ 'u tsho'i shes yon can rnams kyis rang rang gi 'gan 'khri de ci zhig yin pa shes gi mi 'dug la shas kyis shes yon can dang dpon po gcig lcogs byed pa'i bzo ston gyin 'dug la shas ni tshwa khu ltar/ sgyu rtsal bshad sa/ shes rig bshad sa/ rtsed mo rtse sa gang la yang the ba red/— 297 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/de bas rang gi 'gan 'khri ngo ma bo de gang du yod pa shes rgyu ni ha cang gal che ni red/ 'di ni nga tsho rang nyid la cha mtshon na'ang / shin tu gal che gi snyam/byang skar/ de ni shes yon can gyis rang gi 'gan 'khri gang yin pa ma rtogs pa'i rtags red/ gal te khyod sger gcod kyi spyi tshogs shig gi nang du yod pa'i shes yon can zhig yin tshe/ sger gcod kyi spyi tshogs ni‘‘byis pa'i spyi tshogs’’red/ ‘‘byis pa'i spyi tshogs’’kyi nang na shes yon can rnal ma la go sa ye nas yod pa ma red/ khe phan yang rag rgyu yod pa ma red/ tha na khri mun du 'gro dgos pa dang rang srog gcod dgos pa'i tshad la yang slebs rgyu red/ de 'dra mi rigs gzhan gyi lo rgyus steng ha cang mang po 'dug dper na/ yo rob shar ma'i gnas tshul la bltas na ha wel dang / wa le sa'/ me che ne khi la sogs spyi tshogs de 'dra brgyud yong ba dang dka' las mang po myangs te 'ongs pa red/yin na'ang kho tsho'i spyi tshogs da lta legs lam du 'gro gi yod pa red/tshad de nas bsam na/ 'u tsho'i shes yon can mang che shos kyis mtshan snyan grags 'dod pa tsam dang / tshul min gyi khe phan tsam bsam pa yin gyi red/ don dam pas/ khyod shes yon can rnal ma zhig byed 'dod na chab srid pa zhig gtan nas yong thub pa ma red/ de rang — 298 —

dpa' dar ring mo/gis shes dgos gi rang gis rang gi gnas mal gang du yod pa shes dgos gi de ha cang gtso bo red/ don grub rgyal gyi steng nas bshad na/ bsam bzhin dang / bsam bzhin ma yin pa/ gang ltar kyang /khong gi sbyor ba la bltas na 'gan 'khri de la nges shes zab gsal rnyed yod pa'i tshod red/zhogs dung / shes yon can rnal ma zhig la mtshon na/ 'gan 'khri de ci zhig yin pa dang / ci zhig bshad dgos pa dang ci zhig bshad mi dgos pa/ mdor na khyod kyi rtsom du ci zhig bris na 'grig pa dang / ci zhig bris na mi 'grig pa de ma shes tshe/ dbang sgyur pa la kha yag ngo dga' bshad de bran gshis lhang la 'bud ni red/ bran g.yog byas na thob bya zhig rag gi yod las che mod/ de'i phan chad nas 'u tshos shes rgyu zhig yod pa ni/ mang tshogs la de 'dra'i mgo g.yog mgo skor dang bslu brid thebs bzhin yod pa de red/nyi gzhon/ 'o le/ shes yon can gyi bran gshis de ha cang tshabs chen zhig red/ bran g.yog yod tshad kyi nang nas shes yon can gyi bran g.yog ni ches 'jigs su rung ba zhig red/ shes yon can la bran gshis tshang ba yin na de'i nyes dmigs dang / de las 'byung ba'i chag 'jig ni gzhan gang las kyang ha cang tshabs che ba red/— 299 —

tsher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/zhogs dung / shes yon can ni mi rigs shig la mtshon na bla srog lta bu yin pa red/ bla srog de la bran gshis tshang song na de 'grig yod pa ma red/nyi gzhon/ bran gshis tshang ba'i shes yon can ni rkub g.yog red/rgya skad kyismo7 zhes pa de red/ thog mar shes yon can rang steng na bran gshis de yod pa'i rkyen gyis bran bdag dang bdag po'i ngo la bltas te 'dzum dmul dmul dang mgo sgur sgur byed ni red/ 'u tsho'i deng sang gi shes yon can mang po zhig gi steng du bran gshis de ha cang gsal po red/ kho tshos chab srid dang bsam blo sger gcod pa'i‘‘dgongs pa'i’’shugs bstan dang bcas pa rang rgyud la 'jags par byed pa dang /bdag po'i tshab tu mi rnams bran g.yog tu 'god par blo dang bkod pa sna mang 'then gi yod pa red/ tha na kho pa tshos bdag po'i tshab tu gang gi dbang grags dang sger gcod la khas mi len pa'i rang tshugs can gyi shes yon can dag 'chi lam du skrod gi red/ don grub rgyal ni de ltar 'u tsho'i bran gshis can gyi yon tan pa tshos 'chi lam du brdzangs pa red/bran gshis tshang ba'i shes yon can gyis mi bu sgal tshigs can tshar gcod pa'i thabs ni ya nga ba dang gdug rtsub che ba red/ de'i rkyen gyis/ 'u tshor rkub g.yog shes yon can mang gi zer ba yin/— 300 —

dpa' dar ring mo/me lce/ 'u tshor bran gshis tshang ba'i shes yon can mang ba dang /yang na bran gshis tshang ba'i shes yon can gyi dpung mthug pa'i rkyen gyis/deng sang lta tshul gsar pa bshad pa dang / mi bu rgyang 'bod byed pa dang / bdag dang / rang dbang dang / mang gtso dang / 'dra mnyam bshad pa yin na mang mang gi mig nang gi tsher ma ru 'gyur gyin yod pa red/ de yin kyang / 'u tsho la mkho ba ni rang dbang shes yo/na can yin pa kho thag red/ rang dbang shes yon can gyi lam bu de bdams pa yin na/ mi rang nyid kyi khe phan dang mi rang nyid kyi ca ne/mi rang nyid kyi khyim tshang sogs mang po mang po zhig blos gtong thub dgos 'dug rang dbang shes yon can ni dgag sgrub shes yon can dang mi tshul shes yon can las kyang rtogs pa dang bsam sbyor tshad mthon por slebs yod pa zhig red/ des mi tshad shes yo/na can gyi 'gan 'khri de yang je lcir song yod pa red/bdun pa/ mjug bsdu ba/byang skar/ gsham nas ngas mjug bsdu ba'i tshig 'ga' bshad/dus rabs snga ma'i dus 'gor 'jar pan du 'e tob he rob sbu meduzer ba ① 'e tob ho rob sbu me/ (tshotsholospra 1 —9)'jar pan gyi dbu blon 'ig

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/zhig byung / rgya nag tu yan h+phu zer ba zhig byung / kho gnyis kas dbyin ji ru phyi 'grim slob gnyer byas shing slob grogs su gyur pa dang /shes bya yon tan gyi cha nas bshad na'ang gcig las gcig lhag pa red zer gi so so'i rig gnas dang spyi tshogs khor yug gi dbang gis/phyir rang yul du log rjes 'e tob he rob sbu me 'jar pan rgyal khab kyi dbu blon du bkur/ skabs der 'jar pan rgyal khab kyi srid 'byor rig gsum thad yar rgyas chen po byung ba la kho'i mdzad rjes ha cang che zer ba red/ yan h+phu ni shes yon can du gyur te/ ‘‘'phel 'gyur smra ba’’sogs nub gling gi bstan bcos chen mo brgyad rgya yig tu bsgyur pa red/ thengs dang por rgya nag la nub phyogs rig gnas kyi spyi khog mtshams sbyor byas pa red/ mkhas pa rnams kyis kho ni rgya nag pa'i blo mig 'byed mkhan dang por 'jog gi 'dug phyis su pe cin slob chen gyi slob gtsor spyan 'dren zhus pa red/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu par 'u tsho la'ang skyes bu chen po don grub rgyal byung ba red/khong yang de gnyis dang 'dra bar rang yul nas thon te pe cin du slob gnyer la phyin pa red/ mi ring bar 'u tsho'i rig gnas gsar pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du gyur pa red/ yin na'ang / 1985lor slebs pa na/ 'u tshos gong gi mi rigs de gnyis kyis rang gi skyes bu chen po'i — 302 —

dpa' dar ring mo/rin thang la yin 'jog dang mi gzhi la gong bkur byed pa lta bu phar zhogarang rigs kyi slob grwa'i slob gtso rnams kyis tha na khong la slob khrid gnang sa'i khrid stegs shig kyang ma sprad pa red/ rang gi phugs 'dun mngon du ma gyur pa dang / skabs de'i yon tan pa'i sde gtso byas te spyi tshogs kyis kha yan dang dkrog gtam sna tshogs bzos par brten/mthar thug 'u tshos khong nyid phangs med du 'chi lam du brdzangs pa red/da lta mi mang pos khong nyid la rjes dran zhu gi yo/da par bltas na/ khong gi rin thang ngo ma de tshang mas shes 'dug pa'i snang ba ster/ de lta yin na shin tu bzang mod/ 'on kyang nga tshos bltas na de tsam gyis chog gi ma red/ khong gi mdzad rjes la dus thog tu yin 'jog ma byas pa dang /khong gis rin thang 'don par mthun rkyen ma sbyar ba/ der ma zad khong nyid btsan thabs kyis 'jig rten phyi mar brdzangs pa la 'u tsho mi re res zhe thag pa nas bshags pa byed dgos ni red/ deng phyin chad de 'dra mi byed pa'i dam bca' dgos ni red/ gal chen nang gi yang chen de red/2005lo'i zla12pa'i tshes17nyin yi ger bshus te gtan la phab/— 303 ge

cher ma'i lam gyi nga ro/mjug byang /1nga rang tsher ma'i lam du zhugs nas phal cher lo ngo brgyad tsam 'gor/ mi lo de dag gi ring la ci zhig bshad 'dod kyi spobs pa me ri ltar 'phyur zhing ci zhig 'bri 'dod kyi ngar shugs chu khol bzhin gdus/ kho bo'i lta tshul lam bsam blo de dag ni phyi nang nyis cha nas‘‘smin’’pa zhig gtan nas ma yin na'ang / 'di ni rang nyid kyi sger tshugs dang rang dbang gi bsam gzhig cig tu kho bos 'dod/ rang gi dran tshul lam lta tshul de dag snga rjes su deb tu bcos te2003lor〈mi gzhi'i snying stobs〉bkram pa dang / 2005lor〈khu sim khad kyis dkrog〉bkram pa yin/da thengs kyang2005—2007lo'i bar gyi bris rtsom dag phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa deb chung 'di ru grub/ des na/ 'di ni gzhon skyes smra brjod pa zhig gis mi yul la phul ba'i zas rin tsam zer na'ang chog mi rigs la phul ba'i legs skyes tsam zer na'ang chog gang ltar da ni deb chung 'di klog po dag gi spyan sngar 'bul rgyu byung ba la gnas skabs su rang nyid kyi rdog phres lci mo zhig phrag nas phogs zin pa lta bu'i dga' tshor zhig skyes 'ong / legs nyes dpyad 'jog gi rgya ma ni spyan dkyus yangs pa'i klog po rnams kyi lag tu yod pas deb chung 'di'i bzang ngan gyi lci yang de khyed tshos gzhal rogs gnang /— 304 —

mjug byang /2spyi lo2006lo'i ston ka nas bzung〈bla dpe tshogs〉kyi jus 'god dang par skrun phyogs la 'bad pa brgya phrag byas shing / snga phyir lam gyi 'gag 'phrang gang mang brgyud mthar da lta gzhi nas〈bla dpe tshogs〉kyi deb tshom dang po de lam lhongs byung / 'di ni nged dpe skrun khang la mtshon na'ang 'dra/ deb de dag gi rtsom po dag la mtshon na'ang 'dra/ bsam blo gsar pa'i rgyugs phye 'tshol ba'i klog po dag la mtshon na'ang 'dra/ tshang ma rab tu spro 'os pa'i las don 'ig ci la min/'dir ched du gsal bshad byed rgyu zhig la dpe tshogs 'di'i khrod kyi phyi gling gi mi ming phal che ba dbyin skad sgra bsgyur pa yin zhing / 'jar pan pa rnams 'jar pan skad kyi sgra bsgyur pa dang / rgya ming rnams〈rgya bod shan sbyar tshig mdzod〉kyi〈 rgya bod sgra sgyur shan sbyar gyi re'u mig〉〉ltar sgra bsgyur pa yin/ de sngon〈bdag dpe tshogs〉su yod pa'i mi ming rnams de la bstun yod/3mjug tu zhu 'dod pa ni drang gtam brjod cing tsher ma'i lam du hur brtson gyis 'jug 'dod kyi spobs pa can dang rnam dpyod can yod na/ 〈bla dpe tshogs〉ni‘‘mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dang me tog mnyam bzhad’’kyi ldum ra chen po zhig yin pas/ 'di la deb tshom dang po'i 'phror da dung deb tshom gnyis pa dang /deb tshom gsum pa sogs kyi dpe skrun 'char gzhi yod pa'ang kun gyis thugs — 305 —
